4. This game focuses on construction and development, which helps enhance players' logical thinking and coordination abilities, providing a positive and enjoyable gaming experience that boosts players' confidence. 302062:
Champion Duel
 Sign-Up Phase
1. Sign-up: Monday to Wednesday Sign up and Join. Combat will not result in loss, and units regular usage will not be affected. 
2. There are Qualifier stage and Championship stage. Top 8 of the Qualifier stage will join the Championship stage. 
3. Troop formations can be changed in "My Troop Formation" before the match starts. 

 Qualifier Competition
1. Thursday is when the Qualifier competition starts, a total of 10 rounds of combats will ensue, an interval of 60 Minutes in between. 
2.Commanders can change troop formations anytime and apply the latest formation to the next match. There will be a 5-minute cooldown before another change. Formations cannot be changed 5 Minutes before each match starts. 
3. 3 accumulated losses will be deemed eliminated. 
4. Top 8 determined by the number of victories will advance to the Championship stage. (If it's a cross-server duel, then top 8 come from top 4 of both servers.)
5. When two Commanders have the same victory number, Commander with more points (determined by combat loss) will be deemed eligible for the Championship competition. 

Championship Competition
1. Top 8 of the Qualifier competition will join the Championship stage. 
2. Commanders can change troop formations anytime and apply the latest formation to the next match. There will be a 5-minute cooldown before another change. Formations cannot be changed 15 Minutes before each match starts. 
3. Championship includes Round of Top 4, Semi-finals, and the Finals, which starts at 12:00 (Game Time) Friday, Saturday and Sunday respectively. 
4. Multiple rounds of combat will ensue, and the Commander with more victories will advance. 

 Combat Attributes
1. During the event, bonus to rally attacks and to Base defense are excluded. 
2. All techs related to combat bonus will work. 
3. During the event, if a Commander's hero attributes enhanced, hero upgraded, skill unlocked, tech advanced, structure upgraded or other similar improvements made, then the Commander must go to "My Troop Formation" to save the change in order to make it work on the next match. 

Rewards
1. In the Qualifier competition, a reward will be earned for each victory. The unclaimed rewards will be sent via mail after the entire event is over. 
2. In the Championship competition, all Commanders will receive rewards based on their ranking. 
3. Championship competition rewards will be sent via mail after the event is over.

141150:
1. Drones will continuously attack enemies in battle, <color=#099b4a>they themselves will not be attacked.</color>

2. Drones can gain a certain amount of experience progress when undergoing <color=#099b4a>Data Training</color>. When the progress is filled, the drone will level up and improve its Attributes. <color=#099b4a>The Attributes of the drone will be converted into the Attributes of our Hero at a certain ratio. For the conversion ratio and the actual increase in Hero Attributes, please click on the relevant location on the interface</color>
When consuming Battle Data for Data Training, there is a chance of a training critical hit:
When the training progress is less than 80%, there is a 50% chance of a critical hit, which doubles the experience progress equivalent to the consumed Battle Data.
When the training progress is 80% or more, there will be no training critical hit.
Training that requires additional Drone Parts will not result in a training critical hit.

3. When the Drone level reaches <color=#099b4a>30/50/70/90/110</color>, the skill level increases.

4. The <color=#099b4a>Drone Component</color> feature is unlocked when the Headquarters reaches level 15. A drone can equip up to 6 components, which can greatly enhance the Hero's Attributes. Three components of the same type and level can be merged to obtain a higher-level component of the same type.

5. On the 85th day of the server opening, the <color=#099b4a>Skill Chip</color> system can be activated. Each scheme can install <color=#099b4a>an Initial Skill, an Offensive Skill, an Interference Skill, and a Defensive Skill</color>. Before the battle, you can choose a chip scheme to allow the drone to gain the skill effect of the Skill Chip in the battle. Skill Chips can be upgraded by consuming other Skill Chips, <color=#099b4a>improving the Attributes of the drone</color>. SSR and UR rarity Skill Chips can be promoted by consuming Skill Chips of the same name, further <color=#099b4a>enhancing the skill effect of the Skill Chip</color>.

Commanders,
Alert: We've spotted some players forming fake alliances in the game. These rogue players are tampering with alliance notifications, mailing false messages, and pretending to be alliance leaders or R4 members, encouraging others to share outside contact information (such as Discord, Line, WeChat) for non-game-related interactions.
Such actions outside our game can expose your private data and may lead to losses. To prevent this, please:
1. Refuse and report any misuse of personal or alliance identities to spread personal contact info for scams.
2. Safeguard your alliance's integrity by removing those involved in these schemes to preserve a healthy game atmosphere.
3. If you encounter any of the above behaviors, please report it through [Avatar] -> [View] -> [Report], or tap [Customer Service] on the loading screen's top left.

Your gameplay and privacy are our priorities, and we will enforce measures to ensure a safe environment.
Appreciate your cooperation. Happy gaming!

457530:
[Introduction]
1. Commanders can initiate up to 4 Intercity Trades daily, each using a Truck temporarily. More squads unlocked means more trucks.
2. Trucks travel random paths and can be looted.
3. Upon arrival, initiators collect remaining rewards from the Truck.

[Trade Initiation]
1. Choose up to 5 heroes to defend each Truck, each hero can only guard one Truck.
2. Defending heroes can't be swapped after the Truck's departure
3. Each Truck gets one free chance to refresh its rewards upon selection.

[Trade Rewards]
1. Collect remaining rewards after the Truck's arrival.
2. Continuous use of Trade Contracts to refresh Trucks increases the likelihood of acquiring higher-rarity Trucks.
3. Higher Truck rarity and Base level mean more valuable base goods.

[Truck Looting]
1. Commanders can plunder non-allied Trucks on the map, each player can plunder up to 4 times per day.
2. After a successful attack, randomly plunder goods and resources from the Truck.
3. During plunder battles, no units are lost on either side, and each truck can be looted up to 2 times.

[Probability Details]
1. Different rarity Trucks have varying refresh weights based on refresh counts (including free refreshes):
(1): N(50) R(30) SR(10) SSR(5) UR(5)
(2): N(30) R(30) SR(20) SSR(10) UR(10)
(3): N(20) R(20) SR(30) SSR(15) UR(15))
(4): N(0) R(20) SR(40) SSR(20) UR(20)
(5): N(0) R(0) SR(50) SSR(25) UR(25)
(>5): N(0) R(0) SR(0) SSR(0) UR(100)
2. After unlocking the Reindeer Sleigh Ride, it has 10 fixed chances in Truck refreshes with Trade Contracts, independent of refresh frequency.
3. Probability calculation: If the Truck weight is UR(100), Reindeer Sleigh Ride(10), the chance for a UR truck is 90.9% (100/110), and for a Reindeer Sleigh Ride is 9.1% (10/110).

458102:
1. Selecting Participants
Only the <color=#DC143C>top 32 Alliances</color> in Warzone power rankings can join each event.
Alliance R4s or R5s must decide on the battle time, participants, and substitutes during the registration stage.
Each Alliance can assign up to 20 participants and 10 substitutes, with participants getting priority battlefield access.

2. Entering the Battlefield
Players must meet 3 conditions to enter the battlefield:
A. Be a participant or a substitute for this battle.
B. Belong to the registered Alliance.
C. Their bases should not be on the Contaminated Land near the Capitol.

3. Battle Stages
Preparation Stage: Participants from both sides can enter the battlefield's safe zone. Your side will be marked in blue, the enemy in red. You can't be attacked in the safe zone.
Stage 1: Capture Oil Refineries, Science Hubs, Info Centers, and Field Hospitals to earn [Battlefield Points].
Stage 2: Capture the Nuclear Silo, Arsenal, and Mercenary Factory to gain [Battlefield Points].
Stage 3: Oil Wells will appear randomly on the map. Harvest them to get [Battlefield Points].

The side with the most [Battlefield Points] wins the battle.

Note: Captured buildings will generate [Battlefield Points] that exceed their storage capacity after a period. Attacking and capturing these buildings lets you pick up these additional [Battlefield Points].

458504:
Participation Conditions
1. Alliance must have 20 or more members.
2. Member of the Alliance for over 24 hours.
3. Warzone has enabled Alliance Intercity Trade mode.
4. Train Station building has been unlocked.
5. Alliances can dispatch up to 1 regular train and 2 Mega Express Trains daily.
6. Only the top 20 Alliances in the server ranking can get a free regular train.

Acquiring the Train
1. Regular Train: At warzone time 00:00 daily, Alliances meeting the participation conditions are granted a trade train. It enters preparation state after an R4 or R5 designates a conductor.
2. Mega Express Train: When no train is in preparation on the track, commanders can call a Mega Express Train and automatically become the conductor.
3. The train is made up of four carriages (1 to 4 from top to bottom), each transporting different rewards.

Train Prep Stage
1. The preparation stage lasts 4 hours. After this, the train automatically departs to commence trade in various cities.
2. Train Conductor: At this stage, the conductor needs to assign guard troops for the train and check the cargo.
3. Passengers: At this stage, passengers must queue in front of the carriage they wish to board. At the end of the stage, a passenger is randomly selected from the queue to enter the carriage. Reminder: the train will verify passengers 5 minutes before departure, and boarding will be closed during that time.

Train in Transit
1. Trains may be attacked by other commanders during operation. A successful attack plunders 3 random cargo slots.
2. Each train can be plundered up to 3 times.

Rewards
1. Train Conductor: After the train reaches its station, the conductor will receive all the remaining cargo from the train's front section and its carriages.
2. Passengers: Upon arrival, passengers get the remaining cargo from their respective carriages as a reward.

Participation Conditions:
1. Only Commanders with a Base Level of 10 or higher can participate in the Alliance Duel.
2. Alliances with 20 or more members are eligible to enter the Alliance Duel.
3. Only the top 32 Alliances in each Warzone can participate in the Alliance Duel matchmaking for the following week.

How To Play:
1. Your Alliance will engage in a week-long duel with an enemy Alliance. Each day features a different duel theme, and Alliance Members can earn Duel Points by completing tasks related to the theme. The Alliance with the most Duel Points wins the day's duel. The Alliance with the highest score at the end of the week wins the weekly duel.
2. The Alliance Duel offers generous Rewards, including daily Individual Points ranking rewards (ranked against all members from both Alliances), daily winning Alliance rewards, and weekly winning Alliance rewards. Please unite and contribute to your Alliance's success!
3. If you change Alliances during the duel, you will not be able to earn Alliance Points for 1 Day, but your Individual Points will not be affected and you can still open Chests with your Individual Points. Please choose carefully, Commanders.
4. Only Packs that contain Diamonds can earn you points.

801105:
[Schedule] 
1. The Apex Arena is accessible starting every Tuesday. 
2. Battle days are from Tuesday to Friday. 
3. Resting period is from Saturday to Monday. 

[Participation] 
1. Each arena event may feature commanders from 1 to 4 Warzones competing together.
2. During the arena period, eligible commanders (top 200 in "Total Hero Power" ranking on the server) can join the competition.

[Competition Stage] 
1. Initial rankings in the Arena are based on the commanders' power. 
2. Commanders can challenge others with similar ranks. 
3. Win to swap rankings with the challenged commander.
4. Limited challenges available in each event round.

[Reward Settlement] 
1. Rewards are determined every Friday based on the final rankings.
2. Rare avatar frame included in the rewards can increase the attack ability of all heroes. 
3. Ranking rewards will be distributed via mail. 

[Formation]
1. The commander's first squad is set as the default defense.
2. Defense formations can be adjusted after the event starts.
3. Arena battles use the commander's highest-level units with no injuries.

801419:
Event Overview
The Warzone Duel is a 1v1 challenge between warzones where victory is determined by capturing the rival's Capitol.
In a single competition set over 2 to 3 weeks, between 4-8 warzones are paired against one another to crown the champion Warzone!
Clinching the championship title requires the President to gather all potential allies within the Warzone.

Competition Rules
Non-Season Period: Warzones in a bracket face off in random matches, with winners advancing and facing other winning warzones until the final champion is decided.
During Game Season: Warzones in the same season group are matched against each other according to their season ranking to find opponents.
Matchmaking Rule: Winners will be matched with winners, and losers with losers.
Victory Condition: Victory is achieved by capturing the enemy warzone's Capitol.

Event Stages
SUNDAY to FRIDAY: Warzone scoring stage, where warzones earn points by winning various events.
Invaders & Defenders: At the end of the gaming period on Friday, the warzone with the higher score becomes the invader. The one with the lower score is the defender.
Capitol Defense Battle: Beginning on Saturday's gaming period, the invading side can relocate to the defender's warzone to launch an assault on their Capitol and compete for its final ownership.

Capitol Defense Battle
Commanders from the same warzone become allies, not foes, in the combat over neutral buildings, ensuring that internal warzone conflicts don't extend to these battles (commander base attacks are not included). 
Unity and strategic collaboration are vital for commanders within the same warzone!

Capitol Ownership
When the attacking side successfully captures the enemy Capitol, it will be owned by the alliance with the highest contribution to the occupation.
If the Capitol is captured by an alliance from another warzone, it will still provide city connectivity to the alliance that owns it.
801426:
From Sunday to Friday is the Warzone Points Race stage. The warzone with higher points gains the invasion right. 
On Saturday, the invader can head to the enemy's warzone and seize its Capitol.
The side with lower points is the defender which needs to defend its Capitol on Saturday. 
Warzone points can be obtained by completing following acts:

801432:

The war between war zones is imminent, and we must unite to face the new era's onslaught together!

801454:
Schedule (In-game Time) 
Saturday [00:00:00] 
Warzone scoring contest ends
Saturday [00:04:00]
Invasion and defense zones are determined based on warzone points.
Saturday [00:05:00] 
Invading commanders can teleport to the defending warzone. 
Saturday [12:00:00] 
Capitol and giant cannons are removed from protected status and officially enter the Capitol War phase. 
Saturday [12:00:00]~[16:00:00] 
The winner of Capitol War emerges, and the winning warzone advances to the next round. 
Saturday [24:00:00] 
Cross-warzone enemy elimination event ends, and the ranking rewards are settled. 

Capitol Defense Rules 
When Capitol Defense begins, the 4 giant cannons become available for capture as well. 
In battles for Capitol and giant cannons, commanders from the same warzone are considered of the same side, meaning no combat among them. 
For example, when Alliance A from Warzone #1 seizes the Capitol, commanders from Alliance B Warzone #1 will see their troops garrison in the Capitol after dispatching over. 

Giant Cannon Capabilities 
Giant cannons are crucial strategic weapons in Capitol defense. 
After capturing a giant cannon, it automatically attacks the enemy-held Capitol and kills certain amounts of units garrisoned inside at regular intervals. 
When your side tries to seize the Capitol, the captured giant cannon significantly accelerates the Capitol capture. 

Successful Capitol Capture 
Capitol Defense lasts a maximum of 4 hours, if both warzones stay below 100%, the defenders win.
The winning warzone advances to the next round of the Warzone Duel and matches against the winner of another Capitol war until the ultimate champion is determined. 
Once the Capitol contest ends, leaderboard rankings will be locked (commanders can still earn points and collect chests).

Warzone Winning Streak Rewards:
Winning warzones can build up winning streaks, with rewards increasing for each consecutive win.
If you lose, the streak resets and no more wins will count.

season_trailblazer_slogan: Fortune favors the bold in exploring the world first!
season_trailblazer_01: Challenge high-level Lands for great rewards!
season_trailblazer_02:
ABOUT THE EVENT:
1.After the event starts, the time commanders first captured the highest level Land is recorded and ranked.
2. Higher the land level captured, higher the ranking. For the same level, faster capture leads to better ranking. Rewards are based on final rankings.
3. During the event, ranking rewards are settled daily and delivered via mail.
season_trailblazer_mail: Commander, your ranking in the Frontline Pioneer event this season is {0}. Here are your rewards.
season_sever_intrusion_002: After the Warzone Expedition begins, you can compete for Lands in other Warzones.
season_sever_intrusion_003: Building an "Alliance Outpost" is needed for the first expedition to another Warzone.
season_sever_intrusion_004:
ABOUT THE EVENT:
1. After the event starts, R4 and above members can place Alliance Outposts in other Warzones. From Monday to Friday during the event, you cannot attack commander bases in other Warzones.
2. Once placed, outposts provide initial Lands. Commanders can teleport there, starting from the outpost to capture other Lands.
3. Outposts gradually open over time. Each Alliance can have a maximum of 4.
4. Once placed, outposts cannot be retracted. Please be noted.
season_sever_intrusion_007: The Neutral Cities in the new season hold vast treasures. Commanders, gear up for the struggle and seize the wealth!
season_sever_intrusion_011:
ABOUT THE EVENT:
1. After Land and City connection, Alliance R5/R4 can declare war on Cities.
2. After declaring war, the contest begins. Each alliance can only declare war on one City at a time.
3. Troops will be affected by virus during sieges. Please increase troop Virus Resistance to reduce impact.
4. Siege battles are risky, with a portion of units dying directly. The specific ratio is detailed on Cities.
5. There will be first-time City capture rewards for participants. Alliance members will also receive City rewards. Alliances receive Loot chests as well, distributed by R5 or R4.
6. After capturing a City, all Alliance members get buffs. The City enters a protected state for a period, during which it can't be declared war upon by other Alliances.

ABOUT THE EVENT:
1. After the event begins, you can declare war on Thursdays and Saturdays. Alliance members R4 and above can declare war within the season's group on other Warzone Cities.
2. First capture of a City by another Warzone's Alliance offers loot rewards, displayed in the City List.
3. War can be declared after connecting Alliance territory to the targeted City, allowing for subsequent City capture.

season_hero_promotion_006:
ABOUT THE EVENT:
1. After the event starts, you can promote the specified SSR Hero to the corresponding UR Hero in the event interface.
2. Promotion conditions: SSR Hero reaches 5 Stars, no level limit.
3. After the hero is promoted, the star will be reset to 3 Stars, the skill level will be reset to level 1, the Hero Level is retained, and the original SSR Hero's Wall of Honor disappears.
· The Skill Medals consumed to upgrade the skill level will be returned by mail, and the Shards consumed to upgrade the Wall of Honor will be returned in the form of [corresponding hero Shards] by mail
· The Shards consumed to ascend the SSR Hero from 0 Star to 5 Stars will not be returned.
4. After the hero is promoted, you can use the original hero's Shards or SSR Universal Shards to upgrade the new UR Hero. (Ascending stars requires double the Shards)

1. After the event starts, levels of any two heroes can be swapped.
2. Swapping levels may lock skills unlocked by the level, increasing hero level can restore skill levels.

season_city_battle_tips001: You or an ally must have Land connected to the City to declare war and attack the City.
season_city_battle_tips002:
War Declaration Rules: 
1. An alliance of more than {0} members can declare war on cities. 
2. Alliances may launch {1} war declarations daily, resetting at server time 0:00.
3. Alliances are restricted to declaring war on one City at a time. Members can attack only after a declaration is made. 
4. Alliances cannot attack Cities without a formal war declaration. 
5. Each war declaration has a 12-hour duration.
6. Multiple Alliances can declare war on the same City.
7. Newly established Alliances need to wait 24 hours before declaring war on a City.
8. When declaring war on a City, the Alliance must have at least one Land connected to it.
9. For cross-warzone City declarations, the daily limit for declarations is shared.
season_city_battle_tips003:
HOW TO GET POINTS:
 Commanders earn 1 Alliance point for each point of City durability destroyed.
The Alliance with the highest points gains City ownership.

season_ui_desc044:
CAPITOL CONQUEST RULES: 
1. After the Capitol opens, an Alliance can only compete if it has any land adjacent to the Capitol.
2. The contest spans 8 hours. The Alliance that holds the Capitol for a total of 4 hours first, or the one with the most time at the end, wins.
3. Victory grants the Alliance leader the title of President.
4. Near the Capitol lies Contaminated Land. Entering this area disables radar, shields, and halts all world exploration activities.

season_mail_desc005:
Dear Commanders:
The new season is coming soon!
The world is about to undergo drastic changes, prepare with your allies to face the impact of the new world!

During the season preparation period: The Profession Hall is open for construction.
After the Profession Hall is built, you can select a profession.
Engineer:
Full of creativity, they can improve production methods to increase the efficiency of resource acquisition. They can also provide enhancements for allies.
War Leader:
This role can maximize the potential of troops, enhance the attack effect of troop combat. They can also use clever tactics to increase the damage received by the enemy.
After the season begins, you will be able to earn Profession EXP, as well as reselect your Profession.

Have a great game!
Note: The Warzone will transition at the start of the season. The server will restart after the transition is complete. Please avoid starting alliance events when the countdown to the season start reaches zero.
season_mail_desc006:
Dear Commanders:
Welcome to the new season!
The world has undergone many changes, all cities have been taken by enemies, and the alliance has been forced to relocate to the outermost parts of the world.
But your alliance remains united, daring to face any challenge!

To quickly get started with the new season, you can follow these guidelines:
1. Check the season manual to understand the new gameplay
2. Play according to the guidance of the season tasks
3. Command the alliance according to the guidance of the alliance milestones
4. Learn about the new activities of the season cycle through [World Dynamics]
Or you can seek help from players in the alliance!
Have a great game!
season_mail_desc007:
Dear Commanders,
The season is now in the settlement stage.
During this phase, the following changes will occur:
1. All leaderboards will remain static
2. Alliance R5 or [Butler] can allocate rewards to members based on alliance reward tiers
3. All seasonal gameplay will be sequentially closed, cleared, or reset
4. Teleportation across Warzones is no longer permitted
5. [Season Battle Pass] and [Season Weekly Pass] are no longer available for purchase
6. Note: Season resources will reset to zero at the end of the countdown, ensure they are consumed beforehand!
7. At the end of this season, we'll clear: Alliance buildings, your season buildings, Alliance season tech, all season lands, and two kinds of season resources.
8. The following won't reset: Your Profession rank, Profession EXP, Profession EXP items, city control in this warzone, and the season store.
9. Season recruitment will close once the season countdown ends (any remaining season recruitment tickets can be used for hero recruitment in the next season).

Stay tuned for upcoming off-season activities!
season_mail_desc008:
Dear Commanders:
Thank you for your participation, the season has ended, and the season entrance has been closed!
1. Alliance Buildings have been cleared and removed
2. Season individual buildings have been cleared and removed (this will lead to a decrease in individual Power)
3. Season-related tasks have been cleared and removed
4. Season resources have been cleared
5. Season Hero Recruitment event has ended (remaining Recruitment Tickets can still be used for the next season's event)
6. Season lands have been removed
7. Zombies and other enemies that appeared during the season have disappeared

The new season, with new gameplay, will start within the next month!
season_ui_desc050:
After the fall of the Doom Legion, the world experienced a fleeting peace. Dr. Nier, who escaped in a hurry, left behind unresolved secrets beneath the Capitol.
Fifteen years earlier, he had arrived at a castle in the north, where he quickly married the young Lady in Red, the estate's owner. She was aware that he was after her family's secret artifact, the Gift of Blood Spawn. Despite this, she chose to ally with Nier to form the Doom Legion, hoping to restore her family's former glory and ascend as queen of the world.

Ten years ago, the driven Lady in Red took a daring step by injecting herself with the Gift of Blood Spawn. She then secluded herself underground, biding her time until the moment was right.
Now, as the queen emerges, she brings forth the Crimson Plague, plunging humanity into turmoil. Commander, the stage is set for a deadly conflict—this is your chance to demonstrate that you are the true ruler of this world!

activity_desc_1000012:
ABOUT THE EVENT:
1. After the event starts, the time commanders first killed the highest level Zombie in the new season is recorded and ranked.
2. The higher the level of the Zombie killed by the commander, the higher the ranking. When the level of the Zombie killed is the same, the commander who kills faster ranks higher. Rewards are based on the commander's ranking at the time of event settlement, the higher the ranking, the better the rewards.
3. During the event, settlements are made daily, and ranking rewards are delivered via mail.
activity_desc_1000013:
ABOUT THE EVENT:
1. After the event starts, the time consumed by the Alliance to capture the Military Stronghold is recorded and ranked.
2. The higher the level of the Military Stronghold captured by the Alliance, the higher the ranking. When the level of the Military Stronghold captured is the same, the Alliance that captures faster ranks higher.
3. During the event, settlements are made daily (Does not reset leaderboard data). Rewards are based on the Alliance's ranking at the time of event settlement, the higher the ranking, the better the rewards. Ranking rewards are delivered via mail.
activity_desc_1000014:
ABOUT THE EVENT:
1. After the event starts, commanders can collect Genetic Fragments through daily activities in the new world.
2. These Fragments are sorted into six types, from I to VI. Assembling a complete set allows for a recombination attempt and earns a reward, details of which are available in the reward section.
3. Allies can exchange Fragments with each other.
4. Please be noted that each recombination consumes one recombination attempt, which naturally accumulates over time but will not exceed the maximum limit.
activity_desc_1000015:
ABOUT THE EVENT:
1. After Alliance Military Stronghold and City connection, Alliance R5/R4 can declare war on Cities.
2. After declaring war, the contest begins. Each alliance can only declare war on one City at a time.
3. If the alliance lacks Military Strongholds or Cities, it must first capture a level 1 Military Stronghold. After connecting territories, it can declare war on other Cities.
4. Troops will be affected by toxins during sieges. Please increase troop Virus Resistance to reduce impact.
5. Siege battles are risky, with a portion of units dying directly. The specific ratio is detailed on Cities.
6. There will be first-time City capture rewards for participants. Alliance members will also receive City rewards. Alliances receive Loot chests as well, distributed by R5 or R4.
7. After capturing a City, all Alliance members get buffs. The City enters a protected state for a period, during which it can't be declared war upon by others.
8. When a city is captured by another Alliance, it also enters a protection period. Abandoning a city does not reset the protection countdown.
activity_desc_1000016:
ABOUT THE EVENT:
1. After the event starts, on Tuesdays and Fridays each week, the Crimson Legion will counterattack Alliance Cities.
2. The Crimson Legion can attack Cities regardless of their protection status.
3. The Crimson Legion will announce its attack targets before the counterattack, allowing Alliance members to prepare in advance.
4. Successfully defending against the Crimson Legion's attacks will earn the Alliance rewards. The more waves defended, the better the rewards.
5. If defense fails, the Crimson Legion will damage the City. If a City's Durability drops to zero, the City will be considered lost and revert to the control of the Crimson Legion.
activity_desc_1000017:
ABOUT THE EVENT:
1. After the event starts, Alliance R4+ members can place "Alliance Outposts" in other Warzones.
2. Once placed, Commanders can teleport there, starting from the outpost to capture other Military Strongholds within range.
3. Outposts gradually open over time. Each Alliance can have a maximum of 4.
4.An Alliance can place only one outpost per Warzone. Once placed, outposts cannot be retracted. 
5. During non-war days (Sunday to Friday), when you are on the Contaminated Land, you can be attacked by other commanders from different Warzones. During war days (Saturday), you can attack bases of commanders in other warzones.
6. After the event begins, you can't declare war on cities early.
activity_desc_1000018:
ABOUT THE EVENT:
1. After the event begins, you can declare war on Thursdays and Saturdays. Alliance members of rank R4 or higher can declare war on alliance cities within their own Warzone or other Warzones in the season's grouping.
2. First capture of a City by another Warzone's Alliance offers loot rewards, displayed in the City List.
3. War can be declared after connecting Alliance Military Stronghold to the targeted City, allowing for subsequent City capture.

season_ppt_virus_desc01:
The RA virus, also known as the "Gift of Blood Spawn," comes from ancient insects preserved in amber. Throughout the generations, the Lady in Red's family worked tirelessly to preserve this. 

Each virus particle, merely 100 nanometers across, can multiply to 2000 in just an hour after infecting a human. Initial symptoms include fever, dry cough, and fatigue, followed by a week of increased appetite and severe breathing difficulties as the body begins to mutate and become highly infectious.

Early mutants of the RA virus are less intelligent and uncontrollable. An upgraded version of the RA virus produces a gel-like substance that encapsulates the infected, slowing their mutation. The longer this process, the smarter the infected become, sometimes even smarter than average humans. 
After 10 years of hibernation, the Lady in Red evolved into the almighty, Crimson Queen. Her intelligence and power far exceed our imagination.
season_activity_story_desc002:
The Crimson Queen has unleashed the Crimson Plague, spreading the RA virus worldwide.
Even ordinary zombies are affected by the virus, becoming stronger and harder to control. We must defeat these monsters before they fully evolve!
season_activity_story_tittle003: Purge the Polluted Area is starting soon
season_activity_story_desc003:
Our military outposts built to take down the Crimson Queen have been captured.
A creature known as the "Corruptor" now occupies these posts, spreading the RA virus further. This virus not only contaminates the land but also spawns new infected zombies, making the virus more contagious! It's critical to tackle these Polluted Area immediately!

season_activity_story_desc004: Following the spread of the RA virus, gathering and recombining Genetic Fragments worldwide will help us develop antibodies.
season_activity_story_desc005: End the virus threat, seize control of cities, and strategically ensure your Alliance remains invincible.
season_activity_story_desc006:
The Crimson Queen is furious with your victories and has upgraded the RA virus, spawning numerous enhanced mutants known as the "Crimson Legion."
These monsters will launch attacks from major Cities against your bases.

season_activity_story_desc008: By declaring war on other warzones, we can take over their Cities! Our ultimate aim is global domination!
season_activity_story_desc009: The Crimson Queen's evil plan has been completely crushed, and we've saved the world once again. But the war isn't over, and a major battle between warzones is about to start.

Mason was once a member of the elite Ironclad Squadron, which was celebrated for its valor in battles against the Doom Legion until their leader, Garm, betrayed them and joined the enemy.
Despite the odds, Mason and his allies like Monica and Gump defended their city, keeping humanity's hope alive.
Now transformed, Mason has upgraded to a formidable UR Hero with his new Ironclad Vehicle.

season_UI_info_101:
1. You must defeat the Corruptors guarding the stronghold to take control of it.
2. An alliance can initially capture only Lv.1 strongholds.
3. After capturing their first stronghold, an Alliance can only seize strongholds or Cities adjacent to their territory.
4. Attacks on strongholds captured by other Alliances are not allowed unless they are adjacent to your territory.
5. The more troops stationed at a stronghold, the faster it can be captured.
6. If the troop count is too low, the capture will fail due to slow progress.
7. When a stronghold captured by your Alliance is attacked by another, it enters a contest state. The Alliance that reaches 100% progress first successfully captures it.
8. Once a stronghold changes hands, it enters a 36-hour protection period and the defending troops are refreshed.
9. Initially, each Alliance can capture only three strongholds, but the maximum number of strongholds increases with the number of cities captured.

season_mail_desc010:
Dear Commanders:
Get ready for the upcoming season—Crimson Plague!
The world is about to change dramatically, so gear up with your allies for the challenges ahead!


During the season's prep stage, the Professional Hall is open for construction.
Once built, you can choose a profession:
Engineer:
Innovators at heart, engineers can optimize production to boost resource efficiency and strengthen allies.
War Leader:
Masters of mobilization, they enhance troop combat effectiveness and employ tactics that increase enemy damage.
After the season begins, you will be able to earn Profession EXP, as well as reselect your Profession.

Happy hunting!
Note: The Warzone will transition at the start of the season. The server will restart after the transition is complete. Please avoid starting alliance events when the countdown to the season start reaches zero.
season_mail_desc011:
Dear Commanders:
The new season—Crimson Plague, has started!
The world has undergone vast changes: the Crimson Queen's powerful mutants have overtaken all cities, and her plague ravages the region. Our alliance has been pushed to the world's fringes.
The Capitol has fallen, the Crimson virus has spread globally, yet our alliance remains strong and our soldiers motivated!


Start the new season by following these steps:
1. Review the season manual for new gameplay details.
2. Follow the season task guidelines.
3. Command the alliance according to alliance milestone guidance.
4. Learn about new seasonal events in [World Dynamics]
Or you can seek help from players in the alliance!
5. Season-specific buildings will be removed at the end of the season.

Happy hunting!

City Attack Rules (current season):
1. Alliances can declare war on up to 2 Cities per day
2. In the same Warzone, an Alliance can capture up to 6 Cities
3. During the season, Alliances can also capture up to 6 Cities in other Warzones

season_rules_ui_desc036: The world has changed dramatically, with the Crimson Queen's forces swallowing the globe. Every city has fallen to her legions, forcing all commanders and their allies to the edges of the earth.
season_rules_ui_desc037: This land has been infected by a potent virus carried by zombies. Surviving the apocalypse requires enhanced [Virus Resistance], achievable only through constructing a [Virus Research Institute].
season_rules_ui_desc038: [Military Strongholds] serve as bases for the Queen's elite forces. Alliances must first secure a Level 1 Stronghold to claim their initial territory and expand by seizing additional Military Strongholds. Securing these Strongholds is essential for launching assaults on Cities.
season_rules_ui_desc039: To declare war on a city, an alliance must control at least one adjacent [Military Stronghold]. Additionally, capturing cities increases the cap on the number of strongholds an Alliance can control—for every 1-5 level City captured, the Alliance's Stronghold limit +1.
season_rules_ui_desc040: Engaging with zombie forces without adequate virus resistance can lead to infections among your troops. Returning troops can adversely affect the base with negative effects. Allies' treatments can reduce virus intensity, and overcoming other commanders can help spread the infection.
activity_1000012_plot1: The zombies here seem to have mutated. Some units show Viral Infection Symptoms after fighting them.

activity_1000012_plot4: That's a smart move. Let's go!
activity_1000013_plot2: It's a big one, indeed. It's been spreading the virus.

activity_1000014_plot2: These genetic pieces aren't whole yet. We need to piece them together to decode the data.
activity_1000014_plot3: The results are unpredictable, but every time we mix these pieces, we learn something valuable.

1. Commanders can either individually challenge instructors or rally allies for a joint attack.

3. Defeating them rewards all Alliance members at the event's end.

Selection Stage:
1. When the event begins, an R4 or R5 must select the difficulty and challenge time. The alliance requires at least 20 members to initiate the drill.
2. Once selections have been made, the event transitions to the Preparation Stage. If a challenge time has not been chosen by 22:00 server time on the final day of the event, the event will expire. 

Preparation Stage:
1. All Alliance members may donate resources, to receive alliance contributions and boost the Critical Hit rate for the combat phase.
2. After the donation goal is reached, members may still donate to receive alliance contributions, but there is no additional damage bonus for the combat stage 

Combat Stage:
 This phase must be initiated manually by an R4 or R5 and lasts 30 minutes 
2. Once started, Marshal's Elite Guards will position themselves at the Drill Ground, and commanders can only attack them by initiating rallies. 
3. Rallies initiated by R4s or Officials receive an additional damage bonus against the Elite Guards.
4. After the Combat Stage, rewards are distributed based on the total damage dealt by the alliance and by the individual .
5. Enabling "Offline Participation", allows your highest power squad to automatically join a rally with 20 seconds remaining, if slots are available.

Reward Stage
1. The higher the damage inflicted by the Alliance , the more substantial the rewards, and the more difficult the challenges you will unlock
2. Commanders who deliver significant individual damage secure better rewards.
3. Based on their individual damage, the commander with the highest damage, can increase his allies Alliance Rewards by up to 10x!

activity_desc_99011:
1. During the Event, use event items to roll dice. Each roll indicates the number of steps.
2. Roll either one die (regular roll) or two dice (roll 2 dice).
3. Different squares: item squares, event squares, and the start square. Item Square: Landing on an item square grants rewards and square EXP. Upon reaching a specific EXP value, the item square can be upgraded, with higher levels yielding better rewards.
4. Land on event squares for unexpected random events.
5. Arriving at or passing the Starting square randomly grants rewards and EXP for 3 item squares.
6. Achieve your goals by completing tasks to claim rewards for the Goals.
7. If the square's EXP is already maxed out, triggering a random event that grants EXP will not increase the EXP further.
8. Treasure Chests appear randomly on squares. Claim a chest by stepping on it. Once a chest is claimed, it refreshes on a different square.
9. Chest opening odds: Treasure Voucher *1000 (0.01%), Treasure Voucher *100 (0.1%), Treasure Voucher *10 (4%), or Treasure Voucher *1 (95.89%).
10. Buying packs triggered from Snowbound Hunt event earns you VIP points.
activity_desc_98009:

2. Supply boxes require keys to open. Higher-quality boxes offer better rewards but consume more keys.
3. Commanders can hold up to four unopened supply boxes at a time. If the limit is reached, summoning supplies will no longer yield new boxes.
4. There's a chance to trigger a critical hit when opening boxes, doubling the rewards. The critical hit rate depends on the box type:
Supply boxes containing a Legendary Decoration Chest have a 5% critical hit rate.
Other supply boxes have a 10% critical hit rate.
5. During the event, commanders can earn extra points through supply summons and box openings. Reach the required point milestones to unlock progress rewards.

activity_desc_99026:
1. During the event, use Boomopoly Tokens to roll the dice. The number rolled indicates the number of steps taken.
2. Rolls can be either a regular roll (one die) or a double roll (two dice).
3. Squares are divided into Item Squares, Event Squares, and the Starting Square. Item Square: Landing on an Item Square grants rewards and square EXP. When a certain EXP value is reached, the Item Square can be upgraded, with higher levels yielding better rewards.
4. Landing on an Event Square triggers a random event, with unexpected surprises waiting to be revealed.
5. Arriving at or passing the Starting Square randomly grants rewards and EXP for 3 Item Squares.
6. During the event, landing on a Missile Square grants a Missile. Clicking on the Missile in the interface deals damage to the Nian Beast. Each damage dealt randomly grants a reward. When the damage reaches a certain value, you can claim stage rewards and send gifts to your Alliance (Nian Beast Loot). During the event, you can claim Nian Beast Loot up to 120 times.
7. When the damage to the Nian Beast reaches 10,000, the Nian Beast enters a defeated state. In this state, the Nian Beast's HP significantly decreases. Every 2,000 damage dealt allows you to claim extra Chest Rewards, up to 300 times.
8. If the square's EXP is already maxed out, triggering an EXP event will not increase the EXP further. Squares randomly refresh the Treasure Chest. Stepping on the corresponding square grants the Chest Reward. Once a chest is claimed, it refreshes on a different square.
9. Buying packs triggered from Boomopoly also grants corresponding VIP Points.
Drop Rates:
1. Missile Damage Rewards: 2% chance to get one Universal UR Hero Shard, 2% chance to get one Boomopoly Chest, 12% chance to get one Resource Choice Chest (SSR), 44% chance to get one 5-minute Universal Speed-up, 40% chance to get 10 Diamonds.
2. Opening the Boomopoly Chest has a 0.01% chance to get 1000 Boomopoly Vouchers, 0.1% chance to get 100 Boomopoly Vouchers, 4% chance to get 10 Boomopoly Vouchers, 95.89% chance to get 1 Boomopoly Voucher.
3. The damage of the Missile has an 80% chance to deal 10 damage, 20% chance to deal 20 damage.
4. Random Event Squares have a 10% chance to grant 10 Boomopoly Vouchers, a 12% chance to make the next double roll free, a 12% chance to make the next roll a backward roll, a 18% chance to grant an extra 2 EXP to the next Item Square you land on, and a 40% chance to trigger the Mystery Store, and an 8% chance to trigger the corresponding Challenge event item.
5. Nian Beast Alliance Gifts have a 0.1% chance to get 10,000 Diamonds, 0.9% chance to get 1,000 Diamonds, 4% chance to get 100 Diamonds, 50% chance to get 10 Diamonds, 45% chance to get 1,000 Alliance Contribution Points.

2901010:
ABOUT THE EVENT:
1. Once the Zombie Invasion starts, numerous invading zombies will appear the World Map. Commanders can locate the nearest invading zombies through the event menu.
2. Killing invading zombies grants "Courage Medals." Use them to redeem for a variety of rewards at the event store.
3. There's a small chance that a Zombie Boss will appear after killing invading zombies. They offer rich rewards but are very powerful, you will need to rally troops to defeat them.
4. During the zombie attack, the damage commanders inflict on the Zombie Boss will be accumulated and ranked. At the end of the event, rewards based on ranking can be claimed in the mailbox. The higher the cumulative damage, the better the rewards.
5. After the event ends, commanders who participated in defeating the invading zombies will receive Invasion Defender rewards.

trialtower_012:
Basic Rules:

1. There are three Battlefields in the Honorable Campaign, and rewards can be obtained by completing the challenges in each Battlefield.
2. The Battlefields include "Iron Formation" (Recommended for Tank Heroes), "Sky Policy" (Recommended for Aircraft Heroes), and "Missile Frontline" (Recommended for Missile Vehicle Heroes). You can select the Battlefield by clicking the arrows on the left and right sides of the screen.
3. Challenge progress resets at 00:00 server time every Sunday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Each challenge period lasts 2 days.
4. Before the progress is reset, only one level can be selected in each Battlefield, and once chosen, it cannot be changed.
5. After completing the selected level for the first time, you can immediately challenge the next one. Only one additional level can be challenged in each cycle.
6. Each hero can only participate in one Battlefield challenge per cycle. Please assign your elite forces wisely.
7. Heroes below Level 100 may have a chance for a Super Upgrade in the campaign, directly advancing 1 level for free, but it cannot exceed the current Level Cap of the hero.
8. Campaign Medals earned can be exchanged for items in the Campaign Store.

mail_yanzheng_title: View your Last War Link Code
mail_yanzheng_content:
Dear {0}:

Your verification code for linking your account is:

{1}

Please enter this code in - Profile - Account - Link Account to complete the account linking process.

Last War Support Team
delete_account_content_01: Choosing to delete your account will delete all characters under it. Please confirm again. If you want to delete a specific character, please select delete character.
delete_account_content_02:
After your consent, [Account Deletion] will remove the following:
1. Linkages between this account and all [Last War] characters.
2. All information associated with this account, including but not limited to account linking information, IP address, device information, etc.
3. All game data of characters bound to this account, including but not limited to activity logs, chat records, in-app purchase records, etc.

Once deleted, this content cannot be recovered. If you decide to proceed with the deletion, please read the [Termination Agreement], check "Agree," and then proceed to the next step.
delete_account_content_04:
The [Account Deletion] process will be completed within 7-14 days after you submit your application. During this time, we will restrict all gaming activities of the characters linked to this account: apart from "Withdraw Application" or "Contact Customer Service", you will not be able to perform any gaming operations on any character.
We will keep all the characters bound to this account in a "safe mode," meaning they cannot be attacked, until the [Account Deletion] process is either completed or cancelled.
<color=#ff0000>You can cancel your application and resume normal gameplay at any time during the review process by clicking the "Withdraw Application" button.</color>
Once the application is approved, we will ask again to confirm your decision: if you proceed, all the game data associated with all characters of this account will be deleted. Click on [Character Inquiry] to view associated characters.

If you agree, please click the "Submit Application" button below.
delete_account_content_05: Submitting the application will delete all characters in the list. Do you wish to proceed with the application?
delete_account_content_06: Your application has been submitted, and you will be forced to log out shortly. Please do not uninstall the game yet. By logging in, you can understand the current status of your application.
delete_account_content_07:
Your [Account Deletion] application is currently in the status of: Under Review.

If this application was not made by you, or you wish to cancel it, you can click the "Withdraw Application" button below to retract your application. For any other queries, click "Contact Customer Service".
delete_account_content_08:
Your [Account Deletion] application is currently in the status of:
Approved.

<color=#ff0000>Once the [Account Deletion] process begins, it cannot be stopped, and the deleted content cannot be recovered. </color>In addition to account binding information and personal information, all game data associated with all characters of this account will also be deleted. You can click on [Character Inquiry] to view related characters.
If this application was not made by you, or if you wish to cancel it, click the <color=#ff0000>Withdraw Application</color> button below to retract your application.
delete_account_content_09:
Your [Account Deletion] application is currently in the status of:
Rejected. 
The rejection may be due to disputes over account ownership. Please contact customer service for detailed information. We will address it soon!
delete_account_content_10: Please confirm again if you wish to proceed with [Account Deletion]: Once confirmed, the deletion process cannot be stopped, and the data cannot be recovered.
delete_account_content_11:
The account data has been completely deleted.
You can now close and uninstall the game. Game restart will initiate new character creation, along with fresh game data and account setup. Be informed.
We wish you a joyful journey ahead.
delete_account_content_12:
Important Notice:
1. If you only wish to <color=#ff0000>Delete Current Character</color>, please select <color=#ff0000>Delete Character</color>.
2. If you want to <color=#ff0000>Create New Character</color>, click on your avatar on the main interface - Settings - Character Management to obtain a new character on a designated server.
3. If you confirm that you want to <color=#ff0000>Delete Account</color>, please be aware that <color=#ff0000>this action will Delete All Server Characters under the Account, and all game progress will be lost.</color>
4. You must wait 7 days between account deletion requests. You can't make consecutive requests.
5. You can only request to delete your account once all squads return to base.
delete_account_content_13: The system has not detected any account linked to you. If you want to experience a new character or delete an existing one, please choose "Delete Character".
delete_account_content_15: Operation failed in the cross-Warzone environment. Return to your original Warzone to proceed with deletion.

season_comic_1: Dr. Nier was once a hero of this world. His scientific achievements saved many lives.
season_comic_2: Unexpectedly, he changed—he created a private army and unleashed a virus worldwide, turning people into zombies.
season_comic_3: These zombies, controlled by Nier, evolved into an organized force.
season_comic_4: He named this force the Doom Legion and led them to seize the Capitol.
season_comic_5: Finally, through the fierce battles of commanders and heroes, the Doom Legion was defeated, and the world saw a temporary peace!
season_comic_6: But the cunning Nier escaped with his remnants to a distant desert.
season_comic_7: There, he found the tomb of an ancient pharaoh and discovered the secret of an ancient virus, gaining new power.
season_comic_8: The desert swallowed the Capitol, and a huge pyramid rose from the ground. Nier has returned with new power!
season_comic_9: The Lady in Red came from an ancient family. She gave the family's secret, the “RA virus”, to Nier. The two became partners... husband and wife.

doomsday_activity_desc1002:
Participation Conditions:
1. Players with a base level of 8 or above can participate.

How to Play
1. During the event, Doom Walkers will attack commanders' bases, please be prepared.
2. On event day, the respawn time of Doom Walkers will be more concentrated.
3. During the event, Doom Walkers will not blast way the Commander's base.
4. When Doom Walkers breach the commander's headquarters, the death rate of idle units decreases by 90%.

Rewards:
1. During the event, the first kill reward of Doom Walkers can be claimed up to 3 times.
2. After completing Warzone tasks during the event, commanders who meet the conditions can claim rewards.
3. Rewards will be based on the total damage inflicted on Doom Walkers and will be sent after the event ends based on rankings.

Under 15 years: 5,000 yen (tax included)

drop_info_desc2:
About Radar Level
1. Accumulate a certain number of Radar Tasks to upgrade the Radar level, thereby improving various Attributes of the Radar.
2. Each time the Radar is upgraded, you'll get a certain number of Radar Tasks.
3. After the Radar reaches level 6, you can perform the Help Allies and Geological Sampling tasks with one click. After the Radar reaches level 4, you can continuously claim radar task rewards.

The following Radar Tasks will only appear once a day
1. Eliminate the Doom Legion (SR 60%, SSR 30%, UR 10%)
2. Defeat the Doom Elite (SR 60%, SSR 30%, UR 10%)
3. Kill the Doom Walker (SSR 80%, UR 20%. Requires Radar level 7 and Base level 15)
4. Rescue the Rebellion (SR 60%, SSR 30%, UR 10%)

Radar Task Discovery Rates
1. Kill Zombies 29.93% (N 8.98%, R 7.48%, SR 5.99%, SSR 4.49%, UR 2.99%)
2. Help Allies 29.93% (N 8.98%, R 7.48%, SR 5.99%, SSR 4.49%, UR 2.99%)
3. Geological Sampling 19.95% (N 9.98%, R 5.99%, SR 2.99%, SSR 0.79%, UR 0.2%)
4. Collect Resources 19.95% (SR 9.98%, SSR 5.98%, UR 3.99%)
 5. Excavation Tasks 0.24% (UR 0.24%, Requires Radar level 6)

Additional Radar Tasks can be obtained when the Radar is upgraded, as follows:
Level 2: Kill Zombies ×3
Level 3: Diamond Mine ×1, Help Allies ×2
Level 4: Defeat the Doom Elite ×1, Diamond Mine ×1, Help Allies ×2
Level 5: Eliminate the Doom Legion ×1, Diamond Mine ×1, Geological Sampling ×2
Level 6: Diamond Mine ×1, Coin Mine ×1, Help Allies ×2
Level 7: Diamond Mine ×2, Coin Mine ×1, Geological Sampling ×2
Level 8 and above: Diamond Mine ×1, Coin Mine ×1, Geological Sampling ×2, Kill Zombies ×1

Special Note: If you are not part of an Alliance when receiving additional Radar Tasks, you will not be able to get the Help Allies task.

mail_content10085:
Dear Commander,

This is Monica. I'm excited to report on the latest progress of our drone center.
After months of effort, the drone skill system is about to finish its final tuning phase and will be officially operational in a few days.
The core feature of this system is its powerful functionality and flexibility. By installing skill chips, drones will be able to demonstrate various strong skill effects in battle, enhancing combat capability and adaptability to different battlefield environments.
We're confident in the potential of this technology and believe it will bring significant strategic advantages to our military operations.

Best regards,

Staff officer
Monica

activity_desc_99050:
1. During the event, commanders can use Easter Egg Coins for lottery draws. Each draw will earn points, and when the points reach a certain amount, you can claim stage rewards.
2. During the event, you can complete daily tasks to collect patterns and receive rewards. Rewards for completed tasks that were not claimed in time will be sent via mail the next day.
3. If the lottery result includes a 'Chest' pattern, it will trigger a chest opening. Commanders can choose one to open. For each 'Chest' pattern in a single lottery result, there is one chance to open a chest. Opening a chest can earn great rewards.
4. The more identical patterns in the lottery result, the better the rewards. When using the 5x mode for the lottery, both the consumption and rewards will be 5 times the initial amount.
5. During the event, purchasing Easter Egg Coin packs can earn you a limited Easter Red Packet.
6. At the end of the event, unused Easter Store Vouchers and Easter Egg Coins will be converted into Speed-up Items and sent via mail. Please use them in time.
activity_desc_99051:
1. During the event, commanders can use Easter Store Vouchers to exchange for various valuable rewards in this store.
2. Each item category in the store has a limit on the number of exchanges. Once all exchanges are made, no more can be made.
3. Once an item is exchanged in the store, it cannot be returned. Please choose wisely.
4. After the exchange store closes, Easter Store Vouchers and Easter Egg Coins will be converted into Speed-up Items and sent via mail. Please use them in time.
activity_desc_99052:
1. During the event, complete tasks, participate in Battle Pass, complete Radar Assistance Event (50% chance to get 1, 35% chance to get 2, 15% chance to get 5 each time), kill monsters, Rally Boss, Doom Walker, Monster Invasion, General Trials (50% chance to get 1, 35% chance to get 2, 15% chance to get 5 each time), and attack Wanted Bosses (50% chance to get 2, 35% chance to get 4, 15% chance to get 10 each time), you may get Easter Carnival Eggs.
2. Easter Carnival Eggs can be used in the Colorful Gala event.
3. At the end of the event, Easter Carnival Eggs will be recycled into Speed-up Items and sent via Mail.
4. Easter Carnival Eggs obtained through in-app purchases are not counted towards the limit.
activity_desc_99054:
1. All commanders within this Warzone are eligible to participate.

drop_info_desc6:
1. Commanders can contribute to Alliance technology by donating Coins and Diamonds, thereby advancing the progress bar for Alliance tech EXP. Once the bar is full, the Alliance can begin researching that technology.
2. Each donation by a commander, whether in Coins or Diamonds, pushes forward the Alliance tech EXP by 50 points and awards 50 Alliance contribution points. Moreover, donations have a chance to trigger a critical hit, yielding additional tech EXP. The odds for critical hits are as follows:
No critical hit - 45%
2x critical hit (an extra 50 points of Alliance tech EXP) - 30%
3x critical hit (an extra 100 points of Alliance tech EXP) - 15%
5x critical hit (an extra 200 points of Alliance tech EXP) - 10%
3. Every donation uses up 1 chance, whether it triggers a critical or not. Donation chances refresh every 20 minutes if you haven't hit the limit.
4. There's no daily limit on the number of times commanders can donate to Alliance tech using Diamonds. However, the Diamond cost for each donation increases with the number of donations made that day. The cost starts at 2 Diamonds for the first donation and increases by 2 Diamonds with each subsequent donation, up to a maximum of 50 Diamonds.

winter_battlefield_rules1001:
[Winter Storm Battlefield] - 5v5 live battles!
Reports say our teams are fighting hard in the snow outside the city. We need to send our best Special Forces now to help, wipe out all Enemy Forces, and protect our own! Get ready for battle now!
winter_battlefield_rules1002: [Spawn Area] - It's a tight battlefield, and both sides' bases can only be set up in the spawn area. You can't move your base.
winter_battlefield_rules1003: [Capturing Sites] - On the battlefield, both sides have an Artillery Site and a MG Site in their trenches. You need to take these to wipe out the Enemy Forces.
winter_battlefield_rules1004: [Site Effects] - After taking a site, it automatically attacks Enemy Forces. If either side's Forces are all gone, that's a loss!
winter_battlefield_rules1005: [Missile Site] - The Missile Site in the middle of the battlefield opens up now and then. It's got massive firepower, so you have to take it to win!
winter_battlefield_rules1006: [Healing Units] - Med packs drop on the battlefield now and then. Commanders need to send troops to get them, healing your Infantry or Armored Forces so they can keep fighting!
winter_battlefield_rules1007: [Airdrops] - Reinforcement supplies drop on the battlefield now and then. Send your troops to grab them. Getting these supplies boosts your troops' attributes throughout the battle.
winter_battlefield_rules1008: In the icy winter, the red and blue armies clashed in the suburbs. After a day of intense battle, both sides are determined to fight to the end. We need to support the battlefield now, wipe out the enemy, and protect your troops!
winter_battlefield_rules1009:
1. Once you're on the battlefield, taking over Artillery Sites and MG Sites lets you kill Enemy Forces. If either side's Infantry and Armored Forces are all gone, that's a loss.
2. If time runs out on the battlefield, the side with fewer Forces left loses.
3. The Missile Site in the middle of the field opens up now and then. It's got massive firepower but works for a limited time. Taking it is crucial to winning.
4. When you enter the battlefield, your highest-level units automatically fill the separate Drill Ground. They won't show up in your base's Drill Ground and won't leave the battlefield after the fight.
5. In battle, your units won't die. After the fight, all severely wounded units will automatically heal for free.
winter_battlefield_rules1010:
1. The event starts. 
The event will start on Wednesdays, four weeks after the server opens, with matched battles taking place every Sunday (subject to change during the testing phase of the event.)

2. Matchmaking. 
Commanders with bases level 15 and above can join, with several time slots available for matching on battle day.

3. Entering the Battlefield 
When all 10 matched commanders confirm they'll join, everyone automatically enters the battlefield.

4. Battle Stage
Prep Stage: Participants are split into red or blue teams, starting in a safe zone, and you can't move your base here. 
Battle time: You can take over MG and Artillery sites, which lets you take out Enemy Forces. 
Missile Site opening: The Missile Site opens up now and then, and taking it lets you efficiently take out Enemy Forces. 
Heal Your Forces: You can heal the Forces severely wounded on the battlefield, enabling them to fight again.
Kill Enemy Forces: You can deliver a final blow to severely wounded troops, ensuring they are permanently out of action and cannot be healed.
Medical Drops: Periodically during combat, medical packs are dropped for defeated Forces, reviving them to rejoin the fight.
Speed Boost: Your marching speed and the speed at which your troops return to your base after defeat are both enhanced on the battlefield.

Battle End:
When the number of surviving Infantry and Armored Forces on one side reaches 0 first, the battle ends, and the other side wins. 
When the battle time ends, the side with fewer surviving Forces loses. If the number of surviving Forces is the same, it is a draw.

1. Complete secret tasks of SSR or higher rarity to earn random treasure map fragments. Successfully, and perfectly, completing these tasks may yield extra fragments.
2. There are seven types of treasure map fragments required for treasure digs. You need one of each to proceed with an excavation. If you're short on any fragment, the dig can't happen.
3. Exchange fragments with your allies. Starting an exchange will temporarily remove your offered fragment. If the exchange goes through, you'll get the fragment you wanted. If you decide to cancel, you'll get your fragment back. Only one active exchange allowed at a time.
4. Drop Rates for obtaining treasure map fragments from secret tasks: Each of the seven fragments has a 14.28% drop rate.
5. Perfectly complete SSR tasks for a 5% chance to win an extra treasure map fragment. Perfectly complete UR tasks for a 15% chance to get an extra fragment.
6. There is a guaranteed chance to find a UR chest after digging 15 times. If you don't get a UR chest in 15 tries, the 16th attempt will guarantee one. After finding a UR chest, the counter resets.

zombieRush_tips_06:
About the Event
The Doom Legion is planning a counterattack. Alliances must complete radar tasks to gather clue points, locate the Doom Legion base to stop them.

Event Start
1. Alliance members can earn clue points by completing these radar tasks:
· Kill Doom Legion enemy +300
· Kill Doom Elite +300
· Kill Doom Walker +300
· Kill Zombie +10
· Assist Allies +10
· Geological Sampling +10
· Resource Gathering +10
· Digging Tasks +10
2. Once enough clue points are gathered, R4/R5 can search to find the Doom Legion base and start the challenge right away.
3. Before searching, you can choose the level of the Doom Legion base. Higher levels mean tougher enemies and better rewards.
4. The initial search requires waiting to connect to the Sky Eye system. After each successful search, the Sky Eye system will enter a cooldown period.

Eligibility
1. You are required to have been in the alliance for more than 48 hours and to have been offline for less than 72 hours.
2. Your base level must meet the selected difficulty
3. The base is not in a cross-warzone state.

Event Rules
1. Zombie troops will attack bases meeting the eligibility after the stronghold appears
2. Zombie attacks bypass your shield, remember to set your defenses
3. Once a base is defeated, it won't be targeted again during this event.

Rewards
1. The more defense waves you withstand, the greater your rewards
2. The more waves your Alliance withstands, the greater the alliance rewards.
3. Only members who have been in the Alliance for over 48 hours can claim Alliance rewards.

season_mastery_tips_7:
Profession Description:

1. During the season, killing monsters, capturing cities, and upgrading season buildings can earn you profession experience.
2. Leveling up your profession can earn you profession skill points.
3. The profession skill on the far right is the season's special skill. This special skill will be unlocked after the season starts and reset at the End of Season. The skill points used for the special skill will be returned after the reset.
4. The special skills may vary from season to season.
5. Each season has a different Level Cap for the profession. Once the level reaches the Level Cap, further experience gained will not increase the profession level, but will be stored at a certain ratio. The stored profession experience will be sent via mail at the start of the next season.

vip_s_connection_title: Welcome to the exclusive service channel!
vip_s_connecttion_content:
Dear Commander,
This is Kimberly. In recognition of your outstanding performance on the battlefield, we have upgraded your security clearance to S-Tier. This is not an ordinary notice, but the key to unlocking an exclusive priority support channel just for you.
Within this channel, you will no longer face impersonal system replies. Instead, I will provide you with dedicated, in-depth support:
Privilege 1: Exclusive Channel — For any in-game issues, suggestions, or feedback, please contact me directly. I will contact the dev team directly, track the process end to end, and do my best to ensure the most professional and reasonable resolution.
Privilege 2: Tactical Advisor — More than basic Q&A, I will serve as your personal tactical consultant. Based on your needs, we will provide more targeted lineup recommendations and resource planning strategies, helping you optimize your power structure and maximize the effectiveness of every investment.
Privilege 3: Top-Secret Previews — New events, new gameplay, and new season plans: you will receive key previews ahead of other players, helping you seize the initiative.
Privilege 4: Honor and Customized Privileges — In future plans, we intend to gradually introduce exclusive physical gift benefits, and may also showcase your honor through official promotions, allowing all players to witness your achievements.
Activate your exclusive support now (after completing the linking process, you will receive a one-time exclusive reward, and services will be provided only for the linked account).
WhatsApp: <link=https://wa.me/message/PPZ5DS53IUKFN1><color=blue>https://wa.me/message/PPZ5DS53IUKFN1</color></link>

Activation Code: Please send your [UID] (Note: You can tap your avatar in the top-left corner -> tap the top-right corner -> on the Personal Info page, tap the copy button at the top.)

Wishing you all the best in life and unstoppable victories in battles!
Kimberly and the Last War Team
vip_s_reward_content:
Dear Commander, thank you for adding our exclusive contact channel, and thank you for your continued support!
Please check and claim your welcome rewards!
You can view your remaining item quantities at the top-left corner of your Base, or check the details in Mail → In-App Purchases.
If you have any questions, feel free to contact your dedicated customer support at any time. We look forward to hearing from you.

Enjoy the game!
Last War Team

activity_desc_99080:
1. During the event, commanders can use Music Note Tokens for lottery draws. Each draw will earn points, and when the points reach a certain amount, you can claim stage rewards.
2. During the event, you can complete daily tasks to collect patterns and receive rewards. Rewards for completed tasks that were not claimed in time will be sent via mail the next day.
3. If the lottery result includes a Chest pattern, it will trigger a chest opening. Commanders can choose one to open. For each Chest pattern in a single lottery result, there is one chance to open a chest. Opening a chest can earn great rewards.
4. The more identical patterns in the lottery result, the better the rewards. When using the 5x mode for the lottery, both the consumption and rewards will be 5 times the initial amount.
5. During the event, purchasing Music Note Token packs can earn you a Diamond Golden Egg.
6. At the end of the event, unused 'Music Festival Vouchers' and Music Note Tokens will be converted to Universal Speed-up Items and sent to your mailbox. Items not retrieved on time will expire and can be manually converted into universal Speed-up items in your inventory.
7. Conversion Rate: Music Festival Voucher *1 = 1-minute Speed-up item *20. Music Note Token *1 = 1-minute Speed-up item *30
activity_desc_99081:
1. During the event, commanders can use Music Festival Vouchers to exchange for various valuable rewards in this store.
2. Each category in store has a limit on the number of exchanges. Once all exchanges are made, no more can be made.
3. Once an item is exchanged in store, it cannot be returned. Please choose wisely.
4. After the exchange store closes, 'Music Festival Vouchers' and 'Music Note Tokens' will be converted into universal Speed-up Items and sent via mail. Items not retrieved on time will expire and can be manually converted into universal Speed-up items in your inventory.
5. Conversion Rate: Music Festival Voucher *1 = 1-minute Speed-up item *20. Music Note Token *1 = 1-minute Speed-up item *30
activity_desc_99082:
1. During the event, all these activities give you a chance to earn "Carnival Music Notes:" a) Complete tasks and Battle Pass tasks, b) Finish Radar assistance events (30% chance to get 1, 25% chance to get 2, 20% chance to get 3, 15% chance to get 4, 10% chance to get 5 each time). c) Kill monsters, rally Bosses, or Doom Walkers, participate in Monster Invasions, General Trials, Alliance Exercise, Maxwell's "Comrades," defeat Ironclad Vehicles, Corruptors or Infected Zombies (30% chance to get 1, 25% chance to get 2, 20% chance to get 3, 15% chance to get 4, 10% chance to get 5 each time). d) Attack the Wanted Bosses (20% chance to get 2, 20% chance to get 3, 10% chance to get 4, 10% chance to get 5, 10% chance to get 6, 10% chance to get 7, 10% chance to get 8, 5% chance to get 9, 5% chance to get 10).
2. Use Carnival Music Notes in the "Rock n' Roll Party" event.
3. After the event ends, Carnival Music Notes will be converted to Universal Speed-up Items and sent to your mailbox. Items not retrieved on time will expire and can be manually converted into universal Speed-up items in your inventory.
4. Carnival Music Notes obtained through in-app purchases are not counted towards the limit.
5. Conversion Rate: Carnival Music Note *1 = 1-minute Speed-up item *2
activity_desc_99084:
1. All commanders within this Warzone are eligible to participate.
2. For 10 Carnival Music Notes submitted earns you {0} points. Accumulate enough points to upgrade the level of the Party.
3. Each level offers a one-time reward claim, applicable only to your Warzone.
4. Individual and Alliance points are ranked separately during the event, with rewards distributed based on final standings.
5. A minimum of 10 points is necessary to be listed on the individual rankings. A minimum of 10 points is required for inclusion in the alliance rankings.
6. By the end of the event, Carnival Music Notes will be converted to Universal Speed-up Items and sent to your mailbox. Items not retrieved on time will expire and can be manually converted into universal Speed-up items in your inventory.
7. Conversion Rate: Carnival Music Note *1 = 1-minute Speed-up item *2.

1. In a 3v3 Brawl, if the same commander attacks and defeats you 3 times, you can take revenge on them.
2. You can only take revenge on the same commander once.
3. Taking revenge costs 1 attack and 500 Diamonds. If you have no attacks left or lack Diamonds, you can't take revenge.
4. After the 3v3 Brawl ends, all revenge counts will be reset.

1. After entering the battlefield, hold Missile Sites or Oil Wells to earn points. The first to reach 30000 points wins.

winter_battlefield_rules1029:
1. Event Start:
The event begins for the first time after the server's 7th week, with match battles on Saturdays. During off-season periods, the event will open on each Monday.

2. Matching:
 Commanders with Headquarters at level 15+ can participate, with several matching times on battle day.

3. Entering the Battlefield:
 Once 10 commanders confirm, they all automatically enter the battlefield.

4. Battle Stage:
Preparation Stage: Participants can enter the safe zone. Your side is blue, the enemy is red. The safe zone can't be attacked.
Battle Stage: Holding Oil Wells earns lots of Battlefield Points, while Missile Sites earn fewer Battlefield Points. Missile Sites will attack all enemy-held buildings, killing the stationed troops.
Silo Opens: The Silo opens after some time. Holding it earns a lot of Battlefield Points.
Supply Airdrop: 
Resource packs periodically drop in the battlefield. Send troops to collect them for Battlefield Points.

Battle Ends: The first to 30000 Battlefield Points wins immediately.
If time runs out, the side with more Battlefield Points wins. If scores are tied, both sides lose.

emergency_center_desc_1006:
After the troops finish a battle and return to the Base, we'll save some units who were supposed to die, turning them into critically wounded units. The Rescue Center will receive these units and attempt to save them. There is a limit on the number of critically wounded units that can be received. If this limit is exceeded, the units will die.
The time required to rescue units cannot be reduced by using Speed-ups or Diamonds, but Alliance help can reduce the time. There is a cooldown period between rescues, and you cannot use the rescue function during this cooldown.
Upgrading the Rescue Center will increase the conversion rate of dying units to critically wounded units, the intake limit for critically wounded units, and reduce the rescue cooldown time, helping you minimize unit losses in battle!

Note: Only battles that take place on the World Map may result in critically wounded units. Battles in areas like the Desert Battlefield or Winter Battlefield will not result in critically wounded units, as there are no real casualties.
