season_mail_desc012:
Dear Commanders,
As the battles have ceased, the season has ended and we have entered the settlement period. We appreciate your dedication and exceptional efforts throughout the season!
During this time, the following changes will occur:
1. Rankings for the season are now locked in place.
2. R5 or Butler can distribute member rewards based on Alliance reward tiers.
3. Season-specific events and features will be closed and reset or removed gradually.
4. Season-specific cross-warzone teleport will be disabled.
5.War declarations and attacks on Military Strongholds are no longer allowed.
6. [Season Battle Pass] and [Season Weekly Pass] can no longer be purchased.
7. Note: [Immune Protein], [Mutant Crystal], [Genetic Fragment] resources and items will be cleared and converted to Profession EXP at the end of the season. You can choose to use them as needed!
8. Note: Alliance Loots will also be cleared at the end of the season, so Alliance admin should distribute rewards in time!
9. Season buildings will be removed at the end of the season.
10. The following will remain unchanged: profession levels, profession EXP, profession EXP items, and city capture status in this warzone.

Thank you again for your participation. Stay tuned for the off-season celebration event!
season_mail_desc013:
Dear Commanders,
Your bravery during the season has once again saved the world. Thank you for your active participation, the season has successfully ended, and the season entrance is now closed.

Here's what's changed:
1. The virus is no longer spreading.
2. All Individual and Alliance season buildings have been removed (your power may drop as a result).
3. Season-specific skills have been reset, and all skill points have been returned.
4. Season tasks have been reset and cleared.
5. Exclusive season resources and items have been removed.
6. The game season hero recruitment event has ended (any remaining tickets can be used in the next season).
7. The game season monsters have disappeared.

However, the battlefield is ever-changing, and our fight continues! Next season, we'll journey to a new world, face unknown challenges, and create legends in the frosty winds!

champion_duel_rules_detail1001: Once the event opens, all players with bases above level 15 from 16 Warzones can sign up to join!
champion_duel_rules_detail1002: Commanders from 16 Warzones will compete in multiple matches, earning rich rewards and fighting for glory!
champion_duel_rules_detail1003: The battle follows 3v3 rally rules, a real test of your strategic and power skills.
champion_duel_rules_detail1004:
Seeded Player: Among the commanders who register in each warzone, those ranked in the top 8 in "Total Hero Power" will automatically be recognized as seeded players.
When setting up groups, we'll place each Warzone's top seeded player in separate groups, and we'll try our best to spread the other seeded players from the same zones across different groups as well.
champion_duel_rules_detail1005: Get ready to make predictions during the semi-finals and Knockout stages! Use your knowledge and luck to grab some awesome prizes.
champion_duel_rules_detail1006: Among the commanders who register in each warzone, those ranked in the top 8 in "Total Hero Power" will automatically be recognized as seeded players.
champion_duel_rules_detail1007: We'll mix up seed players from the same Warzone into different groups to keep the competition fair.
champion_duel_rules_detail1008: During the Qualifiers, players in each group will be automatically matched with 8 opponents of similar strength every day for 4 days. Rankings are based on players' points.
champion_duel_rules_detail1009: The top 8 players in each group can advance to the next match.
champion_duel_rules_detail1010: Players who win a ranking in their group can secure a reward for all players on the server.
champion_duel_rules_detail1011: The semifinals will last 4 days. For the first 3 days, 2 opponents will be matched each day, and on the final day, 1 opponent will be matched. Each commander will face every other commander in their group once.
champion_duel_rules_detail1012: To win against each opponent, you need to win 2 out of 3 rounds.
champion_duel_rules_detail1013: The top 2 players in each group can advance to the knockout rounds.
champion_duel_rules_detail1014: Players who participate in the battles can earn a reward for all players on the server at settlement.
champion_duel_rules_detail1015: In the knockouts, one loss and you're out - no second chances!
champion_duel_rules_detail1016: You need to beat your opponent in 2 out of 3 rounds to win. In the finals, it takes 3 wins out of 5 rounds to grab the victory.
champion_duel_rules_detail1017: The player who becomes the champion will receive a unique emote and grant a bonus emote for all players on the server.
champion_duel_rules_detail1018: Each knockout competitor can score a reward for the entire server when points are tallied.

hero_overview_tips01:
About Attribute Boost:
1. The list shows key boosts, and each attribute may have one or multiple sources.
2. Hero Attack, HP, and Defense boosts from levels and tiers are influenced by corresponding attribute boosts, other sources are not affected.
3. Some battle-effective attribute boosts are not listed.

About Hero Rarity:
Heroes come in three rarities: SR (Super Rare), SSR (Super Super Rare), and UR (Ultra Rare).
season_s1_stronghold_desc01:
The battle for Stronghold lasts up to 4 hours. Once ended, the zone enters a 36-hour protection stage.
If the capture progress is not 100% when the timer ends, the capture fails.
Note: If the Stronghold was neutral, it will go to the alliance with the highest capture progress.
season_s1_city_desc01:
The city protection time always ends at 12:00 server time.
The default protection duration is until 12:00 (server time) on the next natural day, 6 days after the battle ends.
When the warzone declaration event starts, the protection duration changes to 12:00 (server time) on the next declaration day (Thursday, Saturday), 6 days after the battle ends.
Each declaration lasts up to 1 hour, and exceeding the limit counts as a failed capture.
The contest stage will end at 24:00. Commanders, please arrange your war declaration time in advance.

report_helper_strategy_1_detail:
Troop Counters:
1. Heroes are divided into 3 troop types: Tank, Aircraft, Missile Vehicle.
2. Troop types counter each other:
Tanks deal 20% less damage to Aircraft
Aircraft deal 20% less damage to Missile Vehicles
Missile Vehicle deal 20% less damage to Tanks.
report_helper_strategy_2_detail:
Hero Roles:
1. Heroes have 3 roles: Guardian, DMG Dealer, and Support.
2. Guardian heroes take more damage, put them in the front row to maximize their role.
3. Common Guardian heroes: Murphy, Carlie, Williams, Lucius, McGregor, and Adam.
report_helper_strategy_3_detail:
The enemy's main damage is Physical damage. Try these to increase heroes' Physical resistance:
1. Research relevant Tech
2. Upgrade Armor-type gear first
3. Deploy Murphy for extra Physical defense.
report_helper_strategy_4_detail:
The enemy's main damage is Energy. Try these to increase heroes' Energy resistance:
1. Research relevant Tech
2. Upgrade Radar-type gear first
3. Deploy Carlie, Lucius for extra Energy defense.
report_helper_strategy_5_detail:
It's a close match:
1. Random factors like critical hits, stuns, and skill targeting exist in battle.
2. These cause fluctuations in battle outcomes between evenly matched commanders.
3. When this happens, gear up and try again!

activity_berserkboss_desc_02:
Background
Three mysterious tombstones appeared around the Capitol. Reports show that zombie bosses awaken from these tombs periodically, emitting a rampaging aura, and continuously attack the Capitol. These bosses are extremely powerful, requiring the joint efforts of all commanders to defeat them.

Boss Information
1. At 0:00, 6:00, and 12:00 server time, a Rampage Boss will awaken from the tombs.
2. Commanders with Base level 8 and above can attack the Rampage Boss, with a maximum of 3 attacks per boss.
3. Each boss has different traits. Attacking their weaknesses deals more damage.
4. When a Rampage Boss loses 100% HP, it becomes Vulnerable and can't be attacked. Executing the "Eliminate" command on a weakened boss grants substantial rewards.

Rewards
1. At 24:00 server time, any bosses not killed will escape. Players who dealt damage to any Rampage Boss during the event will receive reward via mail. The more damage the boss takes, the better the rewards.
2. The top 100 commanders in total damage to Rampage Bosses will receive extra ranking rewards.
3. If three bosses are successfully killed during this event, stronger bosses will appear in the next event, with even better rewards.
activity_berserkboss_desc_06: Kill the boss to get rewards instantly, or they will be mailed after the event ends.

activity_desc_99087:
1. Use Sportsopoly Tokens during the event to roll the dice and move forward based on the roll.
2. You can choose a single roll (1 die) or double roll (2 dice, rewards not doubled).
3. There are item, event, and starting squares. Item squares provide rewards, experience, and training points. Upgraded squares offer better rewards.
4. Stepping on an event square initiates a random event with potential surprises.
5. Crossing the starting square grants random rewards from 3 item squares and their experience. Rolling 2 dice help you reach faster.
6. Training points earned during the event (same for single and double rolls) can be used to complete event goals and claim rewards once the specified amount is reached. Each time you successfully claim a reward, the required points will be deducted from your current training points.
7. Event goals reset daily. If you meet the conditions but don't claim rewards from the previous day, they'll be sent via mail (with training points deducted). Any remaining training points will carry over to the next day. Points won't be sent to you after the event ends.
8. If a square's experience is maxed, further experience events will not increase it. The square will refresh with a Treasure Chest, granting rewards when landed on.
9. Buying mystery packs during Sportsopoly grants additional Diamonds and VIP points, equivalent to the Diamond Store (excluding the double portion).
10. Select auto-roll to automatically roll (1 die or 2 dice). Rewards will be placed in the temporary chest (click to claim the rewards). Training points will count towards goals immediately and won't go into the chest.
11. Sportsopoly Tokens will convert to Universal Speed-up items and be sent via mail at the event's end. Unclaimed items will expire but can be manually converted in the inventory. Conversion Rate: Sportsopoly Token *1 = 1-minute Universal Speed-up item *40. Sports Festival Lucky Box *1 = 1-minute Universal Speed-up *30.
activity_desc_99088:
1. During the event, you can use "Sports Festival Vouchers" in this shop to trade for various rewards.
2. Each item in the shop has a limit on how many times it can be exchanged. Once the limit is reached, no more exchanges can be made.
3. Items exchanged in the shop cannot be returned, so please exchange wisely.
4. After the shop closes, "Sports Festival Vouchers" will be converted into Universal Speed-up items and sent via mail. Items not converted in time will expire but can be manually converted in the inventory.
5. Conversion Rate: Sports Festival Voucher *1 = 1-minute Universal Speed-up item *20

Luck: Affects how often power-ups appear. Higher luck value means more power-ups.

winter_battlefield_tips1057:
Note: Kill scores, capture scores, and plunder scores are used to evaluate titles like MVP after the battle ends, they do not affect the battle outcome.
Kill score rules:
1. Each level 1 enemy unit killed grants 6 kill points.
2. Each level 2 enemy unit killed grants 9 kill points.
3. Each level 3 enemy unit killed grants 12 kill points.
4. Each level 4 enemy unit killed grants 15 kill points.
5. Each level 5 enemy unit killed grants 18 kill points.
6. Each level 6 enemy unit killed grants 21 kill points.
7. Each level 7 enemy unit killed grants 24 kill points.
8. Each level 8 enemy unit killed grants 27 kill points.
9. Each level 9 enemy unit killed grants 30 kill points.
10. Each level 10 enemy unit killed grants 33 kill points.
11. Each level 11 enemy unit killed grants 36 kill points.
12. Each of your level 1 unit that dies grants 2 kill points.
13. Each of your level 2 unit that dies grants 3 kill points.
14. Each of your level 3 unit that dies grants 4 kill points.
15. Each of your level 4 unit that dies grants 5 kill points.
16. Each of your level 5 unit that dies grants 6 kill points.
17. Each of your level 6 unit that dies grants 7 kill points.
18. Each of your level 7 unit that dies grants 8 kill points.
19. Each of your level 8 unit that dies grants 9 kill points.
20. Each of your level 9 unit that dies grants 10 kill points.
21. Each of your level 10 unit that dies grants 11 kill points.
22. Each of your level 11 unit that dies grants 12 kill points.
Capture score rules:
1. Each second you hold a building grants 500 capture points.
2. Each second you hold an airdrop location grants 2000 capture points.
Plunder score rules:
1. Capturing enemy buildings grants 100 plunder points for each victory point you earned.
2. Each victory point gained through airdrops grants 100 plunder points.

season_s2_alliance_building_desc01:
- The Alliance Furnace is a seasonal structure that vanishes when the season ends.
- The Alliance Furnace boosts the temperature in its range. Higher levels provide more heat.
- The Alliance Furnace is in a protected state during its initial construction.
- The Alliance Furnace can only be built within Lv.1 territory for its initial construction.
- The Alliance levels up the Furnace by collecting [Rare Soil].
- The Alliance Furnace automatically upgrades as the amount of [Rare Soil] increases. The more [Rare Soil] the Alliance has, the higher the Furnace level.
- The Alliance can continuously obtain [Rare Soil] by capturing Cities.
- If the Alliance's [Rare Soil] is plundered, the Furnace level drops accordingly.
season_s2_alliance_building_worldinfo01: Turning on the Alliance Furnace raises the temperature of the surrounding land, impacting all commanders within the area.
season_s2_alliance_building_desc02: To move the Alliance Furnace, build a Furnace Relocation Spot at the target site.
season_s2_alliance_building_worldinfo02:
When the Alliance Furnace Relocation Spot is complete, only Alliance Admins (R4 and above) can Move the Alliance Furnace.
Relocation is not allowed if the Alliance Furnace Relocation Spot's durability is insufficient.
Relocation is not allowed if the Alliance Furnace's durability is insufficient.
During the Beast Crisis, moving the Alliance Furnace while it's under attack will result in defense failure.
In the Rare Soil War, moving the Alliance Furnace is forbidden once the preparation and war stages begin.
After building the Alliance Center Relocation Spot, building another one will require a Cooldown of 4 hours.

season_s2_activity_story_desc01: The polar region, without its heat source, is quickly covered in snow. Many valuable supplies are buried underneath. If we can melt the snow, we can uncover these "treasures."
season_s2_activity_story_desc02:
Emperor Boreas has secretly been in touch with the Doom Legion for a long time. He commissioned Nier to create a virus that can survive at absolute zero - CL-7 (also known as Cryogenic Lifeform No. 7).
Now, only the Emperor's infected guards - soldiers and beasts - can move on this frozen wasteland. By boosting our virus resistance, we can eliminate them and show the Emperor our fiery resolve!
season_s2_activity_story_desc03:
When the severe cold hits, the people in the polar region use "coal" to keep the furnaces burning. It provides warmth and upgrades the titanium alloy factory, making it a vital resource.
Now, the Emperor's guards control all the coal mines. We must defeat them and take over the Digging Strongholds to have enough "coal" to thrive in the polar region.
season_s2_activity_story_desc04:
Some survivors were caught in an avalanche, and this dog led the rescue team to find them. The survivors call it "Snowflake" because it loves to roll in the snow.
However, it seems none of them are its owner. Commander, can you take care of "Snowflake"? Just feed it regularly. "Snowflake" is great at finding things in the snow and might bring you some surprises!
season_s2_activity_story_desc05:
Emperor Boreas was once a hero to be admired, but power corrupted him, turning the polar region into a frozen wasteland.
We must reclaim the frozen cities, relight the furnaces, and restore warmth to the land.
season_s2_activity_story_desc06:
Emperor Boreas has unleashed his strongest beast troops to attack us. Their main target is the Alliance Furnaces.
We must defend these heat sources and stop the Emperor's plans!
season_s2_activity_story_desc07:
Commander, you've done great in the polar region, but we're still short on Rare Soil. By joining local military groups, we can seize a large amount of it.
These groups have different ideologies and are at war. The [Rebels] fight against tyranny and aim to create a free federation after defeating the Emperor. The [Gendarmerie] were once loyal to the Emperor but now want a new ruler. Both factions are respectable, so we must choose our side carefully.
season_s2_activity_story_desc08:
Rare Soil, buried deep underground, has excellent thermal conductivity, quickly absorbing and storing heat. In the polar region, where heat is scarce, it's essential for survival.
Both the [Rebels] and the [Gendarmerie] are after it. This war is essentially a battle for Rare Soil. Whoever controls more will dominate the conflict.
season_s2_activity_story_desc09: Commander, we've come a long way, defeating the Emperor and saving the polar region. Now it's time to settle the conflict between the [Rebels] and the [Gendarmerie]. This will be an epic final battle. Stand firm with your faction and secure the ultimate victory!
season_s2_activity_story_desc10:
The Nuclear Furnace is at the polar center because it's the heat distribution hub. All warmth radiates from here to the rest of the region. This is why the Emperor froze it, plunging the entire region into ice.
While we've activated temporary furnaces in cities, it's not a long-term fix. We need to reclaim the Nuclear Furnace to bring back sustainable warmth.
season_s2_activity_story_desc11:
Violet's father, a brilliant scientist under Emperor Boreas, discovered Rare Soil, helping the polar people survive the brutal cold. Violet, driven by rebellion and justice, left to join the army, growing distant from her father but still yearning for his approval.
They arranged a long-awaited reunion, but tragedy struck.
Poison gas filled the restaurant, turning her father into a monster. Violet survived thanks to a military antibody injection.
Devastated, she vowed to continue his research and find the culprit, all clues leading to the tyrant Boreas. An assassination attempt on Boreas led to his mutation, causing chaos in the polar region.
Guilt-ridden, Violet used herself for virus research.
Now, under the commander's guidance, she returns to her frozen homeland. Determined to save her people and herself, Violet knows it's time for retribution. The final battle begins!
season_s2_activity_story_desc13: As the fight for Rare Soil heats up, both factions are ramping up their efforts to seize it. The battle has reached its peak, and any mistake could cause heavy losses!
season_s2_activity_story_desc14:
Commander! The nuclear furnace is free, and Emperor Boreas and his zombie guards have disappeared into the cold wave.
Though our victory is significant, the situation is still dire. The Nuclear Furnace is more damaged than we expected, requiring constant troop deployments for repairs.
Crucially, we must restart the furnace swiftly and race against other warzones. The sooner we get it operational, the more we can boost our warzone's temperature!
Commander, rally your forces and fight for our warzone!

season_s2_mail_desc005:
Dear Commanders,
Season II: Polar World is coming soon! Get ready with your allies to face new challenges!
Your warzone will be relocated to the distant northern polar region, which is covered with ice and snow all year round, with a cold climate, and rumors of giant beasts appearing.
In Season II, the ruler of the polar region - Emperor Boreas has shut down all heat sources, causing it to be completely covered by ice and snow. We have to defeat the Emperor and restore life to the polar region.
However, not only are we entrusted with this mission, but we also have to be careful of harassment from other warzones while fighting against the Emperor.
After the opening of Season II, the Level Cap for professions will be opened to Lv.70
Winter is coming, are you ready?
Note: The Warzone will transition at the start of the season. The server will restart after the transition is complete. Please avoid starting alliance events when the countdown to the season start reaches zero.

season_activity_1000039_des01:
ABOUT THE EVENT
1. After the event starts, the President can choose the faction of the warzone during the faction selection stage. Changing factions will trigger a cooldown each time. If your chosen faction is full, the President can use "Force Join" to add their warzone to that faction, displacing a random warzone to another faction. There is a cooldown period between each use of "Force Join."
2. Factions are divided into [Gendarmerie] and [Rebels], each with 4 warzones.
3. During the faction selection stage, the faction information of each warzone is hidden. During the faction announcement stage, this information becomes public.
4.The warzone faction affects the following [Rare Soil War] event. Alliances from different factions can declare war on each other for Rare Soil. If multiple Alliances declare war on one Alliance, the defending side can invite other Alliances from the same faction that have not been declared war upon to assist in defense during a specific time phase.
5. During the faction selection stage, the president can choose to [Show Faction], making their warzone information public early. Once revealed, you can't hide it again.
6. At the start of the faction selection stage, a preliminary grouping is made based on the strength of each warzone. This does not determine the final result, and the President can still use [Force Join] to choose a faction freely.
season_activity_1000040_des01:
ABOUT THE EVENT:
1. After the event begins, the warzone's faction determines attack and defense roles. The attack and defense roles will switch over time. When the attacking side wins a declaration of war, they can plunder a certain percentage of Rare Soil from the defending Alliance.
2. Each war declaration round includes five stages: declaration, invitation, preparation, war, and end of war.
3. Declaration: During this stage, R4 and above members in the attacking faction's Alliances can declare war on Alliances in the defending faction.
(1) Only one Alliance can be declared on at a time.
(2) You can only declare war on Alliances within the defending faction that are in the same Rare Soil ranking group as your Alliance.
(3) Up to three Alliances can declare war on one Alliance at the same time.
(4) The war target can be changed anytime during the declaration stage. The final target at the end of the stage becomes the war opponent.
4. Invitation: During this stage, if multiple Alliances declare war on a defending Alliance, R4 members of the defending Alliance can invite other Alliances from the same faction that have not been declared war upon to assist in defense.
(1) If three Alliances declare war, the defending side can invite up to two Alliances as defense partners. If two Alliances declare war, one Alliance can be invited.
(2) You can only invite Alliances within the defending faction that are in the same Rare Soil ranking group as your Alliance for defense support.
(3) If the invited Alliance agrees to defend, no further changes to defense partners can be made. If the R4 and above members of the invited Alliance do not agree, the R4 and above members of the inviting Alliance can change the defense invitation anytime.
(4) R3 members of the invited Alliance can vote on the invitation.
5. Preparation: During this stage, the war between the attacking and defending Alliances is confirmed and cannot be changed. The war stage begins after the preparation stage countdown ends. You can’t move the Alliance Furnace during the preparation stage.
6. War: During this stage, the defending Alliance's Furnace CAN be attacked. The attacking and defending Alliances can fight each other to determine the war's outcome.
(1) The attacking Alliance's Furnace does not need to be connected to the territory, and troops can directly execute attack commands. Defense partners entering the defending Alliance's Furnace won't engage with the inviter's or other defense partners' troops.
(2) If the attacking troops defeat all defending troops in the Furnace, they can reduce the Furnace's durability.
(3) If the Furnace is destroyed within the countdown, the attacking side wins, ending the war stage early.
(4) If the attacking side fails to destroy the Furnace within the countdown, the defending side wins.
(5) Certain actions during the war stage, such as killing enemy units or healing, can earn event points. Reaching point milestones will earn corresponding rewards.
(6) The war stage duration will vary based on the number of Alliances on the attacking and defending sides. The specific time is shown in the war stage countdown in the event interface.
(7) During the war stage, the Furnace's durability will not automatically recover, nor can the Furnace be relocated.
(8) If the defending Alliance's Furnace has 0 durability or hasn't been constructed when the battle begins, the defense will be considered lost. The attacking side will loot Rare Soil (divided evenly among multiple attacking Alliances).
7. End of war: During this stage, rewards are sent based on the war's final outcome.
(1) The winning Alliance can receive victory rewards in the event interface. If the defending Alliances (including defense partners) are fewer than the attackers, the rewards will be boosted, up to three times the normal rewards.
(2) If the attacking side wins, they can plunder a portion of Rare Soil from the defending Alliance (defense partners are NOT affected).
(3) When multiple Alliances are attacking, the Rare Soil rewards will be distributed proportionally based on the damage each Alliance did to the furnace durability, while the defender's Rare Soil loss remains the same.
(4) The end of war stage lasts until server time 0:00 the next day. Unclaimed victory and event point rewards will be sent via mail.
(5) If the defending Alliance's R4 does not rebuild the Furnace ruins by the end of this stage, the ruins will be automatically rebuilt.

ABOUT THE EVENT:
1. After the event starts, the time consumed by the Alliance to capture the Digging Stronghold is recorded and ranked.
2. The higher the level of the Digging Stronghold captured by the Alliance, the higher the ranking. When the level of the Digging Stronghold captured is the same, the Alliance that captures faster ranks higher.

season_s2_food_activity_51:
The stray dog, Snowflake, is hungry and cold. Commander, please help it.
GUIDELINES:
1. Commanders can earn ingredients from daily tasks in the new game season.
2. There are 4 types of ingredients: Meat, Fruits/Vegetables, Dairy, and Flour. Use these ingredients to create different dishes.
3. The dog's tastes may change. Check the “Recipe” function on the event page for how to make food. After receiving food, the dog will give the commander some treasures it found in the snow.
4. If the food matches the dog's taste, the rewards will be better. Try to make food that suits its taste!
season_activity_1000037_des02:
ABOUT THE EVENT:
1. Once the territory is connected to the City (including diagonally), R5/R4 members of the Alliance can declare war on the City.
2. After the declaration, Cities can be captured. Only one City can be targeted by each Alliance at a time. Losing the territory linked to the city mid-way through a war declaration will abort the declaration and prevent the capture of the target city.
3. Without Digging Strongholds or Cities, an Alliance must first capture a Lv. 1 Digging Stronghold. Connected territories allow further declarations.
4. Troops will be affected by toxins during sieges. Please increase troop Virus Resistance to reduce impact.
5. Siege battles are risky, with a portion of units dying directly. The specific ratio is detailed on Cities.
6. There will be first-time City capture rewards for participants. Alliance members will also receive City rewards. Alliances receive Loot chests as well, distributed by R5 or R4.
7. After capturing a City, all Alliance members get buffs. The City enters a protected state for a period, during which it can't be declared war upon by others.
8. When a city is captured by another Alliance, it also enters a protection period. Abandoning a city does not reset the protection countdown.
9. After declaring war on a city you've abandoned, there's a waiting period.
10. The number of Digging Strongholds and Cities that can be captured each day is limited. The total number of Cities your Alliance can capture does not affect the total number of Digging Strongholds. You can view the exact limits in the [Alliance] -> [Alliance Cities] section.
season_activity_1000038_des01:
ABOUT THE EVENT:
1. Once the event begins, mutant beasts will attack the Alliance Furnace every Tuesday and Friday.
2. A warning will be issued before the beasts' attack, so Alliance members can prepare for it.
3. Successfully defending against the beasts earns rewards. More waves defended means better rewards.
4. If your defense fails, the mutated beast will damage the Alliance Furnace (You can still earn rewards for each successfully defended wave that follows). Once the Furnace's durability drops to 0, it will turn into ruins, and you won't be able to collect rewards from future waves.
5. If there's a warning and the Alliance has no Furnace or it's already ruined, it's a defense failure, and no rewards are given.
6. During the beasts' attack, the Furnace can be moved, but the beasts' target stays the same. Failing to kill these beasts means a defense failure.

season_activity_1000041_des01:
ABOUT THE EVENT
1. The Faction Duel is the ultimate battle between the [Rebels] and [Gendarmerie], with the winning faction claiming a large amount of Rare Soil.
2. The duel lasts 7 days: Monday to Saturday are for contesting invasion rights, and Sunday is the battle day.
3. During the contest stage, the 4 warzones of the same faction will compete for points against the opposing faction. The faction with the most points earns attack rights.
4. Battles take place in the defending faction's highest-ranked Rare Soil warzone.
5. After the battle begins, in Cannon and Capitol battles, commanders within the same faction will support each other, and victory is determined by capture progress of factions.
6. The Rare Soil reward for the winning side depends on how many buildings are held by the faction at the end of the battle:
Control Capitol: +10M
Control each Cannon: +5M
7. Please note, the Rare Soil resources only affect the [Faction] leaderboard, and the winning faction's Alliance won't get any additional Rare Soil.

season_s2_desc01:
In the far northern polar region, there's a forbidden zone, tamed by ice and snow, making it barren and lifeless. Once bustling cities are now snow-covered, with buildings like icy tombs, as if time has stopped. Thick snow covers the streets, and cold winds howl through frozen alleys, producing ghostly roars.

This place once had a prosperous industrial nation. Despite its strength, its people endured a "heat crisis." The old government banned personal fires to control people, providing paid central heating instead. The people hated this, and many poor froze to death in the streets.

A hero eventually overthrew the old government, lifted the "fire ban," and built large furnaces in every city, ending the "heat crisis." He was the last king, Emperor Boreas, but the demon slayer became a demon himself. His brutal rule caused people to revolt, and he was attacked by Violet, forcing him to hide in an ice cellar with biochemical weapons. Facing freezing to death, he had no choice but to break the dangerous containers in the ice cellar, surrounding himself with viral gas. 

Miraculously, the low temperatures kept the virus inactive, preventing him from becoming a monster. He kept his mind and gained great power but could only survive in extreme cold.

With this power, he destroyed all who opposed him and shut down all furnaces, turning the nation into a dead city.

To restore life to the polar region, our army will march north, vowing to defeat the mad Emperor Boreas, liberate the cities from his control, open the furnaces, and bring warmth back to this land!
season_s2_desc02:

- Bases with low temperatures will freeze, and allies can help break the ice and raise the base temperature.
- Stay warm by working with your allies and Alliance.
season_s2_mail_desc006:
Dear Commanders,
Welcome to the new season!
Winter is here, and the conditions are harsher than we expected, we can only set up bases on the outskirts for now.
But your Alliance is united and ready for any challenge!

To get started with the new season, follow these tips:
1. Read the season manual to learn about new features.
2. Follow the season tasks to play.
3. Plan Alliance tactics based on Alliance milestones.
4. Check World Dynamics for new season activities.
You can also ask strategists in your Alliance for help!
Happy hunting!
season_s2_mail_desc007:
Dear Commanders,
As the battles have ceased, the season has ended and we have entered the settlement period. We appreciate your dedication and exceptional efforts throughout the season!
During this time, the following changes will occur:
1. Rankings for the season are now locked in place.
2. R5 or Butler can distribute member rewards based on Alliance reward tiers.
3. Season-specific events and features will be closed and reset or removed gradually.
4. Season-specific cross-warzone teleport will be disabled.
5.War declarations or attacks on Cities and Strongholds are disabled, and season resources (rare soil, coal) will stop generating.
6. [Season Battle Pass] and [Season Weekly Pass] can no longer be purchased.
7. Note: Reminder: [Titanium Alloy], [Coal], and [Dog Food Ingredients] will be cleared at the end of the season and converted into profession EXP.
8. Note: Alliance Loots will also be cleared at the end of the season, so Alliance admin should distribute rewards in time!
9. Individual and  Alliance season buildings will be removed at the end of the season.
10. The following will remain unchanged: profession levels, profession EXP, profession EXP items, and city capture status in this warzone.

Thank you again for your participation. Stay tuned for the off-season celebration event!
season_s2_mail_desc008:
Dear Commanders,
Your bravery during the season has once again saved the world. Thank you for your active participation, the season has successfully ended, and the season entrance is now closed.

Here's what's changed:
1. The world has returned to warm weather, and all temperature-related gameplay has been disabled.
2. All Individual and Alliance season buildings have been removed (your power may drop as a result).
3. Season-specific skills have been reset, and all skill points have been returned.
4. The bonus effects from the Game Season Boost event have been removed.
5. Season tasks have been reset and cleared.
6. Exclusive season resources and items have been removed (Titanium Alloy, Coal, Dog Food Ingredients, Rare Soil).
7. The game season hero recruitment event has ended (any remaining tickets can be used in the next season).
8. The game season monsters, frozen survivors, and polar guests have disappeared.

But remember, the tides of war are ever-changing, and new challenges are on the horizon! In the next season, we will embark on a new adventure and continue to build the legend!

The Polar Cold Wave was once a rare climate event. When it hit, fierce winds and blizzards swept the polar region, temperatures dropped sharply, and people had to overdrive their Furnaces just to keep their homes warm.
But the CL-7 (Cryogenic Lifeform No. 7) receptor lowers the surrounding temperature, making cold waves more frequent. As the virus spreads, the Polar Cold Wave happens more often and becomes more dangerous.
We must, like the locals, overdrive our furnaces to survive these tough times.

hero_backstory_desc_40012:
Violet is in her early twenties, with a resume that seems intentionally altered, leaving no trace of her past. She is rebellious and mysterious, rarely sincere with others. Her purple hair, hidden under her long robe, sways like a snake's tongue, full of danger and allure.

Surprisingly, this young lady is a rare virologist in the military, focused on finding viral weaknesses and creating biochemical weapons to fight the virus, displaying remarkable talent. Her knowledge seems to come from an old, carefully kept notebook, of unknown origin.

Violet looks enchanting, but few can win her heart. No one wants to be her test subject.
hero_backstory_desc_50025:
A secret message kept Violet awake all night. The person she loved and hated was making a world-changing decision.

Early the next morning, Violet left without a word. She put on her coat, hid the old notebook in her pocket, and headed alone to the icy polar region.

"Eternal beauty and love" is a Violet's floral meaning and her father's name for her. As a child, she and her father were close, and she learned medicine from him. The notebook was part of that legacy. But the good times ended. Her father joined Emperor Boreas's research team to modify the W virus for cold temperatures. Violet couldn't understand his actions and left home to join the military.

Now, her father sent her a secret message, revealing the truth. He pretended to help the Emperor but was delaying the virus's development. His plan was discovered, so he stole the new virus, Cryogenic Lifeform No. 7 (a.k.a. CL7), to give to the Emperor's enemies.

"If I get the code, I can help the commander defeat the Emperor," thought Violet, deciding to meet her father.

But she found a cold corpse instead of a warm embrace. Memories flashed, and her grief and anger grew. She picked up her sniper rifle for revenge.

After a thrilling revenge, the Emperor got infected with CL7, surviving only in cold temperatures. His power grew, freezing the polar region. Calm again, Violet took a virus sample from her father's body and returned to base. It was time for a new weapon. To achieve eternal beauty and love, she would become the virus's eternal enemy.

season_s2_activity_100041_plot_03: But this time, it's not just a battle between warzones...it's a faction war!
season_s2_activity_100041_plot_04: I don't really get it, I just see more people and more chaos!

season_s2_activity_100045_plot_04: You'll get used to it in time, I'll go light the furnace.
season_s2_ppt_week_1_desc1: To crush Emperor Boreas's ambitions, you and your allies are gathering on the outskirts of the polar region. It's very cold and the temperature drops further as you approach the center.
season_s2_ppt_week_1_desc3: Temperature is a major challenge in the polar region and will continuously impact your base's stats. Your base temperature will slowly align with the environment, and maintaining higher temperatures will give you bonus stats.
season_s2_ppt_week_1_desc9: In the polar region, blizzards caused by severe cold waves will come at intervals. When they hit, the temperature across the region falls, with stronger blizzards causing even greater drops.
season_s2_ppt_week_1_desc10: Beyond the freezing conditions, Emperor Boreas's army is also a formidable foe. Teaming up with your allies and helping each other will make us stronger.
season_s2_ppt_week_1_desc14: To face the extreme conditions and survival challenges of the polar region, the following season buildings and resources will support you and your allies. At the season's end, these resources will be converted into Profession EXP, and the buildings will be dismantled.
season_s2_ppt_week_1_desc19: Emperor Boreas is hidden deep within the polar region, using the cold and his virus army to resist. Make sure your territory stays connected and advance steadily to secure victory.
season_s2_ppt_week_1_desc22: As our power increases, we've gradually taken over all the cities on the polar outskirts. It's time to move the Alliance Furnace forward and push deeper into the polar region!
season_s2_ppt_week_2_desc24: Emperor Boreas sent mutant beasts to push us out of the polar region, and they're aiming for our Alliance Furnace. If it's destroyed, the freezing cold could severely harm us. Act now, wipe out the mutant beasts, and defend our furnace!
season_s2_ppt_week_2_desc25: “Snowflake” uncovered survivors beneath the snow. It always seems to find something special in the icy landscape to cook up its favorite meals. Maybe it'll surprise you!
season_s2_ppt_week_3_desc26: Through many battles, Violet has gained new insights...She's on the verge of a transformation!
season_s2_ppt_week_3_desc27: Even though we've established ourselves in the polar region, defeating Emperor Boreas will still need help from local groups. Each group has its own beliefs, and joining one will make enemies of the others. We must choose wisely.
season_s2_ppt_week_4_desc30: What began as small disputes grew into ideological conflict, dragging the commanders of both factions back into war... Rare Soil, crucial to modern industry, is now the target. The side with the most will claim the final say.
season_s2_ppt_week_4_desc34: The Nuclear Furnace sits at the heart of the Polar Region, packed with endless energy and generating heat that can cover the entire region.
season_s2_ppt_week_5_desc35: Even though Emperor Boreas has been defeated, the Nuclear Furnace has been left in ruins by the war. The mission to save the polar region isn't over yet. Only by restarting the Nuclear Furnace can we truly bring warmth back.
season_s2_ppt_week_6_desc36: The war rages on, and the fight for Rare Soil is reaching its peak. If the attackers win, they can seize a greater portion of the defenders' Rare Soil.
season_s2_ppt_week_7_desc37: As the war draws to a close, both factions are locked in a final battle. Seize the enemy's Nuclear Furnace to bring this war to an end!
season_s2_ppt_week_1_desc2: Once cities in the Polar Region are captured, they will start producing Rare Soil over time. Rare Soil is a crucial Alliance resource this season, and at the end of the season, alliances will be ranked by how much they have. The higher the rank, the better the rewards.
season_s2_ppt_week_1_desc4: When the base temperature reaches 40°C, an “On Fire” countdown begins. Once it ends, the base will start burning, losing durability over time. You can extinguish the fire manually or with help from allies. If the temperature remains above 40°C, the countdown will restart.
season_s2_ppt_week_1_desc5: When the base temperature hits -20°C, a “Frozen” countdown begins. After it ends, the base will freeze, preventing the use of “Advanced Relocation” and rallying. Besides the commander's base, all units will also freeze at -20°C.
season_s2_ppt_week_1_desc6: When a target is “Frozen,” you'll need to send troops to “Break the Ice” before you can capture or attack. Icebreaking uses Stamina, and completing it grants Profession EXP.
season_s2_ppt_week_1_desc7: You can deploy a recon plane to 'Warm Up' an ally, which consumes coal and increases their base temperature.
season_s2_ppt_week_1_desc8: Temperature impacts the surface. The lower it is, the more ice and snow will cover it. When the surface temperature rises above 0°C, the ice and snow will melt, revealing hidden resources that can be collected by recon planes.
season_s2_ppt_week_1_desc11: Polar zombies and mutant beasts carry lots of viruses. Troops need to upgrade the “High-heat Furnace” to boost their Virus Resistance for better performance. If resistance is too low, forced attacks might result in severe losses, so proceed with caution.
season_s2_ppt_week_1_desc12: A large Furnace built by the Alliance that raises the temperature in a set area when turned on. Overdrive the Alliance Furnace for more heat, but this uses more coal. The Alliance Furnace will be removed at the end of the season.
season_s2_ppt_week_1_desc13: Defeating polar monsters will reward you with season resources that can be used to upgrade buildings and tackle upcoming challenges.
season_s2_ppt_week_1_desc15: This is a game season resource, used to build season buildings. The [Titanium Alloy Factory] produces Titanium Alloy continuously, and these resources will be converted into Profession EXP at the end of the season.
season_s2_ppt_week_1_desc16: This is a game season resource, used to build seasonal structures or to fuel the [High-heat Furnace]. Capturing Digging Strongholds allows continuous Coal production, and these resources will be converted into Profession EXP at the end of the season.
season_s2_ppt_week_1_desc17: This is a game season building that resists cold and viruses, providing Virus Resistance. When activated, it uses a small amount of season resources to raise the environmental temperature. Overdriving the High-heat Furnace increases the temperature but consumes more season resources. Using [Titanium Alloy] upgrades the furnace. Higher levels offer more virus resistance and higher heat when ignited. The furnace will be removed at the end of the season.
season_s2_ppt_week_1_desc20: Digging Strongholds were once crucial for producing coal, but they've been taken over by mutant beasts under Emperor Boreas's control. Defeat the beasts, reclaim the Digging Strongholds, and resume coal production.
season_s2_ppt_week_1_desc21: All cities in the Polar Region have heating systems, but Emperor Boreas ordered them shut down. Reclaim the cities, activate the furnaces, and raise the temperature across the city.
season_s2_ppt_week_1_desc23: As the furnace level rises, the alliance's coal needs grow. Capture advanced Digging Strongholds to solve the issue.
season_s2_ppt_week_3_desc28: Some commanders think the new polar region needs new rules, so they formed the “Gendarmerie,” vowing to uphold their idea of justice!
season_s2_ppt_week_3_desc29: Some commanders think the people of the polar region should go back to their normal lives, so they created the “Rebels,” willing to fight to the bitter end for freedom!
season_s2_ppt_week_4_desc33: On Wednesdays and Saturdays, the attacking side will face the defending Alliance in battle. If the attackers succeed, they can plunder a share of the defenders' Rare Soil.
season_s2_ppt_week_1_desc18: This game season building generates [Titanium Alloy] continuously. Upgrade the factory with [Coal] to boost production speed. All factories will be removed after the season ends.
season_s2_ppt_week_4_desc31: War Declaration Days are on Tuesdays and Fridays (server time), where one faction attacks while the other defends. Declarations can only target opposing Alliances with the same Rare Soil ranking group. The attacking faction rotates weekly.
season_s2_ppt_week_4_desc32: Once the War Declaration stage ends, if several Alliances declare war on one, the defending Alliance can invite other Alliances in the same faction with the same Rare Soil ranking group to help defend.

hospital_quick_rule:
1. When you manually adjust the number of wounded units to treat some of them, the system will save the time needed as the default for the next treatment.
2. When you choose to treat all the wounded units, the system will reset the default and set the next treatment to treat all.
3. If you don't have enough resources to treat all the wounded, the system will adjust the number treated based on available resources.

season_ice_survivor_28: Phew, thank goodness! I was sure I'd never see the storm again!
season_ice_survivor_29: No problem! It's all because of our commander!
season_ice_survivor_30: Commander? Are you all some kind of army?
season_ice_survivor_31: Actually, we're a bunch of huge armies! The strong kind!
season_ice_survivor_32: Oh! Count me in! I'll help you take down Boreas and his zombie empire!
season_ice_survivor_33: So warm... did I make it to paradise?
season_ice_survivor_34: Not quite, but our base is pretty warm! Rest there first.
season_ice_survivor_35: Oh! So warm! I love it! I haven't been warm since the emperor shut down all the city furnaces!
season_ice_survivor_36: Lucky you! Our base has a big furnace!
season_ice_survivor_37: Who are you? Where am I? My name is...
season_ice_survivor_38: Hey, hold on! Quit asking those dumb questions! It's so cliché!
season_ice_survivor_39: Fine, fine. The way you look and talk, you're definitely my savior.
season_ice_survivor_40: Bingo. How about I get you a place to stay too?
season_ice_survivor_41: That'd be awesome! Got any food? Wine? Heat?
season_ice_survivor_42: Whoa! Are you poisoned? Your lips are really purple!
season_ice_survivor_43: Guess I'll have to put you back in the ice!
season_ice_survivor_44: No, no! I'm just concerned about you.
season_ice_survivor_45: Oh, is that right? Looks like I got you wrong. Want to come home with me?
season_ice_survivor_47: You saved me, right? You look familiar.
season_ice_survivor_49: Ah! I got it! Your wanted posters were everywhere before the city froze!
season_ice_survivor_50: I've always had a lot of followers. The more they talk about me, the more the emperor fears me.
season_ice_survivor_51: You're not just my idol—you're my hero! Please let me join! I need to defeat the emperor and avenge my family!
season_ice_survivor_53: Oh, now I remember! You were with my father. We really shouldn't have saved you.
season_ice_survivor_54: You've got it wrong. I've always been on the doctor's side and helped delay CL-7.
season_ice_survivor_56: Take me to your base. I'll prove it through my actions!
season_ice_survivor_57: Cough cough! I can't go on.
season_ice_survivor_58: You're lucky to be alive. Follow me, and you might survive a little longer.
season_ice_survivor_59: What a comforting thing to say.
season_ice_survivor_60: What's really comforting is fire and wine. Our commander is the one who can make spring bloom in this frozen land.
season_ice_survivor_61: If that's true, I'll survive to the end and give my all to warm this land!

season_s2_stronghold_desc01:
The battle for Stronghold lasts up to 4 hours. Once ended, the zone enters a 36-hour protection stage.
During this season, each alliance can capture up to 2 Strongholds per day, and hold a maximum of 4 in total.
If the capture progress is not 100% when the timer ends, the capture fails.
Note: If the Stronghold was neutral, it will go to the alliance with the highest capture progress.
season_s2_city_desc01:
The City's first protection period ends at 12:00 server time.
After capturing the City, protection lasts until 12:00 server time 6 days later on the next natural day.
Each declaration lasts up to 1 hour, and exceeding the limit counts as a failed capture.
In this season, an alliance can declare war on 2 Cities per day, with a maximum of 6 Cities total.

emergency_center_desc_1013:
After the troops finish a battle and return to the base, we'll save some units who were supposed to die, turning them into critically wounded units. The Rescue Center will receive these units and attempt to save them. There is a limit on the number of critically wounded units that can be received. If this limit is exceeded, the units will die.
Rescue units instantly using resources. There's a cooldown between rescues, during which the rescue function is unavailable.
Upgrading the Rescue Center will increase the conversion rate of dying units to critically wounded units, the intake limit for critically wounded units, and reduce the rescue cooldown time, helping you minimize unit losses in battle!

Note: Only battles that take place on the World Map may result in critically wounded units. Battles in areas like the Desert Battlefield or Winter Battlefield will not result in critically wounded units, as there are no real casualties.

ghostrecon_rules: No.2487 Ghost Ops Guide: 1. Only commanders with a Base Level of 18 or higher can join Ghost Ops (Higher base levels likely mean better rewards, right? ^^) 2. Every Thursday, the Secret Command Post will release 3 Ghost Ops missions. These missions must be carried out in other warzones, with available times as follows: Server Time 00:00-03:00, 06:00-09:00, 12:00-15:00, 18:00-21:00. Signals will be cut off during other times, so missions can't be executed (Better set your alarms...) 3. Inviting allies to team up for these missions is the best choice! You can find many teams within the Ally Team. If you can't find one, you can complete it solo... Well, it's better than wasting the opportunity. 4. Important! After completing a mission, you need to MANUALLY claim the reward. Allies can't claim it for you (It's quicker to claim at the Secret Command Post). 5. Every commander who participates in a mission will receive rewards. If you complete special conditions in UR rarity missions, you'll get super generous special rewards (Teaming up makes it easier to meet these conditions! So team up!) 6. season_s2_activity_1000047_description_1:
The Nuclear Furnace has been captured, waking Glacieradon from its deep underground sleep. Glacieradon is a major threat to the Furnace - kill it and restart the Furnace!
RULES:
1. There are 4 Glacieradons, appearing from the four corners of the map and moving through cities toward the Nuclear Furnace.
2. Glacieradon cannot be attacked while on the move. If it crosses cities held by commanders, it will stop and attack the city, allowing commanders to fight back.
3. When Glacieradon attacks a city, Alliance members of that city can send troops to defend. Successfully defending against Glacieradon's attack will keep the city safe from damage.
4. Daily attacks on Glacieradon are limited and reset at 00:00 server time.
5. Defending Glacieradon's attack against cities won't reduce its HP.
6. Glacieradon periodically decreases the Nuclear Furnace's activation progress by a percentage. At the time of event settlement, Warzone rewards are distributed based on activation progress rankings. If progress is tied, the Warzone that achieved it first ranks higher. After the settlement, a display period begins, during which Warzones that haven't eliminated Glacieradon or activated the Nuclear Furnace can continue, but their progress will no longer affect the leaderboard. Once the event ends, any Glacieradon that remains will automatically disappear, and no Warzone kill rewards will be issued.

1. After defeating Glacieradon, commanders in the faction can claim rewards in the event interface.
2. You can attack Glacieradon up to 5 times daily. Attack attempts on different Glacieradon are counted separately.

activity_desc_98009_new2:
1. During the event, Commanders can spend diamonds to draw lots, with one free chance to draw lots every day. Drawing lots will definitely yield item rewards, and there is a chance to get additional Supply Boxes.
2. Opening Supply Boxes requires keys. The higher the rarity of the Supply Box, the better the rewards, but the more keys are required.
3. There is a chance to obtain an unlocked free supply box, opening this box does not require a key.
4. Commanders can hold up to four unopened Supply Boxes at the same time. If the number of Supply Boxes held by the Commander has reached the limit, no new Supply Boxes will be obtained from the draw.
5. When Commanders open Supply Boxes, there is a 5% chance of a critical hit, yielding double rewards.
6. During the event, Commanders can earn extra points when drawing lots and opening Supply Boxes. When the accumulated points reach a certain value, progress rewards can be claimed.

season_s2_camp_war_info01:
From Monday to Saturday is the Faction Points Race Phase. The Faction with higher points gains the invasion right. 
The invaders can head to the highest-ranking Rare Soil warzone of the opposing faction on Sunday and attempt to seize their Capitol.
The faction with lower points becomes the defenders, who need to protect their Capitol in the highest Rare Soil ranking warzone of their own faction on Sunday. 
Faction points can be obtained by completing following acts:
season_s2_camp_war_info02:
Schedule
Saturday [24:00:00] 
Faction scoring contest ends
Sunday [00:04:00]
Invasion and defense zones are determined based on Faction points.
Sunday [00:05:00] 
Invading Faction commanders can teleport to the defending warzone. 
Sunday [12:00:00] 
Capitol and giant cannons are removed from protected status and officially enter the capture stage. 
Sunday [12:00:00]~[16:00:00] 
The winner of the Faction Duel is decided. 
Sunday [24:00:00] 
Enemy elimination event ends, and the ranking rewards are settled. 

Capitol Defense Rules 
When Capitol Defense begins, the 4 giant cannons become available for capture as well. 
In battles for Capitol and giant cannons, commanders from the same faction are considered of the same side, meaning no combat among them. 
For example, when Alliance A from [Gendarmerie] faction seizes the Capitol, commanders from Alliance B [Gendarmerie] faction will assist in defending the structure when dispatched to Capitol.
The Capitol can accommodate up to 100 garrisoned troops. 
A giant cannon can accommodate up to 100 garrisoned troops. 

Giant Cannon Capabilities 
Giant cannons are crucial strategic weapons in Capitol defense. 
After capturing a giant cannon, it automatically attacks the enemy-held Capitol and kills certain amounts of units garrisoned inside at regular intervals. 
When your side tries to seize the Capitol, the captured giant cannon significantly accelerates the Capitol capture. 

Successful Capitol Capture 
Capitol Defense lasts a maximum of 4 hours, if both warzones stay below 100%, the defenders win. 
The winning faction will receive a substantial amount of [Faction Rare Soil] at the end of the battle if the Capitol is under their control and based on the number of Cannons collected.
Control Capitol +10M
Control each Giant Cannon +5M
Once the Capitol contest ends, leaderboard rankings will be locked (commanders can still earn points and collect chests).

season_s2_activity_1000051_desc01:
After the Nuclear Furnace is captured, the sound of battle awakens Glacieradon from deep underground. Glacieradon is a major threat to the Furnace - kill it and restart the Furnace!
RULES:
1. There are 4 Glacieradons, each day after the event begins, one Glacieradon will appear. They come from the four corners of the map and moving through cities toward the Nuclear Furnace.
2. Glacieradon cannot be attacked while on the move. If it crosses cities held by commanders, it will stop and attack the city, allowing commanders to fight back.
3. When Glacieradon attacks a city, Alliance members of that city can send troops to defend. Successfully defending against Glacieradon's attack will keep the city safe from damage.
4. Daily attacks on each Glacieradon are limited and reset at 00:00 server time.
5. Defending your city from Glacieradon's attack also reduces its HP.
6. Glacieradon will gradually reduce the Furnace's activation progress over time. Once fully activated, Glacieradon can no longer interfere with the process.
7. Commanders in the same faction can help each other attack Glacieradon in their warzones, or assist in activating each other's furnaces to speed up the process.
8. When the faction successfully activates the furnace and defeats Glacieradon, rewards can be collected from the event page.

activity_godzilla_rule: Kill Invading Zombies 1. When the Zombie Invasion starts, large numbers of zombies will appear on the World Map. Commanders can use the event interface to quickly find the nearest zombies. 2.After killing zombies, commanders will earn Courage Medals, which can be used in the event shop to exchange for various rewards. 3. There's a small chance that a Zombie Boss will appear after killing zombies. The Boss offers great rewards but is extremely powerful, so commanders must rally their troops to defeat it. 4. During the Zombie Invasion, the damage commanders deal to the Zombie Boss will be tracked and ranked. After the event, ranking rewards will be sent to your mail. The more damage you deal, the better the rewards. 5. All commanders who participated in the Zombie Invasion will receive a defense reward at the end of the event. Glacieradon Appears 1. Defeating the Zombie Bosses earns Glacieradon progress points for your Alliance. 2. Once enough points are gathered, the Alliance leader and R4 can trigger the Glacieradon challenge manually. 3. Each Alliance can only begin the Glacieradon challenge once per event. Battle with Glacieradon 1. Glacieradon uses ice attacks that freeze commander bases, preventing relocation or rallying. 2. You can attack Glacieradon up to 30 times during the event. 3. Every successful attack reduces Glacieradon's HP and may trigger a critical hit that deals multiple times the damage. 4. The challenge lasts 60 minutes. If Glacieradon's HP hits 0, it's defeated. If not, it will escape. Glacieradon Rewards 1. Every successful attack earns an attack reward, with critical hits yielding multiplied rewards. 2. The player who deals the final blow gets a 10x attack reward. (If the final blow is a critical hit, e.g., x2, the final reward will be 12x.) 3. When Glacieradon is defeated, it drops Glacieradon's Treasure. Collect it for a large reward. (New Alliance members cannot collect treasure within 24 hours of joining.) 4. If Glacieradon is defeated in time, All alliance members get a reward mail. If not, everyone gets a participation reward. (Each player can only get the reward mail once per event.) 5. Glacieradon leaves 2 hours before the event ends, and no more challenges can be started after that. Plan your challenges wisely.

dispatchtask_level_35_rule: ABOUT THE EVENT: 1. You can send heroes to undertake Secret Tasks everyday. Each mission takes time to complete before rewards can be collected. 2. There are 7 levels of mission difficulty, scaling with your base's level. Higher difficulties mean better rewards. 3. Each Secret Task offers different rewards. You can refresh non-initiated Secret Tasks to select ones with the rewards you want. However, missions with red stars won't refresh, as they offer the highest rewards. The drop rates for Secret Tasks of different rarities upon refreshing are as follows: SR missions: 68% SSR missions: 24% UR missions: 8% 4. N secret missions reset daily at server time 0:00, while a starred mission appears every three days. Manage your time efficiently. 5. You can plunder rewards from non-allies and assist allies in collecting theirs. Maintain a strong mutual aid bond with your allies. 6. migration_activity_interface_10119:
After transferring to a new Warzone, your activity data will be handled according to these rules:

[Warzone Rankings]
1. You will be removed from the original Warzone leaderboard and placed on the new one.
2. If rankings are tied, the time of achievement will be based on your new Warzone entry time.

[Apex Arena]
1. Your eligibility for Apex Arena will depend on the new Warzone leaderboard. Once eligible, you'll join the arena in the last position.
2. Your challenge attempts will reset when you transfer to a new Warzone.
3. Since there's a delay in updating the warzone rankings, entering the Apex Arena may take some time after transfer. Please wait patiently.

[Storm Arena]
1. Eligibility for Storm Arena will be determined by the new Warzone leaderboard. Once eligible, your points will reset, and you'll be added to the arena.
2. Your challenge attempts will reset when you transfer to a new Warzone.
3. Since there's a delay in updating the warzone rankings, entering the 3v3 Brawl may take some time after transfer. Please wait patiently.

[3v3 Brawl]
1. Eligibility for 3v3 Brawl will be determined by the new Warzone leaderboard. Once eligible, your points will reset, and you'll be added to the arena.
2. Your challenge attempts will reset when you transfer to a new Warzone.
3. Since there's a delay in updating the warzone rankings, entering the 3v3 Brawl may take some time after transfer. Please wait patiently.

[Alliance Duel]
1. Your personal points and those earned for the old Warzone Alliance will be kept.
2. After joining your first Alliance in the new Warzone, you can immediately start earning Alliance points without waiting for a day.
3. Unclaimed point chests will be mailed to you during the transfer.

[Radar Tasks]
1. Progress on active tasks will be kept and can be continued in the new Warzone.
2. Completed but unclaimed tasks can still be collected.
3. Your remaining task attempts and refresh times will carry over to the new Warzone.
4. You don't need to wait 24 hours after joining an alliance to compete for the Excavator reward.

[Secret Mobile Squad]
1. Ongoing tasks will transfer and can be completed in the new Warzone.
2. Tasks that are finished but not yet claimed will still be rewarded.
3. The tasks and remaining attempts from the original Warzone will carry over to the new one.

[Ghost Ops]
1. Tasks in progress will be instantly completed when you transfer to a new Warzone, with rewards sent by mail.
2. Remaining task attempts and completion count will be transferred.

[Intercity Trade]
1. Upon transferring, any ongoing trucks and trains with you as the conductor will be completed right away.
2. Your dispatch and plunder counts will carry over without resetting.
3. After joining the first Alliance in the new Warzone, the cooldown for Alliance trains won't trigger, and you can join trains or become the train conductor right away.
4. When transferring, if you're the train conductor and the train is in the prep stage, the passengers will be automatically selected, and the train will go straight to its destination.
5. The transfer will reset the truck's rarity. Be sure to dispatch it promptly.

[Alliance Exercise]
1. When you transfer to a new warzone and join your first alliance, the first-day cooldown for Alliance Exercise won't apply.
2. Note: Alliance Exercise rewards can only be claimed once every two days.

[General's Trial]
1. Your challenge difficulty and progress will carry over to the new Warzone.
2. After transferring, previously claimed rewards cannot be reclaimed.

[Doom Walker]
First-kill attempts from your original Warzone will carry over.

[Wanted Boss]
1. After transferring to a new Warzone, your attack attempts, rewards, and achievement progress will carry over.
2. Your damage stats from the original Warzone leaderboard will be transferred, placing you in the appropriate position on the new Warzone leaderboard.

[Desert Storm Battlefield]
 After transferring to the new Warzone, joining your first alliance will not trigger the 1-day cooldown, allowing you to register immediately.

[Zombie Siege]
1. After transferring to a new Warzone, you can join the first Alliance without triggering the 48-hour event cooldown, allowing you to take part and earn rewards as normal.
2. Please be noted: If the event has already started when you join an Alliance, you won't be able to join this time.

[Individual Arms Race]
1. If the Individual Arms Race stage hasn't switched upon transferring, your current points will carry over. If it has switched, unclaimed rewards will be sent via mail.
2. After transferring, you will be removed from the leaderboard and re-enter after the daily reset.

[Zombie Invasion]
Monster summoning level progress and Courage Medals will carry over.

[Honorable Campaign]
Challenge attempts and progress will transfer from the original Warzone.

[Armed Truck]
Accumulated rewards from Armed Trucks will be retained.

[Bullseye Loot]
Your current event progress will carry over to the new Warzone and can be completed there.

[Airdrop Supplies]
Event progress will carry over and can be completed in the new Warzone.
[Glittering Market]
Event progress will transfer to the new Warzone and continue there.

[Total Mobilization]
Event progress will carry over to the new Warzone and continue there.

[Loot Domino]
Event progress will transfer to the new Warzone and continue there.

[Daily Must-buy]
Cumulative purchase progress will continue in the new Warzone.

[Weekly Deal]
Your current purchases and progress will be retained and can continue in the new Warzone.

activity_desc_99102:
1. During the event, use Halloweenopoly Tokens to roll the dice, moving forward based on the number rolled. 
2. You can choose a single roll (1 die) or double roll (2 dice, rewards not doubled). Both rolls earn the same Treasure Points, and once you've collected enough, you can claim a target reward. 
3. The board is made up of different squares: item squares, event squares, and start squares. Landing on an item square gives you rewards and EXP. When squares level up, you'll receive even better rewards. Event squares trigger random events, full of surprises. 
4. Passing or landing on the start square grants you rewards from 3 random item squares and corresponding square EXP. 
5. Daily event goals reset each day. If you miss claiming any rewards, they'll be sent to your inbox. Unused Treasure Points carry over to the next day. No extra points are granted after the event ends. 
6. Max-level squares don't earn extra EXP from events, but you'll find Spooky Chests randomly, which grant bonus rewards. 
7. Buying Mystery Packs during Halloweenopoly gives Alliance gifts and the same amount of Diamonds and VIP points you'd get from the Diamond Store (excluding any doubled points). 
8. If you enable auto-roll, dice rolls will be handled automatically, and rewards will go into a temporary chest (click to claim). Event progress will be stored and handled manually after the auto-roll ends. 
9. Unused Halloweenopoly Tokens will be converted into speed-up items after the event and sent by mail. Expired items can still be manually reclaimed. Conversion rate: Halloweenopoly Token *1 = 1-minute Universal Speed-up *40

battlesystem_info1:
1. Drones will continuously attack enemies in battle, <color=#099b4a>they themselves cannot be attacked.</color>

2. Drones can gain a certain amount of experience progress when undergoing <color=#099b4a>Data Training</color>. When the progress is filled, the drone will level up and improve its attributes. <color=#099b4a>The attributes of the drone will be converted into the attributes of your heroes at a certain ratio. For the conversion ratio and the actual increase in hero attributes, please click on the relevant location on the interface</color>
When consuming Battle Data for Data Training, there is a chance of a training critical hit:
When the training progress is less than 80%, there is a 50% chance of a critical hit, which doubles the experience progress equivalent to the consumed Battle Data.
When the training progress is 80% or more, there will be no training critical hit.
Training that requires additional Drone Parts will not result in a training critical hit.

3. When the Drone level reaches <color=#099b4a>30/50/70/90/110</color>, the skill level increases.

4. The <color=#099b4a>Drone Component</color> feature is unlocked when the Headquarters reaches level 15. A drone can equip up to 6 components, which can greatly enhance the hero's attributes. Three components of the same type and level can be merged to obtain a higher-level component of the same type.

5. On the 82nd day after the server launch, players can unlock the <color=#099b4a>Combat Boost</color> and <color=#099b4a>Skill Chip</color> systems. The <color=#099b4a>Combat Boost</color> system lets players upgrade Drones even more, improving their stats. Once <color=#099b4a>Combat Boost</color> reaches Level 10, the <color=#099b4a>Skill Chip</color> system becomes available.
With the <color=#099b4a>Skill Chip</color> system, players can equip an <color=#099b4a>Initial Skill, an Offensive Skill, an Interference Skill, and a Defensive Skill</color>. Players can choose a chip preset before battles to activate those skills for the Drone. SSR and UR rarity chips can use same-name chips to ascend their stars, further <color=#099b4a>boosting skill chip effects</color>.
Unused chips can also be used for the <color=#099b4a>Combat Boost</color>. Every time you advance to a new Combat Boost Stage, the <color=#099b4a>Chip Skill Boost</color> increases, adding extra power to chip skills.

As darkness falls, get ready to escape the Haunted Town!
During the event, use Haunted Town Tickets to compete with other players from your server, challenge yourself to run the farthest!

Desert_strom_tips1046:
1. Two Alliances are matched in the same battlefield to compete for control of the nuclear silo. 
2. The Alliance that holds buildings continuously will earn [Battlefield Points], and the side with the highest score at the end wins. 
3. Thanks to a mysterious force, your units <color=#DC143C>cannot die</color> in battle. After the fight, all severely wounded units will automatically recover for free. 
4. During battle, commanders will receive <color=#DC143C>one free teleport</color> at set intervals.
5. Each alliance can send up to <color=#DC143C>20 Commanders</color> into battle, with at least <color=#DC143C>1 Commander</color> required for matchmaking.
Desert_strom_tips1047:
1. In the battle, killing hostile units grants significant [Individual Points], but not [Battlefield Points]. Higher-level enemies yield more points. 
2. You'll get 1 free teleport opportunity every 2 minutes, followed by a cooldown. Teleporting is suspended during cooldown. 
3. Units won't <color=#DC143C>die</color> in the battle, they are considered severely wounded and will be sent to the Hospital with unlimited capacity. All units will fully recover after the battle. 
4. Commanders who leave the battlefield can't re-enter. Temporary exits don't have a wait time. 
5. When you enter the battlefield, your highest-level units automatically fill the separate Drill Ground. They won't show up in your base's Drill Ground and won't leave the battlefield after the fight.
6. All boosts from tech, VIP Level, Base Skins, Titles, Decorations, and Drones work in battle.

new_arena_tips_8:
[Start]
1. Storm Arena begins with a two-day warm-up, and each event period lasts a week.

[Join the Arena]
1. Both the Elite-level and Mid-level Arenas will open each event. Commanders from 1 - 4 Warzones will fight in the Elite-level Arena, while 1 - 2 Warzones will compete in the Mid-level Arena.
2. To enter the Elite-level Arena, your total hero power needs to rank in the top 200 in your Warzone. Commanders with total hero power ranked between 201 and 800 enter the Mid-level Arena. Your position when the arena begins determines your placement. After the arena opens, if your power rank rises from below 801 to between 201 and 800, you will automatically join the Mid-level Arena. If your total hero power reaches the top 200 while being in the mid-level arena, you'll get a promotion option to move to the Elite-level Arena. This option stays open throughout the season.

[Match Stage]
1. Initial rankings are based on commanders' power.
2. Starting score: 1000 pts.
3. When challenging, you'll be matched with 5 commanders close to you. Pick one to battle. Winning adds points, while losing deducts points. The larger the point difference, the bigger the points gained or lost.
4. Commanders have a limited number of challenges per day during the event.

[Rewards]
1. Complete 1, 3, and 5 challenges daily to unlock reward chests.
2. At the end of each arena, individual and Alliance rewards will be determined by final rankings.
3. Rewards will be sent via mail.

[Lineup]
1. By default, your strongest squad will be set as the defense lineup. When the Arena becomes available, commanders need to save their defensive lineup manually. If left unsaved, the lineup will adjust automatically as the squad lineup changes.
2. After the match begins, you can adjust your defense lineup.
3. Arena fights don't consume units, and your highest-level units will be used.

hero_backstory_desc_40010:
Mason was once a celebrated general of the Land of Liberty.

In the heat of his prime, he led the Ironclad Squadron into battle, standing as a shield for the people while the Doom Legion pressed relentlessly forward. He never wavered, driven by an unshakable loyalty to his homeland.

But the day came when the government chose to retreat, leaving Mason and his squadron abandoned. With no aid in sight, they defended the last city, holding onto a fragile hope.

Just when hope seemed dimmest, betrayal came from within. Vice Commander Garm joined the Doom Legion, exposing their hideout. The Legion struck hard and fast, spreading the virus and shrinking the city's safe haven. Doubt gnawed at Mason...was there still meaning in fighting?

Yet, a glimmer of light pierced through. In a chance meeting with a strategist, Mason saw a spark of hope that reignited his will. He rallied his remaining troops, defending until you, the Commander, arrived with reinforcements.

Under your leadership, the tide of war shifted. Mason and his squadron claimed their first victory over the Doom Legion.

The city Mason vowed to protect now stands as the birthplace of a counterattack. And to Mason, you are the new guiding star.
hero_backstory_desc_50023:
After countless victories under the Commander's lead, Mason's spirits had lifted, yet one shadow still lingered—Garm's betrayal.

Years ago, when Garm lost all hope in the Land of Liberty government, he betrayed Mason and the Ironclad Squadron, handing over the design for their legendary Ironclad Vehicle to Marshal Nier, leader of the Doom Legion. Now, Mason's intelligence confirms Garm's survival and his return with a modified, more dangerous version of the vehicle—a weapon of destruction aimed directly at the Commander's forces.

The upgraded vehicle threatened everything Mason fought for, but it wasn't just about the machine. To Mason, this was personal. He set out to face Garm, seeking both justice for his squadron and vengeance for the betrayal.

As the battle rages, Mason and Garm finally meet face to face. Once brothers in arms, they now stand as bitter enemies. Garm sneers, mocking Mason's strength and declaring himself the true power. Though seething with anger, Mason stays focused. Using his intimate knowledge of the vehicle's design, he leads his comrades in a calculated attack. At the crucial moment, Mason leaps onto the vehicle, disabling its core system and shattering Garm's plans.

Garm was defeated, and Mason reclaimed the vehicle. This time, he vowed to use its power not for revenge, but to safeguard the future of humanity.
