alliance_train_rules: Participation Conditions 1. The alliance must have at least 20 members. 2. Members must have unlocked the train station and have been in the Alliance for over 24 hours. 3. Each Alliance can send out 1 regular train and 2 Mega Express Trains daily. Note: Only Alliances in the top 50 of this server's ranking can get a regular train each day. [Train Details:] 1. Regular Train: At 0:00 each day (server time), eligible Alliances will get a trade train. An R4 or R5 member must assign a conductor for the train to enter the preparation stage. 2. Mega Express Train: When no train is being prepared, the commander can summon a Mega Express Train and will automatically be assigned as conductor. 3. The train consists of four carriages, numbered 1 to 4 from top to bottom, each carrying different rewards. [Train Preparation Stage] 1. The preparation stage lasts 4 hours. Afterward, the train will automatically set off for trade in various cities. 2. Conductor: Can assign a guard team and refresh cargo items on the train. A bonus surprise will be unlocked after 5 refreshes! 3. Passengers: Can queue at their desired carriage and switch freely. Once preparation ends, no further queuing is allowed, and the system will randomly select 5 passengers for each carriage. [Train Operation] 1. While moving, the train can be attacked by other commanders. Successful attacks will plunder 3 random cargo slots. 2. Each train can be plundered a maximum of 3 times. [Train Rewards] 1. Conductor: Receives all remaining cargo items in the engine slot and carriage slots. 2. Passengers: Receive any remaining cargo items in their carriage slot.

ghostrecon_rules_new: No.2487 Ghost Ops Guide: 1. Only commanders with a Base Level of 18 or higher can join Ghost Ops (Higher base levels likely mean better rewards, right? ^^) 2. Every Thursday, the Secret Command Post will release 3 Ghost Ops missions. These missions must be carried out in other warzones, with available times as follows: Server Time 00:00-03:00, 06:00-09:00, 12:00-15:00, 18:00-21:00. Signals will be cut off during other times, so missions can't be executed (Better set your alarms...) 3. Inviting allies to team up for these missions is the best choice! You can find many teams within the Ally Team. If you can't find one, you can complete it solo... Well, it's better than wasting the opportunity. 4. Important! After completing a mission, you need to MANUALLY claim the reward. Allies can't claim it for you (It's quicker to claim at the Secret Command Post). 5. Every commander who participates in a mission will receive rewards. If you complete special conditions in UR rarity missions, you'll get super generous special rewards (Teaming up makes it easier to meet these conditions! So team up!) 6. On the day each operation starts, you can assist allies up to 3 times a day. Once you reach the limit, you can still assist others, though you won't get any rewards from the task, but it will strengthen friendships and contribute to the Alliance! :) 7. On the day each operation starts, you can plunder 5 Ghost Missions daily. (Try to plunder UR-rarity missions). No number 8 for now (Let's keep the friendly vibes going ^^).
dominator_plot_1: Our radar... seems to have picked up a very "special" signal!
dominator_plot_3: No, no, we've found a baby gorilla!
dominator_plot_4: Well? In a world like this, that really is "special."
dominator_plot_5: It's so dangerous out here—should we bring it back with us?
dominator_plot_8: Hey, poor thing, come with us, it's too dangerous to stay here.
dominator_plot_10: It seems to want to show us something! Lead the way!
dominator_plot_11: Wow, look at that huge gorilla! It's seriously hurt, and the little one seems so worried.
dominator_plot_12: It's badly hurt. The baby gorilla we found must be very concerned and came out searching for help, leading us here.
dominator_plot_14: This gorilla warrior has been guarding the village gate, stopping zombies from getting close. It fought for three straight days before collapsing. Please, help save it!
dominator_plot_15: I heard Emperor Boreas once started an "Overlord Project" to train super-beasts as secret weapons. Who'd have thought one would end up protecting humans?

dominator_plot_21: Roar!!! (Struggles to get up and charges into the battle)
dominator_plot_22: We can't let it fight alone! We need to join in too!
dominator_plot_24: Its gear is tough, but that last blast was intense—it might be in rough shape!
dominator_plot_25: RAA! RAA! (Circling around the gorilla, anxious)
dominator_plot_26: We need to get it back to base to treat it—it saved us!
dominator_plot_27: We've got to get it back safely!
dominator_plot_28: The chopper to transport the Gorilla Overlord is here. Where should we take it?
dominator_plot_29: We just found an abandoned base nearby that hasn't been prepped yet—let's place it there to recover!
dominator_plot_30: All set! Let's get to the base and check on the Overlord's condition!
dominator_plot_31: Water, food, medicine... we need to gather these supplies quick!
dominator_plot_32: RAA! RA! (Handing over supplies it found)
dominator_plot_33: So that's why it wasn't here—it went to gather supplies!
dominator_plot_34: Right on time! Let's use these for now, but we need more. Let's scan with the radar to find extras!
dominator_plot_37: Hey, look! We prepared some new gear for you! It may not be as strong as your old set, but it'll still give you a combat boost. Try it out!
dominator_plot_38: We've been together for quite a while—I'd hate to see you go. Want to stay with us and fight side by side?
dominator_plot_40: Alright, I'll take that as a yes! Welcome to the team, Gorilla Overlord!
dominator_plot_41: You're strong, but your combat style needs a bit of work, and teamwork is still rough. Let's hold off on the battlefield for now and focus on training!

dominator_overview_desc_5:
There are three ways to strengthen the Overlord:
1. Promote Overlord's title and title levels.
2. Level up skills to boost Overlord's combat strength.
3. Conduct team training to improve the bond between heroes and Overlord in battle, strengthening the Overlord and heroes.

dominator_star_desc_2:
You can use specific promotion shards to promote an Overlord's battlefield title.
Each title has 10 levels, and reaching the max level upgrades to the next title.
Promoting titles gives the Overlord these enhancements:

season_builders_alliance_activity_desc: Builder Alliance Guide: Event Start: The Builder Alliance event begins in the 4th week of this season. Eligible Alliances can choose to transform into a Builder Alliance between the 4th and 7th weeks, with the transformation lasting for the entire season. 2. New Features: Builder Alliances unlock new City-building mode, Builder settlement rewards, individual Builder goal rewards, and Alliance goal rewards. 3. Restrictions: Builder Alliances cannot declare war on Cities, are not included in Alliance Influence Point rankings, and members who receive Builder goal rewards cannot earn Alliance Influence Point settlement rewards (Warzone Influence Point settlement rewards remain available after transformation). 4. Construction Process: Builder Alliance members with R4/R5 rank can select captured Cities to construct Support Facilities. Construction begins at 0% progress and requires Alliance donations to complete. When progress reaches 100%, the Support Facility is successfully built (Building Materials can be earned through daily tasks and radar tasks, you must be in the alliance for over 24 hours to start donating materials). 5. Facility Benefits: Support Facilities built by Builders grant benefits to Builders and City owners (some facilities also benefit all commanders in the same Warzone). If the City owner is from a different Warzone, only the durability benefit applies, with no additional benefits. 6. Material Conversion: Any remaining Building Materials in a commander's inventory will convert to Profession EXP at a 1:100 ratio after the end of the season. 7. Facility Removal: After season settlement, Support Facilities cannot be built or dismantled. They will stop producing resources and providing benefits at the season's end and will be removed at the start of the next season.

1. The event features 5 unique Frontline Breakthrough stages. After completing a stage, you can either proceed to the next one or save your progress and return later. Saved progress can be resumed anytime during the event. Exiting mid-challenge, however, will count as a failed attempt.
2. Clearing all 5 stages consecutively or failing any stage will trigger the final calculation of cleared stages and remaining troops. Your score will be recorded in both Warzone and Alliance rankings, prioritizing cleared stages first, and then remaining troops if tied.
3. Complete 3 stages to unlock all goal rewards! Please note: troops left in the event will not transfer back to your base.
4. The final 10 minutes of the event are reserved for leaderboard settlement, during which gameplay is disabled.
5. Each event will have specific Master Leaderboard requirements. Commanders who qualify will be listed on the global Master Leaderboard. (The master leaderboard updates every minute, but there may be a slight delay in the data.) Rewards for warzone and master rankings will be sent via in-game mail after the event ends.

vip_base_skin_rules1: Welcome to your VIP18 custom base skin service! To keep things smooth and aligned with the game style, please follow these rules during the design process.
vip_base_skin_rules7: For the best results, ensure at least 60% of your design focuses on the main element!
vip_base_skin_rules10: - Match the Style: Stick to the game's relaxed and playful look, avoid designs that are overly fantastical or hyper-realistic.
vip_base_skin_rules12:
- Avoid standalone animal designs (e.g., just a single cat).
- Animals can be combined with structures, like in existing Meow-lody base skin design.
- Designs must feature stylized creatures, human or human-like designs are strictly prohibited.
vip_base_skin_rules14:
- Keep it simple—each design should highlight one main element. Examples include current VIP18 designs like the battleship, plane, or throne.
- Avoid combining multiple main elements (e.g., battleship + planet or throne + dragon).
- The final right of interpretation belongs to Last War Official, and the official team will review designs based on multi-dimensional standards, such as reference to production difficulty, actual presentation effects, etc., for the evaluation of main and auxiliary elements.
vip_base_skin_rules15: Complex designs may not display well on mobile devices.
vip_base_skin_rules16: d. Avoid Conflicts with Storyline or Planned Future Updates
vip_base_skin_rules17: Your design will be reviewed against the game's future updates to prevent conflicts with planned content. If a theme or concept is already part of an upcoming update, it cannot be used for your custom design.
vip_base_skin_rules20: Designs must be 100% original. Avoid using copyrighted materials or ideas from other games, movies, or brands.
vip_base_skin_rules22:
- <color=#fb7156> Designs must not include any content that violates regulations or involves political, religious, or legal risks. </color> This includes but is not limited to:
- Depictions of blood, pornography, extreme violence, horror, drugs, abuse, cruelty, torture, or any elements that may cause physical or psychological discomfort, or any disturbing content are not allowed.
- Content involving discrimination, hate speech, or derogatory remarks based on race, gender, nationality, or religion is not allowed.
- Encouragement of dangerous activities or depictions of hazardous materials is not allowed.
- References to political figures, parties, national symbols (such as flags or emblems), or politically sensitive events is not allowed.
- Offensive, defamatory, or divisive symbols, slogans, gambling-related content, or any other elements that may trigger disputes is not allowed.
- To maintain diversity and neutrality, religious symbols, sectarian imagery, religious ceremonies, inflammatory religious content, misleading portrayals of religion, or any other religiously related elements are NOT allowed.
- Content that infringes third-party intellectual property rights (including but not limited to trademarks and copyrights), violates personal privacy, or involves or endangers children/minors is not allowed.
- Content violating the Last War User Agreement or relevant legal regulations is not allowed. The full User Agreement can be accessed in-game for detailed requirements.
- Last War team reserves the right to review and interpret any unspecified violations.
vip_base_skin_rules25:
- Creating your custom base skin is a premium service that requires <color=#fb7156>at least 5 months</color> for design and production.
- The scheduling for concept sketches will follow the order of VIP18 achievements and will be notified in advance. If the concept is not finalized at least 7 days before the sketching date, the schedule will be postponed and may not follow the original confirmation order, potentially affecting the overall production time. We recommend discussing details with the team early to ensure timely confirmation and avoid delays.
- <color=#fb7156>Please note: The exact schedule can only be provided once the concept sketch phase begins. We will strive to complete the production within 5 months after concept confirmation, but the timeline may vary depending on the skin's complexity, communication, and revisions.</color>
- Thank you for your patience! We look forward to creating a one-of-a-kind base skin just for you!
vip_base_skin_rules27:
- All VIP18 custom headquarters base skins are exclusive, one-of-a-kind creations that cannot be replicated or resemble other VIP18 designs, completed or in progress.
- We guarantee a fully personalized and exclusive design for each VIP18 user.
vip_base_skin_rules30:
- After you submit your design ideas or reference materials, our creative team will review them.
- We'll work with you to ensure the design aligns with these rules, provide feedback, and make adjustments to meet your expectations and game standards.
vip_base_skin_rules32:
- Last War reserves the right of final interpretation for these rules.
- We'll update the rules over time based on real cases and user feedback to improve the service.
vip_base_skin_rules33: We sincerely appreciate your understanding and cooperation with these rules. If you have any questions or need assistance, please don't hesitate to contact us. We look forward to creating your exclusive VIP18 base skin design!

zone_mobilization_rule: [Schedule] 1. Donation stage: 4 days. 2. The battle stage and settlement stage: 2 days. 3. Settlement stage: 1 day. [Donation Gameplay] · Donations: 1. After the event starts, the President can initiate airship construction. All commanders work together to build it. 2. You can complete daily tasks via the Sky Battlefront event to earn Airship Tokens. 3. Using Airship Tokens to donate will increase airship construction progress. Donations grant Individual Progress Points and Alliance Progress Points. Reach specified individual progress to unlock Individual Reward Chests. Reach specified Alliance progress to unlock Alliance Reward Chests. 4. The airship construction has 3 stages. When the donation progress meets the construction goal, the airship is completed. 5. Once the airship is completed, the Rush Stage begins. During the rush stage, the airship will be upgraded and strengthened based on the highest donation progress reached in this stage, boosting its combat capabilities. · Discoveries: 1. Activating an Alliance Reward Chest has the chance to reveal an Alliance Resource Tile or a Supply Tile. (Note: Members who joined the Alliance less than 24 hours cannot contribute progress points to the Alliance or claim Alliance Chests.) 2. Click the Airship Token button to earn tokens through daily tasks, check resource tiles, and gather resources. If sufficient resources are gathered, additional Airship Tokens will be granted based on the collected amount. 3. Click the Supply Tile button to locate discovered supplies. (Act fast! Supplies can be collected by other members.) [Battle Gameplay] ·Preparation: 1. During the Battle stage, the President selects a location in enemy warzone and launches the airship. 2. The airship enters Teleport Mode and reaches the target after a countdown. 3. Enemy airships will target your warzone. Work together to take them down. 4. The Sky Predator airship have a time limit for challenges. If not defeated, they will retreat. ·Combat: 1. Enemy Sky Predator fires at some targets randomly, burning bases and reducing Durability. 2. The Sky Predator is very strong and requires rally attacks to defeat it. 3. Each rally attack reduces the airship's HP based on the number of defeated queues, while also recording the damage caused by each commander. 4. When the HP drops to certain thresholds, the airship activates a shield. Break the shield within the specified time to continue the challenge. If not, the airship enters a temporary Rampage Mode, launching more powerful attacks. 5. When fighting the Sky Predator airship, a win streak of 5 rounds counts as a triumph. If the airship's shield is active, you’ll need 20 consecutive wins to claim victory. [Rewards] · Donation Rewards: 1. Completing donations for airship construction grants Individual Chests based on individual progress and Alliance Chests based on alliance progress. 2. Once airship construction progress is met during the Donation stage, all warzone members can claim a Warzone Airship Construction Reward. 3. After the event ends, unused Airship Tokens are removed and converted into 1-minute speed-ups at a 1:1 ratio. · Expedition Rewards: In the Expedition tab, the damage caused by your airship to the enemy warzone determines the Warzone Rewards that your warzone commanders can claim. · Defense Rewards: In the Defense tab, commanders can claim a Defense Reward when the airship's HP reaches certain thresholds. activity_desc_99120:
1. During the event, use Snowopoly Tokens to roll the dice, moving forward based on the number rolled. 
2. You can choose a single roll (1 die) or double roll (2 dice, rewards not doubled). Both rolls earn the same Snowopoly Points, and once you've collected enough, you can claim a target reward. 
3. The board is made up of different squares: item squares, event squares, and start squares. Landing on an item square gives you rewards and EXP. When squares level up, you'll receive even better rewards. Event squares trigger random events, full of surprises. 
4. Passing or landing on the start square grants you rewards from 3 random item squares and corresponding square EXP. 
5. Daily event goals reset each day. If you miss claiming any rewards, they'll be sent to your inbox. Unused Snowopoly Points carry over to the next day. No extra points are granted after the event ends. 
6. Max-level squares don't earn extra EXP from events, but you'll find Snowopoly Chests randomly, which grant bonus rewards. 
7. Buying Mystery Packs during Snowopoly gives Alliance gifts and the same amount of Diamonds and VIP points you'd get from the Diamond Store (excluding any doubled points). 
8. If you enable auto-roll, dice rolls will be handled automatically, and rewards will go into a temporary chest (click to claim). Event progress will be stored and handled manually after the auto-roll ends. 
9. Unused Snowopoly Tokens will be converted into speed-up items after the event and sent by mail. Expired items can still be manually reclaimed. Conversion rate: Snowopoly Token *1 = 1-minute Universal Speed-up *40
activity_desc_99121:

3. Items redeemed from the store cannot be returned, please choose wisely.

Items not retrieved on time will expire and can be manually converted into universal Speed-up items in your Inventory.
5. Conversion Rate: Christmas Voucher*1 = 1-minute Universal Speed-up*20, Christmas Voucher Lucky Chest = 1-minute Universal Speed-up*30

dominator_story_content_1:
The Emperor's divine favor has made me the chosen one! To think, I, Dimitri, am entrusted with leading the [Overlord Project].
With CL-7, I will craft war machines of unmatched power—beasts that will shatter armies and bring eternal glory to the Emperor!
Gorillas—intelligent and strong—are perfect test subjects. This is not just an experiment, it is my masterpiece!
dominator_story_content_2:
Progress! Finally, true progress! My heart pounds like a war drum!
After injecting CL-7, two of my specimens—T-34 and T-67—have survived. They didn't devolve into babbling monsters like the others.
Next, they will undergo rigorous training—intelligence, strength, adaptability. They will become the Emperor's finest tools of war. No more whispers of failure or execution. No! The path forward is one of glory, promotions, and eternal honor! Long live Emperor Boreas!
dominator_story_content_3:
The Emperor was attacked?
Fools! He is invincible, strengthened by CL-7. Regular bullets cannot harm him.
Yet, I must focus on T-67. It is brilliant—its intelligence surpasses even my expectations. But brilliance comes at a price: rebellion. It grows harder to control.
Still, I've noticed something... curious. It shows affection for T-34. How fascinating. How exploitable! I know this bond can be my tool.
dominator_story_content_4:
What a disastrous day...
The plan was simple: torment T-34 to provoke T-67's aggression and cement its obedience. But Daria... Daria ruined everything! That fool pushed too far and killed T-34! The effect on T-67 was immediate. It broke its restraints! Clad in Overlord gear, it tore through the lab like a force of nature. Half the facility is rubble.
I've sent an army of mutant beasts after it, though I have little hope they'll succeed. The rebels press us on every front, and now this.
And Daria? She received her just reward—a dose of CL-7. Let her become the experiment she was always meant to be.
dominator_story_content_5:
We found T-67, but at what cost? The entire pursuit team lies in ruins.
It now guards the entrance to some backwater village, keeping zombies at bay. Compassion? For the weak, like T-34? Unacceptable! If it falls into rebel hands, all is lost.
I'll deploy more troops and handle it personally. I'll inject the virus into its brain myself. The village? It must burn.
dominator_story_content_6:
It's over. Everything is over. The rebels have taken the nuclear furnace, and the frost melts from the polar plains. The heat is sickening, a bitter reminder of my failure. Even the researchers—cowards—have fled to bask in the warmth of this cursed thaw. They've turned their backs on the Emperor.
Traitors! Unforgivable traitors!
I've unleashed the rest of my mutant beasts. Let them hunt the betrayers. Let them destroy T-67, which has fully turned against us. My greatest creation has become my greatest shame.
I've fused with CL-7. My body freezes, but my loyalty burns eternal. For the Emperor...
dominator_story_signature_1: —Dimitri, Head of the Overlord Research Division

decoration_info: Certain decorations come with an Upgrade Split mechanic, available only for upgrades at level 3 or higher. Split Rules: Upgrading or repairing consumes one specific decoration, granting an instant boost to attributes. For every one-third of the total required decorations consumed, an additional attribute boost will be triggered. Attribute Retention: Unlocking the split feature ensures the total attributes per level remain unchanged compared to the original version, regardless of the split functionality.

season_person_building_long_desc780000:
Nier unleashed a cursed mummy army using the "Monument of the Dead," spreading their magic across the land.
To combat this, we've built the Curse Research Lab—knowledge is our greatest weapon.
season_person_building_long_desc781000:
Water is precious in the desert, but we must save some for crafting Sacred Water. It's essential for breaking curses, made from pure spring water, salt, and prayers.
Sacred Water will help us counter Nier's evil plan with our own.

The Protectors, once protectors of the Golden Empire, will rise again when the land is in peril.
Use the Altar to connect with them and enhance their powers.
season_person_building_long_desc787000:
Scarlett took the "Monument of the Dead" from Nier, summoning mummies and sandstorms. Repeating this method would bring disaster.
Luckily, the "Golden Tribe" reached out to us. They taught us that inscribing obelisks can summon Protectors safely, providing power to rival Nier's without causing sandstorms.
season_s3_effect_desc94081: Under the Pharaoh's Obelisk, a portion of fallen units will be reserved for future summoning.
season_s3_Mummy_ui_info02:
The mystical energy of the Golden Realm ensures units with unmatched willpower do not decay in death but act with purpose.
Locals call them Desert Protectors.
A prophecy once said: When sand fades and the earth turns green, the dead will return.

Sequence for converting dead units into pending protectors:
1. Severely wounded units are sent to the Hospital after battle. Units who die are prioritized for the Emergency Center, and those left out may partially convert to pending protectors.
2. If hospitals are full and severely wounded units die, some will convert to pending protectors.
3. Units stationed in the Drill Grounds who die when the base is breached will partially convert to pending protectors.
4. Protectors in the Protector's Field are immune to death from base breaches.
season_s3_replace_dialog041: Mummies and Desert Bosses carry curses. Troops need to upgrade the Curse Research Lab to boost their Curse Resistance for better performance. If resistance is too low, forced attacks might result in severe losses, so proceed with caution.

season_s3_weekcard_desc04: Build an extra Blessing Fountain during the season with the Season Weekly Pass. During the validity of the Weekly Pass, the Blessing Fountain offers Sacred Water.
season_s3_villages_dialog01: Welcome to the desert's crown jewel!
season_s3_villages_dialog02: This oasis is truly a miracle.
season_s3_villages_dialog04: What a grand city you've built!
season_s3_villages_dialog05: Try some of our freshest dates.
season_s3_villages_dialog07: Are you the new leader here?
season_s3_villages_dialog08: Your people look content and happy.
season_s3_villages_dialog09: Wishing you a bountiful harvest and calm days ahead.
season_s3_villages_dialog11: I can show you our local traditions.
season_s3_villages_dialog12: The city shines brightly under the sun.
season_s3_villages_dialog13: Long journey through the desert? You must be exhausted!
season_s3_villages_dialog14: How do you deal with the sandstorms?
season_s3_villages_dialog15: Take some of our fresh spring water with you.
season_s3_villages_dialog16: Our caravans are well connected with your city.
season_s3_villages_dialog17: May your reign stand tall like the pyramids.
season_s3_villages_dialog18: Want to check out our Goldust?
season_s3_villages_dialog19: Protect your people, sandstorms are frequent.
season_s3_villages_dialog20: The winds carry tales of your greatness.
season_s3_villages_dialog21: Where are you from? Got any fun stories?
season_s3_villages_dialog22: My family always lends a hand to travelers.
season_s3_villages_dialog24: The moon here is unlike anywhere else.
season_s3_villages_dialog25: Do you believe in the sun god's power?
season_s3_villages_dialog26: Want to hear the secrets of the temple?
season_s3_villages_dialog27: Your people must be so proud of you.
season_s3_villages_dialog28: Ever heard the myths of the sandworms?
season_s3_villages_dialog29: May the desert spirits watch over you.
season_s3_villages_dialog30: Want to join me for a sunrise?
season_s3_villages_dialog31: Camels are the desert's heart and soul.
season_s3_villages_dialog32: Your outfit is unique, where's it from?
season_s3_villages_dialog33: I see bravery in you amidst the sandstorm.
season_s3_villages_dialog35: A water well is the lifeline of the desert.
season_s3_villages_dialog36: May your fortune flow endlessly like the river.
season_s3_villages_dialog37: Your journeys have breathed life into the desert.
season_s3_villages_dialog38: Need a guide across the sands?
season_s3_villages_dialog39: Glad to see you among the desert's protectors.
season_s3_villages_dialog40: Your sharp mind outshines even the brightest sun.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog01: I'm an explorer hunting for something shiny!
season_s3_adventurer_dialog03: Or should we settle the share first?
season_s3_adventurer_dialog04: Once, I spent three months looking for a scarab.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog05: Finally found it in a well, used as a decoration.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog06: That's when I learned treasures lie in the unexpected.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog07: A sandworm nearly got me once!
season_s3_adventurer_dialog08: Just as it opened its mouth, I found the path to the ruins!
season_s3_adventurer_dialog09: Life is a mix of risks and surprises.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog10: Deep in the pyramid, I uncovered a golden statue.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog11: But as I moved it, it turned to dust.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog12: Looks like the Pharaoh's curse is no joke!
season_s3_adventurer_dialog13: I found an old map hidden in the ruins.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog14: It led to a forgotten temple, its entrance buried in time.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog15: Maybe the desert was telling me to slow down and reflect.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog16: I nearly gave my life chasing an ancient gem.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog17: Only to find it was just a glass trinket.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog18: The journey, though, was worth more than the treasure.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog19: I dug up a gold bracelet one quiet night.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog21: That moment, I felt the true weight of history.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog22: A friend once betrayed me for a golden key.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog23: Later, we learned it unlocked nothing at all.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog24: Trust is the real treasure in life.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog25: The sands always take, but they also reveal.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog26: After a storm, I uncovered a hidden shrine.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog27: Inside, I found a stone tablet covered in runes.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog28: Some say treasure isn't real, but every artifact tells a story.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog29: An old charm reminded me of the splendor of ancient times.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog30: Treasures may not always be riches but the stories they tell.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog31: I got lost in an underground labyrinth for two whole days.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog32: Eventually, I came across an ancient Goldust jar.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog33: To this day, the memory of its brilliance remains etched in my mind.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog34: Gold's brilliance can lead or mislead.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog35: A fight over a gold trinket broke my team apart.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog36: That day, I learned friendship is the real treasure.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog37: Once, I lost all my supplies during an adventure.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog38: Yet, I found an unexpected oasis in the desert.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog40: One quiet evening, I unearthed an ancient lamp.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog41: Its faint light revealed the path to a lost temple.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog42: That moment felt like pure magic.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog43: Patience is the desert's greatest lesson.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog44: I spent days chasing a golden shimmer.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog45: It was just sunlight on a stone.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog46: I started an adventure dreaming of treasure.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog47: But returned with a broken clay shard.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog48: Its story, however, was worth more than gold.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog49: I found the head of an ancient statue in the sands.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog50: But the rest of it lay buried beyond my reach.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog51: Some things are meant to remain untouched.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog52: The night sky over the desert outshines any riches.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog53: One night, I saw a meteor fall while resting on the sand.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog54: At that moment, I felt I needed nothing else.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog55: I lost my hoard to a vicious sandstorm.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog56: But afterward, I found an ancient engraved tablet.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog57: The desert always seems to test our determination.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog58: Once, the ground collapsed beneath me during a dig.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog59: I ended up in a hall filled with intricate carvings.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog60: The carvings told a pharaoh's story—it was breathtaking.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog61: I found a mysterious coin with strange symbols.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog62: It wasn't gold, but its intrigue held my attention.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog63: Every treasure hides a unique story.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog64: I ventured into the desert for a single painting.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog65: Its signs pointed to a forgotten place.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog66: I could spend my life following these leads.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog67: The desert is like an eternal puzzle.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog68: Every answer leads to more questions.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog69: That's why I'm always drawn to treasure hunting.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog71: Once, my team clashed over a golden artifact.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog72: It made me cherish bonds over material gains.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog73: Once, I dug up an ancient stone figure.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog74: Something about its stare gave me chills.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog75: Some treasures are meant to stay hidden.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog76: The desert holds riddles no one can fully answer.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog77: One day, I found a tunnel buried beneath the sand.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog78: At its end was a hall shimmering with gold!
season_s3_adventurer_dialog79: During a journey, I followed the flow of sand dunes.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog80: Following shifting sands, I discovered a bronze treasure.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog81: That moment, I knew I had touched something timeless.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog82: Every bit of desert sand whispers a hidden tale.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog83: I once dug up a golden scarab, worn by time's touch.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog84: It taught me that time both takes and leaves behind.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog85: In a temple lost to the ages, I found an old text.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog86: It recounted stories of a long-forgotten war.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog87: Reading it was more valuable than any gold I'd found.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog88: In a forgotten temple, I discovered an old manuscript.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog89: It described the traditions and ways of life back then.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog90: It made me treasure every step of my own journey.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog91: The desert always seems to call me back.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog92: I followed the breeze once and found an ancient well.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog93: Surrounding it were gold trinkets from a lost age.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog94: I once dug all day and found nothing.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog95: But the stars above made it all worthwhile.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog96: Sometimes, the adventure is the real treasure.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog97: Desert winds always carry secrets if you listen.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog98: Once, the sound of the wind led me straight to an ancient site.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog99: It was the best decision I ever made!
season_s3_adventurer_dialog100: I stumbled on a golden sword buried deep in the sands.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog101: Its design was exquisite, a piece of history in my hands.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog102: I felt like I was standing in the middle of an ancient war.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog103: I found a bronze instrument in the ruins.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog104: Its haunting sound seemed to tell stories of the past.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog105: It made me realize that treasures hold more than material value.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog106: The desert always surprises me with new lessons.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog107: Once, I uncovered a strange symbol no one had ever seen.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog108: It kept me curious for years.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog109: At the desert's edge, I found shards of pottery from a forgotten era.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog110: The designs spoke of myths from long ago.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog111: It brought me closer to the legends I've always chased.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog112: Desert nights often remind me of my treasure hunts.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog113: I discovered what could have been the Pharaoh's crown.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog114: But it disappeared like an illusion in my hands.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog115: On one journey, I found a golden chamber underground.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog116: But each treasure I took made the ground sink.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog117: That taught me when to stop.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog118: Once, I unearthed a tablet with ancient writing on it.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog119: It seemed like a message from the past meant for us.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog120: Perhaps, it's a treasure meant for all who discover it.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog121: The desert tested me often, but it also rewarded me well.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog122: Once, a desert fox led me to an oasis.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog123: It was a moment of pure gratitude.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog124: I saw a golden light during one of my digs.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog125: It led me to a temple with an ancient lamp inside.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog126: That lamp reignited my love for treasure hunting.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog127: I spent two years chasing a legendary gem.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog128: When I finally found it, it crumbled into sand.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog129: But its story made it worth more than gold.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog130: Deep in the desert, I met an old wanderer.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog131: He said true treasure tests the heart, not just the hands.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog132: That made me rethink my journey.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog133: Once, I entered an underground maze with a team.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog134: When we got lost, I found a mural of a temple.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog135: It gave me hope to press on.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog136: The desert doesn't give up its secrets easily.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog137: I uncovered a golden scarab once, but the sands buried its trail.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog138: That moment taught me the power of time.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog139: One night, I heard whispers in the wind.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog140: They led me to a hidden underground chamber.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog141: Inside, ancient golden relics filled the space.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog142: Deep in the sands, I stumbled on a forgotten ruin.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog143: Inside, I found a book filled with ancient riddles.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog144: That moment forever changed how I viewed the desert.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog145: Once, I wandered into strange sand dunes.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog146: Every grain glimmered like gold under the sun.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog147: It was a stunning trick of nature.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog148: I unearthed a ring carved with an ancient spell on one trip.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog149: When I wore it, it glowed faintly.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog151: During a perilous journey, I lost my team.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog152: Their sacrifice led me to an ancient tablet.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog153: It held stories of a lost civilization.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog154: The desert feels like home, yet always tests me.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog155: Every challenge uncovers a bit more of its mysteries.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog156: You should try exploring its secrets yourself.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog157: I once found a golden blade near a sandworm's nest.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog158: It was the closest I've ever been to danger.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog159: That moment taught me the price of exploration.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog160: Under the desert stars, everything feels so small.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog161: I realized then, treasures are just part of the adventure.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog162: The journey itself is the greatest reward.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog163: Though my travels never end, I must say goodbye for now.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog164: The desert always calls, but your city feels like a safe haven.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog165: May our friendship shine like the stars above. Goodbye, friend!
season_s3_adventurer_dialog166: The desert taught me to be patient and persistent in my search for treasure.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog167: Once, I dug for three days and finally found a golden goblet.
season_s3_adventurer_dialog168: That feeling of triumph still lingers.

ABOUT THE EVENT
1. Sandworms will appear during the event. Hunt them to complete missions and earn rewards.
2. When the troops of alliance members engage in battles, they create shock waves. When the progress bar fills, the last commander to trigger it will attract a sandworm to attack their base. Bases entangled by small sandworms can't send out troops but can escape using teleport items, but the small sandworm will disappear, forfeiting rewards. (Only ongoing rally marches can continue)
3. After a sandworm is defeated, the commander attracted will receive a bonus discovery reward via mail.
4. As the event continues, large sandworms will appear. Bases outside the alliance center will be blasted away when attracting large sandworms.
5. Commanders who leave the alliance will no longer accumulate shock wave value.

ABOUT THE EVENT:
1. Once the event begins, commanders can pick a vault to enter.
2. Vaults have a time limit. When the time expires, the vault disappears.
3. Inside, use Archaeologist Hammers to break stones. Breaking stones may reveal traces of ancient relics.
4. Fully clearing stones from a relic activates it.
5. Vaults are divided into individual and alliance types. In personal vaults, activating all relics grants the vault rewards.
6. In alliance vaults, breaking the stones covering a relic earns the corresponding relic reward. Each member of the alliance is allowed to break one stone.
7. Commanders can ask allies for help in personal vaults. Each player has a daily limit on how many stones can be broken with help.

1. Once the territory is connected to the City (including diagonally), R5/R4 members of the Alliance can declare war on the City.
2. After the declaration, Cities can be captured. Only one City can be targeted by each Alliance at a time.
3. Without Digging Strongholds or Cities, an Alliance must first capture a Lv. 1 Digging Stronghold. Connected territories allow further declarations.
4. Troops will be affected by curses during sieges. Please increase troop Curse Resistance to reduce impact.

6. There will be first-time City capture rewards for participants. Alliance members will also receive City rewards. Alliances receive Loot chests as well, distributed by R5 or R4.

8. When a city is captured by another Alliance, it also enters a protection period. Abandoning a city does not reset the protection countdown.
9. After declaring war on a city you've abandoned, there's a waiting period.
10. The number of Digging Strongholds and Cities that can be captured each day is limited. The total number of Cities your Alliance can capture does not affect the total number of Digging Strongholds. You can view the exact limits in the [Alliance] -> [Alliance Cities] section.

season_s3_activity_1000072_desc01:
How to Play:
1. Trade Post contests start daily at 12:00 server time, except on Wednesdays and Saturdays. Trade Post levels are announced on the event panel ahead of time.
2. Each contest runs for 1 hour. During the contest, commanders in the same game season group can capture the Contaminated Land around the Trade Posts.
3. You don't need connected alliance territory to join the contest, but your base must be on the Contaminated Land near the Trade Post to send troops. Commanders from the same alliance won't fight each other, but progress is tracked individually.
4. For neutral Trade Posts, the commander with the most progress at the end of the contest wins ownership. If the Trade Post is already owned, you must reach 100% progress before the timer ends to claim ownership.
5. Once the contest ends, the Governor can restock items, allowing all commanders in the season to purchase items using Diamonds. Alliance members of the Governor receive discounts, and the Governor has access to exclusive items.
6. After the trading stage ends, the Trade Post reopens for contesting. Taxes from sales are returned to the Governor as a Golden Egg, which can be shared in chat by the Governor.
7. If the Governor abandons the Trade Post or sells out all items, taxes are issued to the Governor early as Golden Eggs.
8. Each Trade Store item has a daily purchase limit of 1, and each commander has a limited number of purchases per day. Items are sold on a first-come, first-served basis.

season_s3_activity_1000063_desc01:
ABOUT THE EVENT
1. When the event begins, two Faction Leaders will be chosen based on the combined power of the warzones at the start of the season. The Faction Leaders will decide the division of the two factions—Golden Tribe and Scarlet Legion—by a coin toss. One warzone will join Golden Tribe while the other will join Scarlet Legion.
2. After the Faction Leaders select their factions, the Presidents of other warzones can choose their faction during the faction selection stage. Each faction change will trigger a cooldown. If the desired faction is already full, the President can use "Force Join" to add their warzone to that faction, displacing a random warzone from it to the opposite faction (this does not affect the Faction Leaders' factions). A cooldown period applies between each use of "Force Join."
3. Factions are divided into Golden Tribe and Scarlet Legion, with 4 warzones in each faction. The chosen faction will influence the declaration order during the subsequent Goldust Conquests.
4. During the faction selection stage, warzone faction choices will remain hidden. Once the faction announcement stage begins, all hidden information will be revealed.
5. In the subsequent Goldust Conquests, alliances from different factions can declare war on each other to compete for Goldust. If multiple alliances declare war on the same alliance, the defending side can invite other Alliances from the same faction that have not been declared war upon to assist in defense during a specific time phase.
6. During the faction selection stage, the president can choose to [Show Faction], making their warzone information public early. Once revealed, you can't hide it again.
7. After the event begins, commanders can teleport freely across eight warzones within the same season group. 
8. At the start of the faction selection stage, a preliminary grouping is made based on the strength of each warzone. This does not determine the final result, and the President can still use [Force Join] to choose a faction freely.

season_s3_city_desc01:
Lv. 1 Trade Post
First opening: Sunday 12:00 (server time)
Opening interval: 7 days
Contest duration: 1 hour
Troops stationed in the Trade Post will gradually increase capture progress over time.
Progress is tracked separately for you and your allies.
During the contest, the first commander to reach 100% progress wins the Trade Post.
If no commander reaches 100% by the end of the contest, the commander with the highest progress takes the Trade Post if it has no Governor.
If the Trade Post already has a Governor, the current Governor retains control if no one reaches 100% by the end of the contest.

season_s3_activity1000071_story_desc:
Scarlett's daring raid on Nier's Monument of the Dead bought us precious time, but the threat is far from over. Nier has discovered new sources of power, growing even stronger by the day. Now, waves of mummies are rising from the sands, creating a fresh and terrifying challenge.

We have every reason to believe Nier's next move will be a large-scale assault on our bases and allies. To withstand this impending storm, we must act now. Strengthen our defenses, prepare our forces, and brace for the battle ahead.
season_s3_activity1000063_story_desc:
Commander, as you battled fiercely on the frontlines, our scouts uncovered an extraordinary find—a cache of ancient Goldust, treasures from the long-lost Golden Realm.

Now, two powerful factions are fighting for control of Goldust. The treasure-hunting Scarlet Legion, led by Jones, faces off against the Golden Tribe, descendants of the Golden Realm. Both factions have their strengths and could be valuable allies. It's up to you to choose where our loyalties lie. Make your decision wisely—our success in this conflict depends on it.
season_s3_activity1000074_story_desc:
Commander, we've uncovered a crucial weakness in the sandworms—these creatures are highly sensitive to sound. When exposed to noise levels above 170 decibels, they're forced to leap from the sand, leaving them vulnerable to attack.

To exploit this, we've developed Trap Landmines, specifically designed to lure the worms out of hiding. Radar scans suggest that even larger sandworms are lurking underground, having hoarded valuable resources. Eliminating them would be a major win for our forces.
Take action now, Commander! Deploy the Trap Landmines, flush out the sandworms, and turn them into resources for our victory.
season_s3_activity1000064_story_desc:
Goldust in the Golden Realm has always been tied to mysterious powers. It sharpened human senses, enhanced spiritual strength, and even allowed communion with the souls of the dead. Initially, Goldust was used to pass down wisdom and preserve ancestral knowledge. But as greed grew, its purpose shifted—to awaken the dead and enslave them.

Fueled by this mysterious power, the mighty Golden Realm rose, ruling the desert for millennia. Its unique mystical system, far removed from modern science, became the foundation of its dominance. Yet, an unprecedented sandstorm devastated the Goldust fields, halting production. The empire collapsed into obscurity.

Now, the rediscovery of this ancient Goldust has ignited a new war. The Scarlet Legion and the Golden Tribe clash over control, each seeking to reclaim the glory of the past and shape the future of the Golden Realm.
season_s3_activity1000073_story_desc:
Greetings, Commander. I am the leader of the Golden Tribe, descendants of the once-mighty Golden Realm. Our ancestors turned the harsh sands into a flourishing oasis with sheer determination and innovation, creating a legacy of hope and prosperity.
Though the empire has fallen, we, its descendants, have continued to nurture this land, passing down hope and glory through generations.

But now, Nier threatens everything we've worked for. With the power of the Monument of the Dead, he's corrupted our Protectors, plunging the oasis back into desolation. The land withers under his control, undoing centuries of progress.

Your arrival gives us a fighting chance. Stand with us, help rebuild the oasis, and together we will reclaim the glory of the Golden Realm. The Golden Tribe will reward your efforts generously.

Let us restore what once was, and secure the future of this sacred land.
season_s3_activity1000067_story_desc:
Scarlett was born in the Rainy Mistlands to a wealthy family with ties to the Bred clan. Her grandfather, a legendary businessman and leader of the secretive "Dragon's Lair," collected rare treasures in their castle, now a vault of historical relics.

These treasures weren't stolen but reclaimed from past wars, with the hope of returning them to their rightful owners. However, with many civilizations lost to time, the artifacts now rested untouched in the castle.

Scarlett was close to her grandfather and grew up inspired by his legacy. Her interests lay in archaeology and artifact appraisal, where she excelled at uncovering truths hidden in ancient relics.

Through her investigation, she discovered the murderers were former Dragon's Lair members, exiled for their greed. They stole from ancient ruins, forgotten temples, and even her family's collection.

Scarlett was the only survivor. Alone, consumed by hatred, she vowed revenge.

season_s3_activity_1000071_desc01:
ABOUT THE EVENT:
1. Once the event begins, Desert Bosses will lead armies to attack the Alliance Center every Tuesday and Friday.
2. A warning will be issued before the Desert Bosses' attack, so Alliance members can prepare for it.
3. Successfully defending against the attacks earns rewards. More waves defended means better rewards.
4. If your defense fails, the Desert Bosses will damage the Alliance Center (You can still earn rewards for each successfully defended wave that follows). Once the Alliance Center's durability drops to 0, it will turn into ruins, and you won't be able to collect rewards from future waves.
5. If there's a warning and the Alliance has no Alliance Center or it's already ruined, it's a defense failure, and no rewards are given.
6. During the attacks, the Alliance Center can be relocated, but the enemy's target will not change. Failure to defeat the waves of the Desert Bosses will result in defense failure.
season_s3_story_desc:
Across oceans, mountains, and through relentless desert storms, an ancient and forgotten kingdom is quietly awakening.

After his crushing defeat, Nier has hatched a new, dark plan. Leading the remnants of his Doom Legion, he has journeyed far to the Golden Realm and unearthed the legendary Monument of the Dead. This artifact, once a symbol of imperial might, holds the power to awaken unstoppable Protectors and was the ultimate weapon of conquest. After the fall of the Golden Realm, the monument was sealed inside the Great Pyramid, and its guardians fell into eternal slumber beneath the sands.
Now, Nier has unlocked the monument's secrets and crowned himself as the new Golden Realm. With his army of Protectors awakened, he has unleashed raging sandstorms that consumed the realm.

But hope remains—Scarlett, who had been tracking Nier for some time, intercepted and stole the Monument at a critical moment. Though she couldn't entirely negate Nier's power, she has enabled us to summon Protectors. The fight for the Golden Realm's future is about to unfold!
season_s3_activity1000062_story_desc:
With the power of the Monument of the Dead, Nier has summoned an army and unleashed destructive sandstorms, reducing the once-lush realm to a barren wasteland.

Commander, it's time to take action. Reclaim the cities seized by Nier and breathe life back into this land. The future of the Golden Realm rests in your hands!
season_s3_activity1000072_story_desc:
The Goldust of the Golden Realm were more than just luxuries for nobles, they were lifelines of trade. Stretching from the towering Great Pyramid to the West Sands Peninsula, trade posts dotted the Golden Route, offering rest and trade opportunities to passing caravans.

Today, Nier's forces occupy these trade posts. Reclaiming them would not only reopen this thriving trade network but also bring merchants and resources back to our troops. It's not just a tactical win—it's the first step toward reviving a lost legacy.

season_activity_1000064_des01:
ABOUT THE EVENT:
1. After the event begins, the warzone's faction determines attack and defense roles. The attack and defense roles will switch over time. When the attacking side wins a declaration of war, they can plunder a certain percentage of Goldust from the defending Alliance.
2. Each war declaration round includes five stages: declaration, invitation, preparation, war, and end of war.
3. Declaration: During this stage, R4 and above members in the attacking faction's Alliances can declare war on Alliances in the defending faction.
(1) Only one Alliance can be declared on at a time.
(2) You can only declare war on Alliances within the defending faction that are in the same Goldust ranking group as your Alliance.
(3) Up to three Alliances can declare war on one Alliance at the same time.
(4) The war target can be changed anytime during the declaration stage. The final target at the end of the stage becomes the war opponent.
4. Invitation: During this stage, if multiple Alliances declare war on a defending Alliance, R4 members of the defending Alliance can invite other Alliances from the same faction that have not been declared war upon to assist in defense.
(1) If three Alliances declare war, the defending side can invite up to two Alliances as defense partners. If two Alliances declare war, one Alliance can be invited.
(2) You can only invite Alliances within the defending faction that are in the same Goldust ranking group as your Alliance for defense support.
(3) If the invited Alliance agrees to defend, no further changes to defense partners can be made. If the R4 and above members of the invited Alliance do not agree, the R4 and above members of the inviting Alliance can change the defense invitation anytime.
(4) R3 members of the invited Alliance can vote on the invitation.
5. Preparation: During this stage, the war between the attacking and defending Alliances is confirmed and cannot be changed. The war stage begins after the preparation stage countdown ends. You can’t move the Alliance Center during the preparation stage.
6. War: During this stage, the defending Alliance's Alliance Center CAN be attacked. The attacking and defending Alliances can fight each other to determine the war's outcome.
(1) The attacking Alliance's Alliance Center does not need to be connected to the territory, and troops can directly execute attack commands. Defense partners entering the defending Alliance's Alliance Center won't engage with the inviter's or other defense partners' troops.
(2) If the attacking troops defeat all defending troops in the Alliance Center, they can reduce the Alliance Center's durability.
(3) If the Alliance Center is destroyed within the countdown, the attacking side wins, ending the war stage early.
(4) If the attacking side fails to destroy the Alliance Center within the countdown, the defending side wins.
(5) Certain actions during the war stage, such as killing enemy units or healing, can earn event points. Reaching point milestones will earn corresponding rewards.
(6) The war stage duration will vary based on the number of Alliances on the attacking and defending sides. The specific time is shown in the war stage countdown in the event interface.
(7) During the war stage, the Alliance Center's durability will not automatically recover, nor can the Alliance Center be relocated.
(8) If the defending Alliance's Alliance Center has 0 durability or hasn't been constructed when the battle begins, the defense will be considered lost. The attacking side will loot Goldust (divided evenly among multiple attacking Alliances).
(9) The Alliance Center has four support structures: the Sacred Water Hut, Exploratory Well, Mithril Plant, and Obelisk. Destroying these structures allows attackers to plunder 5% of the defenders' Goldust for each one taken down. 
7. End of war: During this stage, rewards are sent based on the war's final outcome.
(1) The winning Alliance can receive victory rewards in the event interface. If the defending Alliances (including defense partners) are fewer than the attackers, the rewards will be boosted, up to three times the normal rewards.
(2) If the attacking side wins, they can plunder a portion of Goldust from the defending Alliance (defense partners are NOT affected).
(3) When multiple Alliances are attacking, the Goldust rewards will be distributed proportionally based on the damage each Alliance did to the Alliance Center durability, while the defender's Goldust loss remains the same.
(4) The end of war stage lasts until server time 0:00 the next day. Unclaimed victory and event point rewards will be sent via mail.
(5) If the defending Alliance's R4 does not rebuild the Alliance Center ruins by the end of this stage, the ruins will be automatically rebuilt.

season_s3_hero_40006_story:
Scarlett was born in the Rainy Mistlands to a wealthy family with ties to the Bred clan. Her grandfather, a legendary businessman and leader of the secretive "Dragon's Lair," collected rare treasures in their castle, now a vault of historical relics.
These treasures weren't stolen but reclaimed from past wars, with the hope of returning them to their rightful owners. However, with many civilizations lost to time, the artifacts now rested untouched in the castle.
Scarlett was close to her grandfather and grew up inspired by his legacy. Her interests lay in archaeology and artifact appraisal, where she excelled at uncovering truths hidden in ancient relics.

Through her investigation, she discovered the murderers were former Dragon's Lair members, exiled for their greed. They stole from ancient ruins, forgotten temples, and even her family's collection.

season_s3_hero_50026_story:
To hunt her enemies, she founded the Scarlet Raiders, a group of treasure hunters that doubled as her means to track down her family's killers. Each clue brought her closer, intensifying her desire for revenge.
But when she found them, they had become zombies, stripped of their humanity and beyond retribution. Standing with her blade, Scarlett was overwhelmed by shock and despair. She realized her hatred had blinded her, trapping her in a cycle of misery.
Remembering her grandfather's teachings about peace and preserving treasures for the world, Scarlett decided her revenge was insignificant compared to the world's greater crisis.

She let go of her revenge, disbanded the Scarlet Raiders, and joined the Justice Vanguard . Scarlett chose to fight for hope and humanity, turning her skills to saving the world instead of avenging the past.

season_s3_activity_1000073_desc01: The silent desert holds the seeds of hope, and the oasis awaits bold commanders to restore its life. Greenification Rules: 1. Greenification Command: You can only greenify sand lands that are adjacent to existing greenified areas. 2. Progressive Expansion: The available greenification range will increase as the event progresses. 3. Greenification Progress: Once 80% of a region is greenified, it's considered complete and contributes to the overall warzone progress. 4. Desert Artifact: Greenified areas have a chance to reveal desert artifacts. Each region contains a set amount of artifacts. Stage 1 (Weeks 1-4 of the Season): 1. Greenification Range: Greenification unlocks only after a city is captured. 2. Restricted Areas: Strongholds, Trade Posts, and the Capitol cannot be greenified during this stage. 3. Greenification Start Point: Capturing a city will convert surrounding Contaminated Land into greenified areas, serving as the initial point for expansion. Stage 2 (Weeks 5-7 of the Season): 1. Greenification Expansion: Commanders can greenify regions starting from Level 1 and expand step-by-step to Cities, Strongholds, Trade Posts, and the Capitol. 2. Unlocking Progress: Reaching 80% greenification progress in the current level unlocks the next level, leading up to Level 7 Capitol greenification. 3. Cross-Warzone Greenification: Commanders can now greenify warzones freely across the 8 warzones within the same season group. Ranking and Rewards: During the season, commanders are ranked weekly based on the greenified area they've completed, with rewards distributed based on their ranking.

Dear Commander,
A new chapter of oasis building is here! With the efforts of all commanders, greenified land is spreading across the desert. The second stage of the "Building an Oasis" has now begun. Let's take the oasis to the next level of prosperity together!

Free Expansion: The greenification area now spans the entire season group! Commanders are no longer limited by warzones or alliance control and can freely select target areas to greenify.
2. Greenification Unlocked: Level 1 regions, including Cities, Strongholds, and Trade Posts, are now fully open to greenify.

3. Unlocking Progress: Reach an 80% greenification rate in the current region level to unlock the next one automatically. Continue the effort to unlock Level 7 greenification for the Capitol and achieve full warzone prosperity!

In this second stage, every greenified tile you create brings glory and rewards to you and your warzone! Complete greenification milestones at each stage to earn even more rewards!

Now is the time to show your strategy and leadership. Commanders, let's unite to turn the desert into an oasis and shape a brighter future!

season_s3_rules_desc02: Dr. Nier has uncovered the Monument of the Dead, bringing the Doom Legion back to power. Our mission to defeat him leads us to the mysterious Golden Realm, where ancient powers have magical effects on our soldiers.
season_s3_rules_desc04: Goldust is produced over time in captured Cities within the Golden Realm. The more Goldust your Alliance owns at the end of the season, the higher your ranking and the better your rewards.
season_s3_rules_desc06: The Alliance Center was created to tackle the desert's challenges. It provides vital bonuses and ensures smooth operations for commanders and their allies.
season_s3_rules_desc08: The mystical powers of the Golden Realm allow some resolute soldiers to convert into Desert Protectors after losing their lives in battle. With their unshakable will to protect, they march again to serve their commander! (Once they march, Desert Protectors return to the desert and will not return to the commander's base.)
season_s3_rules_desc10: After a unit is killed, a portion of the units can be converted into Desert Protectors with the help of allies. Using the special item, the Protector Horn, you can directly obtain the converted Desert Protectors.
season_s3_rules_desc12: The number of Desert Protectors you own determines which Protector skills are unlocked. More Protectors mean more powerful skill effects.
season_s3_rules_desc14: Allies can help commanders instantly convert pending Desert Protectors. At first, each help action converts 5 Protectors.
season_s3_rules_desc16: In the desert, sandworms pose a silent threat. Their vision is weak from years underground, but they react strongly to sound. Frequent battles by alliance members can draw their attention—be prepared for an attack. Discover and defeat them, and local residents will reward you.
season_s3_rules_desc18: Juvenile sandworms encircle the commander's base near the noise source when drawn out. Encircled bases cannot dispatch troops temporarily. You can escape using a teleport item, but the sandworm will flee, and rewards will be lost.
season_s3_rules_desc20: Adolescent Sandworms will attack the commander's base that created the noise source. The attacked base will be blasted away. If the base is within the alliance center's range, it will interfere with the Sandworm's path, protecting the base from attack.
season_s3_rules_desc22: Adult sandworms, with their massive size, are immune to regular sounds. To capture them, you must use Trap Landmines.
season_s3_rules_desc24: Sandworms pose a danger to locals but hold significant value. Defeating them rewards you with sandworm scales, which can be exchanged for valuable prizes from the locals.
season_s3_rules_desc26: This season's special buildings will assist you and your allies in surviving the harsh desert conditions and mysterious forces. At the end of the season, resources will turn into Profession EXP, and game season buildings will be dismantled.
season_s3_rules_desc28: This resource is for constructing season buildings, helping commanders adapt to the harsh desert environment. Any unused Mithril will be converted into Profession EXP at the end of the season, so use it wisely.
season_s3_rules_desc30: This resource is for constructing season buildings, helping commanders adapt to the harsh desert environment. Any unused Sacred Water will be converted into Profession EXP at the end of the season, so use it wisely.
season_s3_rules_desc32: A game-season structure that grants Curse Resistance. Use Sacred Water to upgrade its level. Higher resistance helps commanders better handle desert threats. The building will be dismantled after the season.
season_s3_rules_desc34: A game-season structure that improves Sacred Water production for your base. Upgrade it with Mithril to increase production, speeding up season building construction for a strategic advantage. The building will be dismantled after the season.
season_s3_rules_desc36: A game-season structure that strengthens the base stats of Desert Protectors. Upgrade it with Sacred Water and Mithril to improve their levels. A higher Altar level boosts Desert Protectors' effectiveness against enemies. The building will be dismantled after the season.
season_s3_rules_desc38: A game-season structure that increases the maximum capacity for Desert Protectors. Upgrade it with Sacred Water and Mithril to improve its level. Having more Desert Protectors unlocks more powerful skill effects.
season_s3_rules_desc40: The sleeping desert holds hope. Capture cities to transform the barren sands into lush greenery.
season_s3_rules_desc42: During our chat with Jones, we learned the desert hides countless treasures! Grab an Archaeologist Hammer and see what lies beneath the solid stones…
season_s3_rules_desc44: Under Nier's command, mummies are attacking fiercely, aiming for our alliance center. Without its protection, sandworms will hinder our advance. Gather your forces, defend against the mummies, and stop Dr. Nier's plans!
season_s3_rules_desc46: The commander's arrival has revitalized the desert, attracting merchants. However, trade often leads to disputes, and now a new war begins…
season_s3_rules_desc48: This season features a new world building: Trade Posts. Trade Posts of varying levels open at 12:00 server time (except on Wednesdays and Saturdays). Each Trade Post remains open for one hour, but if it is captured within that hour, the contest period will end early.
season_s3_rules_desc50: Capturing a Trade Post doesn't require adjacent territory. As long as a commander's base is on Contaminated Land surrounding the Trade Post, they can launch attacks and try to capture it. Commanders can also capture Trade Posts in other warzones. The commander who secures ownership becomes the Governor.
season_s3_rules_desc52: The Trade Post Governor can summon camel caravans. Once the caravan arrives, other commanders can buy items at the Trade Post. Each item in the Trade Post can only be purchased once per day. The Trade Post Governor can buy exclusive items, and allies of the Trade Post Governor enjoy discounts.
season_s3_rules_desc54: Diamonds spent at Trade Posts generate tax revenue. When all items sell out, or the Trade Post is abandoned by the Governor, the accumulated tax is sent to the Trade Post Governor as a Golden Egg, which can be shared in the chat.
season_s3_rules_desc56: In her fight against Nier, Scarlett experiences a breakthrough!
season_s3_rules_desc58: With deeper understanding of the desert and the habits of sandworms, along with the high value of their scales and rewards from defeating them, a new group of sandworm hunters has appeared. From here on, the battle dynamic may shift entirely...
season_s3_rules_desc60: The divide between natives and outsiders sparks a new conflict: the Scarlet Legion versus the Golden Tribe.
season_s3_rules_desc62: The most powerful warzones are chosen to represent their factions. Their overwhelming strength means they cannot be part of the same faction. (The top two warzones are ranked based on the total power of their top 500 commanders and will serve as faction leaders.)
season_s3_rules_desc64: As the ultimate desert resource, the amount of Goldust determines the final season ranking for Alliances. Secure the Goldust and become the ruler of the desert!
season_s3_rules_desc66: This legendary holy structure that seals the Monument of the Dead is Nier's last bastion. Conquer it to shatter his plans and bring a new leader to the desert!
season_s3_rules_desc68: After reclaiming the Great Pyramid and sealing the Monument of the Dead, the desert curse is lifted. It's time to transform the sands into a flourishing oasis.
season_s3_rules_desc70: As the war nears its end, the final battle between the factions is on the horizon. Capture the enemy's Great Pyramid to bring this conflict to a close!
decoration_desc16012: Whisper my name with reverence or fear, for I am the “Dragon God”, god of all that is fierce and merciless.
season_s3_sandworm_tips010: After the Sandworm is killed, rewards are sent via mail.
season_s3_pre_plot_01: Monica, I've confirmed that Nier from the Doom Legion has fled to the Golden Realm!
season_s3_pre_plot_02: Seriously? That place is nothing but endless desert, with hardly any modern civilization. Why would he go there?
season_s3_pre_plot_03: I'm not sure. I've visited a few times before, and it's not a peaceful place. Ancient protectors lie buried beneath the sands, and the whole empire is enveloped in a mysterious ancient force.
season_s3_pre_plot_04: If he gets access to that power, we're in big trouble. I'll head there myself to check it out.

season_s3_mail_desc80266:
Dear Commander,
Season III: Golden Realm is about to begin! Rally your allies and prepare for an epic journey through the scorching sands!
This season takes you deep into the desert's heartland, a realm of pyramids and pharaohs cloaked in ancient curses and mysteries. This barren yet captivating land brings searing heat by day, biting cold by night, and endless challenges. From giant sandworms lurking in the dunes to ancient mummy armies awaiting revival, danger lies in every corner!
Nier, now crowned the new Golden Emperor, commands the Monument of the Dead and has awakened a legion of mummies buried beneath the sands. Alongside his Doom Legion remnants, he's swept across the desert, turning oases to dust and cutting off vital supplies. The Golden Realm is in despair.
But hope remains. Scarlett has bravely seized the Monument of the Dead, granting us the ability to summon Protectors—powerful allies crucial in turning the tide against the mummies. Lead the Protector forces, face Nier's legions, and lift the desert's ancient curse to restore life to the Golden Realm!

The path ahead won't be easy. Beyond Nier's armies and colossal desert beasts, rival commanders also seek the desert's treasures and glory.

In Season III, the profession level cap increases to Lv.100, unlocking new skills and strategies. Expect new troops, structures, and thrilling desert-themed gameplay to arrive in style!
The drums of war echo across the sands—your legend begins now. Are you ready for the challenge?
Note: The Warzone will transition at the start of the season. The server will restart after the transition is complete. Please avoid starting alliance events when the countdown to the season start reaches zero.
season_s3_mail_desc80267:
Dear Commander,
Welcome to Season III: Golden Realm!
The desert is calling, its dangers greater than ever. Though our bases are confined to the desert's edge for now, this land brims with both peril and untold riches. Your alliance is ready—united to face sandstorms, massive sandworms, and hidden threats.

Here's how to dive into the season:
Read the Season Guide: Familiarize yourself with new desert strategies and gameplay.
Complete Main Quests: Explore the desert and earn valuable rewards.
Plan Alliance Strategies: Coordinate milestones and secure desert strongholds.
Follow World Dynamics: Stay ahead of dynamic season changes and activities.
Reach out to alliance leaders for advice on key strategies like sandworm hunting and oasis captures.

Commander, the fiery sands are ablaze with opportunity. Let the desert's trials forge your greatness!
