season_s3_plot1000: So, these sandstorms and mummies—are they all Nier's doing?
season_s3_plot1001: Exactly. He used the Monument of the Dead to transform the oasis into a desert and resurrect a horde of mummies.
season_s3_plot1002: The Monument of the Dead... is that what you're holding?
season_s3_plot1003: Yes, I took it from Nier. While it doesn't weaken him, it allows us to summon Protectors. With their help, we can defeat the mummy army, reclaim the Great Pyramid, and turn the desert back into an oasis!
season_s3_plot1004: This is the Monument of the Dead?
season_s3_plot1005: Yes, it may look worn, but it holds ancient, mysterious power.
season_s3_plot1006: To repair it, we must first decode the ancient technology of the Golden Realm.
season_s3_plot1007: The monument is covered with symbols and inscriptions. What do they mean?
season_s3_plot1008: "In the Golden Realm, death is not the end… Protectors await the call…"
season_s3_plot1009: Intriguing, but I don't get it.
season_s3_plot1010: It probably means fallen units don't truly die but become Protectors waiting to be summoned?
season_s3_plot1011: Ah, thanks for clarifying. Helpful, I guess.
season_s3_plot1012: Look over here! There's a big disc with four smaller ones on it!
season_s3_plot1013: These must represent the Protectors' unique abilities, right?
season_s3_plot1014: That's right. To unlock them, you'll need to summon more Protectors.
season_s3_plot1015: Sacred Water can be used to upgrade the Curse Research Lab and enhance Curse Resistance.
season_s3_plot1016: The Blessing Fountain is the most efficient way to generate Sacred Water.
season_s3_plot1017: Mithril, a mineral hidden beneath the desert, is essential for building seasonal structures.
season_s3_plot1018: Capturing digging strongholds is one of the best ways to gather Mithril!
season_s3_plot1019: For the locals, Goldust is not just for luxury but vital for rituals and a mark of status.
season_s3_plot1020: The complex craftsmanship required to produce Goldust greatly increases their rarity.
season_s3_plot1021: Goldust is known as the "Desert's Gold." Controlling the Goldust means controlling the desert.
season_s3_plot1022: Commander, you've discovered a rare creature—the Golden Scarab!
season_s3_plot1023: These beetles represent the ancient Golden Realm and are rumored to lead to hidden treasures.
season_s3_plot1024: Fast and elusive, they might bring you unexpected rewards!
season_s3_plot1025: Commander, congratulations to you and your Alliance for completing the Alliance Center!
season_s3_plot1026: This fortress is the strongest in the desert and a testament to your alliance's strength and unity.
season_s3_plot1027: It produces Goldust and provides powerful buffs to members within its range!
season_s3_plot1028: The Trade Post is the heart of rare resource exchange in the Golden Realm.
season_s3_plot1029: The person who controls the Trade Post is respected by the locals as the Governor.
season_s3_plot1030: Owning a Trade Post grants status and the opportunity to amass immense wealth.
season_s3_plot1031: Commander, you stand before the majestic Great Pyramid!
season_s3_plot1032: It's the desert's iconic landmark and the key to untold secrets and treasures.
season_s3_plot1033: But beware—countless enemies are drawn to it. Prepare yourself, as this will test your wisdom and strength!
season_s3_plot1034: This land was once a vibrant oasis but is now a lifeless wasteland.
season_s3_plot1035: Nier and his forces have utterly devastated it.
season_s3_plot1036: Commander, reclaim these cities, revive the oasis, and bring hope to the desert once again!
season_s3_rules_desc091: Protectors not only possess enhanced Curse Resistance but also have far superior stats compared to units of the same level.
season_s3_rules_desc093: Troops carrying Protectors can only bring 1/10 the number of regular units, but they are still far more powerful than units of the same level.
season_s3_rules_desc095: Protectors receive all unit buffs and gain additional strength by building and upgrading the Altar.

Once deployed for battle, Protectors will not return.
However, when the troops come back, commanders will earn Profession EXP (based on the number and level of Protectors).

running_boss_willy_rules:
Participation Conditions:
1. Players with a base level of 8 or above can participate.

How to Play
1. During the event, there's a high chance that Doom Walkers will attack commander's base. Stay alert and prepare for defense.
2. On the event day, when Doom Walker breach the commander's headquarters, the death rate of idle units decreases, and it won't blast away the Commander's Base.
3. During the event, defeating Doom Walkers may reveal Willson the Slugger. All rally participants are credited as discoverers.
4. Both the rally initiator and participants will consume stamina when rallying against Willson the Slugger.

Rewards:
1. During the event, the first kill reward of Doom Walker can be claimed up to 3 times.
2. Commanders who discover Willson the Slugger will receive a discoverer reward after Willson is defeated.
3. After completing Warzone tasks during the event, commanders who meet the conditions can claim rewards.
4. Rewards will be based on the total damage inflicted on Doom Walkers and will be sent after the event ends based on rankings.

season_s3_activity_plot_desc01: Wait... is that a real mummy?
season_s3_activity_plot_desc02: Yes. Nier awakened them using the Monument of the Dead. Stay sharp - they could attack at any moment.
season_s3_activity_plot_desc03: It's tragic how these ancient nobles have become mindless minions.
season_s3_activity_plot_desc04: Agreed. They deserve peace... Let's set them free!
season_s3_activity_plot_desc05: Monica, watch out! That's a Golden Mummy!
season_s3_activity_plot_desc06: A Golden Mummy? Sounds like something special.
season_s3_activity_plot_desc07: Correct. Only ancient high-ranking nobles underwent that ritual, meaning they're far stronger than regular mummies!
season_s3_activity_plot_desc08: Good thing you're here. I'll report this to the Commander. Let's not rush in recklessly!
season_s3_activity_plot_desc09: We're too late—the city has fallen...
season_s3_activity_plot_desc10: Unbelievable! The Doom Legion is even stronger than before.
season_s3_activity_plot_desc11: We can't let our guard down—the war isn't just making us stronger.
season_s3_activity_plot_desc12: You're right. We need to proceed carefully and connect our territory step by step.
season_s3_activity_plot_desc13: The Golden Tribe representatives invited us to join them.
season_s3_activity_plot_desc14: Hmm, I received an invite from the Scarlet Legion as well.
season_s3_activity_plot_desc15: Commanders are debating which faction to join—there's even a Faction Leader Warzone!
season_s3_activity_plot_desc16: It's a decision that could determine our allies and enemies, but I trust the Commander and President to make the best call!
season_s3_activity_plot_desc17: Scarlett, do you know about Goldust?
season_s3_activity_plot_desc18: Of course. Goldust is an underground resource as valuable as gold in the desert.
season_s3_activity_plot_desc19: No wonder factions are going to war over it.
season_s3_activity_plot_desc20: Exactly. We might be next. Let's get ready to defend our Goldust!
season_s3_activity_plot_desc22: It was caused by a sandworm moving underground. Sandworms have poor vision but incredible hearing.
season_s3_activity_plot_desc24: No worries. Sandworms are valuable—if we lure one out and defeat it, we can trade its scales for rare goods.
season_s3_activity_plot_desc25: Hey! I found a vault deep in the desert—wanna check it out?
season_s3_activity_plot_desc26: A vault? Could it hold artifacts from ancient nobles?
season_s3_activity_plot_desc27: Not really. This is archaeology—artifacts belong in museums. But I can offer you other rewards!
season_s3_activity_plot_desc28: You look intrigued—come on, grab your hammer! You'll need it to uncover treasures!
season_s3_activity_plot_desc29: Our scouts spotted Golden Mummies assembling near the Alliance Center.
season_s3_activity_plot_desc30: It's Nier's counterattack. But how many are there?
season_s3_activity_plot_desc31: Reports say around thirty. With the alliance's strength, we should manage.
season_s3_activity_plot_desc32: Rally the soldiers. Even with ally support, we must be battle-ready!
season_s3_activity_plot_desc33: Is this the trade post marked on the map? It looks abandoned.
season_s3_activity_plot_desc34: Probably due to Nier's rule—merchants no longer dare trade here, so it's deserted.
season_s3_activity_plot_desc35: That makes sense... If we reclaim it, we can restore its prosperity.
season_s3_activity_plot_desc36: Right, but trade posts attract competition, and where there's trade, there's conflict.
season_s3_activity_plot_desc37: Scarlett, look! The flowers I planted sprouted... but why did they wither so soon?
season_s3_activity_plot_desc38: It must be the curse from the Monument of the Dead. It's the same curse that turned the Golden Realm into a desert.
season_s3_activity_plot_desc39: I hate this curse! How do we lift it?
season_s3_activity_plot_desc40: The Doom Legion likely has devices maintaining the curse. If we capture the cities, they should recover.
season_s3_activity_plot_desc41: Commanders seem to have adapted—the sandworms aren't a threat anymore.
season_s3_activity_plot_desc42: Yes! I heard some Commanders are even hunting them on purpose.
season_s3_activity_plot_desc43: No surprise—sandworm scales are highly valuable at the market.
season_s3_activity_plot_desc45: The ultimate faction battle is here—are you ready?
season_s3_activity_plot_desc46: I won't mess up this time!
season_s3_activity_plot_desc47: Don't beat yourself up, Scarlett. We've already taken Nier down, haven't we?
season_s3_activity_plot_desc48: Thank you, Monica! I will give it my all in this final battle!

mail_content30113:
Dear Commander,
We have optimized the decoration upgrade rules in this update. Some commanders encountered an issue where, during "decoration repairs," the number of required level 1 same-name decorations were not correctly calculated when there were multiple same-name decorations above level 1 in their headquarters.

The issue has been resolved. If there are multiple same-name decorations above level 1 in your headquarters, the highest-level decoration will be kept, and the others will be split into the corresponding number of level 1 decorations. You can now use them normally for "decoration repairs."

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused. Thank you for your understanding and support. Enjoy the game!

activity_desc_99130:
1. During the event, Commanders can use "Rose Tokens" to spin for rewards. Each spin grants points, and reaching the required points unlocks stage rewards.
2. You can complete daily tasks to collect patterns and receive rewards during the event. If you complete a task but don't claim the reward in time, it will be sent via mail the next day.
3. If the result includes a Chest pattern, it will trigger a chest opening. You can choose one chest to open. For each Rose Chest pattern in a single spin result, there is one chance to open a chest, offering great rewards.
4. The more matching patterns in the spin result, the better the rewards. When using the 5x spin mode, both the consumption and rewards will be 5 times the initial amount.
5. During the event, purchasing Rose Token packs can earn you a Diamond Golden Egg.
6. At the end of the event, unused Rose Tokens will be converted to Universal Speed-up Items and sent to your mailbox. Items not retrieved on time will expire and can be manually converted into universal Speed-up items in your inventory.
7. Conversion Rate: Rose Token *1 = 1-minute Speed-up item *30
activity_desc_99131:

2. Each item category in the store has a limit on <color=#099b4a>the number of exchanges</color>. Once all exchanges are made, no more can be made.
3. Once an item is exchanged in the store, it cannot be returned. Please choose wisely.
4. After the exchange store closes, <color=#099b4a>Valentine's Day Vouchers</color>, <color=#099b4a>Valentine's Day Voucher Lucky Chests</color> and <color=#099b4a>Valentine's Day Lucky Chests</color> will be converted into universal Speed-up Items and sent via mail. Items not retrieved on time will expire and can be manually converted into universal Speed-up items in your inventory.
5. Conversion Rate: Valentine's Day Voucher *1 = 1-minute Universal Speed-up item *20. Valentine's Day Voucher Lucky Chest *1 = 1-minute Universal Speed-up item *30. Valentine's Day Lucky Chest *1 = 1-minute Universal Speed-up item *20

season_s3_activity1000067_story_desc_UR:
To hunt her enemies, she founded the Scarlet Raiders, a group of treasure hunters that doubled as her means to track down her family's killers. Each clue brought her closer, intensifying her desire for revenge.

But when she found them, they had become zombies, stripped of their humanity and beyond retribution. Standing with her blade, Scarlett was overwhelmed by shock and despair. She realized her hatred had blinded her, trapping her in a cycle of misery.

Remembering her grandfather's teachings about peace and preserving treasures for the world, Scarlett decided her revenge was insignificant compared to the world's greater crisis.

She let go of her revenge, disbanded the Scarlet Raiders, and joined the Justice Vanguard.

Scarlett chose to fight for hope and humanity, turning her skills to saving the world instead of avenging the past.

season_s3_faction_war_desc08:
ABOUT THE EVENT
1. The Faction Duel is the ultimate battle between the [Scarlet Legion] and [Golden Tribe], with the winning faction claiming a large amount of Goldust.
2. The duel lasts 7 days: Monday to Saturday are for contesting invasion rights, and Sunday is the battle day.
3. During the contest stage, the 4 warzones of the same faction will compete for points against the opposing faction. The faction with the most points earns attack rights.
4. Battles take place in the defending faction's highest-ranked Goldust Warzone.
5. After the battle begins, in Cannon and Capitol battles, commanders within the same faction will support each other, and victory is determined by capture progress of factions.
6. The Goldust reward for the winning side depends on how many buildings are held by the faction at the end of the battle:
Control Capitol: +10M
Control each Cannon: +5M
7. Please note, the Goldust only affect the [Faction] leaderboard, and the winning faction's Alliance won't get any additional Goldust.
season_s3_faction_war_desc09:

1. When an Alliance captures a City, it periodically generates Goldust.
2. Earn Goldust by winning as the attacker in the Goldust Conquest.
3. Season-end rewards are given based on Alliance Goldust rankings.
4. Note: Leaderboard data updates with a delay.
season_s3_faction_war_desc10:
WARZONE GOLDUST:
1. Warzone Goldust is the total Goldust of all Alliances within the warzone.
2. Rewards this season aren't based on warzone Goldust ranks: They're just for show.
3. Note: Leaderboard data updates with a delay.
season_s3_faction_war_desc11:
FACTION GOLDUST:
1. Faction Goldust totals Goldust of all Alliances within the faction.
2. Season-end rewards are given based on Faction Goldust rankings.

season_s3_faction_war_desc19:
1. After the declaration stage ends, you can check the [War Status] panel.
 Invitation Stage: If there are more than one attacking Alliance, the defending Alliance can invite other Alliances of the same faction with similar Goldust rankings, who haven't been declared on, to assist in defense.
Preparation Stage: After the invitation stage, the preparation stage begins. The war duration and reward multiplier will be adjusted based on the number of attacking and defending Alliances.
When both sides have an equal number of Alliances, the war will last 40 minutes, with x1 reward for defense victory.
If the defending Alliances are one fewer than the attackers, the war time reduces to 30 minutes, with x2 rewards for defense victory.

season_s3_faction_war_desc40:
Monday to Saturday is the Faction Points Race Phase. The Faction with the highest points gains the invasion right. 
The invaders can head to the highest-ranking Goldust warzone of the opposing faction on Sunday and attempt to seize their Capitol.
The faction with lower points becomes the defenders, who need to protect their Capitol in the highest Goldust ranking warzone of their own faction on Sunday. 
Faction points can be obtained by completing following acts:
season_s3_faction_war_desc41:
Schedule
Saturday [24:00:00] 
Faction scoring contest ends
Sunday [00:04:00]
Invasion and defense zones are determined based on Faction points.
Sunday [00:05:00] 
Invading Faction commanders can teleport to the defending warzone. 
Sunday [12:00:00] 
Capitol and giant cannons are removed from protected status and officially enter the capture stage. 
Sunday [12:00:00]~[16:00:00] 
The winner of the Faction Duel is decided. 
Sunday [24:00:00] 
Enemy elimination event ends, and the ranking rewards are settled. 

Capitol Defense Rules 
When Capitol Defense begins, the 4 giant cannons become available for capture as well. 
In battles for Capitol and giant cannons, commanders from the same faction are considered of the same side, meaning no combat among them. 
For example, when Alliance A from [Golden Tribe] faction seizes the Capitol, commanders from Alliance B [Golden Tribe] faction will assist in defending the structure when dispatched to Capitol.
The Capitol can accommodate up to 100 garrisoned troops. 
A giant cannon can accommodate up to 100 garrisoned troops. 

Giant Cannon Capabilities 
Giant cannons are crucial strategic weapons in Capitol defense. 
After capturing a giant cannon, it automatically attacks the enemy-held Capitol and kills certain amounts of units garrisoned inside at regular intervals. 
When your side tries to seize the Capitol, the captured giant cannon significantly accelerates the Capitol capture. 

Successful Capitol Capture 
Capitol Defense lasts a maximum of 4 hours, if both warzones stay below 100%, the defenders win. 
The winning faction will receive a substantial amount of [Faction Goldust] at the end of the battle if the Capitol is under their control and based on the number of Cannons collected.
Control Capitol +10M
Control each Giant Cannon +5M
Once the Capitol contest ends, leaderboard rankings will be locked (commanders can still earn points and collect chests).

activity_desc_99136:
How to Play:
1. Kill <color=#249bc5>zombies</color> to collect <color=#099b4a>Cocoa Beans</color>.
2. Use Cocoa Beans to craft <color=#249bc5>chocolate</color> gifts.
3. <color=#249bc5>Send gifts</color> to other players and earn <color=#099b4a>rewards</color> for <color=#249bc5>both sender and recipient</color>.
4. The recommended player list displays <color=#a66cf0>albums</color> and publicly visible <color=#a66cf0>photos posted on their Moments</color>.
5. Only photos uploaded after January 20, 2025, at 20:00 (server time) will appear in recipient profiles.

Gift Rewards:
1. Sending <color=#099b4a>Chocolates</color> and <color=#f53c3d>Romance Rockets</color> earns 10 and 1000 <color=#099b4a>gifting points, respectively</color>.
2. Chocolate gifts grant 2 <color=#099b4a>Standard Gift Boxes</color> to the sender and 1 to the recipient.
3. Romance Rocket gifts grant both sender and recipient 1 <color=#f53c3d>Ultimate Gift Box</color>.

Leaderboard Rankings:
1. Players are ranked based on <color=#099b4a>gifting points</color> earned during the event. Rewards will be sent based on final rankings by the end of the event.
2. Players need a minimum of 300 gifting points to join the leaderboard.

Cross-warzone Gifting:
1. Players can send Romance Rockets to others across servers through the cross-warzone gifting feature.
2. Only <color=#f53c3d>Romance Rocket</color> gifts are allowed for cross-warzone gifting.
3. Special Groups: Servers 3-36, 37-60, and 1281-1291.
4. Other Groups: Starting from Server 61, every 20 servers form one cross-warzone group.

Cocoa Bean Drops:
1. Kill <color=#a66cf0>zombies</color> on the world map to collect <color=#099b4a>Cocoa Beans</color>.
2. Wanted Bosses drop 2-10 Cocoa Beans each time, other sources drop 1-5.
3. Drop probabilities are equal for all quantities.
4. Players must have a 15-day-old account and Base above Level 14 to collect Cocoa Beans from Cocoa Bean drops.

Item Conversion:
1. At the end of the event, Cocoa Beans will be <color=#f53c3d>converted</color> into universal speedup items and sent via mail.
2. Conversion rate: 1 Cocoa Bean = 1-minute Universal Speed-up *2.
3. Expired items can be manually converted from the inventory.
activity_desc_99137:
How to Play:
1. During the event, receiving a <color=#099b4a>chocolate</color> gift will award 1 Standard Gift Box, receiving a <color=#f53c3d>Romance Rocket</color> gift will award 1 Ultimate Gift Box.
2. Opening gift boxes grants <color=#a66cf0>Charisma Points</color>, which can be used to increase Charisma Ranks and earn rewards.
3. Opening gift boxes also grants <color=#a66cf0>Gift Box Tokens</color>. Consuming a specified amount of these Tokens lets you randomly obtain one gift box with the following probabilities: <color=#099b4a>Standard Gift Box {0}</color>, <color=#249bc5>Rare Gift Box {1}</color>, <color=#a66cf0>Deluxe Gift Box {2}</color>, <color=#f53c3d>Ultimate Gift Box {3}</color>.
4. After the event ends, the item Charisma Card will be added to your inventory, recording your final Charisma rank and leaderboard rank.
5. After claiming the <color=#249bc5>Charisma Rank Reward</color>, you will receive a limited-time Valentine's Day themed aesthetic effect for your base on world map.

Charisma Ranks:
1. <color=#249bc5>Opening gift boxes</color> grants <color=#a66cf0>Charisma Points</color>. Collecting a specified amount of Charisma Points earns you a Charisma Star.
2. Every 5 Charisma Stars increases your <color=#a66cf0>Charisma Rank</color> by one.
3. There are 5 Charisma Ranks: Trainee, Rising Star, Celebrity, Idol, and Superstar.
4. Once you reach Superstar, further rank-ups are not possible.

The Leaderboard:
1. Rankings are based on the <color=#a66cf0>Charisma Ranks</color> of players within the server.
2. Players must reach Rising Star to qualify for the leaderboard.
3. The daily Eternal Elegance title owner receives <color=#099b4a>exclusive rewards</color> and distributes <color=#099b4a>gifts</color> to all players in the server.
4. Each player can only win Eternal Elegance once.
5. For the first 7 days, at 00:00 server time, the highest-ranked player who has not yet won the Eternal Elegance will receive the title.

Settlement Period:
1. During the settlement period, you can still open gift boxes to increase your rank.
2. On the 8th day of the event, which is the settlement period, <color=#f53c3d>no additional Eternal Elegance titles</color> will be awarded.

Item Conversion:
1. After the event ends, unused items like Cocoa Beans will be <color=#f53c3d>converted</color> into universal speedup items and sent via mail.
2. Conversion rates:
(a) Standard Gift Box*1 = 1-minute Universal Speed-up *10
(b) Rare Gift Box*1 = 1-minute Universal Speed-up *30
(c) Deluxe Gift Box *1 = 1-minute Universal Speed-up* 100
(d) Ultimate Gift Box *1 = 1-minute Universal Speed-up* 1000
(e) Gift Box Token *1 = 1-minute Universal Speed-up* 1
3.Unconverted items will expire but can be manually redeemed from your inventory.
activity_99136_55:
1. During the event, the Leaderboard is settled daily at 00:00, selecting the "Eternal Elegance" of the day.
2. Each player can earn the title of "Eternal Elegance" only once.
3. The last day of the event is the settlement period, and no new "Eternal Elegance" will be selected during this time.

season_s3_mail_desc80268:
Dear Commander,
With the sands settling, this season has officially ended, entering the settlement stage. We appreciate your dedication and impressive performance!

Settlement Stage Changes:
1. Leaderboards locked: All season rankings are now final.
2. Alliance rewards: R5 or [Butler] can assign rewards based on the alliance tier.
3. Season activities close: Special game modes will gradually shut down, with data cleared or reset.
4. Cross-warzone teleport: Teleporting between warzones within the season's warzone group is no longer allowed.
5. Combat restrictions: You can no longer declare war on or attack cities, strongholds, and trade posts.
6. No resource generation: Cities, strongholds, and alliance centers will stop producing resources.
7. Purchases disabled – [Season Battle Pass] and [Season Weekly Pass] are no longer available.
8. Buff removed: The additional effects from the game Season Boost event have been removed.

After the settlement stage ends, you will see the following changes:
1. Protector content removed: Greenification and Protector-related mechanics will be disabled. [Protector Horns] and [Protectors] will be cleared and converted into [Recruitment Orders].
2. Resource conversion: [Mithril], [Sacred Water], [Trap Landmine Refill], [Archaeologist Hammers], [Sandworm Scales], [Alliance Compasses], and [Desert Compasses] will be removed and converted into Profession EXP.
3. Protector's Field reset: The facility will revert to level 1, and Protectors will not be available outside the season.
4. Season buildings removed: All personal and alliance seasonal structures will be removed.
5. Alliance Loot will be cleared: Alliance leaders should distribute any remaining loot before they disappear.

What Stays the Same: 1. Profession levels, EXP, and Profession EXP items. 2. Greenification progress and city capture status.

Thank you for playing this season! Off-season events are on the way—stay tuned for more fun!
season_s3_mail_desc80269:
Dear Commanders,
Your bravery during the season has once again saved the world. Thank you for your active participation, the season has successfully ended, and the season entrance is now closed.

Here's what's changed:
1. Greenification and Protector-related mechanics are disabled.
2. All Individual and Alliance season buildings have been removed (your power may drop as a result).
3. Season-specific skills have been reset, and all skill points have been returned.
4. Season tasks have been reset and cleared.
5. Exclusive season resources and items have been removed (Mithril, Sacred Water, Protectors, Trap Landmine Refill, Archaeologist Hammers, Sandworm Scales, Protector Horns, Alliance Compasses, and Desert Compasses).
6. Protector's Field has been reset, and Protectors will not be available outside the season.
7. The game season hero recruitment event has ended (any remaining tickets can be used in the next season).
8. The game season monsters, Desert Ruins, and desert guests have disappeared.
9. The Trade Post shop is now closed, and items are no longer available for purchase.

But remember, the tides of war are ever-changing, and new challenges are on the horizon! In the next season, we will embark on a new adventure and continue to build the legend!

The Train Conductor can invite an alliance member as a VIP Passenger.

There are two types of VIP passenger:
1. Special Guest – A lucky rider! Invite your closest ally and earn rewards!
2. The Guardian Defender will replace the Conductor to defend the train against plunderers.

Special Note: VIP passenger rewards include rewards in two train carriage slots chosen by the Train Conductor. If you need to adjust the rewards, please contact the Conductor. <color=#099b4a>The Conductor's rewards stay the same.</color>

alliance_train_vip_rules: Participation Conditions 1. The alliance must have at least 20 members. 2. Members must have unlocked the train station and have been in the Alliance for over 24 hours. 3. Each Alliance can send out 1 regular train and 2 Mega Express Trains daily. Note: Only Alliances in the top 50 of this server's ranking can get a regular train each day. [Train Details] 1. Regular Train: At 0:00 each day (server time), eligible Alliances will get a trade train. An R4 or R5 member must assign a conductor for the train to enter the preparation stage. 2. Mega Express Train: When no train is being prepared, the commander can summon a Mega Express Train and will automatically be assigned as conductor. 3. The train consists of four carriages, numbered 1 to 4 from top to bottom, each carrying different rewards. [Train Preparation Stage] 1. The preparation stage lasts 4 hours. Afterward, the train will automatically set off for trade in various cities. 2. Conductor: Can assign a guard team and refresh cargo items on the train. A bonus surprise will be unlocked after 5 refreshes! 3. Passengers: Can queue at their desired carriage and switch freely. Once preparation ends, no further queuing is allowed, and the system will randomly select 5 passengers for each carriage. [Train Operation] 1. While moving, the train can be attacked by other commanders. Successful attacks will plunder 3 random cargo slots. 2. Each train can be plundered a maximum of 3 times. [Train Rewards] 1. Conductor: Receives all remaining cargo items in the engine slot and carriage slots. 2. Passengers: Receive any remaining cargo items in their carriage slot. Train Privileges 1. When the Alliance Gift Level reaches 8, 12, 16, and 20, the daily free train will gain special privileges. 2. Purchased Mega Express Trains will automatically have all privileges.

season_building_mail_desc:
Commander,
With Nier's defeat, peace has returned to the Golden Realm. Yet, the Protector's Field still holds its power. With Jones' guidance, I have uncovered a hidden truth—once the Protectors complete their duty of defending the Golden Realm, they may pledge their allegiance to a new emperor. Commander, I believe that emperor is you. If you choose to keep the Protector's Field, its level will reset during the season's rest period, and the Protectors will not awaken. Existing Guardians will stay by your side in the form of [Recruitment Orders]. No matter where your journey leads, in any war as fierce as the battles of the Golden Realm, they will stand with you once more!

—Scarlett

1. Collect 5 keys during the event to unlock the Mega Secure Chest and claim great rewards!

2. Complete daily tasks to earn Badges. Accumulate enough Badges to get the keys. Note: Badges can only be obtained by purchasing packs that contain Diamonds.

3. At server reset (00:00 UTC), players will be ranked based on the number of Badges earned that day. Rewards will be sent via in-game mail.

4. When the event ends, final rankings will be determined based on total Badges earned throughout the event. Rewards will be delivered via mail. Note: Mail delivery may take a few minutes. Please be patient.

5. Daily Plan:
Day 1: Radar Training
Day 2: Base Expansion
Day 3: Age of Science
Day 4: Train Heroes
Day 5: Unit Training
Day 6: Enemy Buster

season_alliance_photo_help_1: Don't let the desert winds erase your glory—this season's group photo will preserve your achievements! Event Rules 1. The event is available once season rewards are distributed. 2. During the event, you can take group photos and leave messages via the event menu or the Season Memorial Hall. 3. After the event ends, all content will be locked but remains viewable in the Season Memorial Hall. Alliance Binding 1. Commanders can only participate in the group photo event within the alliance they were in when rewards were distributed. Leaving the alliance means you can only view but not edit. 2. If a commander rejoins the reward-eligible alliance during the event, they can continue editing their group photo and messages. Group Photo Settings 1. Avatar Placement: Drag to adjust avatar positions. Avatars cannot overlap. 2. Frame Rewards: Based on alliance rankings across the 8 warzones: 1st place: Unlocks all frames. 2nd–20th place: Unlocks [Desert Elite]. Other alliances: Unlock [Desert Blessing]. 3. Avatar Size: Avatar size varies based on reward tiers. Commanders who receive Alliance Leader Reward, Tactician Reward, or Core Reward will have slightly larger avatars than other commanders. Additional Notes 1. If a player was not in an alliance during the season settlement or their alliance did not qualify for rewards, they cannot participate in the group photo or messaging. 2. If an alliance is disbanded, players can still view previously generated group photos and messages in the Memorial Hall, but they can no longer edit them. 3. Players with multiple seasonal group photos can review them in the Memorial Hall's history list. 4. Commanders must agree to the Player Guidelines before participating. Gather your allies and make your season memories last!

battlesystem_info1_new:
1. Drones will continuously attack enemies in battle, <color=#099b4a>they themselves cannot be attacked.</color>

2. Drones can gain a certain amount of experience progression when undergoing <color=#099b4a>Data Training</color>. When the progress is filled, the drone will level up and improve its Attributes. <color=#099b4a>The Attributes of the drone will be converted into the Attributes of your Heroes at a certain ratio. For the conversion ratio and the actual increase in Hero Attributes, please click on the relevant location on the interface</color>
When consuming Battle Data for Data Training, there is a chance of a training critical hit:
When the training progress is less than 80%, there is a 50% chance of a critical hit, which doubles the experience progress equivalent to the consumed Battle Data.
When the training progress is 80% or more, there will be no training critical hit.
Training that requires additional Drone Parts will not result in a training critical hit.

3. When the Drone level reaches <color=#099b4a>30/50/70/90/110</color>, the skill level increases.

4. The <color=#099b4a>Drone Component</color> feature is unlocked when the Headquarters reaches level 15. A drone can equip up to 6 components, which can greatly enhance the Hero's Attributes. For components at level 7 or below, 3 components of the same type and level can be merged to obtain a higher-level component of the same type.
Once a component reaches level 8 or higher for the first time, it can no longer be upgraded through merging and must be upgraded using <color=#099b4a>Research Points</color> instead.
For every <color=#099b4a>1%</color> increase in research progress, the component gains an attribute boost. At <color=#099b4a>20%/40%/60%/80%/100%</color>, the component will receive an additional attribute boost.
<color=#099b4a>Note: Any research progress increase below 1% will not grant an attribute boost.</color>

5. On the 82nd day after the server launch, players can unlock the <color=#099b4a>Combat Boost</color> and <color=#099b4a>Skill Chip</color> systems. The <color=#099b4a>Combat Boost</color> system lets players upgrade Drones even more, ascending their stats. Once <color=#099b4a>Combat Boost</color> reaches Level 10, the <color=#099b4a>Skill Chip</color> system becomes available.
With the <color=#099b4a>Skill Chip</color> system, players can equip an <color=#099b4a>Initial Skill, an Offensive Skill, an Interference Skill, and a Defensive Skill</color>. Players can choose a chip preset before battles to activate those skills for the Drone. SSR and UR rarity skill chips can use same-name chips to ascend their stars, further <color=#099b4a>boosting skill chip effects</color>.
Unused chips can also be used for the <color=#099b4a>Combat Boost</color>. Every time you advance to a new Combat Boost Stage, the <color=#099b4a>Chip Skill Boost</color> increases, adding extra power to chip skills.

decoration_desc16020:
[Welcome to EdN] – I run to the convenience store every day, just to keep buying apples. This life feels like a nightmare.
Some days, I'd get hit by a car while riding my bike. Other days, two guys in blue uniforms would mistake me for a courier and start questioning me.
The stares around me were cold, filled with pity and confusion.
Before I knew it, my body had twisted beyond recognition. I was no longer just a "cursed mutant"...
I had become a "Cursed Abnormality."

1. The battle stage lasts up to 30 minutes. If the alliance defeats all three Sandworm stages within the time limit, all members who participated in the battle will receive the highest-tier individual rewards!
2. If you enable Offline Participation, your troops will automatically join your allies' rally against the Sandworm while you're offline.
new_alliance_boss_tips_08: Your alliance will continue to gain combat experience in battles against the Sandworm. The training monster will now upgrade to a Large Sandworm, and its level will be adjusted based on the highest difficulty challenge your alliance has completed. 1. In Stage 1, the Sandworm has no special abilities. If it takes a massive hit, it will be stunned—so strike fast! 2. In Stage 2, the Sandworm summons small sandworms to entangle bases. Defeat them to earn treasure chests and deal extra damage to the Large Sandworm. 3. In Stage 3, the Sandworm enters a Rampage Mode, repeatedly attacking nearby bases. A successful defense will briefly stun it, leaving it vulnerable to extra damage.
new_alliance_boss_tips_09:
[Selection Stage]
1. When switching stages, the Sandworm level will be unlocked based on the highest difficulty your alliance has previously defeated:
Levels 1-2: Unlocks a Lv. 20 Sandworm.
Levels 3-4: Unlocks a Lv. 30 Sandworm
Levels 5-6: Unlocks a Lv. 40 Sandworm
Levels 7-8: Unlocks a Lv. 50 Sandworm
Levels 9-10: Unlocks a Lv. 60 Sandworm
Levels 11-12: Unlocks a Lv. 70 Sandworm
An R4 or R5 must set the difficulty and battle time before the event begins. At least 20 members are required to start. If no time is selected by 22:00 (server time) on the final event day, the event will expire.
2. Once confirmed, the event moves into the Preparation Stage.

[Preparation Stage]
1. Alliance members can donate resources to earn Alliance Contribution and boost their Critical Hit rate in battle.
2. After the donation goal is reached, members can still contribute for Alliance Contribution, but it won't increase the Critical Hit rate further.

[Battle Stage]
1. An R4 or R5 must manually start the battle, which lasts for 30 minutes.
2. Once started, a Sandworm will appear in the Drill Field. Commanders can only attack by rallying troops. Donation levels boost Critical Hit rate, and attacks have a chance to deal 200% Critical Damage. There are 3 stages:
Stage 1: No special skills. A single powerful attack can stun the Sandworm—attack fast!
Stage 2: Summons small sandworms that entangle nearby bases. Defeating them drops treasure chests and also damages the Large Sandworm.
Stage 3: Enters a Rampage Mode, repeatedly attacking nearby bases. Successful defense stuns it briefly, allowing for increased damage. Failed defense reduces base durability.
3. R4s and Officers initiating rallies get extra damage bonuses.
4. Rewards are based on: The highest defeated stage, and the total personal damage dealt.
5. Enabling Offline Participation lets your strongest queue auto-join a rally with 20 seconds left, if a slot is available.

[Rewards]
1. The more the defeated Sandworm stage, the better the rewards. Beating stage 3 unlocks the next difficulty.
2. The more damage you deal, the better your individual rewards. If the Sandworm is defeated, all members who participated in the battle will receive the highest-tier individual rewards.
3. When a Small Sandworm is defeated, it drops 1 lootable chest on nearby open ground. The chest can be collected up to 10 times, and each commander can claim up to 2 Small Sandworm chests per event. When a Large Sandworm is defeated, it drops 10 lootable chests on nearby open ground. Each chest can be collected up to 3 times, and each commander can claim up to 1 Large Sandworm chest per event.

warrior_eagle_plot_1_1: Whoa! What a cool base. The hero who crushed the Doom Legion must be here, right?
warrior_eagle_plot_1_2: Hello? Anyone home? I’m from the Golden Tribe and I’m looking for someone. Can you help me out?
warrior_eagle_plot_1_3: You look exhausted—come on in, grab a bite, and we’ll talk.
warrior_eagle_plot_2_1: Hi, everyone! I’m Meritt, I have a companion named "Skybreaker," a hawk.
warrior_eagle_plot_2_2: My tribe used to train hawks to defend ourselves. But with all the modern tech, people stopped needing them.
warrior_eagle_plot_2_3: Skybreaker was raised by my mother. He grew up with me and fought to protect us from the sandworms and the Doom Legion.
warrior_eagle_plot_2_4: But they were too strong. Skybreaker got hurt and disappeared. The Doom Legion even took the Golden Horn—the artifact that summons hawks.
warrior_eagle_plot_2_5: If I can find the horn, even if it’s just for a chance, I want to sound the Horn to let Skybreaker know I still believe in him.
warrior_eagle_plot_2_6: That’s not good… We’ve already gone through everything the Doom Legion left behind—no sign of anything like a horn.
warrior_eagle_plot_2_7: But—I found this! It’s a transport log that marks where the Horn’s pieces are. We can put it back together!
warrior_eagle_plot_2_8: No worries—our Commander’s got this! Follow the records, and we’ll find Skybreaker together!
warrior_eagle_plot_3_1: Commander, we found a bunch of notes while searching.
warrior_eagle_plot_3_2: Looks like a journal from one of the Golden Tribe...
warrior_eagle_plot_3_3: Let me check it... hmm, these characters look familiar. I’ll translate it and keep it safe for you. Check it out anytime.
warrior_eagle_plot_4_1: I can’t believe it... we rebuilt the Golden Horn! You’re amazing, Commander.
warrior_eagle_plot_4_2: Just one final step—you're the one to sound the Golden Horn!
warrior_eagle_plot_4_3: Come on, let’s be there for the moment!
warrior_eagle_plot_5_2: A bit nervous… but I’m ready!
warrior_eagle_plot_6_1: I’m sorry… I gave it everything, but it’s not working...
warrior_eagle_plot_7_3: Sounds like the horn echoed far. Let’s give it a minute.
warrior_eagle_plot_7_5: Still nothing... maybe Skybreaker forgot what our call sounds like. It’s been so long.
warrior_eagle_plot_7_6: Don’t be sad. Let’s return to base. We’ll try again next time.
warrior_eagle_plot_8_1: I didn’t find him, but I’ve fulfilled my wish. Thanks for everything, Commander.
warrior_eagle_plot_8_2: Wait... is that a bird call?
warrior_eagle_plot_8_3: Look—up there! A huge bird is flying straight to our base!
warrior_eagle_plot_9_2: KEE-ARR! (The hawk seems thrilled to see Meritt again)
warrior_eagle_plot_9_3: I swear, I won’t ever let you go again. Will you still fight by my side?
warrior_eagle_plot_9_5: Commander, I have one final request. Please let Skybreaker and me stay. He needs battles to stay strong, and I know you’ll help him become a true warrior.
warrior_eagle_plot_9_6: Hehe, just like our gorilla, right big guy?
warrior_eagle_plot_9_8: Then it’s settled—Commander, let Skybreaker be your wings! We’ll help you raise a true Hawk Overlord!
warrior_eagle_task_plot_1_1: This is it—the place from the journal!
warrior_eagle_task_plot_1_2: The Doom Legion really hid it inside these ruins. Let’s check around and see what we find.
warrior_eagle_task_plot_1_4: Found it! A piece of the Golden Horn!
warrior_eagle_task_plot_1_5: Looks like those notes were right after all. Meritt, you’re sharper than you look!
warrior_eagle_task_plot_2_1: Looks like we’ll need to take down this enemy to move forward.
warrior_eagle_task_plot_2_2: Then let’s do it, Commander—your orders!
warrior_eagle_task_plot_3_1: Weird... the piece isn’t here. The location should’ve been right...
warrior_eagle_task_plot_3_2: Wait...is that Jones? What are you doing here?
warrior_eagle_task_plot_3_3: Scarlett! Haha, what a coincidence. Wow, still on fire as always!
warrior_eagle_task_plot_3_4: Cut the chatter. Tell me—did you sneak ahead and grab the horn piece? Hand it over!
warrior_eagle_task_plot_3_5: Alright, alright! You and the Commander helped me out a ton. Take it! If I sound that horn, I might end up as bird chow anyway.
warrior_eagle_task_plot_4_1: Take down the big one ahead—that’s the last piece we need!
warrior_eagle_task_plot_4_2: I can’t wait to meet the Hawk!

dominator_story_hawk_content_1:
Golden sunlight bathed the desert as Thunderclaw and I hunted a giant sandworm—the shadow of death itself.
A gift from the Golden Priest, Thunderclaw was my lifelong companion. At dawn, I listened to the dunes, while Thunderclaw soared above, tracing the tremors of prey. One sharp cry—and I knew. The hunt had begun.
dominator_story_hawk_content_2:
Today, I finally wore a wedding gown woven from gold. So light—nothing like the heavy armor I’ve worn for so long.
In the grand hall, warm fire lit the murals and prayers echoed. Everyone smiled. I felt alone.
I approached the Golden Horn, quietly lifted it, and played a familiar tune.
A gust of wind—then, a cry from above.
Thunderclaw was back.
Her golden wings cut through the sky like sunlight. She swooped down from above and landed right next to me. For the first time that day, I smiled.
dominator_story_hawk_content_3:
We once hunted with bows and talons, guided by wind and sun. Now, the battlefield roared with metal, gunpowder, and machines. Steel-winged drones patrolled the skies, needing no rest. Sandworms were shredded by precise bombs—no more tracking or patience required.
Thunderclaw was no longer my weapon...
She stood aside, silently watching me as I learned to wield new weapons.
She no longer took to the skies, nor let out her proud cry. What once soared now sat in silence. The proud hawks faded, their golden feathers drifting away.
Thunderclaw waited for my call, but I never sounded the Golden Horn again.
dominator_story_hawk_content_4:
The desert weeps.
Thunderclaw, now skin and bones, trembles. I fed her well, but the fire in her eyes faded. Now I understand—she longed to hunt again.
Despite my heavy steps and unborn child, I went with her—one last journey. 
...Fate showed no mercy. Thunderclaw’s wings couldn’t withstand the sandworm’s strike. I held her close as it bled in my arms. With the last of her strength, she pecked at my wrist—asking me to follow.
We climbed a steep cliff together. At the top, nestled in the rock, was her nest. There, resting quietly, lay a golden egg.
Thunderclaw gave it a gentle nudge… then closed her eyes for the last time.
Thunderclaw was gone—but her bloodline remained. I gathered the egg into my arms, cradling it gently, feeling the warmth of life still burning inside.
dominator_story_hawk_content_5:
When I heard Meritt cry for the first time, tears blurred my eyes. I clutched her close, feeling her breath. And in that same moment, from the nest, came a soft crack—The golden egg split open. A baby hawk peeked out, amber eyes reflecting the morning light.
Thunderclaw’s heir. We named him Skybreaker.
He flapped clumsily toward Meritt, and she reached out, grabbing his feather with a giggle. There was no fear—only joy. They had found each other.
dominator_story_hawk_content_6:
News came from afar—a deadly virus was sweeping the land, devouring cities one after another. I knew it was only a matter of time before the desert of the Golden Tribe faced the same fate. I was a warrior. The strength of my ancestors flowed through me.
I couldn’t stand aside. I had to fight.
Before I left, I poured all my memories, all my hopes, into the Golden Horn. It once stirred Thunderclaw’s soul into battle—now, it would be Meritt’s guide. I believed that one day, she would find it. One day, she would call upon it.
And when she did, Skybreaker would hear it, rise into the sky, and face the storm by her side.
Meritt, may the wind protect you. May Skybreaker carry you to your own sky.

How to Play:
The entrance to the Secret Vault is located at the center of the Hidden Treasure map.
2. Opening a Hidden Treasure grants you a number of Dig Hammers. The higher the treasure quality, the more hammers you receive.
3. Inside the Secret Vault, use Dig Hammers to break stones. Cracked stones may reveal traces of gems.
4. When all stones covering a gem are broken, the gem activates and flies into a slot on the gate. Once all slots are filled, the gate opens and you receive the treasure inside.
5. Special rewards are available on levels 5, 10, 15, and 20.
6. You can request help from allies. You can receive up to {0} Dig Hammers from allies per day.
7. The Secret Vault resets weekly. {1} levels unlock each week. Progress resets after the countdown ends.
8. While digging, there’s a {2}% chance to trigger a time-limited stage (max {3} times per week). Completing it grants special rewards.

vip_base_skin_rules12_1:
- In view of the need for character creation to be consistent with the aesthetics of Last War, to avoid involving elements that violate the rules, and the potential high cost of production, VIP 18 base skins cannot use human characters as the main creative part, regardless of whether the character is original or from any third party.
- Human character definition and official interpretation rights
- The final right of interpretation belongs to Last War Official, and the official team will review designs based on multi-dimensional standards.
- Official human characters can be used as auxiliary elements, but must comply with the following rules:
- Only the original images of official existing assets can be directly quoted, and no modifications (including but not limited to appearance, color matching, action settings, etc.) are allowed.
- Characters can only be used as auxiliary elements, not as the core of the design.
- At most, one official character can appear in the same skin. Multiple characters are not allowed to exist at the same time.
vip_base_skin_rules26_1: c. Copyright and Reuse Rules of Assets
vip_base_skin_rules27_1:
- Copyright ownership：
- The ownership and usage rights of the in-game assets such as characters and vehicles designed for skins belongs to Last War Official.
- Uniqueness of skin design and avoidance of duplicate content：
- We will try our best to ensure that the core elements of each VIP18 skin (such as theme animals and vehicles) are unique. Due to the existence of common elements (such as basic animal models), similar skins may occur. We will communicate with players about creativity before production. We do not guarantee uniqueness, but will try our best to provide special designs in composition, combination, texture, color matching, dynamic effects, etc.
- Repeat prompt rules：
- We will issue reminders for content with high repetition during the review stage. If you agree, production will continue. If you decline, new ideas will need to be discussed. Once the design is finalized or launched, modifications are generally not possible. 
- We have no right to refuse multiple requests for similar ideas, but we will provide special designs, and some elements may be used in the game in the future.
- If the duplicate content involves copyright disputes, the Last War Official has the right to suspend the rights of the skin until the issue is resolved.

challenge_zombie_alliance_rule_desc: 【Individual Challenge】 · Participation Requirements: 1. Base level must be at least 8. 2. Only one difficulty can be selected per event. 3. Higher difficulties will be unlocked after completing all challenges of the previous level. · Challenge Rules: 1. Commanders can choose to challenge the Instructor individually or initiate a rally to fight alongside allies. 2. After defeating the Instructor, Commanders will unlock challenges against higher-level Instructors. 3. At the end of the event, Commanders will receive rewards for all successfully completed challenges. 4. After completing all challenges of the current difficulty, Commanders will be able to challenge higher difficulties in the next General's Trial event. 【Alliance Challenge】 · Unlock Conditions: 1. When enough Commanders in the alliance complete challenges of the corresponding difficulty, R4 and higher officers can choose to activate the Alliance Challenge. 2.Only one difficulty can be selected for the Alliance Challenge in each event! 3. The higher the chosen difficulty, the more demanding the progress goals will be. 4. The higher the chosen difficulty, the better the rewards will be. (Click on the dots on the progress bar to view the objectives and rewards of each stage.) · Challenge Rules: 1. Once started, the challenge lasts for 30 minutes. During this time, Commanders can rally against or join rallies targeting the Sky Predator. The damage each Commander deals will be accumulated. 2. Total individual damage will be added up as the alliance's total damage. The higher the progress in individual and alliance damage, the better the rewards. Rewards include Trial Keys and other generous rewards. 3. The Sky Predator will launch missile attacks during battle. Bases hit will lose a certain amount of durability and enter a burning state. 4. As the battle progresses, the Sky Predator will charge up three times in total. 5. When the Sky Predator starts charging, the alliance's Warlord will simultaneously activate the Warlord Missile. Allies can assist in transferring energy to the Warlord. Once enough energy is gathered to meet the launch requirement of the Warlord Missile , the Warlord can choose to launch the Warlord Missile to interrupt the charging of the Sky Predator. 6. The Sky Predator hit by the Warlord Missile will enter a stunned state and takes extra damage during this period. 7. If the Sky Predator finishes charging successfully, it will enter 'Rampage Mode'. In this state, its damage to base durability, attack frequency, and range will be greatly increased, posing a major threat to the alliance!Please work together to help the Warlord launch the missile! Please note: if the Warlord’s base moves during the launch, the missile will fail. 8. As the battle becomes more intense, the Sky Predator will automatically enter Rampage Mode in the final moments of the challenge and remain in that state until the challenge ends. 9. Alliance Challenges cannot be started in the final 2 hours of the event, so please plan accordingly. · Reward Settlement: 1. After completing the challenge, the area on the world map where the Sky Predator was located will drop Trial Gift chests. 2. Based on individual challenge performance and alliance challenge performance, Commanders will automatically receive a certain number of Trial Keys. season_s4_story_desc:
Sakura Isle is a beautiful island lying quietly in the Eastern Ocean. 

Legend has it that this land was once shroud in clouds all year round, and when night fell, the Oni General would appear, leading a horde of demons. They paraded through the streets in eerie Wandering Oniwagon, moving in ghostly processions. A miasma of death hung heavy over the land. Any passerby who strayed into their path would be swiftly attacked and instantly reduced to dust. Grotesque in form, these Oni bore twisted horns, hooked claws, and razor-sharp fangs. Some even sprouted tails and wings, as if they had crawled forth from the depths of darkness itself. 
Until one day, the ancestors of the Samurai clan’s Koubutai and the Ninja clan’s Kage no Sato joined forces. After a grueling battle, they slew Oni General—and only then did Sakura Isle see the light once more. Cherry blossoms bloom, volcanoes rise tall, and people live and cultivate their land amidst the changing seasons, with tranquil years and favorable weather.

However, peace was not meant to last. The remnants of the Doom Legion reawakened the long-sealed power of the oni — an ancient virus known as ONV (Oni Virus). They injected the virus into the popular idol Kageyama Ryūran, turning her into Subject Zero, granting her the ability to control the infected. 
But what they didn't expect was that the ONV would awaken the will of the Oni General. That dark soul refused to be controlled, instead backfiring on Ryūran, instantly obliterating the Doom Legion and reclaiming its dominion over Sakura Isle. Under the drive of the ONV, Ryūran built the Nightfall Device, and darkness once again enveloped the entire island. In the name of her idol persona, she held a concert, quietly spreading the ONV among the crowd. 
The virus, active in the darkness, quickly spread, and Sakura Isle soon descended into silence.

Sarah, the hero who once learned ninjutsu at Kage no Sato, gathered a wealth of intelligence for our army. She is the one among us who knows Sakura Isle the best. 

Commander, it's time to go to the battlefield.
We can harness electricity to ignite the light, use its radiance to dispel the darkness, and illuminate the entire island. At that time, the oni will have nowhere to hide, and the light will return to Sakura Isle!
season_s4_tips013:

- Season related buildings and resources will disappear when the season ends.
- Protectors will vanish after the season ends.
- Prioritize learning Season Specializations within your profession for greater efficiency in the new season.
-The world is shrouded in darkness, and we gather with our allies to share the light.
season_s4_mail_desc80301: Dear Commanders, [Season IV: Evernight Isle] is about to begin! A new crisis is quietly brewing in the eastern seas, and a battle between light and darkness is about to unfold. Sakura Isle - once a peaceful place where cherry blossoms bloomed, is now completely swallowed by the mysterious Nightfall Device. The ONV spreads, transforming zombies into Oni. With Blood Night approaching, they become more violent, and the entire island is eroded by darkness, with the spark of civilization hanging by a thread. But you, are the one to ignite hope. The Energy System is restarting, the lighthouse is about to light up, and a night-breaking operation has quietly begun. Here's a sneak peek at the core gameplay of Season IV: 1. Build individual and alliance power systems, and build multi-dimensional illumination defenses. 2. Unlock the Blood Night Event, and fight against enhanced Oni zombies. 3. Capture zombies and transform them into energy minions. 4. More new event gameplay will be launched soon! The light has not gone out, the battle has not stopped! Commander, are you ready to ignite the light in the endless night?

season_s4_mail_desc80302: Dear Commanders, Welcome to the new Season - [Evernight Isle]! At this moment, you have arrived in the mysterious and dangerous Sakura Isle. Affected by the Nightfall Device, the entire island is plunged into prolonged darkness, the ONV continues to spread, and the zombies mutate and become more violent in the Blood Night! Due to the rampant virus in the dark, we can only establish temporary bases on the edge of the island and gradually advance inward. But rest assured, your Alliance is still united, and the lighthouse will illuminate our way forward! Note: This season, the Profession Specialization level cap remains at 100. However, a brand-new Tactical Card System has been introduced to help you craft more flexible strategies. Please take the following key actions immediately to adapt to the current situation: 1. Check the season manual to fully understand new gameplay such as Power System, Lighting Mechanism and Blood Night Event. 2. Complete Main Tasks: Obtain power generation resources, disperse the fog, and steadily expand the territory. 3. Formulate Alliance strategy: Coordinate with the Alliance Center and lighting network, and jointly advance city occupation. 4. Pay attention to [World Dynamics]: Master the season dynamics to participate in new season activities and challenges! The season has officially started, the lighthouse is on, and the horn has sounded. Commander, may you rekindle the hope of mankind in this island swallowed by darkness!

season_s4_pre_desc14: Welcome to the Evernight Isle! Where light meets darkness, and mystery brings delight. Go step into the unknown!
season_s4_manual_desc2:
Sakura Isle is a beautiful island lying quietly in the Eastern Ocean. 
The remnants of the Doom Legion have awakened the long-sealed power of Oni here - an ancient virus known as ONV (Oni Virus). They injected the virus into the popular idol, Kageyama Ryūran, granting her the ability to control the infected. 
Under the drive of the ONV, Ryūran built the Nightfall Device, and darkness once again enveloped the entire island. The virus, active in the darkness, quickly spread. Then, a new crisis broke out.

season_s4_activity_1200010_desc1:
The Ryōtei Restaurant is now open, but the boss is too busy to handle everything. Come and help him to win rewards! 
Rules:
1. After the event starts, one stage can be unlocked each day. After clearing, rewards can be obtained.
2. The Ryōtei Restaurant contains a variety of food cards. Extract 3 identical food cards to complete one elimination.
3. Eliminate all food cards in the stage to clear it. If no more cards can be placed in the elimination area, the stage will fail.
4. Use props prepared by the owner to unleash magical effects during the stage!
5. Clearing the stage without using props grants extra rewards!

4. When you successfully send a Golden Egg, you will automatically receive one reward for yourself. Claiming your own Golden Egg does not count toward the daily limit for claiming those sent by others.

season4_cave_exploration_description_0: There’s a cozy little Izakaya Bar with warm lights spilling out. The owner is into dice games. Want to give it a shot?
season4_cave_exploration_description_1:
Glad you showed up! I’ll give you a head start this round!
(This round, the boss won’t roll a 5 or 6.)
season4_cave_exploration_description_2:
Not bad! I’ll give you another chance!
(This round, the boss won’t roll a 6.)
season4_cave_exploration_description_3:
Now, let’s see what you’re really made of.
(The boss narrows her eyes and lightly shakes the dice.)
season4_cave_exploration_description_4:
The more you win, the more you risk losing...
So, dare to keep playing?
season4_cave_exploration_description_5:
A true gamer never tells you when to stop.
Will you go on?
season4_cave_exploration_description_6:
Each choice is a gamble with danger.
Ready to make your decision?
season4_cave_exploration_description_7:
Victory makes you a legend.
Defeat leaves you with nothing.
season4_cave_exploration_description_8:
Luck can't stay with you forever.
(The boss chuckles, taking back all the rewards.)
season4_cave_exploration_description_9:
Remarkable... You’ve won it all.
(The boss sighs and hands over your final reward.)
season4_cave_exploration_description_10:
The wise know when to walk away.
(The boss smiles gently and slides your reward across the table.)
season4_cave_exploration_description_11:
Lucky Charm is in effect!
(The boss is blocked from rolling a 4, 5, or 6 this round.)

season_s4_manual_desc4: Copper is produced over time in captured cities within the Sakura Isle. The more copper your alliance owns at season's end, the higher your ranking and the better your rewards.
season_s4_manual_desc6: Sakura Isle has been plunged into darkness under the influence of the Nightfall Device. As the ONV virus spreads and grows stronger, the Blood Night approaches, bringing even greater dangers.
season_s4_manual_desc8: The power of the Oni General has been sealed across the city. When the Blood Night descends, fragments of his lingering wrath will manifest above the city.
season_s4_manual_desc10: When the Blood Night descends, Sakura Isle Zombies will be transformed into Blood Night Zombies. Empowered with greater autonomy, they will actively seek out and attack commanders who remain in the Darkness.
season_s4_manual_desc12: Defeat Sakura Isle Zombies for a chance to obtain magical items. Visit the Magatama Shop to trade them for various rewards with the shopkeeper.
season_s4_manual_desc14: Endless darkness has been silently transforming Sakura Isle. The commanders now understand — to overcome Ryūran and the ONV, they must first reclaim the light from the shadows.
season_s4_manual_desc16: In response to the power crisis, scientists created a generator that relies on zombies running nonstop to produce power.
season_s4_manual_desc18: A device that dispels the darkness. The more power it consumes, the larger the area it illuminates. Areas within the Light are unaffected by the Darkness.
season_s4_manual_desc20: After the Zombie Generator is constructed, dispatching an electrician will help the commander transport the power. In their spare time, they can also supervise the zombies to keep running.
season_s4_manual_desc22: When marching with the troops, electricians provide Light, protecting the squad from the effects of Darkness, and potentially reveal surprise rewards.
season_s4_manual_desc24: This season's special building will assist you and your allies in surviving the dark conditions and other crises. At the end of the season, resources will turn into Profession EXP, and game season buildings will be dismantled.
season_s4_manual_desc26: This is a game season resource, used to build the season building [Optoelectronic Lab], helping commanders improve their virus resistance. Any unused quartz will be converted into Profession EXP at the end of the season.
season_s4_manual_desc28: This is a game season resource, used to build the season building [Quartz Workshop], helping commanders improve quartz production. Any unused stones will be converted into Profession EXP at the end of the season.
season_s4_manual_desc32: A game-season structure that provides [Virus Resistance] for commanders. Upgrade it with [quartz]. The building will be dismantled after the season.
season_s4_manual_desc34: A game-season structure that increases [Quartz] production. Upgrade it with [stones]. The building will be dismantled after the season.
season_s4_manual_desc36: A magic building obtained from the Golden Realm, which can once again awaken the Desert Protector to fight for the Commander!
season_s4_manual_desc38: The Blood Night continues to erode Sakura Isle. Whether influenced by the power of the Oni General, or to sever his lingering resentment, Commanders have transformed into Blood Night Hunters, throwing themselves into this bloody hunt.
season_s4_manual_desc40: During Blood Nights, Commanders can transform into the Blood Night Hunter using their Profession Skill. The Blood Night Hunter gains exclusive buffs during this period and can cross servers, but they can also be vulnerable to attacks from other Blood Night Hunters. If their base is breached, they will exit the Blood Night Hunter state.
season_s4_manual_desc42: In a single Blood Night, the commander who survives and has the highest hunting score will be awarded the title of 'Blade of Blood Night', possessing the ability to summon Blood Night Zombies.
season_s4_manual_desc44: When a Commander with the 'Blade of Blood Night' title obtains it again, the title can be upgraded to 'King of Blood Night', possessing the ability to plunge the world into Blood Night.
season_s4_manual_desc72: The ultimate faction battle is upon us. Capture the opponent's Tenryū Castle and become the ultimate victor!

treasure_map_preview_03: Commander, let me tell you a secret— In this adventure about Hidden Treasures, a new chapter is about to unfold. When the countdown reaches its final moment, we will reveal a brand-new treasure map. What lies buried there is not just wealth, but even greater secrets and surprises. With every dig, you’ll get a Mysterious Compass. Hand it to me, and I’ll give you a reward that you cannot refuse. Trust me, I never lie when it comes to treasure. Until then, the Treasure Map Shards in your hand are far from useless. When the time comes, we will count all your shards, every 7 shards can be combined into 1 chance to open a treasure. And those scattered extras that aren't enough for a full set? Don’t worry, I’ll make up the rest, and you won’t walk away empty-handed. When the moment of auto-opening arrives, we’ll unveil each Hidden Treasure based on the set probabilities. Don’t worry, the Pity System still remains. Only now, the pity count will reset, just like an explorer reorganizing gear for the next journey. As for the treasures you uncovered? They’ll be neatly delivered straight to your Mail, like gifts from ancient ruins. Get ready Commander, the real adventure begins the moment the map unfolds! Explorer Jones

season_s4_faction_war_desc08:
ABOUT THE EVENT
1. The Faction Duel is the ultimate battle between the [Kage no Sato] and the [Koubutai], with the winning faction claiming a large amount of Copper.
2. The duel lasts 7 days - Monday to Saturday are for contesting invasion rights, and Sunday is the battle day.
3. During the contest stage, 4 warzones of the same faction will compete for points against the opposing faction. The faction with the most points earns attack rights.
4. Battles take place in the defending faction leader's warzone.
5. After the battle begins, in Cannon and Capitol battles, commanders within the same faction will support each other, and victory is determined by the capture progress of factions.
6. The Copper reward for the winning side depends on how many buildings are held by the faction at the end of the battle:
Control Capitol: +10M
Control each Cannon: +6.5M.
Losing factions will not obtain Copper even if they control those buildings at the end of battles.
7. Please note, the Copper only affects [Faction] rankings, and the winning faction's Alliance won't get any additional Copper.

season_s4_faction_war_desc40:
Monday to Saturday is the 'Faction Points Race' phase. The Faction with highest points gains the invasion rights. 
The invaders can head to the opposing faction leader's warzone on Sunday and attempt to seize their Capitol.
The faction with lowest points becomes the defenders, who need to protect their Capitol in the highest Copper ranking warzone of their own faction on Sunday. 
Faction points can be obtained by completing following acts:
season_s4_faction_war_desc41:
Schedule
Saturday [24:00:00] 
Faction Points contest ends
Sunday [00:04:00]
Invader and Defender factions are determined based on Faction points.
Sunday [00:05:00] 
Invader Faction commanders can teleport to the Defender's warzone. 
Sunday [12:00:00] 
Capitol and Cannons are removed from protected status and enter the capture stage. 
Sunday [12:00:00]~[16:00:00] 
The winner of the Faction Duel is decided. 
Sunday [24:00:00] 
Enemy elimination event ends, and the ranking rewards are settled. 

Capitol Defense Rules 
When Capitol Defense begins, all the Cannons become available for capture as well. 
In battles for Capitol and Cannons, Commanders from the same faction are considered to be on the same side, meaning no combat among them. 
For example, when Alliance A from [Koubutai] faction seizes the Capitol, commanders from Alliance B [Koubutai] faction will assist in defending the structure when dispatched to the Capitol.
The Capitol can accommodate up to 100 garrisoned troops. 
A Cannon can accommodate up to 100 garrisoned troops. 

Cannon Capabilities 
Cannons are crucial strategic weapons in Capitol defense. 
After capturing a Cannon, it automatically attacks the enemy-held Capitol and kills certain number of units garrisoned inside at regular intervals. 
When your side attempts to seize the Capitol, holding a captured Cannon significantly accelerates the capture of the Capitol. 

Successful Capitol Capture 
Capitol Defense lasts a maximum of 3 hours, if both warzones fail to reach 100% progress, the Defenders win. 
The winning faction will receive a substantial amount of [Faction Copper] at the end of the battle if the Capitol is under their control and based on the number of Cannons controlled.
Control Capitol +10M
Control each Cannon +6.5M.
Losing factions will not obtain Copper even if they control those buildings at the end of battles.
Once the Capitol contest ends, leaderboard rankings will be locked (Commanders can still earn points and collect chests).

season_s4_activity_1200011_desc1:
Rules:
1. Throughout the event, during Warless days (Sunday to Friday), commanders can activate the Blood Night Hunter transformation using their profession skill when the Blood Night descends.
2. After transformation, the Commander's base will adopt the exclusive Blood Night Hunter skin. All personal information will be hidden, and special buffs will be granted. However, teleport items cannot be used (cross-warzone teleportation is allowed).
3. Blood Night Hunters can cross servers to any warzone within the season grouping during the Blood Night.
4. Blood Night Hunters can attack each other freely (not restricted by Warless days) but Blood Night Hunters cannot attack normal Commanders unless they are in the Contaminated Land. When a Blood Night Hunter is located in the dark land, normal Commanders can attack their base.
5. Each Blood Night Hunter has 3 Magatama Life Points. Successfully breaching another Blood Night Hunter's base will earn 1 hunting point each time, and deduct one Magatama Life Point from the opponent. If you successfully reduce the opponent's Magatama Life Point to 0, you can eliminate them, not only earning 1 hunting point, but also plundering all the hunting points the opponent owns at that time. At the end of the Blood Night, surviving Hunters will be ranked based on their points, and rewards will be sent via mail.
6. As the Blood Night progresses, certain warzones within the season group will be sealed and become unavailable for hunting. Blood Night Hunters must relocate before the countdown ends or be gradually and automatically eliminated over time. (When in a sealed warzone, 1 Magatama Life Point will be deducted every minute. Blood Night Hunters will be considered eliminated when their Magatama Life Point reaches 0.) Entering a sealed warzone while in Hunter state requires manually exiting the Blood Night Hunter state.
7. When the Blood Night Hunter state ends (either by elimination or the end of the Blood Night), personal information will be displayed.
8. The Blood Night triggered by title skills does not activate the 'Blood Night Hunter' event. 
9. During the Bloodnight Hunter state, you may choose to exit, but doing so will count as elimination.

season_s4_Mummy_ui_info_01:
The mystical energy of the [Obelisk of Protectors] ensures units with unmatched willpower do not decay in death but act with purpose.
Locals call them Desert Protectors.
A prophecy once said: When sand fades and the earth turns green, the dead will return.

Sequence for converting dead units into pending protectors:
1. Severely wounded units are sent to the Hospital after battle. Units who die are prioritized for the Emergency Center, and those left out may partially convert to Protectors.
2. If hospitals are full and severely wounded units die, some will directly convert to Protectors.
3. Units stationed in the Drill Grounds who die when the base is breached will also partially convert to Protectors.
4. Protectors in the Protector's Field are immune to death from base breaches.

season_s4_pre_desc08:
This season, Commanders will head to the mysterious eastern island - Sakura Isle. 
Affected by the Nightfall Device, Sakura Isle is plunged into darkness. As the concentration of the ONV (Oni Virus) increases, Blood Night will visit periodically. Zombies affected by Blood Night will become more violent and dangerous.
season_s4_pre_desc09:
To deal with the crisis brought by the night and the Blood Night, Commanders can build Lighthouses. When the Lighthouse is activated, it can dispel the darkness and enjoy the Light Buffs. 
Dispatching electricians to Allies' Bases can also help to increase the Power Level of Allies, gaining a wider range of light.
season_s4_pre_desc10:
Power is crucial for keeping the Lighthouse running continuously. 
To obtain power stability, the Alliance can build the Alliance Center, and Commanders can also build the Zombie-powered Generator.
season_s4_pre_desc11: Hero promotion and exclusive weapons! This season, Sarah will unlock new powers and undergo a transformation! A fresh set of exclusive weapons has arrived!
season_s4_pre_desc12: Despite the dark nights, the folks of Sakura Isle keep their spirits up. Head to the Izakaya Bar and Ryōtei Restaurant... Help them out and earn awesome rewards!
season_s4_pre_desc13:
The Blood Night descends, and the Blood Night Hunters are ready to begin their relentless hunt. 
The Trade War burden reduction is now live, introducing new defensive official skills! 
The Profession Level Cap remains at Lv. 100, and the brand-new system, Tactics Cards, is coming soon to you! 
Gear up for battle — another victory awaits, and it will be forged by your hands!
season_s4_activity1200002_desc02: Caution: The Oni Boss carries a large amount of ONV. Increase your Virus Resistance before attacking.
season_s4_light_on_ui_desc:
Upgrading the lighthouse can increase the upper limit of power storage.
Lighting requires stored power, the higher the brightness, the higher the consumption.
Allies can send electricians to you to transfer power to your lighthouse.

Brightness Auto-Adjustment: When the power input is lower than the current lighting level's consumption, the lighthouse brightness will be automatically reduced. When the power input exceeds the consumption required for the next lighting level, the brightness will be automatically increased.
season_s4_march_ui_tips03: When illuminating the Path to Battle, the movement and collection speeds can be slightly increased. The buff effects of zombies in the dark can be ignored, and tactical card packs can be found more easily.
season4_cave_exploration_help_1: During the season, Commanders have the opportunity to visit the mysterious Izakaya Bar and engage in an exciting dice game with the owner everyday. There are a total of 7 rounds. Winning each round accumulates more rewards, but failure results in the loss of all accumulated rewards. You can take your rewards at any time, or choose to continue challenging for higher rewards. Using a Lucky Charm can also increase your chances of winning. Only the boldest make it to the end with a smile. Luck is in your hands—ready for another round?

season_travel_world_ui_0:
Nier was once a renowned biologist, one of the most influential scientists of the new era, and the director of the Nier Institute of Science as well as a professor at the World University.

In pursuit of immortality, he began researching viruses that could integrate with the human body. As his research progressed, Nier gradually came to believe that viruses were superior lifeforms. His mindset became increasingly twisted—he became convinced that humanity should embrace viral transformation and evolve into a higher-dimensional existence.

To realize this vision, Nier sought out the ancient Bred family and struck a deal with the Lady in Red. Together, they developed the W-Virus. Disguised as nutritional supplements, they distributed the virus worldwide, triggering hundreds of zombie mutation outbreaks. Amid the ensuing chaos, Nier formed the Doom Legion and launched a global invasion.

After a decade of expansion, the Doom Legion had seized control of the entire Land of Liberty. Nier's virus was sold to dictators and tyrants around the globe, leading to the collapse of the World Union. In response, an independent faction within the Union—Justice Vanguard—dispatched elite commanders to eliminate all armed forces using the virus. Their first stop: the now-occupied Land of Liberty.
