season_s4_activity_plot1: Is this the legendary Ninja? There are sumo wrestlers... and Geishas too?
season_s4_activity_plot2: That's right, but due to the effects of the ONV, these zombies are now nothing more than walking corpses.
season_s4_activity_plot3: Still, even without consciousness, they’re dangerous. The darkness and the virus are always a threat to us.
season_s4_activity_plot4: Got it. I’ll let the Commander know. But first, we need to clear out these zombies if we want to handle the crisis properly.
season_s4_activity_plot5: Wait, are those... Samurai from ancient times?
season_s4_activity_plot6: It looks like it’s been here for centuries.
season_s4_activity_plot7: This seems to be new intel. The ONV can make decayed bodies move again!
season_s4_activity_plot8: It seems we still don’t know enough about the ONV. Let’s boost our virus resistance first, then we can investigate further.
season_s4_activity_plot9: Ugh, the city’s been consumed by the darkness too... But it seems poorly defended. We should go save the people.
season_s4_activity_plot10: Hold on... This city feels off. I think I’ve felt this kind of power before...
season_s4_activity_plot11: Exactly. It’s the presence of the ancient Oni General! The power is intensifying with the Blood Night.
season_s4_activity_plot12: If that’s true, the Blood Night will be dangerous! We’ll need to take the city gradually.
season_s4_activity_plot13: Sarah, if I remember correctly, you’re from the [Kage no Sato], right?
season_s4_activity_plot14: Yeah, they trained me to be a Ninja. But after teaming up with the [Koubutai], I’ve found they’re not so bad.
season_s4_activity_plot15: Both the [Kage no Sato] and the [Koubutai] have made their offers. Which side do you think the Commander should choose?
season_s4_activity_plot16: Since the moment I met the Commander, my sword knew its master! I trust the Commander’s decision!
season_s4_activity_plot17: Both sides seem to be fighting for the Copper. I’ve heard it can communicate with the heavens and summon lightning!
season_s4_activity_plot18: Those are just old legends. Scientifically speaking, it’s a great power storage device, but if damaged, it releases a strong electrical current.
season_s4_activity_plot19: I see, that explains the ancient legends. But why is everyone still fighting for it now?
season_s4_activity_plot20: There might be other motives behind it, but I have a feeling that war is coming.
season_s4_activity_plot21: It seems the Nightfall Device has been activated. I can feel the air growing thicker, the virus must be more active now.
season_s4_activity_plot22: Monica, look! The moon is turning red!
season_s4_activity_plot23: Oh no, what’s happening! I have to report this to the Commander right away!
season_s4_activity_plot24: Hmm, I’ve got a bad feeling. I’ll increase my patrols during this period...
season_s4_activity_plot25: Miss, could you come over and lend me a hand? Since your arrival, the island has been more peaceful, and my shop has had more customers.
season_s4_activity_plot26: Oh, it's the boss of the restaurant! Your business seems to be doing great. How can I help you?
season_s4_activity_plot27: Do you see those food cards on the table? Those are the customers' orders. Just put three cards with the same design together and hand them to me.
season_s4_activity_plot28: Once all the cards are cleared, the task will be complete. Don't worry, I’ll make sure to pay you the reward you deserve.
season_s4_activity_plot29: Sarah, have you heard? A mysterious group called the [Blood Hunter] has been showing up on Sakura Isle, only during the Blood Night.
season_s4_activity_plot30: I’ve met them as well. They may look different, but they all carry the same presence. I can feel their murderous intent.
season_s4_activity_plot31: Killing intent? But they didn’t hurt you, did they? I’ve heard that Blood Night Hunters sometimes fight among themselves for control of the power that summons the Blood Night.
season_s4_activity_plot32: They’re definitely dangerous, but as soon as I was about to turn on the lights, the killing intent disappeared.
season_s4_activity_plot33: That’s odd. Let’s stay careful. I’ll keep the base lit to watch for them.
season_s4_activity_plot34: No surprise, being an economically developed island, the trade post on Sakura Isle is more advanced.
season_s4_activity_plot35: But due to the Nightfall Device, these trading posts are no longer prosperous.
season_s4_activity_plot36: But Blood Night has also opened up new opportunities. I heard merchants have found valuable items on the Blood Night Zombies, but they can only collect them during the Blood Night...
season_s4_activity_plot37: If that's true, it's great news for everyone. Let’s hurry and restore order to the trade posts.
season_s4_activity_plot38: We’ve made it to the legendary Divine Tree!
season_s4_activity_plot39: But... it feels strange. It’s much dimmer than I saw in the records. It must be the darkness covering it...
season_s4_activity_plot40: Once, the Divine Tree brought peace to Sakura Isle and happiness to its people. Now, with the island in darkness, will it still save us?
season_s4_activity_plot41: Maybe we should inject energy into the Divine Tree first. Once it revives, its blessings will spread over the land again!
season_s4_activity_plot42: The conflict between the [Koubutai] and [Kage no Sato] has sparked a war...
season_s4_activity_plot43: Although the immediate trigger was how to handle Ryūran, the real reason lies in the accumulated tensions between the two sides over the years.
season_s4_activity_plot44: If the upcoming war means facing former friends and family, Sarah, would you hesitate?
season_s4_activity_plot45: Of course not. We fight for our beliefs—just as they do. It's for a better future for Sakura Isle!
season_s4_activity1200003_story_desc:
Once a national idol, Ryūran was injected with the ONV by remnants of Doom Legion. Now, she is controlled by the will of the Oni General. She activated the Nightfall Device, shrouding the entire Sakura Isle in darkness and plunging it into eerie silence.
The ONV spread like wildfire. Countless humans were infected and turned into zombies, wandering through the shadows—the isle is now filled with danger.

Commander, let us harness the power of light, dispel the darkness, and reclaim the cities lost to infection.
Only you can bring dawn to this encroaching night. The future of Sakura Isle lies in your hands!
season_s4_activity1200004_story_desc:
Commander, while you fight on the front lines of Sakura Isle, our scouts have discovered a rare vein of Copper. This ancient divine metal holds the power of thunder, capable of channeling the forces of heaven and earth, illuminating the surroundings and driving away Oni. Its significance to the current war cannot be overstated.
The Copper has sparked a fierce competition between two powerful factions. The Samurai Clan's [Koubutai], aiming to forge thunderous weapons to confront the Oni directly; and the Ninja Clan's [Kage no Sato], seeking to use it to expel the ONV from Ryūran’s body, resolving the issue at its root.

We must make a choice and form an alliance with one of them. Whether the unyielding Samurai or the silent Ninjas, both factions possess admirable convictions. Please weigh up the pros and cons, and select the most suitable ally to lead us in this battle for Copper supremacy!
season_s4_activity1200007_story_desc:
She is silent and composed, a decisive elite pilot on the battlefield; she arrives cloaked in darkness, yet fights with the light—an impeccable blade forged by the Ninja Clan’s Kage no Sato. Her name is Kageyama Sara (Sarah).

In her childhood, she and the Clan Leader's daughter, Kageyama Ryūran, made a vow beneath the cherry blossoms to protect their homeland. Even when Ryūran was corrupted by the ONV and became the Catastrophic Idol spreading darkness and death, Sarah never gave up hope of saving her.
Now, Sarah embarks on the path of promotion, swearing to battle the virus with the light and reclaim the fallen Oni with unwavering faith.

Commander, please help her ignite the greatest light operation in Sakura Isle’s history—banish the night from every corner and protect the unfulfilled vow.
season_s4_activity1200010_story_desc:
In a quiet corner of Sakura Isle, a mysterious Ryōtei Restaurant operating in the dark has caught the attention of many diners. The boss is a chef with a secretive past, rumored to have traveled the world and mastered many long-lost culinary arts. Even more astonishing is that his ingredients not only taste exquisite, but also possess a magical power to purify the darkness and heal the soul.

The opening of this Ryōtei Restaurant is, in fact, an important ritual. The boss hopes to awaken the islanders’ yearning for the light through the arrangement of these mystical ingredients. Every dish carries an ancient secret, capable of igniting sparks of hope in the darkness. Though it appears to be a mere eatery, each meal served holds a powerful force—one that can combat the darkness and restore vitality to the island.
season_s4_activity1200011_story_desc:
Under the influence of the Nightfall Device, the sky over Sakura Isle is consumed by endless darkness. As the concentration of the ONV in the air reaches its critical point, the Blood Night quietly descends. At this moment, the vengeful spirit of the Oni General is revived, and the dormant Oni awaken, reorganizing into a stronger and more formidable army under his command.

This is not only the arrival of disaster, but also a perilous opportunity. Commanders can harness the Oni General’s immense power, transforming into Blood Night Hunters and seizing this chance to eliminate their enemies. Every battle is a brutal challenge, with the victors gaining more advantages. While driving away the Oni, will the hunters be able to retain their humanity, or will they ultimately be consumed by the darkness?
season_s4_activity1200012_story_desc:
In the prosperous era of Sakura Isle, the Grand Night Market was one of the busiest marketplaces, its lights flashing and crowds bustling, like the very heart of the island. It was not only the center of daily life for the citizens but also a hub for the flow of goods and trade.
However, ever since Ryūran was controlled by the virus and the Nightfall Device was activated, the Grand Night Market has been taken over by the Oni forces, gradually turning into a desolate wasteland. Now, if we can reclaim control of these districts, we will be able to light them up once again, bringing back merchants and supply caravans to provide our troops with a continuous stream of resources. This is not only a vital strategic supply, but also a crucial step in the revival of Sakura Isle!
season_s4_activity1200015_story_desc:
Commander, Ryūran's Nightfall Plan has been temporarily halted, and light has returned to parts of Sakura Island. However, the conflict between the [Koubutai] and the [Kage no Sato] over the Copper has grown increasingly intense. If tensions continue to rise, the entire island may once again descend into chaos!

We must take a stand and bring this confrontation to an end. No matter where your allegiance lies, fight alongside your comrades, seize control of the Copper, protect the future of Sakura Isle—and claim the final glory!

season_s4_plot_905502: With me here, the generator will produce power and keep the troops in the light.
season_s4_plot_905503: This not only speeds up our march through the darkness, but also makes it easier to fight off the zombies lurking within!
season_s4_plot_905601: Whoa! This is the pinnacle of advanced technology—Alliance Center!
season_s4_plot_905602: Isn’t it just a generator? What’s the big deal?
season_s4_plot_905603: With Tesla’s wireless power tech, it can transfer the power anywhere in our territory—no cables needed!
season_s4_plot_905604: It’s a vital asset. We’ve got to guard it tightly—no way we’re letting the enemy get anywhere near it!
season_s4_plot_905701: Trade has always been vibrant in Sakura Isle, and during the Blood Night, it even offers special deals.
season_s4_plot_905702: The Blood Night has created new opportunities, with some underground sellers only appearing during these dangerous times.
season_s4_plot_905801: Before the dark mist took over, Sakura Isle's nightlife was thriving. Now, however, the cities have shifted focus to the production of Copper.

season_travel_world_ui_08:
In a parallel world, a unified organization known as the Union was established.

Dr. Nier, once the world’s leading virus expert, carefully orchestrated the spread of a virus across the globe, triggering a biological crisis. Amid the chaos, he formed the Doom Legion and used military force to conquer the world.

After ten years of expansion, the Doom Legion has taken control of the entire Land of Liberty. His virus has been distributed to dictators and rulers around the world, causing the collapse of the Union. In response, the Union sends elite commanders to eliminate armed forces using the virus, with the first mission being to reclaim the Land of Liberty, which is currently occupied by the Doom Legion.

After defeating the Doom Legion, players will travel to other regions such as the Rainy Mistlands, the Polar regions, and the Golden Realm, where they will continue to eradicate the virus factions.

season_s4_activity_1200017_desc2: Hey there, I couldn't help but notice the precious Magatama in your hands. How about we make a deal?
season_s4_activity_1200017_desc3: If you’re not looking to exchange just yet, I suggest you collect more Magatama. The more you gather, the better the rewards will be!
season_s4_activity_1200017_desc4: Welcome back, dear customer! Bring that Magatama over, and I promise you won’t be disappointed with what you can exchange it for here!
season_s4_activity_1200017_desc5: Please, don't rush off, dear! How about stopping for a cup of tea?
season_s4_activity_1200017_desc6: Do you know the true value of the Magatama? I can explain it to you, if you'd like.
season_s4_activity_1200017_desc7: Once the deal is made, there's no going back. Please think carefully before placing your order.
season_s4_activity_1200017_desc8: We’ve just received a new batch of goods. It’s the perfect time to trade your Magatama for something special!
season_s4_activity_1200017_desc9: The zombies on Sakura Isle are no easy task. If you manage to gather some Magatama, feel free to come to me for some great exchanges anytime!
season_s4_activity_1200017_desc10: I've heard that Magatama can summon mysterious power from the darkness of the night. It's a rare treasure indeed!
season_s4_activity_1200017_desc11: If you spot something you like, don't hesitate! Good things are meant to be enjoyed by everyone, right?
season_s4_activity_1200017_desc12: You get what you pay for, my shop is fair to all!
season_s4_activity_1200017_desc13: Thank you for your patronage, I’ll be here, always awaiting your next visit!
season_s4_activity_1200017_desc14: Be sure to return once the Blood Night begins. May fortune and strength be with you…
season_s4_activity_1200017_desc15: Much appreciated! Next time, do bring more of those rare Magatama for me to admire!
season_s4_activity_1200017_desc16: You’ve got quite the eye! Even I can’t help but be impressed~
season_s4_activity_1200017_desc17: I’ll keep your Magatama safe~ Come back when you’ve struck it rich!
season_s4_activity_1200017_desc18: Hope to see you again soon—don’t forget to drop by my little shop next time~
season_s4_activity_1200017_desc19: Thank you for your patronage. May the starlight of Sakura Isle guide you safely home...
season_s4_activity_1200017_desc20: Such a delightful guest—I'll be looking forward to our next encounter!
season_s4_activity_1200017_desc21: Drop by often! There might be a surprise waiting for you~

season_s4_city_desc01: A tranquil rural corner, where the scent of hay and the smoke from cooking fires blend together, creating the essence of a simple, rustic life.
season_s4_city_desc02: Amidst the steam, both body and mind quietly relax in the mountain hot springs. It’s the perfect place to rejuvenate and strengthen the troops.
season_s4_city_desc03: The clatter of pots, bowls, and spoons creates a symphony, while the streets are filled with the sights and smells of everyday life and tempting delicacies. A crucial supply hub.
season_s4_city_desc04: The crack of the bat echoes not only the sound of the hit, but also the spirit of youth and passion.
season_s4_city_desc05: The towering spire that pierces the sky symbolizes the ultimate stretch of technology and ambition.
season_s4_city_desc06: A virtual space where light and shadow dance, where reality and illusion converge and collide.
season_s4_city_desc07: A castle guarded by a mighty dragon, where ancient legends meet the edge of modern civilization.

season_s4_manual_desc56: Trade Posts are only open on Tuesdays and Fridays this season, with two levels of Trade Post available each day.
season_s4_manual_desc58: When the Blood Night descends, Trade Post items will be replaced. Commanders can use Magatama to purchase goods from the Blood Night Shop.
season_s4_manual_desc60: Koubutai and Kage no Sato are two ancient factions whose legacies have endured on Sakura Isle for generations. Their history is marked by both fierce rivalries and moments of united resistance. Now, as commanders begin to shift the tide of war, the fate of Ryūran has become the center of an intense dispute between the two camps.
season_s4_manual_desc62: On Sakura Isle, Copper is regarded as a divine metal imbued with the power of thunder. It channels the electricity of the heavens and earth, illuminating the land and driving away oni. The battle for Copper has quietly begun, as Koubutai and Kage no Sato engage in a fierce conflict over its power.
season_s4_manual_desc66: During this season's Copper Conquest, a new Butler official skill has been added, which can bring buffs to the alliance during defense.
season_s4_visitor_massage01: Greetings, mighty Commander. Welcome to Sakura Isle. It is beautiful, but it's facing a grave crisis.
season_s4_visitor_massage02: As you can see, this island has been completely swallowed by darkness. Ryūran and her horde of Oni zombies now rule over it.
season_s4_visitor_massage03: You might not be used to the darkness yet, but as the lighthouses light up, the area of brightness will keep growing.
season_s4_visitor_massage07: It’s so dark out... no way we can even go fishing like this.
season_s4_visitor_massage08: I’ve lost a bunch of weight lately.
season_s4_visitor_massage09: Legend has it that a thousand years ago, the Oni General was once a Samurai of the island, who willingly took the ONV in order to protect Sakura Isle.
season_s4_visitor_massage10: In the end, he lost control and turned into a monster. It took both Koubutai and the Kage no Sato working together to bring him down.
season_s4_visitor_massage11: They say that after the Oni General fell, the virus inside him couldn't be purged. So the Kage no Sato sealed it away, deep and tight.
season_s4_visitor_massage12: There's a good chance Ryūran came into contact with the virus when she was just a kid. After all, she's the daughter of Lord Kageyama Jubei.
season_s4_visitor_massage13: The Electropolis is closed! I used to hang out there, enjoying the air conditioning while watching Ryūran's concerts.
season_s4_visitor_massage14: Ryūran used to buy sugar figurines from me when she was a kid.
season_s4_visitor_massage15: Now, whenever the concert ends, the people coming out look like they've been cursed, with eyes like those of Oni.
season_s4_visitor_massage16: I heard that Lord Kageyama Jubei hasn't left his house for a month. He must be really worried about Ryūran.
season_s4_visitor_massage17: After all, a father and daughter are always in sync. The Ninjas who come to my shop always end up chatting about things like this.
season_s4_visitor_massage18: Lord Kamiizumi Nakazato, the leader of the Koubutai, might come off as cold as ice, but he’s really not a bad person at all.
season_s4_visitor_massage19: He's just so afraid of the virus getting out of control again, that's why he's ready to cut off any potential threat with his blade.
season_s4_visitor_massage20: I've heard your army moves out in the dark. Let me give you a piece of advice—if the moon turns red, don't go out.
season_s4_visitor_massage21: I've heard that even more powerful Oni are going to show up!
season_s4_visitor_massage22: Koubutai and Kage no Sato had a fight in Hot Spring Town.
season_s4_visitor_massage23: Hmph, two prideful fools, and in the end, it's us common folk who have to clean up the mess.
season_s4_visitor_massage24: Sarah isn't from Sakura Isle. Her parents came from the Rainy Mistlands and rest in peace on Sakura Isle due to certain circumstances.
season_s4_visitor_massage25: It was Lord Kageyama Jubei who took her in. Back then, Ryūran had just been born—only two years younger than Sarah.
season_s4_visitor_massage26: When they were little, Sarah loved brushing Ryūran’s hair the most—she even used to say she’d grow up to be her bodyguard.
season_s4_visitor_massage27: Look at them now—blades drawn against each other… Fate really does love to play cruel tricks on people.
season_s4_activity1200005_story_desc:
On Sakura Isle, Copper is hailed as the "Metal of Thunder," an extremely rare energy material. Known for its excellent conductivity and corrosion resistance, it can store high-voltage energy stably, making it widely used in city defense systems, high-frequency electromagnetic weapons, and the construction of lighthouse cores.
In the past, Copper once supported the island's energy network and modern industry, earning it the title "The Last Lifeline of the Island." However, since the activation of the Nightfall Device and the rampant spread of the ONV, the entire island has fallen into a standstill, halting the extraction and transportation of Copper.

Now, a batch of uncontaminated Copper resources has been rediscovered. Upon learning this, the Samurai clan's Koubutai and the Ninja clan's Kage no Sato have each mobilized, aiming to control this vital resource.
Whoever controls the Copper will control the future of Sakura Island. This is not only a battle for resources but also a war of beliefs.
season_s4_activity_1200009_desc35: Use the Profession Skill [Oni Summon], you can attract the Blood Night Oni Legion. The attracted Blood Night Oni Legion will continuously chase the Oni Summon Squad.
season_s4_plot_905001: We’ve finally arrived at the legendary Evernight Isle! No sunlight, just endless darkness.
season_s4_plot_905002: This place was once called Sakura Isle, but now it's shrouded in the Dark Mist.
season_s4_plot_905003: I’ve heard that the mastermind behind it all is Sakura Isle’s idol, Ryūran. She used the Nightfall Device to create the Dark Mist, blocking out the sunlight. But why did she do this?
season_s4_plot_905004: She wanted to cultivate a new type of virus in the darkness, one that would turn its victims into vicious, Oni-like creatures. That was her ultimate goal.
season_s4_plot_905005: Target confirmed! Eliminate the ONV and restore the light to Sakura Isle!
season_s4_plot_905101: That's amazing! We're just one step away from the light—just need a little more Power to make it happen!
season_s4_plot_905102: Looks like we've got a little obstacle ahead. We’ll need to build a Generator to power up the lights before we can push forward. Let's get to work!
season_s4_plot_905103: There’s a “special” generator on Sakura Isle. It’s simple in structure and pollution-free.
season_s4_plot_905105: ...To put it simply, we have zombies running to generate power. As we all know, they never get tired.
season_s4_plot_905201: Thank goodness, finally got rid of those damn zombies!
season_s4_plot_905202: Hey, Commander. I'm an Electrician, I think you'll need me.
season_s4_plot_905203: What a brilliant power generation setup! I'll take care of managing these generators!
season_s4_plot_905301: The power keeps flowing! I never thought I'd say this, but those zombies actually look a bit cute when they're working hard...
season_s4_plot_905302: Free power? How could that not be amazing?
season_s4_plot_905303: Commander, please try activating the L1 Lighthouse Brightness. With more power, the lighthouse can shine even brighter.
season_s4_plot_905401: Commander, please allow me to give you a brief explanation.
season_s4_plot_905402: Each generator has a dedicated electrician in charge, responsible for managing the power distribution and ensuring the efficient use of energy.
season_s4_plot_905403: Here, you can check the operation status of the four generators, as well as the work performance of each electrician.
season_s4_plot_905404: Unless we receive specific instructions from you, we will continue to supply power to the lighthouse for storage and backup.
season_s4_plot_905501: Commander, do you need me to join the troop for marching?
season_s4_plot_905901: Tenryū Castle, the heart of Sakura Isle, was once the residence of the Oni General centuries ago.
season_s4_plot_905902: After the Oni General was vanquished, Tenryū Castle was preserved as a historical site. It is said to be protected by the "Dragon," ensuring it will never collapse.
season_s4_plot_905903: Now, Ryūran has taken control of this castle, turning it into a breeding ground for the ONV.
season_s4_plot_905904: Only by recapturing Tenryū Castle can we bring this war to an end.
season_s4_visitor_massage73: Maybe if we build a ship, we can finally leave this sunless island behind.
season_s4_visitor_massage74: I wonder if this island will ever see the light again someday.
season_s4_visitor_massage75: Do you think, from the outside, this place looks like it’s been veiled with a black silk scarf?
season_s4_visitor_massage76: Have you ever seen those ores wrapped in coils? They call it “Copper,” though it looks nothing like the real red metal.
season_s4_visitor_massage77: There are two kinds of Lucky Cat — one big, one mini. Each holds a different amount of items.
season_s4_rank_score_linke_desc40: Lv.3-4 Trade Posts Conquest has begun!
season_s4_visitor_massage28: When Ryūran was little, she’d always come by for my Onigiri — she and Sarah would joke around, trying to sneak more Tsukemono off each other’s plates.
season_s4_visitor_massage29: Those two girls were inseparable... I just wish we could go back to those days.
season_s4_visitor_massage30: Sarah was the kind of kid who could peel an apple with a Kunai—clean and perfect, not a nick out of place.
season_s4_visitor_massage31: They say the night Sarah joined the army, Lord Jubei sat on the rooftop all night, just staring at the moon in silence.
season_s4_visitor_massage32: The Koubutai bought a large amount of supplies from me, saying it was for cooking at the shelters.
season_s4_visitor_massage33: They were starving themselves, yet they still couldn't stop thinking about those homeless refugees.
season_s4_visitor_massage34: I’m not too steady on my feet, and one night I tripped and fell in an alley, only to be quietly carried back home by someone.
season_s4_visitor_massage35: The neighbors said they looked like people from Kage no Sato, but they moved so fast, all you could see was a blur.
season_s4_visitor_massage36: Lord Kamiizumi Nakazato personally set up tents for the refugees, his hands covered in calluses.
season_s4_visitor_massage37: You think someone like that could be a bad guy? To me, he seems more like he's too righteous and kind-hearted.
season_s4_visitor_massage38: Ryūran was controlled by the will of the Oni General.
season_s4_visitor_massage39: If we could treat her, maybe we could bring her back to her senses.
season_s4_visitor_massage40: Don't let my appearance fool you, I'm actually a big fan of Ryūran!
season_s4_visitor_massage41: Tenryū Castle has become the den of Oni now—who would dare to step inside?
season_s4_visitor_massage42: Please, hurry and eliminate those Oni. Bring light back to Sakura Isle.
season_s4_visitor_massage43: Sakura Isle is absolutely beautiful during the day!
season_s4_visitor_massage44: I often go to Hot Spring Town for a soak.
season_s4_visitor_massage45: I’ve heard that the hot springs there can cure all kinds of ailments!
season_s4_visitor_massage47: Don’t be fooled by his clumsy appearance—he’s actually quite warm-hearted.
season_s4_visitor_massage48: Even with the shortage of supplies, the Grand Night Market is still as lively as ever.
season_s4_visitor_massage49: If you need anything, you can go check it out there.
season_s4_visitor_massage50: Come on, play a few rounds with me!
season_s4_visitor_massage51: No going home until you’re drunk tonight!
season_s4_visitor_massage52: That guy from the Koubutai, Rinmaru, is a real charmer with his pretty face. He even manages to throw a wink while chopping down the Oni.
season_s4_visitor_massage53: Of course, the most handsome one is Lord Nakazato, the leader. Oh, he’s just deadly charming!
season_s4_visitor_massage54: Don’t judge me by my appearance—I used to be quite a tough fighter back in the day.
season_s4_visitor_massage55: If I had a baseball bat, I’d knock those zombies flying. Let them taste my home run!
season_s4_visitor_massage56: The Sky Tower is very high, offering a breathtaking view of the entire Sakura Isle.
season_s4_visitor_massage57: Before the virus outbreak, I even had a branch up in the tower.

season4_buff_info26:
During Blood Night, the following bonuses are granted:
1. Virus Resistance +250
2. Morale +5
3. March Speed +10%
4. PvP Severe Wound Rate -20%
5. PvP Lethality Rate -10%
At the same time, the base transforms into [Blood Night Hunter], the commander’s information is anonymized, and participation in the current Blood Night Hunter event is enabled.

After the base is breached 3 times, the Blood Night Hunter status will be removed, and the commander will be considered eliminated from this round's Blood Night Hunter event.

battle_card_guide_01:
Tactics Cards Function Activated. Install Tactics Cards in the tactical slots to gain various attribute bonuses and skill effects.
When the squad is stationed at the base, the commander can freely switch Tactics Cards that are not in cooldown or have unused uses. Please note, only one Tactics Card with the same effect can be installed at a time.
battle_card_guide_02:
Tactics cards are divided into three categories: Core, Combat, and Resource, each of which can be installed in different positions on the tactical panel.
Core Cards come with powerful active or passive skill effects, and these effects can be enhanced by acquiring duplicates and ascending their stars. In addition to skill effects, Combat and Resource tactics cards also provide random secondary attribute bonuses.
battle_card_guide_03: Go to the Card Pack interface and open tactics card packs of different rarities to obtain a variety of tactics cards. Please note, some tactics cards have a daily acquisition limit.
battle_card_guide_04:
Commander, please note: Combat/Resource Tactics Cards, Tactical Fragments, and unopened Tactics Card Packs will be recycled into Profession EXP at the end of the season, while Core Cards will not.
Additionally, you can disintegrate unnecessary Combat and Resource Tactics Cards to obtain Tactical Fragments to enhance Non-Core Cards.
After reaching the maximum Profession level, you can continue to gain Profession EXP to strengthen Core Cards.

season_s4_activity_1000072_desc46:
ABOUT THE EVENT
1. After a Governor captures the Trade Post, they need to summon a caravan to activate the trade functions.
2. Once the Trade Post is active, Commanders can trade for items there. Each item in a Trade Post can only be purchased once per day.
3. The number of items a Commander can purchase in the Trade Post each day is limited, and the count resets at 12:00 server time.
4. A portion of the Diamonds spent on items will be collected as taxes and sent to the Governor as a Golden Egg.
season_s4_rules_desc52: The Trade Post Governor can summon trade caravans. Once the caravan arrives, other commanders can buy items at the Trade Post. Each item in the Trade Post can only be purchased once per day. The Trade Post Governor can buy exclusive items, and allies of the Trade Post Governor enjoy discounts.
season_s4_activity_1200012_desc01:
How to Play:
1. Trade Post contests start daily at 12:00 server time on Tuesdays and Fridays. Trade Post levels are announced on the event panel ahead of time.
2. Each contest runs for 1 hour. During the contest, commanders in the same game season group can capture the Contaminated Land around the Trade Posts.
3. You don't need connected alliance territory to join the contest, but your base must be on the Contaminated Land near the Trade Post to send troops. Commanders from the same alliance won't fight each other, but progress is tracked individually.
4. For neutral Trade Posts, the commander with the most progress at the end of the contest wins ownership. If the Trade Post is already owned, you must reach 100% progress before the timer ends to claim ownership.
5. Once the contest ends, the Governor can restock items, allowing all commanders in the season to purchase items using Diamonds. Alliance members of the Governor receive discounts, and the Governor has access to exclusive items.
6. After the trading stage ends, the Trade Post reopens for contesting. Taxes from sales are returned to the Governor as a Golden Egg, which can be shared in chat by the Governor.
7. If the Governor abandons the Trade Post or sells out all items, taxes are issued to the Governor early as Golden Eggs.
8. Each Trade Store item has a daily purchase limit of 1, and each commander has a limited number of purchases per day. Items are sold on a first-come, first-served basis.
9. When the Blood Night descends, the Governor can call in one additional Trade Caravan. During Blood Night, the Trade Store’s inventory differs from usual, and its purchase limits reset independently.

season_s4_activity_1200004_desc03:
ABOUT THE EVENT
1. When the event begins, two Faction Leaders will be chosen based on the combined power of the warzones at the start of the season. The Faction Leaders will decide the division of the two factions—Koubutai and Kage no Sato—by a coin toss. One warzone will join Koubutai while the other will join Kage no Sato.
2. After the Faction Leaders select their factions, the Presidents of other warzones can choose their faction during the faction selection stage. Each faction change will trigger a cooldown. If the desired faction is already full, the President can use "Force Join" to add their warzone to that faction, displacing a random warzone from it to the opposite faction (this does not affect the Faction Leaders' factions). A cooldown period applies between each use of "Force Join."
3. Factions are divided into Koubutai and Kage no Sato, with 4 warzones in each faction. The chosen faction will influence the declaration order during the subsequent Copper Conquest.
4. During the faction selection stage, warzone faction choices will remain hidden. Once the faction announcement stage begins, all hidden information will be revealed.
5. In the subsequent Copper Conquest, alliances from different factions can declare war on each other to compete for copper. If multiple alliances declare war on the same alliance, the defending side can invite other Alliances from the same faction that have not been declared war upon to assist in defense during a specific time phase.
6. During the faction selection stage, the president can choose to [Show Faction], making their warzone information public early. Once revealed, you can't hide it again.
7. After the event begins, commanders can teleport freely across eight warzones within the same season group. 
8. At the start of the faction selection stage, a preliminary grouping is made based on the strength of each warzone. This does not determine the final result, and the President can still use [Force Join] to choose a faction freely.

activity_rule_1200005:
ABOUT THE EVENT:
1. After the event begins, the warzone's faction determines attack and defense roles. The attack and defense roles will switch over time. When the attacking side wins a declaration of war, they can plunder a certain percentage of Copper from the defending Alliance.
2. Each war declaration round includes five stages: declaration, invitation, preparation, war, and end of war.
3. Declaration: During this stage, R4 and above members in the attacking faction's Alliances can declare war on Alliances in the defending faction.
(1) Only one Alliance can be declared on at a time.
(2) You can only declare war on Alliances within the defending faction that are in the same Copper ranking group as your Alliance.
(3) Up to three Alliances can declare war on one Alliance at the same time.
(4) The war target can be changed anytime during the declaration stage. The final target at the end of the stage becomes the war opponent.
4. Invitation: During this stage, if multiple Alliances declare war on a defending Alliance, R4 members of the defending Alliance can invite other Alliances from the same faction that have not been declared war upon to assist in defense.
(1) If three Alliances declare war, the defending side can invite up to two Alliances as defense partners. If two Alliances declare war, one Alliance can be invited.
(2) You can only invite Alliances within the defending faction that are in the same Copper ranking group as your Alliance for defense support.
(3) If the invited Alliance agrees to defend, no further changes to defense partners can be made. If the R4 and above members of the invited Alliance do not agree, the R4 and above members of the inviting Alliance can change the defense invitation anytime.
(4) R3 members of the invited Alliance can vote on the invitation.
5. Preparation: During this stage, the war between the attacking and defending Alliances is confirmed and cannot be changed. The war stage begins after the preparation stage countdown ends. You can’t move the Alliance Center during the preparation stage.
6. War: During this stage, the defending Alliance's Alliance Center CAN be attacked. The attacking and defending Alliances can fight each other to determine the war's outcome.
(1) The attacking Alliance's Alliance Center does not need to be connected to the territory, and troops can directly execute attack commands. Defense partners entering the defending Alliance's Alliance Center won't engage with the inviter's or other defense partners' troops.
(2) If the attacking troops defeat all defending troops in the Alliance Center, they can reduce the Alliance Center's durability.
(3) If the Alliance Center is destroyed within the countdown, the attacking side wins, ending the war stage early.
(4) If the attacking side fails to destroy the Alliance Center within the countdown, the defending side wins.
(5) Certain actions during the war stage, such as killing enemy units or healing, can earn event points. Reaching point milestones will earn corresponding rewards.
(6) The war stage duration will vary based on the number of Alliances on the attacking and defending sides. The specific time is shown in the war stage countdown in the event interface.
(7) During the war stage, the Alliance Center's durability will not automatically recover, nor can the Alliance Center be relocated.
(8) If the defending Alliance's Alliance Center has 0 durability or hasn't been constructed when the battle begins, the defense will be considered lost. The attacking side will loot Copper (divided evenly among multiple attacking Alliances).
(9) The Alliance Center has three support structures: the Stone Warehouse, Oil Warehouse, and Magatama Warehouse. Destroying these structures allows attackers to plunder certain percentage of the defenders' copper for each one taken down. 
7. End of war: During this stage, rewards are sent based on the war's final outcome.
(1) The winning Alliance can receive victory rewards in the event interface. If the defending Alliances (including defense partners) are fewer than the attackers, the rewards will be boosted, up to three times the normal rewards.
(2) If the attacking side wins, they can plunder a portion of Copper from the defending Alliance (defense partners are NOT affected).
(3) When multiple Alliances are attacking, the Copper rewards will be distributed proportionally based on the damage each Alliance did to the Alliance Center durability, while the defender's Copper loss remains the same.
(4) The end of war stage lasts until server time 0:00 the next day. Unclaimed victory and event point rewards will be sent via mail.
(5) If the defending Alliance's R4 does not rebuild the Alliance Center ruins by the end of this stage, the ruins will be automatically rebuilt.

zone_mobilization_rule_new: [Schedule] 1. Donation stage: 4 days. 2. Battle stage: 1 day. 3. Settlement stage: 1 day. [Donation Gameplay] · Donations: 1. Once the event begins, the President can access the construction interface to build the Warzone Airship Station. All commanders in the Warzone will participate together to complete the airship construction. 2. You can complete Daily Tasks via the 'Task' entrance in Sky Battlefront event to earn Airship Tokens. 3. Using Airship Tokens to donate will increase airship construction progress. Donations grant Individual Progress Points and Alliance Progress Points. Whenever individual donation progress or alliance donation progress reaches a certain level, a Reward Chest that can be claimed will be activated. 4. The airship construction has 3 stages. When the donation progress meets the construction goal, the airship is completed. 5. Once the airship is completed, the Rush Stage begins. During the rush stage, the airship will be upgraded and strengthened based on the highest donation progress reached in this stage, boosting its combat capabilities. · Discoveries: 1. Whenever individual donation progress or alliance donation progress reaches a certain level, there is a chance to discover an Alliance Resource Tile or a Supply Tile. (Note: Members who joined the Alliance less than 24 hours cannot contribute progress points to the Alliance or claim Alliance Chests.) 2. Click the Discoveries button to enter the Resource Tile tab and view the list of Alliance Resource Tiles. If sufficient resources are gathered from the Alliance Resource Tiles, additional Airship Tokens will be granted based on the collected amount. 3. Click the Discoveries button to enter the Supply Tile tab and view the list of discovered Alliance Supply Tiles. (Note: Supply Tiles can be collected by other Alliance members. Act fast after discovery!) [Battle Gameplay] · Preparation: 1. During the Battle stage, the President selects a location in enemy warzone and launches the airship. 2. The airship enters Teleport Mode and reaches the target after a countdown. 3. Enemy airships will target your warzone. Work together to take them down. 4. The Sky Predator airship have a time limit for challenges. If not defeated, they will retreat. · Combat: 1. The Sky Predator fires at some targets randomly, burning bases and reducing Durability. 2. The Sky Predator is very strong and requires rally attacks to defeat it. 3. Each rally attack reduces the airship's HP based on the number of defeated queues, while also recording the damage caused by each commander. 4. When the HP drops to certain thresholds, the airship activates a shield. Break the shield within the specified time to continue the challenge. If not, the airship enters a temporary Rampage Mode, launching more powerful attacks. 5. When fighting the Sky Predator airship, a win streak of 5 rounds counts as a triumph. If the airship's shield is active, you’ll need 15 consecutive wins to claim victory. [Rewards] · Donation Rewards: 1. Completing donations for airship construction grants Individual Chests based on individual progress and Alliance Chests based on alliance progress. 2. Once airship construction progress is met during the Donation stage, all warzone members can claim a Warzone Airship Construction Reward. 3. After the event ends, unused Airship Tokens are removed and converted into 1-minute speed-ups at a 1:1 ratio. · Expedition Rewards: In the Expedition tab, the damage caused by your airship to the enemy warzone determines the Warzone Rewards that your warzone commanders can claim. · Defense Rewards: In the Defense tab, commanders can claim a Defense Reward when the airship's HP reaches certain thresholds. Defeating the enemy airship scatters Sky Battlefront Loot on world map, remember to claim them. · Ranking Rewards: 1. During the Donation stage, an Alliance Donation ranking is set up. All players in the alliance receive an Alliance Donation Ranking Reward based on the alliance's ranking. 2. During the Battle stage, an Alliance Damage ranking is set up. All players in the alliance receive an Alliance Damage Ranking Reward based on the alliance's ranking. 3. After the airship battle ends, you will automatically enter the settlement stage, and leaderboard rewards will be distributed right away.

season_s4_plot_908601: Lately, the fishing boats haven’t dared to sail out — no fresh fish at all. How’s the sushi restaurant supposed to stay open like this?
season_s4_plot_908602: Once you’ve driven away those Onis, the sushi restaurant will be the first to reopen, no doubt!
season_s4_plot_908701: Electropolis has shut down, and even my rice cooker for sushi gave up on me.
season_s4_plot_908702: No worries though — once the power is back, I’ll have sushi rolling out in no time!
season_s4_plot_908801: Everyone’s on edge about Ryūran — not exactly the best time to open shop right now.
season_s4_plot_908802: Once things settle down, the sushi restaurant will be up and running in no time!
season_s4_plot_908901: Lately the Oni have been running wild—Blood Nights are especially dangerous, and no one dares open for business.
season_s4_plot_908902: Once you drive those Oni away, I won’t have to worry about safety at night anymore!
season_s4_plot_909001: Sarah’s been running around Sakura Isle—I can’t just open my restaurant like nothing’s happening.
season_s4_plot_909002: Once things settle down in Sakura Isle, you’re all welcome to come and try my handmade sushi!
season_s4_plot_909101: Ryūran and Sarah used to come here often when they were kids. Seeing what she’s become now... it really weighs on me.
season_s4_plot_909102: Once Ryūran returns to her old self, I’m throwing a sushi feast to celebrate!
season_s4_plot_909201: My legs aren’t what they used to be—I’m always stumbling around. Running a sushi restaurant is just too much for me now.
season_s4_plot_909202: I heard the Ninjas from Kage no Sato will protect us. Once my legs are better, I’ll open up the restaurant right away!
season_s4_plot_909301: Ryūran has been taken over by the Oni… as her fan, I’m all over the place right now. I can’t focus on making sushi at all.
season_s4_plot_909302: If you can help Ryūran get back to her senses, I’ll open the sushi restaurant right away!
season_s4_plot_909401: The hot springs in town are great, but with so many visitors soaking there, it’s tough to get enough fresh ingredients for sushi.
season_s4_plot_909402: Don’t worry, I’ve already arranged for the best ingredients — the sushi restaurant will be opening soon!
season_s4_plot_909501: The Grand Night Market may be bustling, but supplies are scarce — I can’t even get my hands on soy sauce or wasabi!
season_s4_plot_909502: Once the Grand Night Market gets back to normal and supplies are steady, my sushi restaurant will open right away — you’re all invited to come try it!

season4_comic_1: We set foot on Sakura Isle, only to find the rumors true—the land lies shrouded in a deep, unyielding darkness.
season4_comic_2: Strangely, every trail we followed led us to a single name—the brightest star of Sakura Isle, idol Kageyama Ryūran.
season4_comic_3: Sarah, who grew up on Sakura Isle, volunteered for the reconnaissance mission. She set out alone to Ryūran’s concert, determined to uncover the truth.
season4_comic_4: Once bound by childhood memories, Sarah and Ryūran had shared a precious bond. However, the Ryūran she faces now is no longer the same—Horns crown her brow, claws gleam at her fingertips. The Oni Virus has taken root, and twisted her beyond recall.
season4_comic_5: It seemed Ryūran had long sensed Sarah’s presence. She raised her clawed hand high, pointing straight toward the sky.
season4_comic_6: In the blink of an eye, a shadow tore through the sky, and the helicopter was destroyed in an instant. By sheer instinct, Sarah hurled herself out of the cabin—mere seconds before impact.
season4_comic_7: Then came the beast—a creature with giant wings descending in a deadly arc from the sky. Its massive blade cut through the air, aiming to split Sarah in two.
season4_comic_8: With swift precision, Sarah unleashed her shadow Ninjutsu—her body flickered, then vanished like a mirage in the wind.
season4_comic_9: Ryūran’s performance had reached its climax, with lights and sound crashing together in a frenzy of spectacle.
season4_comic_10: Lost in the performance, the fans remained oblivious as their bodies began to twist and mutate—reasoning slipping away with each beat.
season4_comic_11: Just then, a Kunai whistled through the air, slicing across Ryūran's cheek. Blood bloomed like red plum blossoms on her pale skin.
season4_comic_12: Sarah emerged from the shadows like a true Ninja. Her gaze sharp as a blade. The war between humanity and the virus had quietly begun.

season_s4_update_notice_3:
Dear Commander,
To optimize the season experience, we have made the following adjustments to the current season: 
1. Alliance Resource Tile that may drop after defeating Doom Elites will no longer include Season-Resource-Type Resource Tiles.
(We apologize that this change limits the opportunity for alliance members to collaborate through Alliance Resource Tiles. However, it also eliminates the imbalance in season resource production caused by differences in alliance size and activity levels.) 
2. The auxiliary structures of the Alliance Center are no longer unlocked based on the Alliance Center level, but will now be unlocked progressively with the season timeline.
(This adjustment is intended to make both offense and defense during the Conquest phase fairer for all alliances. It also prevents stronger alliances from gaining additional advantages by rapidly constructing auxiliary structures.)
3. The Profession Level Cap will no longer be increased and remains at level 100. Instead, a brand-new Tactics Cards system has been introduced. After reaching profession level 100, you can continue to earn Profession EXP, which can be used to upgrade Core Cards!
(More details will be revealed once the Tactics Card system is unlocked.)
Thank you for your understanding and support, and wish you fun in the new season!

season_s4_update_notice_4:
Dear Commander,
To further enhance your season experience, we’ve made the following adjustments:

[Lighthouse & Electrician Adjustments]
1. When the Lighthouse's Brightness Auto-Adjustment is enabled, it will automatically turn on after Blood Night ends.
2. Added a new profession skill: Electrician Rally Call. After learning this skill, you can send an Electrician Rally Message in the Alliance chat. Allies can then quickly dispatch electricians to assist your base.
3. Fixed an issue where inner city lighting levels were not displayed correctly when illuminated by other Commanders.

[Wandering Oniwagon Adjustments]
1. The max consecutive battle rounds when attacking a Wandering Oniwagon with a single squad has been adjusted to 5 rounds.

[Blood Night Hunter Adjustments]
1. After a warzone is sealed, Blood Night Hunters remaining in this warzone will not be eliminated immediately. Instead, they will lose Magatama Life Points gradually—1 point per minute—until fully eliminated.
2. Within the first 10 minutes after Blood Night begins, full-map zoom-out will no longer reveal the coordinates of other Blood Night Hunters.
3. Increased survival time rewards for Blood Night Hunters and reduced severe wound rate and death rate for units in combat.
4. The remaining relocation attempts for Blood Night Hunters are now shown on the battlefield details screen.

[Resource Optimization]
1. Added S4 storyline comics.
2. Improved the visual effects when the base lights are turned on.
3. The Divine Tree now illuminates a certain area around it once activated.

Thank you for your valuable feedback and continued support!

On scorched land where no soul survives and fire reigns supreme,
the throne of the Oil King rises high—
a towering monument of power, carved as if from living flames.
He commands with unmatched might,
the spark that ignites war itself…

Beneath his throne lies a hoard of immeasurable wealth,
as if the earth has torn open its core, 
offering all it has to serve his will.

Atop that fiery throne stands the Oil King—
an unquestioned sovereign,
with molten rivers seething at his feet, 
his rule roaring like thunder born of flame.

All who hunger for power must first kneel before him—
or brave the wrath of his burning dragonfire.

season_s4_side_duel__info:
Faction Duel is the ultimate battle between two factions, and the outcome directly affects the faction rankings!
During the Faction Duel, warzones of the same faction are teammates, allowing reinforcements to the Capitols and Cannons controlled by the same faction alliance.
The base color of the commanders of the same faction is displayed as light blue on the map, and the base color of the commanders of the opposing faction is displayed as light red on the map.
There are no attack restrictions between the bases of the commanders of the same faction.
At the end of the battle, in addition to the victory rewards, a large number of [Faction Copper Points] will be added according to the number of Capitols and Cannons controlled by the faction.
In this Faction Duel, the number of Cannons has been reduced from four to three, and their power has been significantly increased.
Each Cannon will be contested in a 1v1 Duel by two Warzones from opposing factions for ownership;
In addition to competing for the Capitol, the faction's Leading Warzone is also allowed to assist their own faction's Warzones in the fight for Cannon ownership.

YiBianJinQu_rules_12:
1. Participation is limited to the top 32 power-ranked Alliances. 
2. Only commanders with bases over Lv.15 are eligible.
3. The alliance has been established for 7 days or more. 
4. Registration becomes available 24 hours after joining an Alliance.
YiBianJinQu_rules_13:
1. In the battle, contributions in all aspects grants [Individual Points], which can be used to charge your Individual Skills. 
2. You'll get 1 free teleport opportunity every once in a while, followed by a cooldown. Teleporting is suspended during cooldown. 
3. Units won't suffer <color=#DC143C>casualties</color> in this battle, they will be sent to the Hospital with unlimited capacity. All units will fully recover after the battle. 
4. Commanders who leave the battlefield can't re-enter for a certain period of time. Temporary exits don't have a wait time. 
5. When you enter the battlefield, your highest-level units automatically fill the separate Drill Ground. They won't show up in your base's Drill Ground and won't leave the battlefield after the fight.
6. All boosts from tech, VIP Level, Base Skins, Titles, Decorations, and Drones work in battle.

season_s4_update_notice_5:
Dear Commander,
To enhance your seasonal experience, we have implemented the following updates:

1. Added a new Butler Skill [Tesla Coil], which the defending side can use on alliance buildings during the Copper Conquest to temporarily increase the building’s durability and damage all enemy bases within attack range.

2. In this season’s Copper Conquest, the Atomic Beast’s Atomic Breath will replace the Warlord Missile.

3. Buff effects from Night and Blood Night on monsters will now be displayed in battle reports.

4. The number of times you can claim rewards from the Large Lucky Cat event now accumulates across days. Unused claims from one day will carry over to the next, up to a maximum of 15.

5. Improved notification messages regarding Blood Night Hunters for battlefield changes and event endings.

6. Adjusted the learning specialization levels for some Season Specializations.

7. Cross-server operations are now supported during the Trade War event.

8. Optimized some visual effects.

9. Fixed the condition description for obtaining auxiliary structures of Alliance Center.

Thank you very much for your valuable feedback.

refund_faq_question1: Why didn’t I receive the pack after payment?
refund_faq_answer1:
If you have made a payment but did not receive the corresponding pack, please contact our customer support and provide a screenshot of the payment order or the order ID.
Usually, players can find a valid receipt in the email associated with their payment method (Google/Apple), which should include the following details:
Order Number/ID
Purchase Date/Time
List of Purchased Items
Unit Price and Total Amount Paid

For your reference, Google platform order IDs follow the format: GPA.aaaa-bbbb-cccc-ddddd; iOS platform order IDs are a 10-character alphanumeric string starting with the letter M.

Once we confirm that the item was not delivered successfully, we will resend it to you via in-game mail immediately.
refund_faq_question2: Why was I charged double when purchasing the pack?
refund_faq_answer2:
If you encounter a duplicate charge, please contact our customer support and provide a screenshot of the payment order or the order ID.
You can find a valid receipt in the email associated with your payment method (Google/Apple), which should include the following details:
Order Number/ID
Purchase Date and Time
List of Purchased Items
Unit Price and Total Amount Paid

For your reference, Google platform order IDs follow the format: GPA.aaaa-bbbb-cccc-ddddd; iOS platform order IDs are a 10-character alphanumeric string starting with the letter M.

Once we confirm that the item was charged twice, we will contact you immediately.
refund_faq_question3: Which payment methods are currently supported in the game?
refund_faq_answer3: The game currently supports payment through the official Google and iOS platforms. If you are unable to make a payment using your account on these platforms, please contact the respective platform’s customer support to verify the status of your account.
refund_faq_question4: Can I change the currency for payment?
refund_faq_answer4: The payment currency is determined by the official Google and iOS platforms. If you are unable to make a purchase using the currency associated with your account, please contact the respective platform’s customer support to verify your account status. Thank you for your understanding!
refund_faq_question5: Why wasn’t my Weekly Pass resent after purchase?
refund_faq_answer5: Currently, the Weekly Pass needs to be claimed manually by logging into the game. Thank you for your understanding and support.
refund_faq_question6: I accidentally purchased an item. Can I get a refund?
refund_faq_answer6:
Please contact our customer support and provide a screenshot of the payment order or the order ID.
You can find a valid receipt in the email associated with your payment method (Google/Apple), which should include the following details:
Order Number/ID
Purchase Date and Time
List of Purchased Items
Unit Price and Total Amount Paid

For your reference, Google platform order IDs follow the format: GPA.aaaa-bbbb-cccc-ddddd; iOS platform order IDs are a 10-character alphanumeric string starting with the letter M.
refund_faq_question7: Why doesn’t the payment page appear after I click to purchase the pack?
refund_faq_answer7:
If you encounter a situation where the payment page does not appear after clicking the pack, we recommend switching your network, clearing the cache, and restarting the game before trying again.
If the issue persists, please feel free to contact our customer support at any time.
refund_faq_question8: What are the restrictions for requesting a refund?
refund_faq_answer8: In principle, users who purchase paid in-game items from our company may request a refund within {0} days from the date of purchase or payment. However, certain items may be subject to refund restrictions. Refunds may not be granted for: Items that have already been used; Items received through gifts or event rewards; Content that takes effect immediately upon purchase (such as Battle Pass, Fund, Weekly/Monthly Pass, First Purchase Bonus, Construction Queue, Research Queue, and Radar Replenish). According to relevant laws and regulations, these types of purchases may not be eligible for a refund.
refund_faq_question9: What happens after a refund is processed?
refund_faq_answer9:
Once you initiate a refund, if the items included in the pack are sufficient for deduction, the system will deduct them accordingly. VIP point items will be deducted from your total VIP progress based on the actual amount received. Diamond items will be deducted from your diamond resources.
If the items are insufficient to cover the refund, an amount of Gold Bricks equivalent to the original pack price tier will be deducted. If you have both paid and free Gold Bricks, the paid ones will be deducted first.
Please note: if your Gold Brick balance becomes negative, your gameplay experience may be affected.
refund_faq_question11: Why did a pop-up about Gold Bricks appear in my game?
refund_faq_answer11: We are committed to maintaining a fair and rewarding gaming environment to ensure all players can fully enjoy the game. Since a refund was initiated and the items in your account were insufficient for deduction, or the request exceeded the no-reason refund period or the limit for exempted item and point deductions, you are required to repay the corresponding refund amount in order to continue playing the game.
refund_faq_question12: How can I repay the Gold Bricks?
refund_faq_answer12:
We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused by the recent refund activity that resulted in a negative Gold Brick balance and triggered a pop-up. This mechanism is designed to maintain a fair and friendly gaming environment — we appreciate your understanding.
If you did not receive the purchased items or received the wrong items, we will do our best to assist you in resolving the issue. However, we are unable to take responsibility for purchases made due to user error.
If you wish to continue playing, please tap the [Purchase] button in the pop-up and bring your Gold Brick balance back to 0 or above.
refund_faq_question13: What is the deduction-free limit for related items and points?
refund_faq_answer13: When you purchase a pack, you also receive associated content such as automatically distributed Alliance Gifts, and event points from the diamonds included in the pack (e.g., for Arms Race, Alliance Duel, and recharge-based events). These associated items and points are not deducted when a no-reason refund is processed. To ensure fairness in the game, the deduction-free refund limit is dynamically adjusted based on your historical top-up and refund activity.

refund_window_goldbrick_details:
1. Gold Brick is a new virtual Item in the game, which can be used to Redeem other virtual Items and is only usable within the game.
2. If your Account undergoes a refund and the Pack Items and related Event Items have been consumed, an equivalent amount of Gold Bricks corresponding to the Pack tier will be deducted.
3. If the Gold Brick balance becomes negative after deduction, your Account's gameplay experience will be affected:
When the number of Gold Brick is between -1 and -10,000, your account will have a Pack Purchase Restriction, preventing you from buying any packs.
When the number of Gold Brick is between -10,001 and -20,000, your account will have a Speech Restriction, meaning you cannot chat in-game while the Pack Purchase Restriction remains in effect.
When the number of Gold Brick is between -20,001 and -40,000, your account will further have an March & Rally Restriction, which means besides the Pack Purchase and Speech Restrictions, you will be unable to deploy on the world map or launch a rally.
Whenthe number of Gold Brick is less than -40,000, your account will have a Login Restriction.
4. From the first time the Gold Brick balance becomes negative, you have 30 days to top up and restore your balance. Once restored, all restrictions will be lifted. If not restored within 30 days, the Login Restriction will be enforced after the countdown ends.

activity_98800_desc1:
<color=#249bc5>Event Gameplay</color>
1. During the event, Commanders can use Bounty Bullets to eliminate zombies in the district and earn rewards.
2. Attacking non-Boss Zombies can be done using <color=#099b4a>Attack</color> or <color=#099b4a>Barrage Strike</color>. <color=#099b4a>Barrage Strike</color> consumes the total number of Bounty Bullets required to attack all current non-Boss Zombies. Attacking Boss Zombies can be done using <color=#099b4a>Attack</color> or <color=#099b4a>Power Laser</color>. <color=#099b4a>Power Laser</color> consumes the total number of Bounty Bullets needed to reduce the Boss Zombie’s remaining HP to zero (each Bounty Bullet reduces <color=#099b4a>10 HP</color> of the Boss).
3. Rewards obtained from attacks will fly into the chest located at the bottom left of the interface. Rewards in the chest must be claimed manually.

<color=#249bc5>Trigger Event</color>
1. Eliminating Zombies during the event may trigger events (Boss Zombie {0}%, Wandering Merchant {1}%).
2. A maximum of {2} Wandering Merchant events can be triggered daily. The merchant will leave after staying for a while.
3. Purchasing Mystery Packs from the Wandering Merchant will grant extra Alliance Gifts, Diamonds, and VIP Points equal to the amount in the Diamond Mall (excluding double rewards).

<color=#249bc5>Area Change</color>
1. Consuming 1 "{3}" will attract zombies in the current area, allowing you to move to a new area. Zombies from the previous area will not follow. Each new area will spawn 8 zombies. Eliminating all zombies in the current area will automatically move you to a new area. You cannot change areas while a Boss Zombie is present.
2. During the event, {4} "{5}" items will be added daily at 00:00 (<color=#099b4a>Items will also appear in the Inventory</color>). A maximum of {6} can be accumulated.
3. Each time you reach a new area, a free chest will appear in the district. Opening it will grant rewards.

<color=#249bc5>Conversion and Reissue</color>
1. Progress Points will reset at the end of the event.
2. Unclaimed rewards in the bottom-left chest and unclaimed progress rewards will be sent via Mail after the event ends.
3. Free items from the Wandering Merchant will be sent via Mail after the merchant event expires.
4. Bounty Vouchers, Bounty Bullets, and {7} items will not be recycled after the event ends.

<color=#249bc5>Others</color>
1. Each attack grants {8} points. Points can be used to claim progress rewards once a specified amount is reached.
2. During the event, Bounty Vouchers can be used in the Trade Store to redeem desired items.
3. The Reward Log panel only records the latest 300 entries.

challenge_zombie_alliance_rule_2_replace: Cooperate to unleash the Atomic Breath and successfully shoot down the Sky Predator!
challenge_zombie_alliance_rule_desc_repl: 【Individual Challenge】 · Participation Requirements: 1. Base level must be at least 8. 2. Only one difficulty can be selected per event. 3. Higher difficulties will be unlocked after completing all challenges of the previous level. · Challenge Rules: 1. Commanders can choose to challenge the Instructor individually or initiate a rally to fight alongside allies. 2. After defeating the Instructor, Commanders will unlock challenges against higher-level Instructors. 3. At the end of the event, Commanders will receive rewards for all successfully completed challenges. 4. After completing all challenges of the current difficulty, Commanders will be able to challenge higher difficulties in the next General's Trial event. 【Alliance Challenge】 · Unlock Conditions: 1. When enough Commanders in the alliance complete challenges of the corresponding difficulty, R4 and higher officers can choose to activate the Alliance Challenge. 2.Only one difficulty can be selected for the Alliance Challenge in each event! 3. The higher the chosen difficulty, the more demanding the progress goals will be. 4. The higher the chosen difficulty, the better the rewards will be. (Click on the dots on the progress bar to view the objectives and rewards of each stage.) · Challenge Rules: 1. Once started, the challenge lasts for 30 minutes. During this time, Commanders can rally against or join rallies targeting the Sky Predator. The damage each Commander deals will be accumulated. 2. Total individual damage will be added up as the alliance's total damage. The higher the progress in individual and alliance damage, the better the rewards. Rewards include Trial Keys and other generous rewards. 3. The Sky Predator will launch the Missile attacks during battle. Bases hit will lose a certain amount of durability and enter a burning state. 4. As the battle progresses, the Sky Predator will charge up three times in total. 5. When the Sky Predator starts charging, the alliance's Warlord will simultaneously activate the Atomic Breath. Allies can assist in transferring energy to the Warlord. Once enough energy is gathered to meet the requirement, the Warlord can choose to unleash the Atomic Breath to interrupt the charging of the Sky Predator. 6. The Sky Predator hit by the Atomic Breath will enter a stunned state and takes extra damage during this period. 7. If the Sky Predator finishes charging successfully, it will enter 'Rampage Mode'. In this state, its damage to base durability, attack frequency, and range will be greatly increased, posing a major threat to the alliance!Please work together to help the Warlord unleash the Atomic Breath! Please note: if the Warlord’s base moves during the skill, the Atomic Breath will fail. 8. As the battle becomes more intense, the Sky Predator will automatically enter Rampage Mode in the final moments of the challenge and remain in that state until the challenge ends. 9. Alliance Challenges cannot be started in the final 2 hours of the event, so please plan accordingly. · Reward Settlement: 1. After completing the challenge, the area on the world map where the Sky Predator was located will drop Trial Gift chests. 2. Based on individual challenge performance and alliance challenge performance, Commanders will automatically receive a certain number of Trial Keys. Other item rewards will be distributed via in-game mail based on damage progress rewards. (Each Commander can only receive damage progress rewards once during the event.) 3. Each Trial Key can be used to open 1 Trial Gift chest. 4. Any unused Trial Keys will be reclaimed and rewards will be reissued after the event ends. 5. If you change alliances after the challenge ends, you will not be able to use your Trial Keys to open Trial Gift chests. Returning to your original alliance will allow you to resume opening them.

YiBianJinQu_rules_1:
Deep within a desolate canyon, a long-hidden viral research facility of the Doom Legion has been exposed. This is the birthplace of Sample Zero, the virus that once plunged the world into chaos. Now, fragments of forbidden data, viral samples, and advanced weapon technology have resurfaced, drawing the gaze of powerful forces once again.
The discovery has sparked a fierce response from two rival factions. Rulebringers, defenders of discipline and control, have mobilized swiftly, aiming to reclaim the virus technology and erase all traces of its existence—before history repeats itself. Meanwhile, Dawnbreakers, a coalition of free fighters and survivors, believes the only way to rebuild the world is to seize the origin of the virus and harness its secrets.
A brutal standoff unfolds in the canyon. What began as a battle for strategic assets has become a fight for the future of humanity—and the right to shape the truth itself.

YiBianJinQu_rules_3:
1. Selecting Participants
Alliance R4s or R5s must decide on the starting players and substitutes during the registration stage.
Each Alliance can assign up to 20 starting players and 10 substitutes, with starting players getting priority battlefield access.

2. Entering the Battlefield
Players must meet 3 conditions to enter the battlefield:
A. Be a starting player or a substitute for this battle.
B. Belong to the registered Alliance.
C. Their base should not be on the Contaminated Land near the Capitol.

3. Battle Stages
Prep Stage: Participants from both sides can enter the battlefield's spawn area. Your side will be marked in blue, the enemy in red. You can't be attacked in the spawn area.
Stage 1: Capture Data Centers, Sample Warehouses, and Power Towers to earn [Battlefield Points].
Stage 2: Capture the Defense System to enable attacks against enemies inside core buildings. After that, capture Serum Factories to gain [Battlefield Points] and Troop Buffs. Power Stations will also appear randomly on the map; gather them to earn [Battlefield Points].
Stage 3: Capture the Virus Lab. Capturing Virus Labs grants a large amount of [Battlefield Points].

The side with the most [Battlefield Points] wins the battle.

Note: Captured buildings will generate [Battlefield Points] that exceed their storage capacity after a period. Attacking and capturing these buildings lets you pick up these additional [Battlefield Points].
season_s4_camp_battle_02:
1. The President and the Vice President of a warzone can select strategic areas for their faction to engage in battle, until 10 minutes before the battle begins.
2. Once a strategic area is selected, only buildings within that area can be attacked or supported when the battle begins.
3. The leading warzone of each faction is not restricted by strategic area limitations.
4. The President and the Vice President may propose a strategic area swap (excluding the Capitol) with the opposing warzone. A swap requires the other side’s approval and consumes one swap attempt from both sides.
5. There is no restriction on attacking the Tenryū Castle area. Everyone is free to attack it.
S2_alliance_photo_help_1: Honor and courage from the Polar World shall never be forgotten. Capture every moment of glory with your allies! Event Rules 1. The event is available once season rewards are distributed. 2. During the event, you can take group photos and leave messages via the event menu or the Season Memorial Hall. 3. After the event ends, all content will be locked but remains viewable in the Season Memorial Hall. Alliance Binding 1. Commanders can only participate in the group photo event within the alliance they were in when rewards were distributed. Leaving the alliance means you can only view but not edit. 2. If a commander rejoins the reward-eligible alliance during the event, they can continue editing their group photo and messages. Group Photo Settings 1. Avatar Placement: Drag to adjust avatar positions. Avatars cannot overlap. 2. Frame Rewards: Based on alliance rankings across the 8 warzones: 1st place: Unlocks all frames. 2nd–20th place: Unlocks [Polar Elite]. Other alliances: Unlock [Polar Blessing]. 3. Avatar Size: Avatar size varies based on reward tiers. Commanders who receive Alliance Leader Reward, Tactician Reward, or Core Reward will have slightly larger avatars than other commanders. Additional Notes 1. If a player was not in an alliance during the season settlement or their alliance did not qualify for rewards, they cannot participate in the group photo or messaging. 2. If an alliance is disbanded, players can still view previously generated group photos and messages in the Memorial Hall, but they can no longer edit them. 3. Players with multiple seasonal group photos can review them in the Memorial Hall's history list. 4. Commanders must agree to the Player Guidelines before participating. This frozen moment—we were there together.
