season_s4_mail_desc80303:
Dear Commanders,
As Sakura Isle gradually lights up, this season has successfully concluded, entering the settlement stage. We appreciate your bravery and dedication during the darkness!

Settlement Stage Changes:
1. Leaderboards locked: All season rankings are now final.
2. Alliance rewards: R5 or [Butler] can assign rewards based on the alliance tier.
3. Season activities close: Special game modes will gradually shut down, with data cleared or reset.
4. Cross-warzone teleport: Teleporting between warzones within the season's warzone group is no longer allowed.
5. Combat restrictions: You can no longer declare war on or attack cities, strongholds, and trade posts.
6. No resource generation: Cities, strongholds, and alliance centers will stop producing resources.
7. Purchases disabled – [Season Battle Pass] and [Season Weekly Pass] are no longer available.
8. Buff removed: The additional effects from the Season Boost event have been removed.

After the settlement stage ends, you will see the following changes:
1. Power, illumination, and Protector-related mechanics will be disabled. [Protector Horns] and [Protectors] will be cleared and converted into [Recruitment Orders].
2. [Quartz], [Stone], [Magatama], [Lucky Charm], [Lucky Charm Golden Egg], and [Ryōtei Restaurant items] will be cleared and converted into Profession EXP.
3. [Protector's Field] will reset to level 1, and Protectors will not be available outside the season.
4. [Battle/Resource Tactics Cards] will be cleared and converted into Profession EXP. [Tactics Card Packs] will be probabilistically converted into Profession EXP or random Core Cards (conversion probability matches the chance of obtaining Core Cards from packs). Core Cards will not be recycled.
5. All personal and alliance seasonal structures will be removed.
6. Alliance Loot will be cleared: Alliance leaders should distribute any remaining loot before they disappear. 
7.[Magatama Golden Egg] will be cleared, please use them in time!

What Stays the Same: 1. Profession levels, EXP, and Profession EXP items. 2. City capture status within the current warzone.

Thank you for your enthusiastic participation this season! Off-season events are on the way—stay tuned for more fun!
season_s4_mail_desc80304:
Dear Commanders,
Your bravery during the season has once again saved the world. Thank you for your active participation, the season has successfully ended, and the season entrance is now closed.

Here's what's changed:
1. The Power system and illumination mechanics have been fully disabled.
2. All Individual and Alliance season buildings have been reset and removed (your power may drop as a result).
3. Season-specific profession skills have been reset and removed, and all consumed skill points have been returned.
4. Season tasks have been reset and cleared.
5. Exclusive season resources and items have been removed (Quartz, Stone, Protector Units, Protector Horns, Magatama, Lucky Charm, Magatama Golden Egg, Lucky Charm Golden Egg, Ryōtei Restaurant items, Battle/Resource tactics cards, and tactics card packs).At the start of the next season, season-exclusive resources and items will be cleared again.
6. Protector's Field has been reset, and Protectors will not be available outside the season.
7. The season hero recruitment event has ended (any remaining Recruitment Tickets can be used in the next season).
8. The season monsters, Dice Tavern, and Sakura Isle visitors have disappeared.
9. The Trade Post shop is now closed, and items are no longer available for purchase.

But remember, the tides of war are ever-changing, and new challenges are on the horizon! In the next season, we will embark on a new adventure and continue to build the legend!

YiBianJinQu_plot_1: Commander, welcome to the front line! Keep an eye on the Battlefield Status Panel at the top — the blue progress bar shows your current score, while the red bar represents the enemy’s.

YiBianJinQu_plot_4: Commander, follow me to get a briefing on the front line! First, use the map to quickly assess the battlefield situation.
YiBianJinQu_plot_5: Capturing battlefield buildings generates points for your faction. Different buildings provide different amounts of points, so choose your strategy wisely based on the situation, Commander!
YiBianJinQu_plot_6: Fighting in this battlefield, assisting allies, and executing tactics will all generate Energy. Once enough Energy is gathered, you can unleash powerful Active Skills — turning the tide of battle in your favor!

ABOUT THE EVENT:
1. Code 87 spawns on the World Map every Monday and Thursday at 00:00, 06:00, 12:00, and 18:00 (server time). Each time it appears, it stays for 3 hours. Commanders can locate it via the event menu.
2. While Code 87 is active, commanders with bases at level 8 or above can send troops to challenge it.
3. Unlimited challenge attempts per day. No rally attacks allowed. (Festival events and events like the Black Market Challenge offer up to 5 extra drop opportunities.)
4. Tank heroes deal extra damage to Code 87.

Rewards:
1. Commanders get rewards after reaching the required number of challenges.
2. On challenge days, the higher the single damage dealt, the better the rewards. Only the highest single damage counts for ranking.
3. Rewards in the "Goals" unlock gradually as server time progresses, and each reward can be claimed once.

At the end of the season, all <color=#dd9628>Combat/Resource Tactics Cards, Tactical Fragments, and Tactics Card Packs</color> held by the Commander will be converted. Conversion Rules:

1. Combat/Resource Tactics Cards will be converted into Tactical Fragments at the same rate as dismantling the respective Combat/Resource Tactics Card.
2. All Tactical Fragments will be converted into Profession EXP at a rate of <color=#dd9628>1 Tactical Fragment = 5 Profession EXP</color>.

activity_desc_99145:
<color=#249bc5>Event Gameplay</color>
1. During the event, Commanders can use <color=#099b4a>Music Note Tokens</color> to spin. Each spin grants points, and reaching the required points unlocks stage rewards.
2. You can complete daily tasks to collect patterns and receive generous rewards during the event.
3. The more matching patterns in the result, the better the rewards. When using the 5x spin mode, both the consumption and rewards will be 5 times the initial amount.

<color=#249bc5>Chest Opening Event</color>
1. If the spin result includes a <color=#099b4a>Music Note Lucky Chest Pattern</color>, it will trigger a chest opening. Commanders can choose one reward from the chest.
2. For each Music Note Lucky Chest Pattern in a single result, there is one chance to choose.
3. If the chosen card is SR (Blue), other SR (Blue) cards will be excluded. (Only one SR card can be flipped.)

<color=#249bc5>Conversion and Reissue</color>
1. Task rewards completed but not claimed in time will be sent via mail the next day.
2. At the end of the event, <color=#099b4a>Music Note Tokens</color> will be converted into Universal Speed-up items and sent to you through in-game mail. Items not retrieved on time will expire and can be manually converted into Universal Speed-up items in your inventory.
3. Conversion Rate: Music Note Token *1 = 1-minute Speed-up Item *30.

<color=#249bc5>Others</color>
1. During the event, purchasing Music Note Token packs can earn you Diamond Golden Eggs.

season_s2_pre_desc08:
This season, Commanders will venture to the northern polar regions.
The polar region remains cold year-round; if your base temperature drops too low, it will freeze, preventing advanced relocation and rally launches.
Occasional blizzards will strike the area, causing the environmental temperature to plummet sharply.
season_s2_pre_desc09:
To withstand the harsh cold of the polar region, Commanders and their Alliances have built furnaces.
Burning coal to keep the furnace running raises the surrounding temperature, helping to stabilize your base temperature.
You can also spend coal to quickly raise the temperature for your allies.
Raising the temperature grants various benefits in the polar region, but beware—if the temperature gets too high, your base may catch fire!
season_s2_pre_desc10:
Beneath the ice of the polar region lie abundant rewards. Raising the world’s environmental temperature will reveal them.
The polar pup "Snowflake" is also a treasure-hunting expert—keep it well-fed, and it will bring you surprises!
season_s2_pre_desc11:
Violet returns to the polar region, where battle and memories intertwine—she is about to undergo a transformation!
A new batch of heroes has received Exclusive Weapon to aid you in conquering the polar region!
alliance_government_10005_26:
Use on any Alliance Building to increase its Durability and transform it into the Tesla Coil, which deals damage to all enemy bases within its attack range.
<color=#f53c3d>During the war preparation and battle stages, you cannot change officials or leave the Alliance.</color>
season_s2_pre_desc12:
Polar cities will produce a new alliance resource: Rare Soil.
Rare Soil can be used to upgrade the Alliance Furnace level and serves as a basis for season ranking rewards.
Commanders will be divided into two factions to compete for Rare Soil. Warlords in the alliance can use exclusive alliance skills to influence the battlefield.
season_s2_pre_desc13:
During the season, players can choose and join factions within their warzone to compete for rare soil.
An unprecedented ultimate duel between factions is coming soon!
season_s2_pre_desc14: Crush the enemy’s plot, reactivate the nuclear furnace, and restore life to the polar region! The all-new season: Polar World awaits your arrival!

season_s1_pre_desc08:
Commanders are about to embark on a new journey to the Rainy Mistlands!
The zombies there are extremely dangerous and carry a high concentration of virus, which affects combat effectiveness of your units!
Please upgrade your Season Buildings to boost virus resistance before sending your troops, so they can perform at their best.
season_s1_pre_desc09:
Due to the climate in the Rainy Mistlands, the virus is exceptionally active. After fighting virus-carrying units, your units may become infected.
The virus is highly contagious and can spread to other Commanders during battles. Allied Commanders can assist each other in curing the infection.
season_s1_pre_desc10:
The Rainy Mistlands is dotted with numerous military strongholds, but they have now fallen into the hands of the Doom Legion.
Large numbers of zombies surround these strongholds and must be eliminated before the strongholds can be captured.
Powerful Corruptors garrison the strongholds. You need sufficient virus resistance to defeat them and reclaim the strongholds!
season_s1_pre_desc11:
For territory security, capturing strongholds and cities in the Rainy Mistlands requires them to be connected to your alliance’s existing territory.
Capturing them increases your Alliance Influence and helps you compete for the seasons final rewards!
season_s1_pre_desc12:
This season, Mason will be promoted to a UR Hero!
Kimberly, DVA, and Tesla will also unlock exclusive weapons, gaining even greater power!
season_s1_pre_desc13: Declare war across warzones and embark on a new journey! With brand new season features [Warzone Expedition] and [Warzone Declaration], you can venture into other warzones to seize cities, boost your Alliance Influence, and compete for the seasons ultimate rewards!
season_s1_pre_desc14:
New Season — The Crimson Plague
Unveil the mysterious veil of the Rainy Mistlands. We await your arrival!

howtoplay_s1_resistance_1: The Monsters carry a virus. Increase your Viral Resistance to attack them.

howtoplay_s1_virus_1: When attacking monsters, different virus stacks may be applied based on the difference in Virus Resistance. The chance to apply a virus stack equals the percentage of damage reduction.

undo_system_rules1: Certain items can be retrieved after being obtained or used. You may undo the action before the countdown ends.
undo_system_rules2:
1. The following items are available for retrieval:
· Choice Chests (which allow you to choose from specified items)
· Materials used to craft drone chips (a maximum of 20 Drone Chips can be retrieved per month)
· Certain items redeemed from the shop (purchase limit will not be reset)
· Resource chests converted into resources (limited to Coins, Food, and Iron).
undo_system_rules3:
Please note that the following actions may result in retrieval being unavailable:
· Earning event points when obtaining the item (such logs will not appear in the Item Retrieval Center)
· Using the item after obtaining it (e.g., decorations, cosmetics, drone chips, etc.)
undo_system_rules4: 2. Performing a retrieval will deduct the same number of items you originally obtained. If you don't have enough items in your inventory for the deduction, you can perform the retrieval as long as you make up the difference before the countdown ends.
undo_system_rules5: 3. Each time a retrieval is completed, one retrieval attempt will be deducted from your total. If you have no remaining attempts left, you will not be able to perform more retrievals.
undo_system_rules6: 4. Your remaining retrieval attempts will reset on the 1st of each month. <color=#f53c3d>Please note that unused retrieval attempts will not carry over to the following month.</color>
undo_system_rules7: 5. Limited-time event. If the event has ended when you attempt a retrieval, it will not be performed.
undo_system_rules8: 6. Your available monthly base retrieval limit is 1. You can gain additional retrieval attempts by increasing your VIP level. If your VIP expires, any used retrievals will be deducted based on the default limit of 1 retrieval per month (to a minimum of 0).
undo_system_rules9: 7. Items bought with Purchased Diamonds will only be refunded as Free Diamonds during retrieval.

howtoplay_s1_info_1:
1. When rallying to eliminate [Doom Elites], different troops have different Virus Resistance. 
2. If the Rally Initiator has higher Virus Resistance than a participant, the participant’s troops will use the initiator’s Virus Resistance.
3. If the rally initiator’s Virus Resistance is lower, the participant’s own Virus Resistance will be used.
4. Virus Resistance between participants is not shared, regardless of its level.
howtoplay_s1_info_2:
1. Troops will be infected when attacking enemies with Virus Resistance requirements higher than their own.
2. Infected troops will bring the virus back to base after they return, causing the Commander's Base to become infected.
3. An infected Base will suffer debuffs depending on the number of virus stacks.
4. Infected Bases can Alliance Help to remove the Infection Status.
howtoplay_s1_info_3:
1. You must first eliminate the infected zombies near the Military Stronghold before you can rally against the [Corruptor].
2. After defeating the [Corruptor], you can send troops to capture the Military Stronghold.
3. The more troops you have at the Military Stronghold, the faster it can be captured.
4. Strongholds above Lv. 1 require adjacent Alliance territory to capture.
5. The [Corruptor] is extremely dangerous! Make sure to raise your Virus Resistance before attacking!
howtoplay_s1_info_4:
1. You can capture two Military Strongholds and declare war on two Cities every day. These limits are independent of each other.
2. War declarations can only be made during Declaration Days after the War Declaration event begins.
3. When capturing Cities across Warzones, these Warzones share a limit of 4 Cities.
4. Capturing Cities increases the capture limit for Military Strongholds in their corresponding Warzones.
howtoplay_s1_info_5:
1. Warzone Invasion requires the construction of an Alliance Outpost.
2. The first time an Alliance Outpost is built, it will be under protection. While protected, the outpost cannot be attacked until construction is finished.
3. After finishing the construction, the outpost enables attacks on Strongholds within its range.
4. If the Alliance Outpost is destroyed, it can no longer be used for launching attacks.
5. A destroyed Alliance Outpost must be repaired, which has a 24-hour cooldown. After repair, it restores 50% Durability.

season_plot_s1_detective_1: No footprints at the scene. Just a shadow that shouldn't exist.
season_plot_s1_detective_2: The case files keep piling up. The empathy? Wearing thin.
season_plot_s1_detective_3: The toxic rain felt like a warning—Heaven's way of saying: stay out of it.
season_plot_s1_detective_4: The rain came right on time, washed the blood clean.
season_plot_s1_detective_5: After the toxic rain, the street splits in two: water on one side, silence on the other.
season_plot_s1_detective_6: Whenever the sun's out, the killer gets bold. Sin under sunlight—that's the real irony.
season_plot_s1_detective_7: When the leads dry up, I stare at the clouds. Unlike people, they don't lie.
season_plot_s1_detective_8: Corpses rot faster under the sun. Not a hunch, but a fact.
season_plot_s1_detective_9: His right eye twitches when he lies. Restless like the mist.
season_plot_s1_detective_10: He's calm, almost too calm to be alive.
season_plot_s1_detective_11: I don’t distrust human nature—I just trust fingerprints more.
season_plot_s1_detective_12: I hate sunny days. Too much light, and nowhere to hide.
season_plot_s1_detective_13: I'm tracking a murder, not filming a drama.
season_plot_s1_detective_14: My gut makes no sense, but my feet never take a wrong turn.
season_plot_s1_detective_15: I hate rain. Especially the toxic kind—clean on the outside, rotten through the core. Just like some folks.
season_plot_s1_detective_16: The body was still there when the mist cleared, but a suspect wasn't.
season_plot_s1_detective_17: Some vanish into the mist, and others appear, in a constant inexplicable loop
season_plot_s1_detective_18: The mist is thickening, and the city is fading like an old photo.
season_plot_s1_detective_19: The scene is too clean—like someone scrubbed the future ahead of time.
season_plot_s1_detective_20: One iced Americano, two unsolved cases, and a sunny day I didn't ask for.
season_plot_s1_detective_21: Some rain washes away evidence. Some... dredges up memories.
season_plot_s1_detective_22: The rain is doing me a favor, covering up my tire tracks.
season_plot_s1_detective_23: Truth hides less in testimony, more in silence.
season_plot_s1_detective_24: How many times now? I've lost count. Can't even tell if the body's moved anymore.
season_plot_s1_footballer_1: Toxic rain? Have we got to bring our own hazmat suits to warm-up now?
season_plot_s1_footballer_2: As soon as the match ended, the rain stopped. Like the sky was saying, “Nice effort, silly.”
season_plot_s1_footballer_3: It’s not that I couldn't run, but the referee and the wind just had it out for me.
season_plot_s1_footballer_4: People talk about our high salaries, without considering the risk of getting sick and playing in toxic rain.
season_plot_s1_footballer_5: The coach told us to give it all. Didn’t say anything about playing nonstop in pouring rain without a break.
season_plot_s1_footballer_6: The coach yelled, “Hang in there!” Then I shouted, “Tell that to my legs!”
season_plot_s1_footballer_7: I pray for clear skies before every match. But I think the referee's got relatives among the clouds.
season_plot_s1_footballer_8: Every time the mist rises, I fool myself into thinking I'm a ninja. The truth is, I can't see a thing.
season_plot_s1_footballer_9: That's a powerful shot? Thanks, that was all the frustration I kicked away.
season_plot_s1_footballer_10: Sunlit grass can be harsh on the eyes, but I’ll take that any day over toxic rain.
season_plot_s1_footballer_11: Sunny days are a dream for photographers, hell for us players.
season_plot_s1_footballer_12: Under the sun, every inch of my skin feels glued together.
season_plot_s1_footballer_13: The field’s so soaked even the ball seems tired of rolling.
season_plot_s1_footballer_14: If sarcasm were a sport, I’d be world champion already.
season_plot_s1_footballer_15: Honestly, I’d rather lose than break a leg slipping in this toxic rain.
season_plot_s1_footballer_16: The forecast said no rain. Well I guess this isn't exactly rain, more like the sky pouring down its wrath.
season_plot_s1_footballer_17: It’s not that I’m not passing the ball. I literally can’t see you, bro! Can you believe this mist could swallow someone whole?
season_plot_s1_footballer_18: There’s so much water in my shoes, I might as well start growing some lotuses.
season_plot_s1_footballer_19: My knees are protesting the weather again, like my cranky grandpa.
season_plot_s1_footballer_20: I’d rather run through the mud than rot on the bench.
season_plot_s1_footballer_21: The mist’s so thick, I can’t even spot the goal. This isn’t a match, it’s hide-and-seek.
season_plot_s1_footballer_22: In the mist, the ball can slip right through my legs and I wouldn't even notice.
season_plot_s1_footballer_23: Some guys score goals non-stop. Me? I’m better at catching raindrops.
season_plot_s1_footballer_24: Rainy matches are the worst—soaked, slippery, frustrating, and a guaranteed cold.
hero_backstory_desc_50027:
Sarah grew up in Kage no Sato, and her closest friend was Kageyama Ryūran.
As a girl of similar age, Ryūran's smile always carried an innocence that felt out of place in their ninja village. Despite being the clan leader's daughter, she was totally down to earth, always dragging quiet Sarah up rooftops, practicing shuriken, and sneaking around at night to catch whispers of the elders' secret plans... Together, they made a promise under the cherry blossoms: to protect this island, and to protect each other.
Yet fate offered them no such chance.

As a child, Ryūran had once wandered into the sealed grounds and briefly came into contact with the Oni virus. Though she showed no symptoms, subtle traces of the virus lingered in her body. When Kamiizumi Nakazato, leader of the Koubutai Squad, discovered this, he proposed a preemptive strike to eliminate future risk. Kageyama Jūbei, furious, swore to protect his daughter at all costs. And so, two once-allied forces were split apart.
Sarah was only eight years old that year—the first time she realized that so-called "justice" could carve such deep and bitter divides.

From that day on, Ryūran changed.
She no longer tapped on Sarah’s window in the dead of night, nor clung to her with talk of ninjutsu or camping adventures. Instead, she began appearing in public—in crowds, on stages, in front of cameras. Her voice graced radio broadcasts, ethereal and stirring, like a shaft of light breaking through the gloom.
Through sheer will, Ryūran rose to become one of Sakura Isle’s brightest stars. She belonged to no faction, served no master. She stood in the spotlight of her own choosing, protecting peace as an idol—soothing hearts with her smile, awakening hope through her songs.

Years later, the remnants of the Doom Legion returned. But this time, they did not attack the sealed grounds of Kage no Sato. They came instead for the body that had once resisted the virus—Ryūran.
She was captured, subjected to cruel experimentation. The Oni virus finally awakened within her, and with it, the ancient will that slumbered deep within—the "Oni General." It was not just a name, but a memory of terror and bloodshed. It took Ryūran's body as a vessel, manipulated her mind, and stripped away her spirit.
She slaughtered the remaining Doom Legion members, returning alone through carnage and silence. But she was no longer Ryūran.
She activated the "Nightfall Device," plunging all of Sakura Isle into eternal night. In the darkness, the Oni virus thrived. Under the spotlight, she traveled as an "idol," spreading infection through her songs and performances. She became the queen of the stage, and the harbinger of calamity. Her face remained as beautiful as ever, but her soul had long been consumed by darkness.

Upon hearing the news, Sarah set off for Sakura Isle.
That night, even the starlight was devoured by the shroud of darkness. Sarah caught sight of that familiar silhouette atop the stage, singing with an otherworldly voice and hollow eyes. She charged ahead, only to be struck down in an instant. Ryūran no longer recognized her. Or perhaps she remembered, but chose not to.
Sarah was gravely wounded, but in her unconsciousness, she dreamed of their childhood promise—standing side by side beneath the cherry blossoms, swearing to protect the island. When she woke up, her gaze was firmer than ever.

She returned to the Commander's side, bringing the only promising proposal: "The Oni virus fears light. With enough light, we can shatter its foundation, and perhaps even... bring her back."
"Let us carry out the greatest Operation Lightbringer in Sakura Isle’s history, so the darkness will have nowhere left to hide!" Sarah looked into the Commander's eyes. In that moment, her voice was gentle yet unshakable.

hero_backstory_desc_40019:
She was quiet and swift, as if born to belong in the sky.
Sarah was one of the youngest pilots in the military with unmatched skills. In every operation, her enemies barely had time to react before her helicopter had already pierced through the sky and completed the mission. But what made her truly fearsome wasn't just her brilliance in the air, it was the other side of her identity—a ninja.

Few knew the truth. Her parents were detectives from the Rainy Mistlands, dispatched to investigate a forbidden virus spoken of only in legend—the Oni virus. Their pursuit of answers led them to Sakura Isle, to a secret village where the virus was sealed.The Oni virus traced back centuries. In ancient times, the ancestors of Kage no Sato and the Koubutai once stood together in defeating the Oni General, a tyrant who ruled in terror and bloodshed. They sealed away both its body and the virus that bore its name, deep within the heart of the island.
Sarah's parents were not intruders. They worked together with the Koubutai and Kage no Sato, forming close bonds in their shared mission to investigate the virus. And during that brief moment of peace, they brought a child into the world—Sarah. That year, the cherry blossoms bloomed brighter than ever, a symbol of new beginnings.

Two years later, Kage no Sato clan leader's daughter—Kageyama Ryūran was born. As a young girl, she once wandered into the sealed grounds and came into brief contact with the Oni virus. Though showing no symptoms, word of Ryūran's situation reached the Doom Legion—a dark force sweeping the globe. They sought to harness the virus’s power and launched a full-scale invasion on Sakura Island.

Soon a war followed. Kage no Sato and the Koubutai fought side by side. Sarah’s parents fought bravely to protect the villagers in battles, but they did not make it. A young girl stood among drifting blossoms and rising smoke, staring up at the blazing sky. Her tears fell silently. From that day on, she became silent and reserved.

She was taken in by Kageyama Jubei, the leader of Kage no Sato, who gave her a new name: Kageyama Sara, carrying the meaning of a cherry blossom that blooms in darkness. She mastered secret ninjutsu in the ninja village and made her mark in the shadow division while still a child. But rather than remain in the shadows, she chose to step into the light and fight on the front lines, for the truth her parents died chasing.

Becoming a ninja was fate. Becoming a soldier was her choice.
She is silent, composed, and decisive, rarely showing her emotions. But behind her calm gaze, a fire still burns bright.
She knows Sakura Isle’s story wasn’t over.
And her war has just begun.

Defeat the Corruptors and retake our Cities!
You can deal more damage by taking advantage of the Corruptor's traits.
mail_content_11038: Perhaps you’ve already noticed, {0} Cities have returned to the control of the Crimson Legion. While you were busy fighting among yourselves, I have amassed a power beyond anything you've faced. Now, the Crimson Tide will once again sweep across the Warzone, and I shall take back everything you stole from me!
mail_content_11039: I forged the Crimson Legion with my own hands, poured everything I had into it. Yet still, I failed to reclaim my palace. Now, my body lies broken, my breath grows faint, and my children are fading one by one. But I won’t run like Nier. I’ll go down with what's left of my family's shattered glory. Enjoy your precious victory while it lasts. Let’s see how long you can actually hold onto it.
s1_weather_plot01: It's cloudy. The sky looks like someone from the Rainy Mistlands just woke up—confused, but still holding on.
s1_weather_plot02: It's cloudy. The sun called in sick today, so let's use the clouds as a temporary shade.
s1_weather_plot03: It's cloudy. Cloudy is the official default setting in the Rainy Mistlands—standard issue, no complaints allowed.
s1_weather_plot04: It's foggy. Outside feels wrapped in steam like a fresh cup of Earl Grey—soft and hazy.
s1_weather_plot05: It's foggy. If you can’t see your neighbors today, don’t worry—they’ve just gone invisible.
s1_weather_plot06: It's foggy. Drive slow, or you might crash into the blurry silhouette of a clock that looks like a teacup’s rim!
s1_weather_plot07: It's raining. Our old friend rain is back—better bring a paddle than just an umbrella.
s1_weather_plot08: It's raining. Don’t ask if it will rain—ask which places haven’t gotten soaked yet.
s1_weather_plot09: It's raining. Rain shows up unannounced, just like the Rainy Mistlands’ dry humor.
s1_weather_plot10: It's raining acid! This rain’s not too friendly—even your umbrella wants to quit.
s1_weather_plot11: It's raining acid! Suit up in protective gear, the rain’s got a bit of attitude today.
s1_weather_plot12: It's raining acid! Wear your corrosion suit—don’t get emotional, this rain doesn’t care.
s1_weather_plot13: A rainbow appeared! The sky added a rainbow blush to the gray—too beautiful to look away.
s1_weather_plot14: A rainbow appeared! Someone just finished crying, and the sky sent an artist right after.
s1_weather_plot15: A rainbow appeared! Don’t blink—rainbows are the hardest VIP shows to book in the Rainy Mistlands.
s1_weather_plot16: It's sunny! The sun’s made a rare appearance—time to dig out those hibernating shorts.
s1_weather_plot17: It's sunny! Sunshine’s open for business—Rainy Mistlands folks have officially switched to vacation mode.
s1_weather_plot18: It's sunny! Skipping sun time is the biggest disrespect you can pay to the Queen’s milk tea.
s1_weather_plot19: It's windy. The wind’s working overtime today—even the cream cookies almost blew away.
s1_weather_plot20: It's windy. If you see my hat, please tell it I miss it terribly.
s1_weather_plot21: It's windy. The wind’s so strong, I’m half convinced I’m about to be blown to the next country.

The Rainy Mistlands has unpredictable weather that’s hard to grasp.
Locals prefer [Sunny], [Light Rain], [Cloudy], and [Rainbow]—pleasant weather that also grants buffs to Commanders.
They dislike [Acid Rain], [Foggy], and [Windy]—suffocating weather that brings debuffs to Commanders.

YiBianJinQu_guide_tips_1:
[Canyon Storm Battlefield] - Battle for Sample Zero!
An Elite Task Force has formed the Rulebringers faction representing power and order, while the freedom-seeking Dawnbreakers faction consists of two Task Forces. Both factions are rallying their forces, and an epic clash is imminent!
YiBianJinQu_guide_tips_2: [Individual Skill] - You can accumulate [Energy] with different types of activities in the battlefield. Energy can be consumed to cast useful [Individual Skills]. There are 4 types of [Individual Skills] that can be flexibly used based on different battlefield conditions!

YiBianJinQu_guide_tips_4: [Serum Factory] - Periodically produces a type of serum with buffs (four types total). When the production countdown ends, all Commanders garrisoned at the [Serum Factory] will receive the buffs from this batch of serum!

ABOUT THE EVENT:
1. After the event starts, one stage will unlock each day. Commanders can enter the stage to play the block puzzle.
2. When a full row or column in the elimination area is filled with blocks, those blocks will be cleared.
3. Some blocks contain Serum Fragments. When these blocks are cleared, the fragments inside will be obtained. Collect the required number of Serum Fragments to complete the stage and earn rewards.

Unable to declare war as today is not a war declaration day.
Declaration of war is available every Wednesday and Saturday. 
Successfully capturing a City after declaring war against it grants you loot rewards.
season_s1_activity1000018_desc02:
ABOUT THE EVENT:
1. After the event begins, you can declare war on Wednesday and Saturday. Alliance members of R4 and above can declare war within the season's group on other Warzone's Cities.
2. The first capture of a City by another Warzone's Alliance grants loot rewards, displayed in the City List.
3. Wars can be declared after connecting Alliance territory to the target City, allowing for subsequent City capture.
season_s1_activity1000018_desc03: War declarations on Cities from other Warzones are only available on War Declaration Days (Wednesday and Saturday).
season_s1_activity1000018_desc04: You can only attack buildings controlled by other Alliances on war declaration days (Wednesday and Saturday).
season_s1_activity1000018_desc05:
ABOUT THE EVENT:
1. After the event begins, you can declare war only on Wednesday and Saturday. Alliance members of R4 and above can declare war within the season's group on Cities (both in this Warzone or in other Warzones).
2. The first capture of a City by another Warzone's Alliance grants loot rewards, displayed in the City List.
3. Wars can be declared after connecting a Military Stronghold controlled by your Alliance to the target City, allowing for subsequent City capture.
season_s1_activity1000018_desc06:
The City protection time always ends at 12:00 server time.
The default protection duration lasts until 12:00 (server time) on the day after 6 full days have passed since the end of the battle.
When the warzone declaration event starts, the protection duration changes to 12:00 (server time) on the next war declaration day (Wednesday, Saturday), 6 days after the battle ends.
Each war declared lasts up to 1 hour, and exceeding the limit counts as a failed capture.
The contest stage will end at 24:00. Commanders, please arrange your war declaration time in advance.

s1_QueenChallenge_htp_info:
Starting from the second week of the off-season, the Crimson Queen will declare war on <color=#f53c3d>Monday and Wednesday</color>, and will launch one massive siege on <color=#f53c3d>Tuesday and Thursday</color>, for a total of 6 sieges.

2. The number of Cities declared as war targets can reach up to <color=#f53c3d>8/10/12/14/15/16</color>.

3. During the war declaration phase, Alliance R4 and R5 members can set several of the targeted Cities as their Alliance Defense Targets. Members can only garrison Cities marked as their own Alliance Defense Targets. <color=#f53c3d>Please coordinate defense plans in advance to avoid leaving any City undefended.</color>

4. Crimson Troops come in <color=#f53c3d>Gold/Silver/Bronze</color> difficulties. Tap the difficulty icon on the City card to view detailed enemy information. <color=#f53c3d>Rewards are not affected by monster difficulty; please set appropriate Defense Targets based on your Alliance Power.</color>

5. During the siege, the Crimson Queen will send a total of <color=#f53c3d>20 waves</color> of Crimson Troops to each City under attack.

6. If Crimson Troops defeat all defending forces, they will deal <color=#f53c3d>1% Durability Damage</color> to the target City, and will remain nearby to launch another attack shortly after. <color=#f53c3d>Send troops back to garrison the target City as soon as possible.</color>

7. After the 20th wave appears, all remaining Crimson Troops will enter <color=#f53c3d>Rampage Mode</color>, increasing Durability Damage to <color=#f53c3d>10 times</color> the original value!

8. If a City is successfully defended, numerous reward crates will appear around it and can be claimed by all Commanders in this Warzone. <color=#f53c3d>If the City's Durability drops to 0, the defense fails and no rewards will appear.</color>

9. If <color=#f53c3d>all Cities</color> are successfully defended during the final siege, the Warzone will receive an additional reward: <color=#f53c3d>Warzone Emblem - Bell Tower</color>, commemorating the complete defeat of the Crimson Queen’s ambition.

season_s1_update_notice_3:
Dear Commander, to improve your season experience, we've made the following adjustments:
1. Added a new "Weather" system, which will affect your actions in the world.
2. After learning the profession specialization skill [Lucky Predator], Serum Chests may drop, granting [Serum Fragment] upon pickup. These can be exchanged for items in the Serum Shop.
3. The [Genetic Recombination] event has been removed and replaced by the [Gene Collection] event.
4. Adjusted season-exclusive profession skills to better align with season-specific gameplay.
5. The Virus Lab now provides a new attribute: reduced severely wounded ratio for units in PvE battles.
6. Added cross-warzone achievements. Participate in cross-warzone Stronghold or City captures to earn rewards.
7. Added S1 Season Titles, obtainable by fulfilling specific requirements during the season.
8. Added Warzone Intel page for quick access to information on target Warzones.
9. Added Current Warfare feature to help view ongoing Alliance battles more clearly after logging in.
10. Added season-exclusive gifts [Black Tea], [Golden Watch], and [Royal Crown], which can be sent to other Commanders during the season.
11. Added season photo feature, allowing you to take commemorative photos with allies after the season ends.
12. War Declaration Days have been changed to Wednesday and Saturday (previously Thursday and Saturday).
13. Protection time for Military Strongholds has been extended from 36 hours to 60 hours.
14. Adjusted the opening times for Lv. 1 / Lv. 3 / Lv. 5 Cities (see in-game for specific timings).
15. Adjusted the difficulty of the [Crimson Legion].
16. Optimized the world surface with new ocean elements at the map edges.
17. Optimized the visual effects of Commander Base coloring.

update_history_3: Dear Commander, to improve your experience, we made the following adjustments:
season_plot_s1_detective_25: Welcome to the [Land of Liberty]. Brew a pot of tea, pack your umbrella, and savor the wonders of this mysterious realm.
s1_plot_1: Oh, it’s not just the weather that’s gotten worse around here. The virus has too.
s1_plot_2: Fortunately, we still have one trick up our sleeve: boosting our [Virus Resistance] to hold it back.
s1_plot_3: Hell, are the zombies evolving into multiple troop types now?
s1_plot_4: Strange as it sounds, that might actually work in our favor. We can counter them by choosing units that counter their troop types.
s1_plot_5: Look at that massive [Corruptor]! Definitely not something to take lightly.
s1_plot_6: But we'll have to bring it down first before capturing the [Military Stronghold].
s1_plot_7: We’ll need higher Virus Resistance if we’re going to stand a chance.
s1_plot_8: This place… it used to be a thriving city. Now? Just ruins and wandering dead.
s1_plot_9: Still, there’s strategic value here—we must reclaim it to restore the future of human civilization.
s1_plot_10: And here lies the old Capitol Building. Whoever controls this place doesn’t just hold power over the warzone—they control the path to the presidency.
s1_plot_11: Exactly. Taking the Capitol means seizing the reins of fate. We must make full preparations!
s1_plot_12: The weather’s going to be all over the place this week.
s1_plot_13: Monica, you picked up a side gig as a weather reporter?
s1_plot_14: In just a few hours… new weather patterns will hit.
s1_plot_15: See those monsters? They’re carrying the virus!
s1_plot_16: Time to upgrade the [Virus Research Institute] and boost our [Virus Resistance]!
s1_plot_17: This is our [Alliance Outpost], our pathway to strike into other Warzones. Of course, it also means others can strike us from their Warzones.
s1_plot_18: So we must protect our [Alliance Outpost], and take out theirs before they get the chance.
s1_plot_19: Look! That monster dropped some Serum when it went down.
s1_plot_20: If I remember correctly, there’s a Serum Shop. We can trade those for more rewards.

Each ally who assists you has a chance to appear in your Street Rush and provide a <color=#ed7623>Support Buff</color>.
The more allies who assist, the greater the <color=#ed7623>Support Buff</color> you can receive during the run. Support status resets daily.
parkour_rule_2: Rush Coins are used for upgrading buff skills or purchasing revivals.

parkour_rule_desc: [Participation Requirements] 1. Base level must be at least 12. 2. Daily challenge attempts: 30 times. [Game Rules] 1. Start Match: · Tap the Start button to enter the match. 2. Controls: · Swipe to dodge obstacles. 3. Objectives: · Sprint for the longest distance. · Collect more Rush Coins. [Ranking Rules] 1. Event rankings settle weekly. 2. Rankings are based on the longest running distance in a single rush each week. [Reward Rules] 1. Individual Rewards: Individual rewards refresh daily, unlocking Individual progress chests based on the daily accumulated Rush Coins collected. 2. Alliance Rewards: Alliance rewards refresh weekly, unlocking Alliance progress rewards based on the weekly total Rush Coins collected by all Alliance members. 3. Ranking Rewards: · Ranking rewards settle weekly. Weekly ranking rewards differ slightly. · The rankings include both the Individual Rankings within the Alliance and the Individual Rankings within the Warzone. [Buff Rules] 1. Upgrade Buffs: · Tap the Buff button to enter the buff upgrade interface, spending Rush Coins to enhance buff effects. 2. Unlock Buffs: · Some buffs are locked and require waiting for a countdown to finish, then manually tapping the Unlock button to activate the buff for free. 3. In-match Buffs: · Unlocked buff items will spawn randomly on the track. · Gain additional buff item drops through Ally Help. 4. Ally Help · Invite allies to help. The more allies that come to help, the more Ally Help buffs can be obtained during the match. · Upgrading the Ally Help buff increases the maximum number of ally appearances during the match. · Ally Help resets daily and requires sending help invitations again. 5. Revive · After unlocking Revive buff, you can spend Rush Coins to revive during matches. · Successfully spending Rush Coins to revive clears all obstacles within a nearby range. · Upgrading the Revive increases the maximum number of revives available per match. Revives cost more Rush Coins the more you use them in a single match. · After reviving, your running distance before revival are retained. · Rush Coins earned in the current match cannot be spent on revive in the same match. [Alliance Vault] 1. Access: · Street Rush - Alliance Vault. 2. Exploration: · Select the target Alliance Vault on the event interface to enter exploration. 3. Refresh Rules: · Automatically refreshes 1 Alliance Vault per day. · Spend Street Rush - Alliance Compass to discover additional Alliance Vaults. · Participating in Street Rush grants a chance to obtain Street Rush - Mystery Boxes. Open the Street Rush - Mystery Boxes for a chance to receive Street Rush - Alliance Compass. · Alliance Vaults last for 24 hours after appearing. 4. Reward Rules: · Successfully break the stones that cover treasures to get the corresponding rewards. · Each commander can break only 1 stone per Alliance Vault. [Notes] 1. Closing the game or quitting when paused may cause your result to be lost and not counted toward the rankings. 2. When the rankings settle across weeks, Street Rush results may fail to register on the rankings.

city_war_howtoplay_info_01:
ABOUT THE EVENT
1. An Alliance's R5/R4 must declare war on a City to start the clash, with one City per Alliance.
2. Alliances with no Cities can declare war on any level 1 City.
3. Alliances with Cities can only target adjacent Cities.
4. City battles are tough and can result in direct unit deaths. Refer to the City's profile for specifics.
5. First-time city capturers in the clash get a bonus, and all alliance members get a city reward.
6. Capturing a city gives all alliance members a boost.
7. Finish race goals within the set time to get rewards, sent to commanders by mail after the event.

city_war_battle_pass_03:
Individual Contest Details:
1. When the City Clash event begins, players can complete battle pass tasks to earn rewards and battle pass points.
2. battle pass tasks unlock alongside the opening of Cities of the corresponding level.
3. Collecting battle pass points will advance your battle pass progress. Each progress milestone grants the corresponding rewards.
4. After joining an Alliance, while neutral Cities are in protection, your radar will refresh 1 Scout City radar task per day.
5. Radar tasks take you directly to scoutable neutral cities. Choose the City and press Scout to complete it.
6. Completing a Scout City radar task unlocks a Wandering Zombie radar task.
7. Completing the Wandering Zombie radar task grants substantial rewards, plus a 10% chance to trigger a hidden radar task.
8. You can earn a substantial amount of Individual Merit by defeating the garrisons and breaking the defenses of neutral Cities that were never captured by an Alliance! 
9. While you are in another Warzone, Individual Contest tasks will stop tracking progress. To complete them, please return to your original Warzone.

1. A cache of crucial supplies has been left behind in neutral Cities. Clues about their whereabouts are held by the zombies lurking there. Defeat them, piece together the Clues, and track down the supplies!
2. During the event, completing Scout Cities Radar Tasks may trigger Wandering Zombie Radar Tasks, which grants clue shards.

While exploring the Restricted Area, you meet Kimberly for the first time.
Though your bond is still new and not yet close, she offers you gifts to help you improve, recognizing a fellow friend with the same goal.
t11_idle_game_special_event_long_desc_13: Kimberly holds immense respect for true power in combat, and she sees the nearby foes as a chance for you to show her your strength.
t11_idle_game_special_event_long_desc_14: Kimberly is in urgent need of items to boost her power and turns to you for help, offering better items in exchange for solving her immediate problems.
t11_idle_game_special_event_long_desc_15: The Doom Legion attacks again, and the enemy numbers are overwhelming. Kimberly is stretched thin and hopes you can help repel them!
t11_idle_game_special_event_long_desc_16: Kimberly thanks you for defeating the Doom Legion, condemns their atrocities, and vows that her hatred toward them will never fade.
t11_idle_game_special_event_long_desc_17: In this brief moment without the Doom Legion, Kimberly finally relaxes and enjoys a pleasant conversation with you.
t11_idle_game_special_event_long_desc_18: According to the intel, the Doom Legion is assembling its formidable forces. Kimberly wants you to prepare thoroughly and build up your strength before the battle.
t11_idle_game_special_event_long_desc_19: To keep units at their best, Kimberly suggests sending them to the Restricted Area for some special training so they are ready for battle.
t11_idle_game_special_event_long_desc_20: The Doom Legion’s latest assault is relentless, with powerful enemies at every turn. After all this time, Kimberly knows your strength is formidable. To ensure victory, she implores you to defeat the enemy generals!
t11_idle_game_special_event_long_desc_21: With the enemy generals defeated, the enemy forces crumbled, securing an effortless victory. Kimberly expresses her heartfelt thanks and genuine respect for you, hoping to continue fighting by your side.

t11_idle_game_special_event_long_desc_26: From the Rainy Mistlands comes Tesla, a master of electromagnetism. He has found an abandoned lab but needs materials urgently.
t11_idle_game_special_event_long_desc_27: With your help, Tesla quickly throws himself into new experiments. However, he soon runs out of ideas and seeks your company to spark inspiration.
t11_idle_game_special_event_long_desc_28: His current project requires real-world testing. Tesla specifically requests the aid of Venom, the ballistics specialist, to help verify his theories.
t11_idle_game_special_event_long_desc_29: With Venom’s assistance, the experiments run smoothly! Tesla now requests some real combat data that only you can deliver.
t11_idle_game_special_event_long_desc_30: Based on the combat data, Tesla believes the destructive power can still be improved. However, he still lacks materials and seeks your help.
t11_idle_game_special_event_long_desc_31: Progress is slow, and results fall short of expectations. Frustrated by how little he understands about zombies, he opens up to you.
t11_idle_game_special_event_long_desc_32: Violet, the Justice Vanguard’s foremost expert on zombie weaknesses, comes to mind. Tesla hopes that you can convince her to help with the experiments.
t11_idle_game_special_event_long_desc_33: Yet Violet’s personality makes Tesla deeply uncomfortable. Even though the research makes huge strides, he remains troubled and comes to you again for counsel.
t11_idle_game_special_event_long_desc_34: Tesla’s research is only step away from completion. He knows that to succeed, he must rely on his "old" partner, Stetmann.
t11_idle_game_special_event_long_desc_35: Together, these two masters of electromagnetism have succeeded, and the electromagnetic bullet is born. Tesla personally seeks you out to express his gratitude!

t11_idle_game_special_event_long_desc_41: DVA expressed her gratitude for your assistance and praised the strength you’ve shown. While chatting, she reminisced about her childhood and her brother, who has been missing for years.

t11_idle_game_desc_59:
Units are an important part of your strength as a Commander. They are now in need of special training. Dispatch your strongest units to zombie-infested Restricted Areas to complete new training and challenges!

[Unlock Requirements]
Own a Barracks of at least Lv. 27

[Dispatch Units]
The system will automatically select your highest-level units for dispatch, and the training squad’s power is calculated based on the unit capacity of the squad with the highest capacity (among all your squads) in your current squad settings.

[Restricted Area Levels]
There are 10 levels of Restricted Areas. You explore the area at your current highest level. In the Restricted Area, you can have your units train by themselves or complete boss challenges.
The higher the level of a Restricted Area, the better the rewards from training and boss challenges! To unlock a higher-level Restricted Area, you must defeat all bosses in the current area.

[Training Exploration]
During training, your units may engage in battles or encounter lost Training Supply Boxes. Additionally, random events may occur!
Events are divided into normal events and special events from heroes. Completing them grants corresponding event rewards!
Note: Some special events require ally assistance to complete.

[Boss Challenges]
You can complete boss challenges during training. After defeating all bosses, the current training ends automatically, allowing you to explore a higher-level Restricted Area.

[About Honorable Campaign]
Although you can no longer participate in Honorable Campaign, available rewards from its highest-level stages will be converted into your available training rewards, along with additional items to enhance your troops! The Campaign Store remains available, and you can still earn Campaign Medals during training to redeem those items.
t11_idle_game_special_event_long_desc_42: DVA maintains rigorous battle training to improve her strength in combat, all in the hope of finding her brother in the Doom Legion.
t11_idle_game_special_event_long_desc_43: DVA greatly respects Schuyler as a pilot. Having lost to Morrison in a flight competition, she realizes her limitations and looks to you to invite Schuyler to guide her strategy.
t11_idle_game_special_event_long_desc_44: Between her training sessions with Schuyler, DVA recalls her past and her family, hoping to present flowers as a token of remembrance.
t11_idle_game_special_event_long_desc_45: Timothy is growing up fast. When DVA showed it a picture of her brother, it reacted in a surprising way! She came to share the excitement with you.
t11_idle_game_special_event_long_desc_46: Timothy seems eager to take DVA somewhere, thinking it might have something to do with her missing brother. With enemies all around, DVA seeks your help.
t11_idle_game_special_event_long_desc_47: DVA found a Doom Legion base hidden from radar at the location Timothy led her to. Commander, please eliminate the threat! She asks.
t11_idle_game_special_event_long_desc_48: The purge ended in victory as the enemy fled. Among their supplies, a pair of boots engraved with Timothy’s name was found. DVA is convinced Timothy would never join the Doom Legion and becomes more determined to find her brother!
t11_idle_game_special_plot_1_1_2: The Restricted Area is swarming with zombies, posing a constant challenge to your squad!
t11_idle_game_special_plot_1_1_3: To ensure you’re fully prepared before venturing deeper into the Restricted Area, I’ve set Training Inspection goals to make sure your squad is ready for the next-level challenges!
t11_idle_game_special_plot_1_1_4: Go for it, Commander! Hope you achieve your goal soon!
t11_idle_game_special_plot_1_2_1: Well done on achieving your goal! May you dominate in the next region!
t11_idle_game_special_plot_1_3_1: Congratulations, Commander! You’ve entered a new area!
t11_idle_game_special_plot_1_3_2: Your next goal has appeared. Hope you achieve it soon!
t11_idle_game_special_plot_2_1_1: Glad to see you here, Commander!
t11_idle_game_special_plot_2_1_2: Your units’ capabilities alone reveal that you are a formidable Commander!
t11_idle_game_special_plot_2_1_3: Years of war have taught me one thing: being strong alone isn’t enough to win a battle. You need powerful, like-minded allies by your side!
t11_idle_game_special_plot_2_1_4: I’m sure you understand this as well. Show me the strength you and your allies possess, for it will inspire hope for those still caught in the war!
t11_idle_game_special_plot_2_2_1: Goal achieved! You and your allies have truly shown me the power of unity!
t11_idle_game_special_plot_2_2_2: Keep up the good work! I can’t wait to see you again!
t11_idle_game_special_plot_2_3_1: We meet again, Commander! Have you and your allies made any new progress lately?
t11_idle_game_special_plot_2_3_2: Time to test the bond between you and your allies again! I look forward to seeing the combined strength of your Alliance!
t11_idle_game_special_plot_5_1_1_1: I’ve discovered an abandoned lab with all the necessary equipment, but the materials for experiments are almost gone.
t11_idle_game_special_plot_5_1_1_2: Commander, I can rebuild this place if you lend me a hand. It will speed up our research on electromagnetic weapons.
t11_idle_game_special_plot_5_1_2_1: Fantastic! This is a brand-new beginning!
t11_idle_game_special_plot_5_2_1_1: The lab reconstruction went smoothly. Still, it feels like something is missing.
t11_idle_game_special_plot_5_2_1_2: I feel stuck. I need some time to clear my thoughts...
t11_idle_game_special_plot_5_2_2_1: Thank you for listening. Consider this a token of gratitude for your help. I hope it'll come in handy.
t11_idle_game_special_plot_5_3_1_1: I’ve found the problem: we need practical experience!
t11_idle_game_special_plot_5_3_1_2: Lab experiments aren’t enough. I need an actual ballistics expert to conduct live-fire trials.
t11_idle_game_special_plot_5_3_1_3: You know who I’m talking about. If you help Venom attain the proper qualifications, I’m sure he’ll be willing to assist me.
t11_idle_game_special_plot_5_3_2_1: Thanks, Venom. You’re exactly who I’ve been looking for.
t11_idle_game_special_plot_5_3_2_2: Count me in, as long as we’re fighting zombies!
t11_idle_game_special_plot_5_4_1_1: Commander, Venom helped me calibrate the data for the shells.
t11_idle_game_special_plot_5_4_1_2: Yet, I need more real-world combat data. I’ll collect it from your regular battles against zombies.
t11_idle_game_special_plot_5_4_2_1: Your command was impressive. But that's not what I'm here about today.
t11_idle_game_special_plot_5_4_2_2: I finally made some progress in the weapon research, but there are still some issues to resolve.
t11_idle_game_special_plot_6_1_1_1: Commander! Happy to see you here!
t11_idle_game_special_plot_6_1_1_2: Let me introduce you to a new friend, Timothy.
t11_idle_game_special_plot_6_1_1_3: What do you think? Isn’t this white horse a dashing little prince?
t11_idle_game_special_plot_6_1_1_4: I discovered it in the forest nearby, and I’m hoping to keep it at our base, if that’s alright with you.
t11_idle_game_special_plot_6_1_2_1: Really appreciate you going along with this.
t11_idle_game_special_plot_6_1_2_2: I just hope Timothy can make it through this apocalypse. It's tougher than it looks!
t11_idle_game_special_plot_6_2_1_1: Commander, I need your help! A stray shot hit the stable’s fence, and Timothy was right next to it!
t11_idle_game_special_plot_6_2_1_2: It panicked, and I’m afraid it’s already run out of the base.
t11_idle_game_special_plot_6_2_1_3: If you can send troops to clear out the zombies nearby, I’ll definitely be able to find it!
t11_idle_game_special_plot_6_2_2_2: You know, I really can’t lose Timothy again.
t11_idle_game_special_plot_6_3_1_1: Commander, you couldn’t have arrived at a better moment. There’s something I’d like to share with you…
t11_idle_game_special_plot_6_3_1_2: You may not know, but I grew up on a horse ranch and have always had a special bond with horses. But Timothy is special.
t11_idle_game_special_plot_6_3_1_3: That's actually my brother's name. He was so adorable, and looked like a little prince with his shiny blonde hair.
t11_idle_game_special_plot_6_3_1_4: The war tore us apart… Timothy is my only hope, and I joined the army to find him.
t11_idle_game_special_plot_6_3_2_1: I'm glad you're hearing me out.
t11_idle_game_special_plot_6_3_2_2: If it weren’t for you, I might have lost all hope long ago.
t11_idle_game_special_plot_6_4_1_1: Commander, do you remember when I talked about my brother?
t11_idle_game_special_plot_6_4_1_2: I’ve been feeling that my strength isn’t improving lately. I’d really appreciate your guidance in training.
t11_idle_game_special_plot_6_4_1_3: Help me become stronger, and I will vanquish our enemies!
t11_idle_game_special_plot_6_4_2_1: I can feel my strength reaching new heights! All because of you, Commander!

t11_idle_game_special_plot_5_5_1_2: The simulation results show that the new weapon isn’t powerful enough against zombies.
t11_idle_game_special_plot_4_1_1_1: Only by growing stronger can we defeat even more enemies!
t11_idle_game_special_plot_4_1_1_2: Commander, your choice to dispatch units for training in the Restricted Area shows real courage.
t11_idle_game_special_plot_4_1_1_3: Here, some gifts for you. I hope they’ll be useful as you grow in strength.
t11_idle_game_special_plot_4_1_2_1: Gifts delivered! I’m eager to see how much stronger you’ll become.
t11_idle_game_special_plot_4_2_1_1: The Doom Legion has become increasingly active these days.
t11_idle_game_special_plot_4_2_1_2: I think we should take the initiative and teach them a lesson!
t11_idle_game_special_plot_4_2_1_3: Now’s the time, Commander. Show us what you’re made of!
t11_idle_game_special_plot_4_2_2_1: The enemies don’t stand a chance against you! Your strength is impressive! I’m almost itching to test my skills against you!
t11_idle_game_special_plot_4_3_1_1: Commander, my weapon’s power isn’t enough right now and needs an upgrade.
t11_idle_game_special_plot_4_3_1_2: But we’re running low on materials.

t11_idle_game_special_plot_4_4_1_1: This battle is so boring! Since when did the Doom Legion start relying only on swarm tactics?
t11_idle_game_special_plot_4_4_1_2: But I have to admit, all these zombies are definitely slowing down our attack.
t11_idle_game_special_plot_4_4_1_3: Commander, come lend me a hand!
t11_idle_game_special_plot_4_4_2_1: Impressive battle! You made it look effortless!

S1_alliance_photo_help_1: The shadows of the Rainy Mistlands will one day fade, but the battles you and your alliance fought shall forever be etched into this land of Crimson Plague. Event Rules 1. The event becomes available once season alliance rewards are distributed. 2. During the event, you can take group photos and leave messages via the event menu or inside the Season Memorial Hall. 3. After the event ends, group photos and messages will be locked and cannot be edited, but they remain viewable in the Season Memorial Hall for future remembrance. Alliance Binding 1. Commanders may only participate in group photos and messaging with the alliance they were in when Season Alliance Rewards were issued. If you leave that alliance, you can only view but not edit. 2. If you rejoin the same reward-eligible alliance during the event, you may continue editing your group photo and messages. Group Photo Settings 1. Avatar Placement: Drag avatars to adjust their positions. Avatars cannot overlap. 2. Frame Rewards: Based on alliance rankings across the 8 warzones: 1st place unlocks all frames, 2nd–20th place unlocks [Mistlands Elite], and all other alliances unlock [Mistlands Blessing]. 3. Avatar Size: Avatar sizes vary depending on reward tiers. Commanders who receive the Alliance Leader Reward, Tactician Reward, or Core Reward will have slightly larger avatars than others. Additional Notes 1. If a player was not in an alliance at the time of season settlement, or if their alliance did not qualify for rewards, they cannot participate in group photos or messaging. 2. If an alliance is disbanded, previously generated group photos and messages will still be viewable in the Memorial Hall but can no longer be edited. 3. If multiple seasonal group photos are accumulated, they can be revisited via the Memorial Hall’s history list. 4. Commanders must first agree to the Player Guidelines before joining the event. May the mark of you and your Alliance's battles echo through the ages!
t11_idle_game_special_plot_5_5_1_3: If you can provide a few more items, I might be able to channel more energy into the weapon.
t11_idle_game_special_plot_5_5_2_1: Thanks for your generosity. I’ll start the research right away.

season3_camp_desc001: After Scarlett left to track down her family's enemies, she formed the treasure hunting group known as the [Scarlet Raiders]. Following her departure, Vice Captain Jones took command and renamed it [Scarlet Legion]. Since then, the legion has roamed the world, uncovering treasures long-lost to time.
season3_camp_desc002: They call themselves the [Golden Tribe], descendants of the ancient Golden Realm who have protected this Land for generations. The [Golden Tribe] are masters of ancient combat techniques that passed down through the ages. Though devoted to peace, they stood unyielding. For thousands of years, no foe has ever set foot upon this land.
season4_camp_desc001: [Kage no Sato] was founded by the Kageyama family and has endured for centuries. After the Oni General's fall, the terrifying oni virus was sealed within the secret chambers of [Kage no Sato]. But fate played a cruel trick—Ryūran was accidentally infected. Since then, the ninjas of [Kage no Sato] have rushed to the Battlefield, seeking a way to purge the virus.
season4_camp_desc002: After the Oni General's fall, the "oni" infected by the virus lost their leader and scattered across the land. To restore peace, the Kamiizumi family formed the [Koubutai], eliminating all demons and bringing peace back to the Sakura Isle. Now, as the virus spreads once again, the [Koubutai] has regrouped their forces to fight, ready to eliminate the source of the Infection, once and for all.

season3_camp_desc01:
Hey, Commander. It's Jones here. You might remember me as part of the Scarlet Legion, that "poor group" dumped by Scarlett. Every day, I'm clashing with that so-called Golden Tribe. But honestly, my day job? I'm an archaeologist. Just call me Professor Jones.

Now, let's talk treasure. There's so much out there just waiting to be unearthed. I need you for the job. Grab your archaeologist hammer, head to the vaults, and uncover relics long forgotten. There's plenty to gain! If you can't find a vault, a compass will show you the way.
Good luck, Commander. Let's make history!
t11_idle_game_special_plot_5_7_1_2: In Justice Vanguard, no one knows zombie weaknesses better than she does.
t11_idle_game_special_plot_5_7_1_3: Once Violet reaches the necessary qualifications, I’m sure she’ll be willing to assist me.

t11_idle_game_special_plot_5_8_1_1: Uh… although the experiment made some progress, I think we should wrap it up.
t11_idle_game_special_plot_5_8_1_2: Don’t get me wrong, I mean… working with Violet, you know, I’m not exactly good at dealing with someone that… energetic.
t11_idle_game_special_plot_5_8_2_1: The experiment has reached its final stage. I’ll keep you updated on the latest progress.
t11_idle_game_special_plot_5_9_1_1: Commander, everything is ready, but I know we’re still one step away from success.
t11_idle_game_special_plot_5_9_1_2: I cannot take this crucial step alone. It isn’t just research, but a clash deep within the soul.
t11_idle_game_special_plot_5_9_1_3: That’s right, I require the aid of my “old” partner. Once Stetmann meets the required qualifications, I’m sure he’ll come to help me.
t11_idle_game_special_plot_5_9_2_2: Don’t mention that name. Without me, you can’t accomplish anything!
t11_idle_game_special_plot_5_9_2_3: Alright, Stetmann, but don’t forget—this is my project. You’re here to support me...
t11_idle_game_special_plot_5_9_2_4: What are you rambling about? Tesla, don’t keep the Commander waiting!
t11_idle_game_special_plot_5_10_1_1: Commander, the experiment has finally yielded results. I believe the new electromagnetic bullets will soon be ready for deployment.
t11_idle_game_special_plot_5_10_1_3: Old partner, you only joined at the very end.
t11_idle_game_special_plot_5_10_1_4: Tesla, this is the difference between a genius and an apprentice
t11_idle_game_special_plot_5_10_2_1: Apologies, Commander, for letting you see that.
t11_idle_game_special_plot_5_10_2_2: I’ll find a way to handle… the relationships between colleagues.
t11_idle_game_special_plot_5_10_2_3: Thank you for your ongoing support!
t11_idle_game_special_plot_6_5_1_1: Sigh... I had an aerial race with Morrison today. I lost miserably.
t11_idle_game_special_plot_6_5_1_2: That guy looks cold and ruthless on the surface, but he’s really cunning behind the scenes! I can only blame my limited experience in real-world combat.
t11_idle_game_special_plot_6_5_1_3: Oh, if Schuyler can teach me some tactics, I’ll definitely become stronger!
t11_idle_game_special_plot_6_5_1_4: Commander, once Schuyler reaches the necessary qualifications, I believe she will gladly help me.
t11_idle_game_special_plot_6_5_2_1: Instructor Schuyler, I’m so glad you are here! I can't wait to start my lesson!
t11_idle_game_special_plot_6_5_2_2: DVA, I think you’ve misunderstood… I’m not just here to teach you what's in the textbooks. I hope you can handle what's ahead.
t11_idle_game_special_plot_6_6_1_1: Instructor Schuyler is merciless… I really walked straight into this!
t11_idle_game_special_plot_6_6_1_2: I’ve come to realize your struggles—the battlefield is unpredictable, and strengths and skills are far from enough.
t11_idle_game_special_plot_6_6_1_3: My father used to remind me of these things all the time. Commander, I want to offer flowers in his memory. There’s so much I wish I could tell him.
t11_idle_game_special_plot_6_6_2_1: Thanks! I’ll tell my family about you too. They’ll be proud of me.
t11_idle_game_special_plot_6_7_1_1: Commander, remember Timothy? Uh… I mean the white horse. It’s grown fast and can now gallop across the fields!
t11_idle_game_special_plot_6_7_1_2: I once showed it a photo of my brother without thinking, and it seemed a bit excited. I can’t imagine it actually knows him… Ah! What a strange coincidence. Could it really know him? What are the odds...
t11_idle_game_special_plot_6_7_2_1: Thank you for hearing me out. I’ll continue looking after Timothy and turn it into a sturdy steed!
t11_idle_game_special_plot_6_8_1_1: Commander! Last time, Timothy recognized my brother’s photo—it really wasn’t a coincidence.
t11_idle_game_special_plot_6_8_1_2: Maybe my brother took care of it just like I did.
t11_idle_game_special_plot_6_8_1_3: It looks like Timothy wants to take me somewhere. Could you help clear the obstacles nearby?
t11_idle_game_special_plot_6_8_2_1: Commander, I didn't find my brother yet, but I came across some marching tracks.
t11_idle_game_special_plot_6_8_2_2: Those seem to be tracks left by the Doom Legion. I’ll continue the search with Timothy.
t11_idle_game_special_plot_6_9_1_1: Commander! Timothy and I found the Doom Legion’s stronghold. It’s so well concealed that our radar didn’t detect it.
t11_idle_game_special_plot_6_9_1_2: If we don’t act, they'll pose a serious threat to our Base. Just give us the order to purge them, Commander!
t11_idle_game_special_plot_6_9_2_1: They appear to have been lurking here for quite a while. I'll check the supplies they left behind for some clues.
t11_idle_game_special_plot_6_10_1_1: Commander, among the supplies from the last Doom Legion purge, I found a pair of riding boots.
t11_idle_game_special_plot_6_10_1_2: Those were my brother’s personal belongings, with his name engraved on it. Now I know why Timothy wanted to take us there.
t11_idle_game_special_plot_6_10_1_3: Trust me, my brother would never join the Doom Legion. We have to find him!
t11_idle_game_special_plot_6_10_2_1: Commander, as long as you’re with me, I won’t give up hope no matter how long it takes!
t11_idle_game_special_plot_4_5_1_1: Thank you so much for your incredible performance in the battle. It really sped up our victory against the enemies!
t11_idle_game_special_plot_4_5_1_2: The Doom Legion has committed far too many atrocities. I will never forget the impact on those close to me and on the world.
t11_idle_game_special_plot_4_5_1_3: All I can think of right now is one mission: to crush the Doom Legion once and for all, and bring laughter and joy back to this world!
t11_idle_game_special_plot_4_5_2_1: Thank you for letting me share all of this with you.
t11_idle_game_special_plot_4_5_2_2: Can't wait to bring down the Doom Legion!
t11_idle_game_special_plot_4_6_1_1: Thanks to our recent efforts, most of the nearby enemies have been dealt with.
t11_idle_game_special_plot_4_6_1_2: Finally, a bit of free time, just right for giving my weapons some care.
t11_idle_game_special_plot_4_6_1_3: Commander, care to take a look at my gears and share your thoughts on how I can improve further?
t11_idle_game_special_plot_4_6_2_1: Excellent advice! I can already feel my power improving!
t11_idle_game_special_plot_4_7_1_1: Commander, we've got intel suggesting that the Doom Legion is gathering its forces.
t11_idle_game_special_plot_4_7_1_2: Looks like a fierce battle is upon us.
t11_idle_game_special_plot_4_7_1_3: Commander, stay sharp. We've got some time left. Let's upgrade our weapons and gears to get ready for the battle ahead!
t11_idle_game_special_plot_4_7_2_1: Impressive, Commander! You’re even more powerful now!
t11_idle_game_special_plot_4_7_2_2: Can’t wait to see you on the battlefield again!
t11_idle_game_special_plot_4_8_1_1: The strength of our units is also crucial to victory.
t11_idle_game_special_plot_4_8_1_2: Have your units continue their training in the Restricted Area!
t11_idle_game_special_plot_4_8_1_3: The Restricted Area is full of danger; only those with great strength can venture in.
t11_idle_game_special_plot_4_8_1_4: Where there’s risk, there’s reward. You can significantly boost your strength in the Restricted Area!
t11_idle_game_special_plot_4_8_2_2: The battle’s approaching. I must get ready!
t11_idle_game_special_plot_4_9_1_1: The Doom Legion is extremely well-prepared this time. They aren't just numerous, but incredibly powerful.
t11_idle_game_special_plot_4_9_1_2: If we stick to this tactic, we risk being overwhelmed by the enemy!
t11_idle_game_special_plot_4_9_1_3: I’ve got a plan, Commander. You’re the strongest, so perhaps you can take down the enemy boss?
t11_idle_game_special_plot_4_9_1_4: Without a boss leading them, they will crumble in no time!
t11_idle_game_special_plot_4_9_2_2: We'll handle the rest of the enemies!
t11_idle_game_special_plot_4_10_1_1: It was all thanks to you that we managed to repel the enemies in the last battle.
t11_idle_game_special_plot_4_10_1_3: Your strength is truly inspiring! I’d better work hard to improve, or I’ll never catch up to you!
t11_idle_game_special_plot_4_10_2_1: I look forward to fighting alongside you again, crushing the Doom Legion, and bringing peace back to this world!

Treasure_map_76:
New Compass Chest Event!
1. Each time you dig for treasure, there’s a chance to obtain a Compass. Collect enough Compasses to unlock more chests.
2. Every Monday at 00:00 server time, Compass Chest progress will reset. Any unclaimed chests will be sent via mail.
3. Once Compass Chest progress is full, excess Compasses will be converted into Mystery Supply Boxes at a rate of 50 Compasses = 1 Box (amounts under 50 are still calculated as 50). Converted Mystery Supply Boxes will be delivered by mail.

Hidden Treasure Details: 
1. Complete secret tasks of SSR or higher rarity to earn random treasure map fragments. Successfully, and perfectly, completing these tasks may yield extra fragments.
2. There are seven types of treasure map fragments required for treasure digs. You need one of each to proceed with an excavation. If you're short on any fragment, the dig can't happen.
3. Exchange fragments with your allies. Starting an exchange will temporarily remove your offered fragment. If the exchange goes through, you'll get the fragment you wanted. If you decide to cancel, you'll get your fragment back. Only one active exchange allowed at a time.
4. Drop Rates for obtaining treasure map fragments from secret tasks: Each of the seven fragments has a 14.28% drop rate.
5. Perfectly complete SSR tasks for a 5% chance to win an extra treasure map fragment. Perfectly complete UR tasks for a 15% chance to get an extra fragment.
6. There is a guaranteed chance to find a UR chest after digging 15 times. If you don't get a UR chest in 15 tries, the 16th attempt will guarantee one. After finding a UR chest, the counter resets.

dsb_duel_rules_1002:
1. Four Alliances are matched into the same Battlefield, fighting for control of the Nuclear Silo.
2. Battles will occur uniformly every Friday at Server Time 12:00, and all Alliances may be enemies.
3. Alliances that control Buildings will earn a large number of [Battlefield Points], and the side with the highest total points will claim Victory.
4. On the Battlefield, your units are protected by a mysterious power and <color=#DC143C>will not die</color>. After each Battle, all severely wounded units will automatically recover for Free.
5. During Battle, Commanders will receive <color=#DC143C>1 Free Teleport opportunity</color> at fixed intervals.
6. Each Alliance Task Force must Dispatch at least <color=#DC143C>1 Commander</color> to be eligible for matching.
dsb_duel_rules_1003:
1. Selecting Participants
Only Alliances that have successfully registered for the Desert Brawl event can select participants.
Alliance R4s or R5s must decide on the participants and substitutes during the registration stage.
Each Alliance can assign up to 20 participants and 10 substitutes, with participants getting priority battlefield access.

2. Entering the Battlefield
Players must meet 3 requirements to enter the battlefield:
A. Be a participant or a substitute for this battle.
B. Belong to a registered Alliance.
C. Their bases should not be on the Contaminated Land near the Capitol.

3. Battle Stages
Preparation Stage: Participants from both sides can enter the battlefield's safe zone. Your side will be marked in blue, the enemy in different colors for distinction. You can't be attacked in the safe zone.
Stage 1: Capture Oil Refineries, Science Centers, Info Centers, and Field Hospitals to earn [Battlefield Points].
Stage 2: Capture the Nuclear Silo and Serum Factory to gain [Battlefield Points].
Stage 3: Oil Wells will appear randomly on the map. Harvest them to get [Battlefield Points].

At settlement, Alliances will be ranked based on the total [Battlefield Points] they earned in the battlefield. Commanders with different rankings will receive different rewards.

Note: Captured buildings generate [Battlefield Points] that will exceed their storage capacity after a period of time. Capture these buildings to collect the [Battlefield Points].
dsb_duel_rules_1013:
1. You'll get 1 free teleport opportunity every 2 minutes. Using it triggers a cooldown, and teleporting is suspended during cooldown. 
2. Units <color=#DC143C>won't die</color> in this battle. Instead, they are sent to the Hospital with unlimited capacity. All severely wounded units will fully recover after the battle. 
3. Commanders who leave the battlefield forcibly cannot re-enter. Temporary exits have no wait time. 
4. When you enter the battlefield, your highest-level units automatically fill the separate Drill Ground. They won't show up in your base's Drill Ground and won't leave the battlefield after the fight. 
5. All boosts from Tech, VIP Level, Base Skins, Titles, Decorations, and Drones work in battle.
dsb_duel_rules_1014:
1. Killing enemy units in battles grants a large number of [Individual Points], but no [Battlefield Points]. The higher the level of the enemy unit, the more points you earn.
2. While garrisoning a building, you gain 30 Individual Points per second.
3. While gathering at an Oil Well, you gain 3 Individual Points per second.
4. Picking up a Points Supply Box grants an equal number of Individual Points!

decoration_desc16064:
Pirate King – My Story 
I started this journey alone 
no map, no crew, no idea of the power hidden inside me, 
Just a dream, a broken ship, and a storm ready to tear it all apart. 
I was dragged into the sea’s depths drowned, wrecked, forgotten. 
That should’ve been the end. 
But deep in the silence of the ocean, I realized something: 
I couldn’t die yet, not until I rose, not until I claimed it all. 
From there, a mysterious bubble pulled me out of the ocean, 
unlocking the power inside me. 
I rose. 
I faced every challenge, pulled myself from the depths again and again. 
I gave myself a reason to rise, a reason to fight. 
When the sea came for me again, I didn’t flinch. 
I unleashed everything my strength, my will, my power. 
I didn’t just survive. I rose. 
Now I sail to face every storm, every battle 
and claim victory. 
Because I’m not just a pirate. 
I Am The Pirate King.
