Basic Rules:

1. There are three Battlefields in the Honorable Campaign, and rewards can be obtained by completing the challenges in each battlefield.
2. The battlefields include "Iron Formation" (Recommended for Tank Heroes), "Sky Policy" (Recommended for Aircraft Heroes), and "Missile Frontline" (Recommended for Missile Vehicle Heroes). You can select the battlefield by clicking the arrows on the left and right sides of the screen.
3. Challenge progress resets at 00:00 server time every Sunday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Each challenge period lasts 2 days.
4. Before the progress is reset, only one level can be selected in each battlefield, and once chosen, it cannot be changed.
5. After completing the selected level for the first time, you can immediately challenge the next one. Up to 4 levels can be challenged in each cycle.
6. Each hero can only participate in one battlefield challenge per cycle. Please assign your elite forces wisely.
7. Heroes below Level 100 may have a chance for a Super Upgrade in the campaign, directly advancing 1 level for free, but it cannot exceed the current Level Cap of the hero.
8. Campaign Medals earned can be exchanged for items in the Campaign Store.

season_coffee_function_rules:
Studies have shown that the specially brewed coffee contains caffeine that can boost Virus Resistance against the zombies. 

1. Drinking coffee increases Virus Resistance and grants a corresponding buff based on the type of coffee chosen. All buffs last for 8 hours.
2. Coffee is produced periodically, up to a maximum of 3 cups. Drinking a new cup will overwrite the previous buff.

season5_comic_1: The Golden Wasteland, the Land of Liberty’s western frontier, is facing a grave crisis.
season5_comic_2: Though remote, this land is rich in CrystalGold. Countless prospectors flocked here, giving rise to a vast commercial empire.
season5_comic_3: At the peak of the empire stands King Spade and his gang, seizing control of everything through wealth and violence.
season5_comic_4: Where there is control, there is resistance — and so, brave rebels have issued a bounty on King Spade.
season5_comic_5: Despite his overwhelming power, King Spade will not let any rebel go unpunished.
season5_comic_6: His gang surrounded the police station, and with a single shot from their leader — Quinn — a fierce battle began.
season5_comic_7: Under overwhelming firepower, the forces of justice began to falter. Yet, at the critical moment —
season5_comic_8: A galloping steed broke through the bandit ranks, wreaking havoc — it was Venom, coming as the Commander’s vanguard to provide support.
season5_comic_9: Under the blazing sun, a duel was about to erupt, and Venom struck Quinn with lightning speed.
season5_comic_10: All of this fell under the watchful eyes of King Spade in the distance, who appeared unfazed.
season5_comic_11: By his side stood a familiar face. Then King Spade whispered, “Now, it’s your turn.”
season5_comic_12: Quinn and her gang of thugs staggered to their feet — risen again as the undead.
season5_comic_13: We saw this coming — once again, the battle against the virus is upon us!
season_s5_plot_915501: Venom, we just received a holographic message from King Spade. That notorious mine lord specifically wants you to take it.
season_s5_plot_915502: We were once partners… back when he was a respected sheriff. Now he’s a tyrant, ruling the Golden Wasteland with fists and gunpowder.
season_s5_plot_915503: What a complete turnaround. Let’s see what tricks he has up his sleeve.
season_s5_plot_915504: Venom, my old partner! I’ve heard your "Commander" is quite extraordinary, quelling virus crises across the world. Hmm… I can’t wait to meet this hero.
season_s5_plot_915505: With this letter comes an invitation to the Golden Wasteland. Tell that “Commander” to come to my CrystalGold mine and enjoy the little “show” I’ve prepared. I’ll make sure to welcome him myself!
season_s5_plot_915506: Damn… this is a trap! By the look of him, he’s almost certainly infected. I can’t let the Commander take that risk — I’ll go deal with him.
season_s5_plot_915601: That King Spade… he’s no longer just a mine lord. He’s mastered virus technology, and his methods are far more extreme and potent than Nier’s.
season_s5_plot_915602: Those poor souls… even in death they find no peace, forced by him to become zombies serving his will.
season_s5_plot_915603: In this wasteland, CrystalGold is all that matters. Wealth, power, status, even the workings of society all revolve around its mining, trade, and use. Whoever controls CrystalGold controls the fate of the wasteland.
season_s5_plot_915604: Commander, now is the time to act. To defeat King Spade, we must seize control of CrystalGold and dismantle his commercial empire. Only then can the wasteland be free again.

zone_selection_location_desc:
1. There are 8 exclusive Spawn Areas around the center of the map, corresponding to the 8 Warzones.
2. Each Spawn Area belongs to a single Warzone and cannot be invaded by other Warzones.
3. Presidents of each Warzone may select their Spawn Area from the available options. There is a 12-hour cooldown after each selection.
4. The selection order for Warzone locations is determined by the [Gold Prospecting Ranking], higher-ranking Warzones choose first.
5. Higher-ranking Warzones may actively swap Spawn Areas with lower-ranking Warzones.
6. Once the results stage ends, all selections are final and cannot be changed.
7. Results calculation: Warzone Result = the total steps of the top 100 Commanders. If a Warzone has fewer than 100 participants, it does not count toward the results. Ties are resolved as follows: Commanders with equal steps → shorter total time ranks higher. If Warzone total steps are tied → the Warzone with the shorter total time ranks higher.
zone_selection_location_game_desc:
Rules: 
1. After the event begins, you will receive 3 challenge attempts per day. Commanders can enter stages to mine gold.
2. When a full row or column of blocks is filled, the blocks will be cleared.
3. Some blocks contain gems. When these blocks are cleared, you'll obtain the gems inside. Collect the required number of gems to clear the stage.

Warzone Result: 
1. A Warzone's score is the total score of its top 100 Commanders. If fewer than 100 Commanders participate, that Warzone will not be ranked and cannot join in area selection.
2. Higher-ranked Warzones can actively replace the spawn areas of lower-ranked Warzones.
3. If multiple Commanders take the same number of steps, the ones with less time spent will rank higher.
4. If multiple Warzones take the same number of steps, the ones with less time spent will rank higher.
5. From Tuesday to Saturday is the [Area Selection Stage], during which positions can be chosen. After Saturday, positions are locked. Sunday is the [Results Stage], during which no changes can be made before the season starts.
6. After the season begins, all Warzone Commanders will spawn within their selected areas.

s5_alliance_battle_time_ui17:
Battle-Ready Time is a key rule this season, affecting all PvP battles for [Cities] and [Banks] during the season.
1. There are three fixed Battle-Ready Time periods each day, each lasting 1 hour.
2. Declarations of war and attacks on captured [Cities] or [Banks] are only allowed during Battle-Ready Time.
3. Battle-Ready Time Rule acts as a complement to protection time, effective when cities and strongholds are outside their protected periods.
4. When an Alliance sets a Safe Time period, members can rest for 15 consecutive hours without worrying about losing Cities or Banks.
5. During its own Safe Time, an Alliance is not prohibited from declaring war or attacking other Alliances’ Cities or Banks.

season_s5_manual_desc1:
In the Golden Wasteland of the Land of Liberty, wealth and violence collide. Driven by Nier’s provocation, Mine Lord King Spade has set his sights on us, sending the Commander a deadly invitation. 
The Wasteland shall burn once more — a fierce battle for CrystalGold is coming, and the fate of this land will be reshaped forever.
season_s5_manual_desc2: CrystalGold is a rare resource of the Golden Wasteland, used to purchase items in the CrystalGold Shop. Throughout this season, various events will yield CrystalGold, and Commanders will compete to become the ultimate CrystalGold Tycoon.
season_s5_manual_desc3: Forge a flourishing Western Town this season, unlocking exclusive season boosts from its buildings. At the end of the season, resources will turn into Profession EXP, and season buildings will be dismantled.
season_s5_manual_desc4: Season resource used to construct the season building [Caffeine Institute], helping Commanders boost Virus Resistance. Unused Coffee will be converted into Profession EXP at the end of the season.
season_s5_manual_desc5: Season resource used to construct the season building [Coffee Factory], helping Commanders boost Coffee Output. Unused Coffee Beans will be converted into Profession EXP at the end of the season.
season_s5_manual_desc6: Season building used for providing [Virus Resistance]. Can be leveled up by using [Coffee]. Also enables the making of [Special Coffee]. This building will be dismantled after the season ends.
season_s5_manual_desc7: Season building used for increasing [Coffee]'s output. Can be leveled up using [Coffee Beans]. The building will be dismantled after the season ends.
season_s5_manual_desc8: Crafted through the season building [Caffeine Institute], Coffee not only grants Virus Resistance, some can also provide additional buffs.
season_s5_manual_desc9: A magic building obtained from the [Golden Realm], which can once again awaken the [Desert Protector] to fight for the Commander!
season_s5_manual_desc10: This season, Commanders from eight warzones will clash on the same map. Seize high-level Cities to earn Influence Points and fight to raise your Alliance’s rankings!
season_s5_manual_desc11: Alliances must first capture a Lv. 1 Bank Stronghold to claim their initial territory, which then serves as the foundation for expansion. Securing a Bank Stronghold is a prerequisite for launching attacks against Cities.
season_s5_manual_desc12: Capturing a City grants a large number of Influence Points, while also increasing your Alliance’s Bank capture limit.
season_s5_manual_desc13: All strongholds in this season are Banks. Capture, plunder, and deposit to keep your CrystalGold flowing!
season_s5_manual_desc14: After capturing a Bank, Alliance members can plunder its CrystalGold within the limited time window.
season_s5_manual_desc15: After capturing a Bank, you can deposit CrystalGold and earn interest based on deposit time. Higher-level Banks allow larger deposits.
season_s5_manual_desc16: The order of the West rests on your bullets. Aim, fire, and eliminate every enemy within meticulously designed stages using limited ammo.
season_s5_manual_desc17: The trade train [Fortune] travels across the Golden Wasteland, carrying cargos that spark envy in everyone.
season_s5_manual_desc18: Commanders can sell their Whiskey through the [Fortune] to earn CrystalGold.
season_s5_manual_desc19: Commanders can attack others aboard the [Fortune] to plunder the Whiskey they have consigned.
season_s5_manual_desc20: Venom returns to the West, avenging his family, fighting for freedom, and ultimately transforming himself.
season_s5_manual_desc21: Aim, shoot, and hit your mark. Compete with other Commanders to prove who is the Wild West's deadliest gunslinger.
season_s5_manual_desc22: For years, King Spade held trade in his grip. The Commander’s arrival sparked hope for reopening the trade routes, but riches always breed conflicts, and now a new war has begun…
season_s5_manual_desc23: Trade Posts are only open on Tuesdays this season, with four levels of Trade Post available each day.
season_s5_manual_desc24: Repair and capture the Warzone Outpost to support other Alliances in the Warzone.
season_s5_manual_desc25: The Warzone Outpost starts in a damaged state and must be repaired through the combined efforts of all Commanders in the Warzone.
season_s5_manual_desc26: The Warzone Outpost can only be captured after it is fully repaired. Capturing it grants all Alliances in the Warzone territory connection and Influence Points.
season_s5_manual_desc27: Capturing the Warzone Outpost grants additional official positions that can be appointed to Commanders across all Warzones.
season_s5_manual_desc28: Capture the Golden Palace, and rule the Golden Wasteland.
season_s5_manual_desc29: Capturing the Golden Palace grants massive Influence Points, helping your Alliance climb and secure its Influence Points ranking.
season_s5_manual_desc30: Capturing the Golden Palace grants additional official positions that can be appointed to Commanders across all Warzones.
season_s5_pre_desc08:
This season, Commanders will venture into a brand-new region: the Golden Wasteland.
A vast region where Commanders from eight Warzones will clash on the same map for control of the Golden Palace in the Central Area!
season_s5_pre_desc09: The [Warzone Outpost] stands in the Central Area of the Golden Wasteland. Once repaired, all Alliances in the Warzone can use the [Warzone Outpost] as Alliance territory to push further into the Central Area.
season_s5_pre_desc10:
Across the Golden Wasteland, trade trains will travel through various Warzones, selling goods at the right moment can yield great profits.
Bank Strongholds are scattered across the Wasteland. Invest wisely, and may fortune favor you in your daring ventures!
season_s5_pre_desc11: Hero Promotion, Exclusive Weapon arrives! Brand-new Exclusive Weapon has arrived as promised! Venom also earns a promotion in his homeland!
season_s5_pre_desc12: In the Golden Wasteland, Cities can only be declared for war on Wednesdays and Saturdays. Each day has just three time slots for capturing Strongholds or declaring war on Cities. Alliance leaders may select a [Safe Time] to protect themselves from enemy attacks.
season_s5_pre_desc13: New [Season Challenge] goals have been added. Completing them grants extra rewards! Season settlement reward conditions are more diverse, offering more ways to earn rewards. There’s always one that suits you!
season_s5_pre_desc14: The Great Gold Rush of the West — who’ll strike gold and become the ultimate tycoon? Join the new season: Wild West, and carve your legend!

activity_desc_1200054:
In the upcoming Season, Alliances from 8 Warzones will contest the same land, capturing Cities and Strongholds as they push toward the Golden Wasteland's ultimate palace.
Due to participating Alliances spanning different time zones, constant battles on the map would quickly wear everyone down. To prevent endless 24-hour attacks and defenses over Cities and Strongholds, the upcoming Season introduces the [Battle-Ready Time] and [Alliance Safe Time] Rules — designed to let Alliances active in different time zones fight in a more controlled, measured way.

[Battle-Ready Time]
1. On each calendar day, you can no longer Declare War on or attack Cities and Strongholds at any time. These actions are only permitted during three designated [Battle-Ready Time] periods. (Available from: Alliance — Settings — Alliance Safe Time.)
2. Each [Battle-Ready Time] lasts 1 hour and the intervals between them are 7 hours. All contesting of Cities and Strongholds will occur within those three [Battle-Ready Time] hours (a total of 3 hours per day).
3. For Cities specifically, declaring war requires both the [Battle-Ready Time] condition and that the day be a War Declaration Day (Wednesdays and Saturdays).

[Alliance Safe Time]
1. Fighting across three [Battle-Ready Time] slots each day can still be intense and exhausting, so the Alliance Safe Time rule is introduced to give members relief.
2. Each Alliance may choose to disable one [Battle-Ready Time]; the disabled slot becomes that Alliance's [Safe Time], meaning the Alliance only needs to defend two [Battle-Ready Time] slots per day.
3. Because [Battle-Ready Time] slots are 7 hours apart, disabling one slot increases an Alliance's continuous rest window from 7 hours to 15 hours.
4. Even if every Alliance sets its own Safe Time, any two Alliances' active periods will still overlap for at least one [Battle-Ready Time].
5. Alliance A's Safe Time prevents attackers (Alliance B) from initiating attacks on Alliance A during that Safe Time, but it does not stop Alliance A from launching attacks during its own Safe Time against other Alliances that are not in their Safe Time.

The Safe Time Rules are quite straightforward in practice: Alliance admins should pick the Safe Time that best suits their members' rest needs.
Because changing an Alliance's Safe Time can greatly alter the map's balance, changes after the Season begins are strictly controlled — with a long cooldown, may only be made on Mondays, and take effect at 00:00:00 game time the following day.
Please change with caution. (During the warm-up/pre-season period, Safe Time changes are not subject to the above restrictions.)

season_s5_htp_info021:
The Alliance Expedition Assembly Point is an essential tool for admins to coordinate Cross-Warzone operations during the season.
1. Each Alliance can create only one Expedition Assembly Point.
2. The Expedition Assembly Point can only be placed in another Warzone, not within your own.
3. When Alliance members use [Alliance Teleporter], they can choose any Assembly Point, which effectively enables cross-server relocation.
season_s5_htp_021: During the season, Alliances are allowed to set up a second Assembly Point in another Warzone.
season_s5_htp_022: The original Assembly Point is purple by default, while the Cross-Warzone Assembly Points are blue by default.
season_s5_htp_023: When Alliance members use [Alliance Teleporter], they can choose any Assembly Point.
season_s5_htp_024: Admins can set one Assembly Point as the default for Assembly Invitations.
season_s5_htp_031: After capturing a Bank, Alliance members can plunder the CrystalGold stored inside. Each plunder grants 1000 CrystalGold.
season_s5_htp_032: Members may also deposit CrystalGold in the bank to earn high returns upon maturity!

season_s5_htp_info011:
The Wild West is a mega map consisting of 8 Warzones and the Golden Wasteland. As the season progresses, more regions will become accessible to Commanders:

1. In week 1, Commanders can relocate only within their Home Warzone.
2. Starting from week 3, Commanders can use "Advanced Teleporter" to move to any of the other 7 Warzones.
3. In week 4, Commanders can use "Advanced Teleporter" to move into the Central Area.
4. Commanders can also move to other Warzones by creating an [Alliance Expedition Assembly Point] and relocating via "Alliance Teleporter".
5. Returning to your Home Warzone also requires "Advanced Teleporter" or "Alliance Teleporter".
6. During the season, most daily activities can be completed in any of the 9 Warzones, there's no need to return to your Home Warzone.
7. On War Day (Saturday), if your opponent during "Alliance Duel" belongs to the same Season Group as you, your Alliance must still use "Advanced Teleporter" to launch an Alliance Assault.
8. When your "Alliance Duel" opponent belongs to a different Season Group, you can use free Cross-Warzone Teleporter to go to their Warzone, and all 9 Warzones of that Season Group will be open for teleportation.
season_s5_htp_info031:
The Bank is a stronghold. It can only be captured once your territory is adjacent to it.
1. Banks are controlled by Gangs and serve as their money-laundering fronts. When an Alliance captures a Bank for the first time, its members can plunder the CrystalGold stored there by the Gang
2. After capturing a Bank, Alliance members can make deposits. Each Commander can hold only one active deposit per Bank
3. Each Commander can hold up to 15 active deposit slips from different Banks at the same time
4. Each Commander can make up to 3 deposits per day
5. When a Bank is captured by another Alliance, all CrystalGold stored inside may be plundered
6. When plundering another Alliance's Bank, only the principal can be taken, interest is not included
7. The Plunder Stage lasts for up to 1 hour, or until completely plundered. If there is still CrystalGold remaining when the countdown ends, a proportional refund of CrystalGold will be returned to the depositors
8. The admins of the Bank's owning Alliance can set the min deposit amount and decide the Bank's service range
9. By default, only Alliance members can deposit. However, admins can change it to allow any Commander within the same Season Group to make deposits
10. Making a deposit requires dispatching a Recon Plane, which can travel to any eligible Bank that meets the deposit conditions

activity_1200044_tips51:
1. You can consign “Whiskey” from your inventory to the Trade Train for sale. Each time the train arrives at a station, the consigned goods will be sold.
2. Each station has a sales limit for goods. As the number of goods sold increases, additional trade stations will become available, and the final number of goods sold cannot exceed (remaining stations × sale limit per-station).
3. If you consign goods while the train is between stations, the goods will only be loaded onto the train at the next stop.
4. Each station has a purchase limit. When the train arrives, it will buy goods in ascending order of sale price. Any goods left unsold after the station reaches its purchase limit will be returned via mail.
5. Consigning goods requires dispatching an Escort Team. The Escort Team will not recover HP after battles with train plunderers until the Escort Team is defeated.
6. Each time the train reaches a station, the Escort Team recovers a portion of their HP.
7. Each station serves as a hub city for the surrounding wasteland.
8. The number of goods that can be consigned each day is 100. Unsold goods do not count toward the daily consignment limit. Unused daily consignment capacity will accumulate, up to a maximum of 1,500.

season5_replace_activity_1000035_des04:
ABOUT THE EVENT:
1. After the event starts, the time consumed by the Alliance to capture the Bank Stronghold is recorded and ranked.
2. The higher the level of the Bank Stronghold captured by the Alliance, the higher the ranking. When the level of the Bank Stronghold captured is the same, the Alliance that captures faster ranks higher.
3. During the event, settlements are made daily. Rewards are based on the Alliance's ranking at the time of event settlement, the higher the ranking, the better the rewards. Ranking rewards are delivered via mail.
season5_replace_activity_1000037_des02:
ABOUT THE EVENT:
1. Once the territory is connected to the City (including diagonally), R5/R4 members of the Alliance can declare war on the City.
2. After the declaration, Cities can be captured. Only one City can be targeted by each Alliance at a time.
3. Without Bank Strongholds or Cities, an Alliance must first capture a Lv. 1 Bank Stronghold. Connected territories allow further declarations.
4. Troops will be affected by toxins during sieges. Please increase troop Virus Resistance to reduce impact.
5. Siege battles are risky, with a portion of units dying directly. The specific ratio is detailed on Cities.
6. There will be first-time City capture rewards for participants. Alliance members will also receive City rewards. Alliances receive Loot chests as well, distributed by R5 or R4.
7. After capturing a City, all Alliance members get buffs. The City enters a protected state for a period, during which it can't be declared war upon by others.
8. When a city is captured by another Alliance, it also enters a protection period. Abandoning a city does not reset the protection countdown.
9. After declaring war on a city you've abandoned, there's a waiting period.
10. The number of Bank Strongholds and Cities that can be captured each day is limited. The total number of Cities your Alliance can capture does not affect the total number of Bank Strongholds. You can view the exact limits in the [Alliance] -> [Alliance City] section.

visitor_plot_07: You can’t get far in the Golden Wasteland without CrystalGold.
visitor_plot_08: Yeah, we used the virus, so what? Out here, you do whatever it takes for power and profit. That’s the rule.
visitor_plot_09: We’ve found more illegal miners, this time to the east.
visitor_plot_10: You sure love stirring up trouble on other people’s turf. Our boss won’t hesitate to wipe you out.
visitor_plot_11: The Golden Wasteland is under King Spade's control. He tramples the law and the dignity of the poor at will.
visitor_plot_12: Let's play a little game. I’ve got two cards here, one stands for war, the other for wealth.
visitor_plot_13: Please, pick the one you think represents wealth.
visitor_plot_14: King Spade used to be a sheriff once. But greed got the better of him, made him sell his soul for gold.
visitor_plot_15: Venom still stands for justice. Though around here, justice is often the quickest way to die.
visitor_plot_16: The scientist supporting King Spade from the shadows is called Nier. He once formed a viral legion of his own.
visitor_plot_17: The boss invited you here only to eliminate you. His ambition goes far beyond the wasteland, he wants the whole world!
visitor_plot_18: You can never catch all the criminals in this world, and I’ll need your help again. This time we found this strange note —
visitor_plot_19: Face north, turn left three times, then turn right once. Tell me, what direction are you facing now?
visitor_plot_20: I was born in Coyote Town, a place where kids can’t even afford water, yet they all know King Spade's name like the back of their hands.
visitor_plot_21: I’ve seen more criminals than you can imagine. Everyone has their reasons, but they must be punished.
visitor_plot_22: This time, we built our mine near a certain spot.
visitor_plot_23: There are a lot of “towers” standing there. Guess where it is?
visitor_plot_24: McGregor is Venom’s brother. He joined the local gang a long time ago to protect his family.
visitor_plot_25: Later on, he was framed by King Spade. And that’s when the brothers finally got to know his true colors.
visitor_plot_26: The contest in the wasteland has begun. Load the whiskey on the train, deposit your CrystalGold in the bank. Do you have what it takes?
visitor_plot_27: It’s been a long time since I saw McGregor and Venom. It's delightful to see the brothers fighting under your banner.
visitor_plot_28: I like your new recruits, they've got some grit in ’em, and some foolishness too.
visitor_plot_29: We’ve caught a few gang leaders. One of them’s been running illegal mining deals.
visitor_plot_30: The culprit is the one in red, please help me identify him!
visitor_plot_31: You should try to do some business with the Trade Train. Who knows, you might just become rich overnight.
visitor_plot_32: King Spade uses the virus to create fear, bending people to his will.
visitor_plot_33: Another mine’s been opened, near a certain spot again.
visitor_plot_34: There are colorful flags flying there. Guess where it is?
visitor_plot_35: Every hunt could be my last, but I’ve got no choice.
visitor_plot_36: You deposited your CrystalGold in the bank? Good move. But don't forget, someone’s always watching.
visitor_plot_37: Justice may be delayed, but it always delivers. King Spade will pay for his greed.
visitor_plot_38: So, how high are you planning to price that whiskey? Ten times the usual? Or half? Nobody out here in the wasteland knows mercy.
visitor_plot_39: We’ve caught a few gang leaders. One of them’s been running illegal mining deals.
visitor_plot_40: The culprit is the one with the pointy hat, please help me identify him!
visitor_plot_41: The boss hates nothing more than someone meddling in his business. Just like you’re doing now.
visitor_plot_42: Doesn’t matter who the target is. Wanted-arrested-executed. Same process every time.
visitor_plot_43: Dr. Nier? He’s not helping King Spade for the money. Looks like he’s trying to “repay the favor” to you.
visitor_plot_44: Back at the police station, Venom used to serve under King Spade.
visitor_plot_45: Ever since he discovered his commander’s corruption, he quit in fury and became a bounty hunter.
visitor_plot_46: I was once a member of Coyote Town, too. Nearly got myself hung just for stealing some food.
visitor_plot_47: King Spade saved me. To repay him, I volunteered to be the first to take the virus, and I’ve never once regretted it!
visitor_plot_48: Reliable intel says a mine was built right next to the Doom Elite's lair to cover its tracks.
visitor_plot_49: To find it, we need to know what kind of creature the Doom Elite is. Any ideas?
visitor_plot_50: CrystalGold isn’t meant for saving. It’s a gambler’s currency.
visitor_plot_51: I met Venom back when I was a bounty hunter. His aim is deadly, the stuff of nightmares for any criminal.
visitor_plot_52: I like your training ground. It feels warm and welcoming...
visitor_plot_53: King Spade’s empire will fall, and him with it.
visitor_plot_54: Think beating King Spade will make life easier in the wasteland?
visitor_plot_55: So naive. Nothing runs without profit, the machines will stop working, as will this society.
visitor_plot_56: We will rebuild the Golden Wasteland, under the rule of law and justice.

season_s5_trade_desc01:
Trade Post
First opening: Starting from Tuesday 12:00 in Week 3 (server time)
Opening interval: 14 days
Contest duration: 1 hour
Troops stationed in the Trade Post will gradually increase capture progress over time.
Progress is tracked separately for you and your allies.
During the contest, the first commander to reach 100% progress wins the Trade Post.
If no commander reaches 100% by the end of the contest, the commander with the highest progress takes the Trade Post if it has no Governor.
If the Trade Post already has a Governor, the current Governor retains control if no one reaches 100% by the end of the contest.

war_zone_outpost_88:
Capturing buildings on the world map grants Influence Points
1. Capturing a City provides the Alliance with Influence Points based on the City’s level
2. When a Warzone Outpost is captured, all Alliances in the controlling Alliance’s Warzone gain Influence Points
3. Capturing a Golden Palace grants a large amount of Influence Points
4. Banks do not provide Influence Points
5. Note: Influence Points are tied to capture status, if a building is lost, the corresponding Influence Points are deducted accordingly
war_zone_outpost_90:
1. After a Warzone Outpost is repaired, it will automatically belong to the corresponding Warzone. In the fifth week after the season begins, the Warzone Outpost Conquest will be unlocked. Warzone Outposts can only change ownership through the Warzone Outpost Conquest. There will be a total of 3 Conquests during the season.
2. Once any Alliance connects to a Warzone Outpost, all members of that Warzone can participate in the attack and defense of Warzone Outposts, with no limit on the number of Warzone Outposts that can be attacked. Multiple Warzone Outposts can be attacked or defended in the same battle.
3. When capturing a Warzone Outpost, capture progress is accumulated among members of the same Warzone.
4. When capture progress is full, the corresponding Warzone will capture the Warzone Outpost, and the Alliance with the highest contribution will gain control of that Warzone Outpost.
5. At the end of battle, if no Warzone has fully filled the outpost capture progress, ownership remains unchanged.
6. During war days, Battle Points can be accumulated to claim chests. Points can be earned within the range of all Warzone Outposts. Each Warzone Outpost Battle Chest progress can only be claimed once per battle.
7. All Warzone Outposts share the same Kill Rankings, which only count points earned during Outpost battles.
8. Warzone Outposts grant Influence Points to all Alliances in the Warzone, and all Alliances can also use Warzone Outposts to connect to Cities.
war_zone_outpost_94: Outposts must be repaired to function, and each Warzone can only repair the outposts of its own Warzone.
war_zone_outpost_95: During repairs, all Commanders of the Warzone can contribute to repair progress
war_zone_outpost_96: After repairs are completed, the Alliance with the highest repair contribution will gain control of the Warzone Outpost
war_zone_outpost_97: Warzone Outposts enables all Alliances in the Warzone to attack nearby Cities
war_zone_outpost_99:
Once captured, the Cannon fires every 10 seconds at all enemy troops garrisoned in the Warzone Outpost, causing a 2% unit loss based on the max March Size per shot.
For every 5 queues garrisoned inside the Cannon, the firing interval is reduced by 1 second, up to a maximum reduction of 4 seconds.

season_s5_activity_1200053_desc01:
How to Play:
1. Trade Post contests start on Tuesday at 11:00 server time. Contests will be held once every two weeks.
2. Each contest runs for 1 hour. During the contest, all Commanders who have joined an Alliance in the same game season group can head over to the surrounding Contaminated Land to capture the Trade Posts.
3. You don't need a connected alliance territory to join the contest, but your base must be on the Contaminated Land near the Trade Post to send troops. Commanders from the same alliance won't fight each other, but progress is tracked individually.
4. For neutral Trade Posts, the Commander with the most progress at the end of the contest wins ownership. If the Trade Post is already owned, you must reach 100% progress before the timer ends to claim ownership.
5. Once the contest ends, the Governor can restock items, allowing all Commanders in the season to purchase items using Diamonds. Alliance members of the Governor receive discounts, and the Governor has access to exclusive items.
6. After the trading stage ends, the Trade Post reopens for contesting. Taxes from sales are returned to the Governor as a Golden Egg, which can be shared in chat by the Governor.
7. If the Governor abandons the Trade Post or sells out all items, taxes are issued to the Governor early as Golden Eggs.
8. Each Trade Store item has a daily purchase limit of 1, and each Commander has a limited number of purchases per day. Items are sold on a first-come, first-served basis.
9. During each conquest period, the same Commander can capture multiple Trade Posts.
season_s5_activity_1200063_desc01:
ABOUT THE EVENT:
1. Once the territory is connected to the City (including diagonally), R5/R4 members of the Alliance can declare war on the City during war declaration time.
2. After the declaration, Cities can be captured. Only one City can be targeted by each Alliance at a time. Losing the territory linked to the city mid-way through a war declaration will abort the declaration and prevent the capture of the target city.
3. Without Bank Strongholds or Cities, an Alliance must first capture a Lv. 1 Bank Stronghold. Connected territories allow further declarations.
4. Troops will be affected by toxins during sieges. Please increase troop Virus Resistance to reduce impact.
5. Siege battles are risky, with a portion of units dying directly. The specific ratio is detailed on Cities.
6. There will be first-time City capture rewards for participants. Alliance members will also receive City rewards. Alliances receive Loot chests as well, distributed by R5 or R4.
7. After capturing a City, all Alliance members get buffs. The City enters a protected state for a period, during which it can't be declared war upon by others.
8. When a city is captured by another Alliance, it also enters a protection period. Abandoning a city does not reset the protection countdown.
9. After declaring war on a city you've abandoned, there's a waiting period.
10. The number of Bank Strongholds and Cities that can be captured each day is limited. The total number of Cities your Alliance controls increases your capture limit of Bank Strongholds. You can view the exact limits in the [Alliance] -> [Alliance City] section.

season_s5_story_desc:
In the Golden Wasteland of the Land of Liberty, wealth and violence collide. Money rules above all, and the law exists only to serve the rich. Capitalists control the resources, the masses are reduced to cheap labor, and a few elites indulge in luxury, indifferent to the struggles of the common people.

The ruler of this chaotic wasteland is the great mine lord, King Spade. Once a legendary sheriff admired across the West, he has now become its wealthiest man, building a vast empire through control of CrystalGold mining. CrystalGold is a rare energy resource that powers weapons and mechs, and circulates as currency across the market. 
King Spade’s rise was not driven solely by firearms and cunning schemes, but through his alliance with Dr. Nier, who enhanced King Spade’s subordinates with a virus, granting them superhuman strength. Even King Spade himself benefited from its effects. He can command other infected individuals, turning them into unpaid laborers, massively expanding his mining empire. At Nier’s urging, King Spade has set his sights on us, sending the Commander a deadly invitation.

Yet, we will not stand idle. Under your command, the hero Venom, a former officer from a small town in the Golden Wasteland, will lead our forces westward, determined to expose King Spade’s collusion with Nier, dismantle the CrystalGold Empire, and stop the expansion of the Doom Legion.
Commander, the Golden Wasteland is on the verge of chaos. A fierce battle over CrystalGold is about to erupt, and the fate of the land will be rewritten.

season_s5_mail_desc80401: Dear Commanders, Season 5: Wild West is about to begin! A new journey awaits, one that will take you deep into the western frontier, where wealth and warfare collide. This is the Golden Vein Wasteland of the Land of Liberty—a world ruled by both money and violence. Once a legendary sheriff, King Spade has now transformed into the ruler of the Golden Age. Using CrystalGold mines, he has built a massive empire, monopolizing wealth and energy, and controlling the lifeblood of the entire wasteland. On this land consumed by greed, gunfire is law, and gold is faith. And you will lead your forces once again, breaking through the fences of power and conspiracy to reclaim freedom for this frontier! Pre-season Highlights: 1. [Warzone Area Selection]: Opens one week before the season officially begins. Warzone Presidents can choose their spawn areas in advance to secure their preferred positions. 2. [Alliance Safe Time Setting]: Alliances can select one of the three Battle-Ready Time periods as their Safe Time. During this period, their Cities and Strongholds cannot be attacked, ensuring strategic safety. Important Notice: During Season 5, [Alliance Exercise] and [Zombie Siege] will be temporarily suspended. Both activities will fully return in the S5 Off-season with brand-new rewards. Stay tuned! [Zombie Invasion] and [General's Trial] event schedules will be reset. In the first week of Season 5, [General's Trial] will open on Wednesday, and in the second week, [Zombie Invasion] will open on Wednesday, alternating between the two events. The Golden Wave rises again, with wealth and glory awaiting their new ruler. Commander, are you ready to ride across the wasteland and create your own Golden Age?

Instructions:
1. After the event begins, 5 shooting stages will unlock each day. Complete stages to earn rewards.

2. In each stage, the Commander must eliminate all enemies using a limited number of bullets to clear the stage and earn rewards. If all bullets are used up before the enemies are defeated, the attempt will fail.

3. Drag on the screen to change Venom's shooting direction. Once fired, bullets will bounce off obstacles. A bullet can bounce up to 5 times and will disappear upon the 6th collision.

4. After the Shooting Duel mode is available, Commanders can create Shooting Duels and invite other Commanders to a duel. Battles take place in real time.

5. In Shooting Duel, Commanders may choose to put down a deposit. Both sides must pay the deposit before the duel begins. The winner takes both deposits, while the loser forfeits theirs. If the duel ends in a draw (both sides run out of bullets without hitting each other or neither side lands a hit within the time limit), both deposits will be returned. If a Commander quits after paying the deposit before the duel starts, the deposit will not be refunded. (Deposit mode is only available during the following Server Time: 04:00-06:00 / 12:00-14:00 / 20:00-22:00).

6. Once an entry deposit is set for a Shooting Duel, invitations can only be sent to Commanders within the same seasonal division. Each Commander can only participate in a certain number of challenges.

season_s5_activity_1200042_desc08: Transaction complete. Wishing you good fortune!
season_s5_activity_1200042_desc09: This is some high-quality CrystalGold. Hope you bring me even more next time.
season_s5_activity_1200042_desc10: Very sharp, my friend. That one’s our best seller!
season_s5_activity_1200042_desc11: Congratulations! Looks like you got exactly what you wanted.
season_s5_activity_1200042_desc12: Buy with confidence. No fakes in my shop.
goods_desc655038: On the lawless frontier, only bullets decide fate. With this nameplate, your heroes' HP is permanently boosted by <color=#099b4a>+1000</color>.
season_s5_activity_1200044_plot01: Just heard from the speaker in town that the “Warzone Train” is arriving and the citizens must be prepared. What’s going on?
season_s5_activity_1200044_plot02: Oh, that’s the Trade Train. Folks here rely on it to ship their homemade whiskey across the land in exchange for CrystalGold.
season_s5_activity_1200044_plot03: Whiskey, huh? We’ve got plenty in our storage. If it can be traded for CrystalGold, maybe I’ll have the soldiers load some onto the train too.
season_s5_activity_1200044_plot04: Yeah, but whiskey prices change with the market. Best pick a good day to sell high.
season_s5_activity_1200045_plot01: Venom, I heard your aim’s improved. Want to give it a try?
season_s5_activity_1200045_plot02: Here, bullets will bounce off walls. If you’re confident, come on then. I’ll be waiting over there for you.
season_s5_activity_1200047_plot01: Just received a report from the sentry. King Spade's forces destroyed our outpost.
season_s5_activity_1200047_plot02: The outpost was destroyed? Does that mean the comms to other Commanders in the Warzone are down too?
season_s5_activity_1200047_plot03: That's right. I heard outposts in other Warzones were hit as well. We need to send troops to repair them as soon as possible!
season_s5_activity_1200047_plot04: Understood. The outpost is critical to the Warzone's control over the Central Area. I’ll dispatch troops right away!
season_s5_activity_1200048_plot01: Have you heard? Other Warzones have started attacking each other’s outposts.
season_s5_activity_1200048_plot02: Makes sense. Outposts are key for entering the Central Area.
season_s5_activity_1200048_plot03: Then we must prepare to fight. At times like this, being aggressive gives us the advantage.
season_s5_activity_1200048_plot04: Exactly. I’m heading to report to the Commander and call for mobilization.
season_s5_activity_1200049_plot01: So this is Golden Palace? King Spade actually put up a statue of himself here.
season_s5_activity_1200049_plot02: Typical of him. Greedy and indulgent.
season_s5_activity_1200049_plot03: Good that we beat him in the end, though Commanders from other Warzones still want to take this place for themselves.
season_s5_activity_1200049_plot04: Get ready for battle. No matter what, it’s time for the Golden Palace to welcome a new ruler!
season_s5_activity_1200053_plot01: Venom, we’ve arrived at the Trade Post. All the posts here are clustered together, but I don’t see any merchants.
season_s5_activity_1200053_plot02: Well, that’s because the Golden Wasteland covers a vast area. Caravans only arrive once every two weeks.
season_s5_activity_1200053_plot03: Once every two weeks? So we only get to restock once every two weeks too?
season_s5_activity_1200053_plot04: Exactly. And all posts open on the same day, so keep an eye on the timing if you want to buy supplies.
season_s5_activity_1200055_plot02: That’s right. With so much CrystalGold being mined every day in the Golden Wasteland, these Bank Strongholds were built to store and withdraw CrystalGold.
season_s5_activity_1200055_plot03: But the banks are also under King Spade’s control now. A Plague Lord is stationed here.
season_s5_activity_1200055_plot04: I’ve heard those Plague Lords are virus hosts too. We’d better increase our virus resistance before making a move.
activity_desc_99155:
<color=#249bc5>Event Gameplay</color>
1. All Commanders within this Warzone can participate. Defeating monsters drops chests, and once collected, the next monster will appear.
2. Use <color=#099b4a>Halloween Candies</color> to attack. Each attack grants <color=#099b4a>10</color> points, and defeating a Spooky Nightwatch grants <color=#099b4a>150</color> points.

<color=#249bc5>Event Rewards</color>
1. Dropped chests start as R rarity. Each chest has <color=#099b4a>5</color> upgrade attempts with a chance to increase its rarity, up to MR rarity.
2. Each attack grants random rewards. You may find <color=#099b4a>Spooky Hallowagon items</color> inside, which will not be converted after the event ends. You may also obtain <color=#099b4a>Spooky Pumpkins</color> during the event. Use <color=#099b4a>Spooky Pumpkins</color> to cheer for the Spooky Hallowagon. Each cheer grants the target +100 Popularity.
3. Chests may also contain <color=#099b4a>Halloween Fireworks</color>. When used, fireworks will be displayed above your Base on the world map, consuming one item per use. This item will not be converted after the event ends.

<color=#249bc5>Ranking & Conversion</color>
1. During the event, both Individual and Alliance Points will be ranked separately (in case of a tie, the one who reaches the points earlier ranks higher). A minimum of <color=#099b4a>100</color> points is required to enter the rankings. Rewards will be distributed based on ranking after the event ends.
2. At the end of the event, Spooky Pumpkins will be converted into speedup items delivered via mail.
3. Conversion rate: Spooky Pumpkin ×1 = Universal Speedup (1 min) ×5
activity_desc_99156:
<color=#249bc5>Event Gameplay</color>
1. During the event, all these activities provide the chance to earn Halloween Candies: a) Complete tasks and Battle Pass tasks, b) Finish Radar assistance events (30% chance to get 1, 25% chance to get 2, 20% chance to get 3, 15% chance to get 4, 10% chance to get 5 each time). c) Kill world map monsters, rally Bosses, or Doom Walkers, participate in Monster Invasions, General’s Trial, Alliance Exercise, and kill Ironclad Vehicles, Corruptors, or Infected Zombies (30% chance to get 1, 25% chance to get 2, 20% chance to get 3, 15% chance to get 4, 10% chance to get 5 each time). d) Attack the Wanted Bosses (20% chance to get 2, 20% chance to get 3, 10% chance to get 4, 10% chance to get 5, 10% chance to get 6, 10% chance to get 7, 10% chance to get 8, 5% chance to get 9, 5% chance to get 10).
2. Defeating the Wanted Boss can drop rewards up to 5 times daily.
3. Halloween Candies obtained from paid Packs or Battle Passes do not count towards the limit.
<color=#249bc5>Conversion</color>
1. Halloween Candies will be converted into Universal Speed-up items at the end of the Event and sent via <color=#249bc5>Mail</color>. Items not converted in time will expire but can be manually converted into Universal Speed-up items in the Inventory.
2. Conversion Rate: Halloween Candy x1 = 1-minute Universal Speed-up x2.

<color=#249bc5>Others</color>
1. Halloween Candies can be used in the Spooky HallowEve event.
2. Below are the drop probabilities for each output method in this Warzone (different Warzones may have slightly different output methods depending on the event).
activity_desc_99159:
1. During the event, use 2025 Halloweenopoly Tokens to roll the dice, moving forward based on the number rolled. 
2. You can choose a single roll (1 die) or double roll (2 dice, rewards not doubled). Both rolls earn the same Treasure Points, and once you've collected enough, you can claim a target reward. 
3. The board is made up of different squares: item squares, event squares, and the start square. Landing on an item square gives you rewards and EXP. When squares level up, you'll receive even better rewards. Event squares trigger random events, full of surprises. 
4. Passing or landing on the start square grants you rewards from 3 random item squares and corresponding square EXP. 
5. Daily event goals reset each day. If you miss claiming any rewards, they'll be sent to your inbox. Unused Treasure Points carry over to the next day. No extra points are granted after the event ends. 
6. Max-level squares don't earn extra EXP from events, but you'll find Spooky Chests randomly, which grant bonus rewards. 
7. Buying Mystery Packs during 2025 Halloweenopoly gives Alliance gifts and the same amount of Diamonds and VIP points you'd get from the Diamond Store (excluding any doubled points). 
8. If you enable auto-roll, dice rolls will be handled automatically, and rewards will go into a temporary chest (tap to claim). Event progress will be stored and handled manually after the auto-roll ends. 
9. Unused 2025 Halloweenopoly Tokens will be converted into speed-up items after the event and sent by mail. Expired items can still be manually converted. Conversion rate: 2025 Halloweenopoly Token x1 = 1-minute Universal Speed-up x40

activity_snatch_server_train_rule:
1. You can plunder goods being transported on the [Fortune].
2. Each refresh will select 3 targets from the train for plunder. After a successful plunder, the list will refresh.
3. Each plunder seizes 10% of the consignor's total goods.
4. Once 50% of the original consigned goods have been plundered, it will no longer appear on the target list.
5. Defense teams do not recover HP after being attacked until the train reaches the next station.
6. Defeated defense teams will recover full HP once the train reaches the next station.
7. Unused plunder attempts will accumulate across days, up to a maximum of 7 attempts.

season_s5_activity1200045_story_desc:
The virus destroyed order, leaving only chaos and violence across the Wasteland.
Venom, once a bounty hunter famed for his composure and deadly aim, has taken up another bounty. When the sun climbs to its peak and the blazing light scorches the streets of the Wasteland, the time for a duel has come.
Every outlaw knows that he shows no mercy, and never hesitates.
Bullets in the chamber. Target locked.
Each duel is a battle of life and death.
season_s5_activity1200051_story_desc:
In the Golden Wasteland of the Land of Liberty, the air still reeks of money and violence.
Venom, once a police officer, has long abandoned the badge and the rules it stood for. Now, he’s a bounty hunter whose name makes outlaws tremble. This time, his mission goes beyond hunting down criminals. He’s out to reclaim his legend in the wilds.
Commander, lend him a hand and lead him through a series of trials and challenges. Each victory will bring Venom one step closer to the peak of legend.
On the road to glory, he will face old enemies once more and write his own justice with bullets and strength.
The wasteland shows no mercy. He must prove himself worthy of the title of "The Strongest Bounty Hunter."
season_s5_activity1200044_story_desc:
In the Golden Wasteland, whiskey can be worth more than CrystalGold for those lost in luxury and vice.
Sensing the potential profit, King Spade built an exclusive railway, enforcing “order” through guns and contracts, and collecting every coin for himself.
To break his monopoly, the Trade Train must sell goods at each station along its route.
Time it right, and the profits will pour in. But every stop is a clash of bullets and gold, where your cargo could be plundered in an instant.
Out here in the wasteland, whoever moves the goods had better be ready to draw their weapons.
season_s5_activity1200047_story_desc:
The outposts across the Golden Wasteland have suffered heavy damage during the prolonged battles. Their communication and control systems are now offline.
We need to repair them to restore connections between Warzones and reopen routes that allow Alliances to attack nearby Cities.
Once an outpost is repaired, the Alliance with the highest contribution will gain control of it, providing a strategic advantage in future conflicts.
This is more than a construction mission. It is a contest of strength among alliances. The faster you repair, the sooner you seize control, and the greater your chance to control the battlefield.
season_s5_activity1200048_story_desc:
Outposts serve as the strategic strongholds between Warzones and the key to controlling both resources and the battlefront.
To seize command, Warzone commanders rally their elites and dispatch their forces in full-scale attacks on the outposts.
The capture of an outpost is more than a symbol of honor. It determines the expansion and survival of the battlefront.
In this long and grueling battle of offense and defense, there is no turning back. Only one side will raise its banner over the ruins.

2025halloween_treasure_main_info_desc:
<color=#249bc5>Basic Rules</color>
1. Deploying a Christmas Sleigh requires a Christmas Sleigh item. Once deployed, it will parade on the world map and remain active for a limited duration. Rewards will be granted when the duration ends.

<color=#249bc5>Duration & Levels</color>
1. The initial <color=#099b4a>Lv.1</color> Christmas Sleigh lasts for <color=#099b4a>30</color> minutes. Upgrading it increases the duration <color=#099b4a>(+10 minutes per level, up to +30 minutes at Lv.4)</color>.
2. Christmas Sleigh Popularity increases through three methods: staying online <color=#099b4a>(+1 per second)</color>, receiving Likes <color=#099b4a>(+30 per Like)</color>, and receiving Cheers <color=#099b4a>(+100 per Cheer)</color>. When Popularity reaches the required amount, the Christmas Sleigh levels up. After reaching the max level, it can still gain Popularity. Each Christmas Sleigh's level is calculated independently.

<color=#249bc5>Christmas Sleigh Rewards</color>
1. When the Christmas Sleigh levels up, it begins reward preparation, lasting <color=#099b4a>120 seconds</color>. Once ready, Popularity Reward Chests will appear on empty spaces around it. If the remaining time is longer than the preparation time, the chests will be distributed before settlement. Commanders from the same Warzone as the deploying Commander can claim rewards, up to <color=#099b4a>{0}</color> chest(s) per Christmas Sleigh and <color=#099b4a>{1}</color> per day.
2. After successfully claiming a Popularity Level Reward Chest, Commanders must wait 1 seconds before claiming again.
3. When a Christmas Sleigh receives Cheers, it sends a Cheer Reward Chest to the cheering Commander. Opening it grants rich rewards. The Cheer Chest can only be claimed by the cheering Commander. If unclaimed before it expires, it will be reissued via mail after your next login (automatically opened upon delivery).
4. When the Christmas Sleigh’s duration ends, settlement occurs based on its Popularity Level. Any extra Popularity exceeding the level requirement grants 1 x 5-minute Universal Speedup for every 100 points (rounded up).
5. The first <color=#099b4a>10</color> Christmas Sleigh Likes each day grant rewards. (Each Like grants a random reward: 1-minute Universal Speedup x2 (70%), 5-minute Universal Speedup x1 (20%), 15-minute Universal Speedup x1 (7%), or 1-hour Universal Speedup x1 (3%)).

<color=#249bc5>Conversion</color>
1. Christmas Sleigh Cheer items are available only during the festival and will be converted into Christmas Sleigh Commemorative Badges when the event ends.
2. Christmas Sleigh items themselves will not be converted after the festival ends.

<color=#249bc5>Additional Notes</color>
1. Each Commander can have up to <color=#099b4a>3</color> active Christmas Sleighs at once.
2. Each Commander can Like the same Christmas Sleigh up to <color=#099b4a>2</color> times and cannot Like their own Christmas Sleigh.
3. Each Christmas Sleigh can receive up to <color=#099b4a>30</color> Cheers and cannot be cheered for by its owner.
4. You can Like Christmas Sleighs from other Warzones.

2. Each day, you can like the top 3 Commanders on the Hallowagon Rankings. Each Commander can like up to 3 times per day. If a Commander in the top 3 has already received a like from you that day, you cannot like them again even if their ranking position changes within the top 3.

Dear Commander, your outstanding performance during this Trade Post open period has earned you the successful capture of a Lv.1 Trade Post!
Based on the level of the Trade Post you've taken, you've been awarded the title Frontier Governor!
As the Governor of the Trade Post, you gain access to multiple perks:
1. Summon caravans to activate trading at the Trade Post. Both you and your allies can enjoy discounts on items purchased from your Trade Post.

3. A percentage of the Trade Post's earnings during trading will be returned to you as a Tax Golden Egg!

gale_arena_rules:
[Start]
1. Gale Arena opens on Monday at 1:00 server time and ends on Sunday at 24:00 server time.

[Join the Arena]
1. Each event period opens three Arenas simultaneously: Elite-level, Mid-level, and Entry-level. The Elite-level Arena includes Commanders from 1 to 4 Warzones, the Mid-level Arena includes Commanders from 1 to 2 Warzones, and the Entry-level Arena includes only Commanders from your Warzone.
2. Entry requirements: Elite-level Arena requires heroes’ total power to rank in the top 200 in your Warzone. Mid-level Arena is for heroes ranking 201 - 800. All Commanders below rank 800 enter the Entry-level Arena. After the Arena opens, if a Entry-level Arena Commander’s hero power rises into the 201 - 800 range, a promotion window will pop up allowing the Commander to move to the Mid-level Arena. Mid-level Arena Commanders who rise to the top 200 will get a promotion window to Elite-level Arena with promotion eligibility retained for the event period.

[Match Stage]
1. Initial rankings are based on Commanders’ combat power.
2. Starting score: 1000 points.
3. Each challenge presents 5 nearby Commanders to choose from. Victory grants points while defeat deducts points. The larger the point difference the more points are gained or lost.
4. Each Commander has a limited number of challenge attempts per day during the event period.

[Rewards]
1. Completing 1, 3, and 5 challenges per day unlocks daily reward chests.
2. At the end of the Arena, final rankings determine individual and Alliance rewards.
3. Rewards are sent via in-game mail.

[Lineup]
1. By default, your strongest squad is used as the defense lineup. Once the Arena starts, Commanders must manually save the defense lineup. Unsaved lineups will automatically change with squad adjustments.
2. After the event begins, Commanders can adjust the defense lineup manually.
3. Arena battles do not result in unit casualties and your highest-level units will be used by default.

season_s5_mail_desc80402: Dear Commanders: Welcome to the brand-new season — [Wild West]! You have arrived at the Golden Wasteland where gunfire and wealth run side by side. Under the manipulation of King Spade, a golden age interwoven with violence and wealth is emerging. The struggle for mines, railways, and the Central Area has erupted in full force. CrystalGold, the new source of faith and order on this land, is rewriting the future of the wasteland. Special Notes: 1. According to the [Warzone Area Selection] results during the pre-season period, Commanders’ bases have been placed in their respective areas. 2. The maximum level for profession specialization remains 100 this season. 3. [Alliance Exercise] and [Zombie Siege] will be temporarily unavailable and will return during the S5 off-season. Key actions to be performed immediately: 1. [Check the season manual] to understand new features such as CrystalGold and Western Towns. 2. [Complete Main Tasks] to repair the Caffeine Institute, increase Virus Resistance, and expand your territory. 3. [Formulate Alliance Strategy] starting from the Level 1 Trailblazer Bank, plan alliance expansion routes, and capture key resource points. 4. [Check [World Dynamics]] to stay updated on season dynamics, participate in limited-time events and challenges, and gain early advantages. The season has officially begun, the winds of the wasteland are rising, and the horns have sounded. Commander, may you wield CrystalGold as your blade and your Alliance as your shield, forging glory and achieving victories in this Golden Wasteland!

season_UI_info_101_s5:
1. You must defeat the Plague Lord guarding the Stronghold to capture it.
2. An Alliance can initially capture only Lv.1 Strongholds.
3. After capturing their first Stronghold, an Alliance can only capture Strongholds or Cities adjacent to their territory.
4. Attacks on Strongholds captured by other Alliances are not allowed unless they are adjacent to your territory.
5. The more troops garrisoned at a Stronghold, the faster it can be captured.
6. If the troop count is too low, the capture will fail due to slow progress.
7. When a stronghold captured by your Alliance is attacked by another, it enters a contest state. The Alliance that reaches 100% progress first successfully captures it.
8. Once a Stronghold changes hands, it enters a 36-hour protection period and the defending troops are refreshed.
9. Initially, each Alliance can capture only 4 Strongholds, however, the Alliance will be able to capture 1 more Stronghold for each captured City, up to a maximum of 12 Strongholds.

ghost_parkour_rule_desc: [Participation Requirements] 1. Base Level must be at least Lv.12. 2. Daily Random Match attempts: 10. 3. Daily Direct Challenge attempts: 10. [Game Rules] 1. Random Match: (limited to 10 times per day) · Tap the Match button to begin. The system will find an opponent of similar strength and pair you against their best-record "Ghost". · Random Match grants Tier Points based on your single-match results, and your individual best record will be added to the rankings. 2. Direct Challenge: (limited to 10 times per day) · Go to the Rankings, select any opponent, and tap the challenge button to match against that Commander’s best-record "Ghost". · Direct Challenge does not grant Tier Points but will record your best completion time on the rankings. 3. Control Tips: · Swipe the screen to dodge obstacles. Hitting obstacles will greatly reduce your running speed. · Try to step on as many Speed Pads as possible for a short acceleration boost; consecutive activations during the boost will upgrade it to a higher-level acceleration effect. · Collect as many Energy Drinks as you can. Once your Energy Bar is full, double-tap the screen to activate Super Boost! (On PC, press the space bar to activate Super Boost.) 4. Core Objectives: · Join and win matches to improve your Tier. · Collect Energy Drinks during matches to unlock Alliance Rewards. · Finish matches faster to climb the Rankings. [Rankings and Rounds] 1. Each round lasts 3 days. Sunday is a rest day with no matches. 2. The rankings resets each round, and a new race map will be introduced when the next round begins. 3. Rewards are distributed based on the shortest single-run completion times each round. 4. Every Commander can give 3 Likes per day to each of the top 3 Commanders on the rankings (9 total). Each Like grants 30 Diamonds. 5. On the rankings, you can watch Match Replays of other Commanders’ best records. 6. You can also issue a Direct Challenge to a specific Commander from the rankings page. After completing the challenge, a challenge record will be generated, which can be shared in chat and includes a Match Replay. [Tiers] 1. There are 5 Tiers: Bronze, Silver, Gold, Diamond, and Master. 2. During the event, Tier Points accumulate continuously and do not reset. 3. Each Random Match grants different number of Tier Points depending on your performance. 4. Each Tier includes multiple point milestones. Reaching a milestone unlocks the corresponding reward. 5. Note: Direct Challenges from the rankings do not grant Tier Points. [Reward Rules] 1. Individual Rewards: Individual rewards refresh daily. Unlock individual progress chests based on the number of matches completed each day. 2. Alliance Rewards: Alliance rewards refresh each round. Unlock Alliance progress rewards based on the total number of Energy Drinks collected by all members each round. 3. Ranking Rewards: · Ranking rewards are settled each round. · The rankings includes: Individual Rankings (Alliance) Individual Rankings (Warzone) Individual Rankings (Warzone Group) 4. Commanders ranked in the top 30 of the Warzone Group rankings will grant every member of their Alliance an Champion Runner's Gift, sent via mail. [Notes] 1. Closing the game or exiting mid-race may cause your result to be lost and not recorded on the rankings. 2. Network issues may cause upload failures. If your best score doesn’t update on the rankings right away, try logging in again to check. 3. When the rankings resets between rounds, results from ongoing matches may not be counted.

1. Wanted Boss events now include brand new titles as daily ranking rewards!
2. After capturing a Bank, the maximum duration of the Bank Plunder stage has been reduced from 12h to 1h.

4. Added countdown information to deposit receipts that have not yet matured.
5. Fixed an issue where the passbook item could not correctly display all deposit slip information in Mail under certain circumstances.
6. Optimized the Alliance Influence Points interface by adding countdown information for the next War Declaration Day.
7. CrystalGold can now be obtained from chests scattered on the ground after capturing a City for the first time.
8. Audio effects and other optimizations.

Thank you for your understanding and support!

arms_race_exchange_howtoplay_info:
1. Only <color=#099b4a>1</color> swap attempt is available per day.
2. When swapping, only stages with <color=#099b4a>later</color> time than the current one can be selected.
3. After swapping, the <color=#099b4a>point requirements, points, and chests</color> of the two stages are completely swapped. For example, if the first 2 chests have been opened in the current stage, after swapping, the current stage will have 3 new unopened chests, while the first 2 chests of the swapped target stage will be in an opened state.
4. Swapping is unavailable if there are unclaimed chest rewards in the current stage.
5. Swapping is unavailable when there is less than 5 minutes remaining in the current stage.

It is recommended that Commanders <color=#099b4a>prioritize completing the current stage of the Arms Race</color> before swapping, as this will allow you to earn Arms Race Badges more quickly.

season_s5_update_notice_2:
Dear Commander, to optimize your season experience, we will implement the following adjustments after maintenance:

1. Protector's Field construction requirements have been reduced from a level 60 Caffeine Institute to a level 50 Caffeine Institute.

2. After defeating Plague Roosters, the Truffle Coffee drop rate has been increased from 15% to 50%.

3. The Bank deposit slip limit has been increased from 12 to 15. You can now hold up to 15 bank deposit slips simultaneously.

4. Strength of Level 10 and Level 11 Defense units has been enhanced.

5. The Grand Nexus Capture Buff has been adjusted to provide a 30% research speed boost.

6. Starting from Season 5, the Sunday [Rampage Bosses] and [The Doomsday] event schedule will be adjusted: the first Sunday of the season will feature [The Doomsday], the second Sunday will feature [Rampage Bosses], and they will alternate in this order.

7. The duration of titles in challenge rewards has been adjusted. Specific details can be viewed in the Challenge Reward interface.

8. Optimized the display of information for the Bank functions and Wasteland Trade interfaces.

9. At the end of the season, gathering troops with more than 10 minutes of remaining gathering time will no longer return automatically.

Thank you for your support and understanding!

worldboss_rules_desc_new_87:
ABOUT THE EVENT:
1. Code 87 spawns on the World Map every Monday and Thursday at 00:00 (server time). Each time it appears, it stays for 23 hours. Commanders can locate it via the event menu.
2. While Code 87 is active, commanders with bases at level 8 or above can send troops to challenge it.
3. Unlimited challenge attempts per day. No rally attacks allowed. (Festival events and events like the Black Market Challenge offer up to 5 extra drop opportunities.)
4. Tank heroes deal extra damage to Code 87.

Rewards:
1. Commanders get rewards after reaching the required number of challenges.
2. On challenge days, the higher the single damage dealt, the better the rewards. Only the highest single damage counts for ranking.
3. Rewards in the "Goals" unlock gradually as server time progresses, and each reward can be claimed once.

Dear Commander, to improve your season experience, we have made the following adjustments

1. Added a new Stronghold Abandonment cooldown: after an Alliance abandons a Stronghold, it must wait 24 hours before attempting to capture the same target again, preventing unfair tactics such as repeated shield-refreshing through "abandon-recapture" loops.

2. CrystalGold Shop update: added new Tactics Cards, gifts, and chroma skins to expand the list of redeemable items.

3. Season Pass optimization: added new daily tasks such as plunder, depositing, and purchasing items.

4. Reduced resistance requirements for Level 5 Strongholds.

5. CrystalGold Tycoon reward optimization: rewards for Individual Total CrystalGold Ranking 1 - 10 have been improved.

6. Fixed an issue where Wasteland Trade event Station collection quantities were abnormal.

7. Trade Post display optimization: the Governor avatar will remain visible even at maximum zoom-out level.

8. Various UI display improvements have been made to present information more clearly and enhance overall interaction.

Dear Commander,

During the recent Frontline Breakthrough event, we detected anomalies in your points acquisition method. Such data activity adversely affects the competitive experience of other Commanders and undermines event fairness.

To maintain a fair in-game environment, the abnormally obtained points have been removed from the leaderboard rankings and will not be eligible for corresponding rewards. Additionally, any subsequent game results on this character and device will not be included in leaderboard rankings.

The Last War Team
server_train_station_rule:
About Station Purchases:
1. Station Purchase Quantity = the maximum amount of goods the train can sell upon arrival. Any goods exceeding this amount will be returned.
2. The station will automatically adjust its maximum purchase quantity based on historical purchase records.
3. The Estimated Sales Quantity is the projected amount of goods that can be sold under current conditions, and it may differ from the station's final actual purchase quantity.

outpost_commander_help_1:
1. Each Commander can hold only 1 Outpost official position. Commanders who already hold an Outpost official position cannot be appointed to another Outpost position.
2. The Alliance Leader of the Alliance controlling the Outpost can appoint an Outpost Protector. The Outpost Protector can assign Outpost official positions to other Commanders via the [Appoint] button in the official position interface.
3. When the <color=#f53c3d>ownership of the current Outpost changes</color>, all Outpost official positions will be cleared. New positions can only be reassigned once the Outpost gains a new owner.
4. Commanders can simultaneously hold official positions from the original Warzone, Outpost, and Golden Palace. Attributes from each position stack, and the specific bonuses can be viewed in the Official's Attributes panel.
5. <color=#f53c3d>At the End of Season, all Central Area official positions will be cleared.</color>
outpost_commander_help_2:
Award Rules:
1. Only Outpost Protectors can distribute awards to Commanders.
2. During the same term, each Commander can receive an award from the same outpost only once, but can simultaneously receive awards from different outposts.
3. Only the Outpost Protector is eligible for the Protector's Reward.
4. Award counts reset only after each Outpost Conquest settlement.

supreme_president_help_1:
1. Each Commander can hold only 1 Golden Palace official position. Commanders who already hold a Golden Palace official position cannot receive another.

2. The <color=#099b4a>Golden Palace President</color> and the <color=#099b4a>Supreme Muse</color> can both appoint official positions via the [Appoint] button in the official position interface.

3. When the <color=#f53c3d>next Golden Palace Conquest begins</color>, all official positions will be cleared, and appointments can only resume after the new Golden Palace President takes office.

4. Commanders can simultaneously hold official positions from the original Warzone, Outpost, and the Golden Palace. Attributes from different official positions stack and can be viewed in the Officials Attributes panel.

5. <color=#f53c3d>At the End of Season, all Central Area official positions will be cleared.</color>
supreme_president_help_2:
Award Rules:
1. Only Golden Palace Presidents can distribute awards to Commanders.
2. During the same term, each Commander can receive an award from the Golden Palace President only once.
3. Only the Golden Palace President is eligible for the President's Reward.
4. Award counts reset only after each Golden Palace Conquest settlement.

season_s5_activity_1200067_rule:
Rules:
1. During the event, every Saturday at 13:00 server time, Alliances whose territory connects to the Golden Palace may take part in capturing the Golden Palace.
2. On Saturday, completing certain actions earns points. Meeting the point requirements grants Point Chests, regardless of whether your Alliance is eligible to capture Golden Palace.
3. Controlling a Cannon grants different effects: if your Alliance controls the Golden Palace, the Mega Cannon boosts your Alliance's capture speed. If not, the Cannon will automatically attack the garrisoned units inside the Golden Palace.
4. Once an Alliance fully captures the Golden Palace, numerous Diamond Resource Tiles will appear around it. Members of the controlling Alliance may send troops to gather at these tiles.
5. The Golden Palace and each Cannon can hold up to 100 troops simultaneously, and each battle can involve up to 10 teams. During the Golden Palace Conquest, troops may march continuously on the surrounding Contaminated Land.

decoration_desc16080:
He crosses the world’s oldest wound, carrying the question no mind can bear to answer. 
Formed where reason breaks and will endures, he comes. 
To behold him is to understand the abyss was never empty. 
What we call ruin, he names release; the quiet beneath all striving.
decoration_desc16081: It's a curious little panda with a quirky streak, always looking out for everyone's well-being. Its favorite treats are bamboo shoots, oranges, and fried oysters. It doesn’t enjoy fighting, but when the situation calls for it, it transforms into a warrior panda and charges into battle with unmatched bravery.
decoration_desc16082: Forged in steel, with battle spirit burning like flame. The War Wolf speaks not — it measures distance only with searing metallic fury. When next it appears, there is no need for words. Its overwhelming power will say everything.

season_s5_update_notice_desc1:
Dear Commander, to improve your season experience, we've made the following adjustments:

1. Added the Warzone Outpost Officials system. You can view details on the Warzone Outpost building page.

2. Unified the rules for entering War Fever during PvP Stronghold battles: During the contest phase, attacking an enemy-controlled Stronghold will trigger War Fever; garrisoning a friendly-controlled Stronghold will not trigger War Fever.

3. Adjusted Warzone Train Consigner logic: changed from a daily consignment count limit to a daily goods sold limit. Unsold goods will no longer count toward the sold-goods total.

4. In High Noon PvP, added a Health system. Each player has 3 Health. Headshots remove 3 Health; hits on other body parts remove 1.

5. In High Noon PvP, bullet count has been adjusted to 20.

6. Improved Officials logic: you can now manage Officials positions while in cross-server status.

7. Adjusted High Noon ranking logic: ranking now prioritizes fewer challenge attempts; fewer attempts result in a higher ranking.

8. Improved Season Resources output display: expired Season Weekly Pass buildings will no longer be included in the output.

9. Season Specialization Train Consigner changed from +1 daily consignment to increasing daily consignment goods capacity by an additional 200%.

10. Adjusted the Bank's default deposit amount from 100 to 6000.

11. Added an Alliance-member filter for Wasteland Trade plunder targets. Only members who join after the feature goes live can be filtered.

12. Fixed an issue where Alliance Influence Pts rankings fluctuated when Alliances had identical Influence Pts values.

13. Fixed various UI adaptation problems.

14. Fixed an issue where Auto Rally would fail in the central area.

15. Increased the Season Merit Medal quantity in Alliance Settlement Rewards.

16. Increased Honor Point rewards for Individual Bank Plunder rankings in certain tiers.

17. Increased the daily recovery count for Free Advanced Teleport in Profession Specialization Season columns from 2 to 3.

18. Fixed an issue where Alliance Safe Time modifications on Monday didn't take effect the next day.
