2025christmas_treasure_main_info_desc:
<color=#249bc5>Basic Rules</color>
1. Deploying a Christmas Sleigh requires a Christmas Sleigh item. Once deployed, it will parade on the world map and remain active for a limited duration. Rewards will be granted when the duration ends.

<color=#249bc5>Duration & Levels</color>
1. The initial <color=#099b4a>Lv.1</color> Christmas Sleigh lasts for <color=#099b4a>30</color> minutes. Upgrading it increases the duration <color=#099b4a>(+10 minutes per level, up to +30 minutes at Lv.4)</color>.
2. Christmas Sleigh Popularity increases through three methods: staying online <color=#099b4a>(+1 per second)</color>, receiving Likes <color=#099b4a>(+30 per Like)</color>, and receiving Cheers <color=#099b4a>(+100 per Cheer)</color>. When Popularity reaches the required amount, the Christmas Sleigh levels up. After reaching the max level, it can still gain Popularity. Each Christmas Sleigh's level is calculated independently.

<color=#249bc5>Christmas Sleigh Rewards</color>
1. When the Christmas Sleigh levels up, it begins reward preparation, lasting <color=#099b4a>120 seconds</color>. Once ready, Popularity Reward Chests will appear on empty spaces around it. If the remaining time is longer than the preparation time, the chests will be distributed before settlement. Commanders from the same Warzone as the deploying Commander can claim rewards, up to <color=#099b4a>{0}</color> chest(s) per Christmas Sleigh and <color=#099b4a>{1}</color> per day.
2. After successfully claiming a Popularity Level Reward Chest, Commanders must wait 1 seconds before claiming again.
3. When a Christmas Sleigh receives Cheers, it sends a Cheer Reward Chest to the cheering Commander. Opening it grants rich rewards. The Cheer Chest can only be claimed by the cheering Commander. If unclaimed before it expires, it will be reissued via mail after your next login (automatically opened upon delivery).
4. When the Christmas Sleigh’s duration ends, settlement occurs based on its Popularity Level. Any extra Popularity exceeding the level requirement grants 1 x 5-minute Universal Speedup for every 100 points (rounded up).
5. The first <color=#099b4a>10</color> Christmas Sleigh Likes each day grant rewards. (Each Like grants a random reward: 1-minute Universal Speedup x2 (70%), 5-minute Universal Speedup x1 (20%), 15-minute Universal Speedup x1 (7%), or 1-hour Universal Speedup x1 (3%)).

<color=#249bc5>Conversion</color>
1. Christmas Sleigh Cheer items are available only during the festival and will be converted into Christmas Sleigh Commemorative Badges when the event ends.
2. Christmas Sleigh items themselves will not be converted after the festival ends.

<color=#249bc5>Additional Notes</color>
1. Each Commander can have up to <color=#099b4a>3</color> active Christmas Sleighs at once.
2. Each Commander can Like the same Christmas Sleigh up to <color=#099b4a>2</color> times and cannot Like their own Christmas Sleigh.
3. Each Christmas Sleigh can receive up to <color=#099b4a>30</color> Cheers and cannot be Cheered for by its owner.
4. You can Like Christmas Sleighs from other Warzones.

<color=#249bc5>Conversion and Reissue</color>
1. After the exchange store closes, <color=#099b4a>2025 Christmas Vouchers</color> and <color=#099b4a>2025 Christmas Voucher Lucky Chests</color> will be converted into Universal Speed-up Items and sent via mail. activity_desc_99174:
1. During the event, use 2025 Snowopoly Tokens to roll the dice, moving forward based on the number rolled. 
2. You can choose a single roll (1 die) or double roll (2 dice, rewards not doubled). Each face of the die has an equal chance of coming up. Both rolls earn the same Treasure Points, and once you've collected enough, you can claim a target reward. 
3. The board is made up of different squares: item squares, event squares, and the start square. Landing on an item square gives you rewards and EXP. When squares level up, you'll receive even better rewards. Event squares trigger random events, full of surprises. 
4. Passing or landing on the start square grants you rewards from 3 random item squares and corresponding square EXP. 
5. Daily event goals reset each day. If you miss claiming any rewards, they'll be sent to your inbox. Unused Treasure Points carry over to the next day. No extra points are granted after the event ends. 
6. Max-level squares don't earn extra EXP from events, but you'll find Wondrous Chests randomly, which grant bonus rewards. 
7. Buying Mystery Packs during Snowopoly gives Alliance gifts and the same amount of Diamonds and VIP points you'd get from the Diamond Store (excluding any doubled points). 
8. If you enable auto-roll, dice rolls will be handled automatically, and rewards will go into a temporary chest (tap to claim). Event progress will be stored and handled manually after the auto-roll ends. 
9. Unused 2025 Snowopoly Tokens will be converted into speed-up items after the event and sent by mail. Expired items can still be manually converted. Conversion rate: 2025 Snowopoly Token x1 = 1-minute Universal Speed-up x40.
activity_desc_99173:
1. Commanders can earn Battle Pass points by completing <color=#249bc5>tasks</color> during the event, increasing the tier.
2. Purchasing premium tiers unlocks more rewards.
3. Rewards not claimed by the end of the event will be sent via <color=#249bc5>mail</color> (Not applicable to daily event tasks).
activity_desc_99172: Purchase packs or make in-app purchases during the event to earn points and substantial rewards.
activity_desc_99171:
<color=#249bc5>Event Gameplay</color>
1. During the event, all these activities provide the chance to earn Christmas Candies: a) Complete tasks and Battle Pass tasks, b) Finish Radar tasks (30% chance to get 1, 25% chance to get 2, 20% chance to get 3, 15% chance to get 4, 10% chance to get 5 each time). c) Kill Zombies, Doom Elites, or participate in Zombie Invasion, General’s Trial, Doom Walkers, Alliance Exercise, and kill Ironclad Vehicles, Corruptors, or Infected Zombies (30% chance to get 1, 25% chance to get 2, 20% chance to get 3, 15% chance to get 4, 10% chance to get 5 each time). d) Attack the Wanted Bosses (20% chance to get 2, 20% chance to get 3, 10% chance to get 4, 10% chance to get 5, 10% chance to get 6, 10% chance to get 7, 10% chance to get 8, 5% chance to get 9, 5% chance to get 10).
2. Defeating the Wanted Boss can drop rewards up to 5 times daily.
3. Christmas Candies obtained from paid Packs or Battle Passes, or from participating in the Snowopoly event, do not count towards the limit.
<color=#249bc5>Conversion</color>
1. Christmas Candies will be converted into Universal Speed-up items at the end of the Event and sent via <color=#249bc5>Mail</color>. Items not converted in time will expire but can be manually converted into Universal Speed-up items in the Inventory.
2. Conversion Rate: Christmas Candy x1 = 1-minute Universal Speed-up x2.

<color=#249bc5>Others</color>
1. Christmas Candies can be used in the X-mas Fright Night event.
2. Below are the drop probabilities for each output method in this Warzone (different Warzones may have slightly different output methods depending on the event).
activity_desc_99170:
<color=#249bc5>Event Gameplay</color>
1. All Commanders within this Warzone can participate. Defeating monsters drops chests, and once collected, the next monster will appear.
2. Use <color=#099b4a>Christmas Candies</color> to attack. Each attack grants <color=#099b4a>10</color> points, and defeating the Frostborne King grants <color=#099b4a>150</color> points.

<color=#249bc5>Event Rewards</color>
1. Dropped chests start as R rarity. Each chest has <color=#099b4a>5</color> upgrade attempts with a chance to increase its rarity, up to MR rarity.
2. Each attack grants random rewards. You may find a <color=#099b4a>Christmas Sleigh item</color> inside, which will not be converted after the event ends. You may also obtain <color=#099b4a>Festive Bells</color> during the event. Use <color=#099b4a>Festive Bells</color> to cheer for the Christmas Sleigh. Each cheer grants the target +100 Popularity.

<color=#249bc5>Ranking & Conversion</color>
1. During the event, both Individual and Alliance Points will be ranked separately (in case of a tie, the one who reaches the points earlier ranks higher). A minimum of <color=#099b4a>100</color> points is required to enter the rankings. Rewards will be distributed based on ranking after the event ends.
2. At the end of the event, Festive Bells will be converted into speedup items delivered via mail.
3. Conversion rate: Festive Bell ×1 = Universal Speedup (1 min) ×5.

season_s5_update_notice_4:
Dear Commander, to improve your season experience, we've made the following adjustments:

1. Settlement Reward Improvements: Titles from the Season's Challenge Rewards are now permanent.

2. Lower Bank Capture Difficulty: Reduced zombie levels and numbers around certain Bank tiers.

3. Sunday Set as a Truce Day: Cities and Strongholds that are owned by Alliances cannot be attacked or declared war on Sundays, giving Commanders more non-battle time.

4. Wasteland Trade Improvements: Slightly increased the purchase quantity when reaching each station, and when robbing goods, the system now checks for changes regarding the state of the goods and displays a corresponding prompt.

5. Zoom Optimization: Added a Warzone View, making it easier to check each Warzone's City and Stronghold capture progress.

6. Improved information display across various interfaces.
season_s5_update_notice_5:
Dear Commander, to improve your season experience, we've made the following adjustments:

1. Settlement Reward Improvements: Titles from the Season's Challenge Rewards are now permanent.

2. Lower Bank Capture Difficulty: Reduced zombie levels and numbers around certain Bank tiers.

3. Sunday Set as a Truce Day: Cities and Strongholds with Alliance ownership cannot be attacked or declared war on Sundays, giving Commanders more non-battle time.

4. Alliance War Compatibility: Attacks on the Golden Palace and Warzone Outposts will now trigger Alliance War notifications, helping Commanders stay updated on frontline activity.

5. Wasteland Trade Improvements: Slightly increased the amount of goods received at each stop; and when robbing goods, the system now checks whether the goods' state has changed and displays a corresponding prompt.

6. Zoom Optimization: Added a Warzone View, making it easier to check each Warzone's City and Stronghold capture progress.

7. Golden Palace Officials Optimization: Official Positions now reset at the start of the Golden Palace battle instead of after it ends.

8. New Golden Palace Scoring Sources: Killing units, losing units, and using Training Speedups now grant additional points.

9. Warzone Outpost Improvements:
- Fixed the Outpost event duration to one week, and each repair now grants a Loot Reward.
- The starting time of the Outpost Conquest has been moved from every Friday in Week 5 onward to every Wednesday.
- Added new scoring sources for the Outpost Conquest: Killing units, losing units, and using Training Speedups.
- Reduced Outpost capture speed during battles.
- Expanded the Contaminated Land around the Outpost to cover the entire City area (after the update, Bases within Contaminated Land will auto-teleport, and players will receive an Advanced Teleporter item as compensation).
- Increased the number of squads that can attack the Outpost from 5 to 10.
- Added a new function allowing Outpost owners to send home squads from other Alliances in the same Warzone. R4 and above members of the controlling Alliance can return garrisoned squads belonging to other Alliances from the same Warzone.

10. Improved information display across various interfaces.

season_s5_city_desc_Stronghold_new:
A land where CrystalGold converges, where guardians and plunderers coexist.
During the current season, attacks on owned Banks are only permitted during 3 designated Battle-Ready Time periods (each lasting 1 hour). If the capture progress does not reach 100% within the period, the capture attempt will be considered a failure. Commanders are advised to plan their attacks in advance.
Season Tips: When the number of defending squads in a stronghold reaches 20 and remains for 7.5 minutes, the stronghold will be successfully captured.

After abandoning a Bank, the Alliance must wait 24 hours before it can capture the Bank again;
When a Bank is successfully abandoned, it will enter a protection state lasting until the next [Battle-Ready Time]. This Battle-Ready Time will avoid Truce Days and the original owning Alliance's [Safe Time]. Commanders are advised to abandon with caution.
S5_alliance_photo_help_1: Don't let the glory of the Western Continent be lost to the shifting sands—let the season's group photo capture the shining moments of your journey with your allies! Event Rules 1. The event becomes available once the Alliance Season Rewards have been distributed. 2. During the event, you can take group photos and leave messages via the event menu or inside the Season Memorial Hall. 3. After the event ends, all group photos and messages will be locked and cannot be edited, but you can still revisit them in the Season Memorial Hall. Alliance Binding 1. Commanders can only participate in the group photo and messages within the alliance they were in at the time Season Alliance Rewards were distributed. Leaving that alliance allows viewing only, with no further editing. 2. If a commander rejoins the reward-eligible alliance during the event, they may continue editing their group photo and messages. Group Photo Settings 1. Avatar Placement: Drag to adjust avatar positions. Avatars cannot overlap when placed. 2. Frame Rewards: Determined by the reward tier of the alliance within the 8 warzones during the season. activity_desc_99179:
Event Rules
1. Complete daily tasks to earn Rhythm Disks.
2. When a note falls to the hit point, tap the button to perform the note.
3. When a number appears on a note, rapidly tap the button multiple times to perform.
4. At the end of each round, rewards are calculated and granted based on your soundtrack score.
5. For the 1st to 3rd mid-session disconnects each day, the run's score will not be counted and the Rhythm Disks spent will be refunded via mail. From the 4th disconnect onward, only the lowest-tier reward will be sent via mail for each disconnect.
6. Successfully performing the final note of a soundtrack grants an additional Performance Completion Score.
7. Under the condition of Perfectly Performing All Notes, all soundtracks share the same theoretical maximum total score.
8. Warzone rankings are based on each Commander's highest single-run score. If scores are tied, the shorter completion time ranks higher.

Acknowledgements
The music used in this event, Fire of Amandine and Welcome to the Smack Down, was created by Commander "The Phantom Muse" from Warzone 940. Our sincere thanks.
To learn more about the stories behind the music, tap <link=https://wiki.lastwar.com/{0}/show/172><color=#249bc5>Go</color></link>

Dear Commander, to optimize the season experience, we will be implementing the following adjustments after maintenance:

Unlock Rewards:

1. Complete a battlefield match to receive guaranteed Reward Points (Requires Total Individual Points of at least 250,000 to earn).

season_s5_mail_desc80403:
Dear Commanders,
As the winds of sand settle and the gunfire fades across the Golden Wasteland, [Season V: Wild West] has successfully concluded and has now entered the settlement stage. Thank you for standing shoulder to shoulder with your alliance, competing for glory and order across the wasteland where CrystalGold and gunpowder collide!

Settlement Stage Changes:
1. Leaderboards locked: All season rankings are now final.
2. Alliance rewards: R5 or [Butler] can assign rewards based on the alliance reward tier.
3. Season activities close: Special season-specific game modes will gradually shut down, with data cleared or reset.
4. Combat restrictions: You can no longer declare war on cities or attack strongholds and trade posts.
5. No resource generation: Cities and strongholds will stop producing resources.
6. Purchases disabled - [Season Battle Pass] and [Season Weekly Pass] are no longer available.
7. Buff removed: The additional effects provided by Season Boost events have been removed.

After the settlement stage ends, you will see the following changes:
1. [CrystalGold] and all season-related gameplay will be disabled (including the CrystalGold Shop, Wasteland Trade, Bank, and other season modules).
2. [Coffee], [Coffee Beans], [CrystalGold], [Whiskey], and [Coffee Recipes] will be cleared and converted into Profession EXP.
3. [Protector's Field] will reset to level 1, and Protectors will not be available outside the season.
4. [Battle/Resource Tactics Cards] will be cleared and converted into Profession EXP. [Tactics Card Packs] will be converted into Profession EXP or random Core Cards based on a probability (conversion probability matches the chance of obtaining Core Cards from packs). Core Cards will not be recycled.
5. All other personal and alliance seasonal structures will be removed.
6. Alliance Loot will be cleared: Alliance leaders should distribute any remaining loot as soon as possible.
7. Cross-Warzone Base teleport during the season will no longer be allowed (except the Central Area).

What Stays the Same: Profession levels, Profession EXP, Profession EXP items, and city capture status.

Once again, thank you all for your enthusiastic participation. S5 off-season events are about to begin; meanwhile, [Alliance Exercise] and [Zombie Siege] will return after the season ends. Stay tuned!
season_s5_mail_desc80404:
Dear Commanders,
Your charge across the season and steadfast defense have once again stabilized order across this continent. Thank you for your active participation. [Season V: Wild West] has successfully concluded, and the season entrance is now closed.

Here's what's changed:
1. All season gameplay has been fully disabled (including CrystalGold-related gameplay, season map conflicts, and season module entrances).
2. All Individual and Alliance season buildings have been reset and removed (your power may drop as a result).
3. Season-specific profession skills have been reset and removed, and all consumed profession skill points have been returned.
4. Season-related tasks have been reset and removed, and official positions in the central region have been cleared.
5. Exclusive season resources and items have been removed ([Coffee], [Coffee Beans], [CrystalGold], [Whiskey], [Coffee Recipes], [Protector Units], [Protector Horns], [Battle/Resource Tactics Cards], and [Tactics Card Packs]). At the start of the next season, season-exclusive resources and items will be cleared again.
6. Protector's Field has been reset, and Protectors will not be available outside the season.
7. The season hero recruitment event has ended (any remaining Recruitment Tickets can be used in the next season).
8. The season monsters and visitors have left.
9. The Trade Post shop is now closed, and items are no longer available for purchase.
10. Commanders will no longer be able to teleport to the Central Area.

But remember, the tides of war are ever-changing, and new challenges are drawing near! Off-season events are ready to deploy, and [Alliance Exercise] and [Zombie Siege] will return. Commanders, let us prepare our forces and await the next call of the horn!

2. <color=#099b4a>Attack Count Rewards</color>: Each attack on any Boss counts toward the attack count, with a daily limit of 3 attacks.
3. <color=#099b4a>Damage Achievement Rewards</color>: Each of the two Boss's has its own achievement rewards list. The achievement rewards of the original Wanted Boss will inherit the original Wanted Boss's event data, and the data will also carry over after the event ends.
4. <color=#099b4a>Damage Ranking Rewards</color>: Rankings are based on the highest damage a player deals to either of the two Boss's and are settled daily.
5. <color=#099b4a>Boss Weakened Rewards</color>: The total of Commanders' <color=#099b4a>highest damage</color> dealt to both Boss's within the Warzone is calculated and applied to them. When a Boss's HP reaches 0, it will enter a weakened state, and treasure chests will spawn on the map.
6. When a player's highest daily damage increases, the corresponding damage value will also be additionally dealt to the Boss.

The Sandworms have been driven into a panicked retreat by your forces, and your Alliance’s reputation has spread far and wide. The Plague Marauder, having learned of your strength, is ready to face you in battle. The exercise monster has been upgraded to [Plague Marauder], with its difficulty set according to the highest-level sandworm your Alliance has previously defeated.

1. The [Plague Marauder] accumulates damage stages progress as it takes damage.
2. Each time it reaches a new damage stage, the [Plague Marauder] will summon a random number of Buffaloes. Dispatched troops can attack the Buffaloes. Defeating them deals extra damage to the [Plague Marauder] and contributes to individual damage.

activity_military_exercises_rule_s5:
[Stage Selection]
1. After the event switches, the [Plague Marauder] exercise monster difficulty will automatically unlock based on the highest-level Sandworm previously defeated by the Alliance.

2. Once the event begins, R4 or R5 must select the difficulty and challenge time for this period:
- The Alliance must have at least 20 members to start the challenge.
- If no selection is made by 21:30 server time on the last day of the event, this period will be void.

3. After the selection is completed, the event enters the [Prep Stage].

[Prep Stage]
1. All Alliance members can donate resources to earn Alliance Contribution Points and increase Damage Bonus during the Battle Stage.
2. Donations beyond the maximum still grant Alliance Contribution Points but will no longer increase the bonus effects.

[Battle Stage]
1. Manually started by R4 or R5, lasting 30 minutes.
2. Once started, the [Plague Marauder] will be summoned. Commanders can only attack it via Rally.
3. Rallies initiated by R4 or Officers gain an additional Damage Bonus.
4. After the battle ends, rewards are calculated based on total Alliance damage and individual damage.
5. By selecting "Offline Participation", your strongest squad will automatically join the rally if there is space remaining during the last 20 seconds.

[Reward Settlement]
1. Higher total Alliance damage results in better Alliance rewards and unlocks higher difficulty.
2. Higher individual damage results in better individual rewards.
3. The Commander with the highest damage grants up to 10× Alliance reward bonus to the entire Alliance.
4. After the battle, the [Plague Marauder] leaves an Exercise Treasure that all Alliance members can claim before the next exercise reset. Rewards not claimed within this time will not be reissued.

refund_policy_short_a: Refunds may be requested within 7 days from the date of purchase (refunds are not available for items that have already been used). Payments made by minors without the consent of their legal guardian may be revoked.
refund_policy_detail: Paid in-game items that have already been purchased may be eligible for a refund within 7 days from the date of purchase or payment. However, if the purchased item has been used, was obtained through gifting or event rewards, or is content that takes effect immediately upon purchase (such as Growth Fund, Weekly Pass, Monthly Pass, First Purchase Pack, Building Queue, Research Queue, and Radar Replenish), the right of withdrawal will be restricted in accordance with applicable laws and regulations. Please note in particular that after purchasing bundles containing Alliance Gifts, the Alliance Gifts will be distributed to both Alliance members and yourself. If you or any other Alliance member uses an Alliance Gift, the bundle will be considered partially used. However, even for products such as the Battle Pass, if the content has not yet been used, the right of withdrawal may still be exercised within 7 days from the date of purchase. If a minor completes a payment without the consent of their legal guardian, the minor or their legal guardian may revoke the transaction, but supporting materials proving the minor's identity must be provided. We will determine whether the payment was made by a minor based on factors such as the payment method holder and account information. If the payment tools used, such as a mobile phone number or credit card, belong to an adult, revocation may be restricted.

season_s5_update_notice_9:
Dear Commander, to further improve the season experience, we have made the following adjustments:

1. During the Settlement Week, cross-Warzone Base teleportation rules have been adjusted so that teleportations are only available between the original Warzone and the Central Area.

2. After the end of Season 5, during Alliance Duels, Base teleportations between opponents within the same Season Group will no longer consume [Advanced Teleporter] items.

3. Fixed an issue where President Declarations could not be edited while in a cross-Warzone state.

4. Fixed an issue where the Contaminated Land display at Warzone Outposts did not match the actual effective range.

5. Trade Post availability has been adjusted from once every two weeks to once per week.

6. After capturing the Golden Palace, its Diamond Mines have been adjusted so that all Commanders in the Warzone of the Alliance that captured the Golden Palace can gather them.

7. In [Wasteland Trade], the plunder filtering rule has been adjusted from filtering out only your own Alliance to filtering out the entire Warzone. After the update, the setting must be reselected and will only apply to newly triggered trains after the update.

8. Optimized the display and appointment logic of Golden Palace Officials, and added the [Warzone Outpost · Reject This Building Official] option. When enabled, Official appointments from Warzone Outposts will be automatically rejected.

9. Fixed an issue where, in Warzone Outposts, knocking back Bases and reducing the Durability of members from the same Warzone would still grant points.

10. Replaced the enemy appearances in the Challenge Stages of the [High Noon] mode.
